detail.title:
Justice Decision Observability (JDO) 
Decision Visibility in Second-Chance Employment Extending Justice Observability to Workforce Reentry Decision Environments (v2.0)
detail.abstract:
Second-chance employment has become an increasingly important component of justice reform, workforce development, and community reintegration efforts. Across the United States, governments, employers, nonprofit organizations, and philanthropic institutions have invested substantial resources in preparing justice-impacted individuals for employment through education, credentialing, coaching, placement services, policy reform, and employer engagement initiatives. Although these efforts have improved employment opportunities for many individuals, comparatively less attention has been directed toward the organizational decision environments that influence whether employment opportunities ultimately become sustained employment outcomes.

This publication extends Justice Decision Observability (JDO) beyond traditional justice-sector environments by establishing workforce reentry as a formal application domain of execution-layer governance. Rather than evaluating individual participants, employer intentions, or workforce program effectiveness alone, the paper argues that organizational decision environments including hiring authority, supervisory discretion, accommodation practices, organizational culture, escalation pathways, and institutional governance represent an important but comparatively underexamined influence on second-chance employment outcomes.

Drawing upon scholarship in workforce reentry, organizational theory, public administration, human factors, behavioral decision science, and AI governance, this publication introduces a governance perspective for understanding how organizational decisions shape employment experiences after hiring opportunities are created. The paper uses the publicly documented Schron/Jergens workforce initiative as an illustrative conceptual case to demonstrate how successful outcomes often remain more visible than the organizational governance conditions that produced them.

This publication is conceptual and doctrinal in nature. As the foundational publication of the Justice Decision Observability W-Series, the paper establishes workforce reentry as an execution-layer governance domain while providing a theoretical foundation for future scholarship and institutional application.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了司法决策可观测性（JDO）框架，将劳动力重新进入职场确立为执行层治理的正式应用领域，主张组织决策环境（而非仅个体因素）是影响"二次就业"能否转化为持续就业结果的关键但被忽视的变量。
AI.research_question: 组织决策环境如何影响司法受影响个体的二次就业结果？JDO框架如何从传统司法部门扩展到劳动力重新进入职场领域？
AI.motivation: 尽管美国在二次就业领域投入了大量资源（教育、认证、辅导、安置、政策改革和雇主参与），但较少关注影响就业机会能否最终转化为持续就业结果的组织决策环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: Justice Decision Observability (JDO)框架；执行层治理（execution-layer governance）；整合了劳动力重返职场、组织理论、公共管理、人因工程、行为决策科学和AI治理等多学科理论。
AI.method: 概念性和理论性研究，采用Schron/Jergens劳动力计划作为说明性的概念案例进行论证。
AI.findings: 组织决策环境（包括招聘权限、监督裁量权、便利化实践、组织文化、升级路径和制度治理）是影响二次就业结果的重要但被忽视的因素；成功结果往往比产生这些结果的组织治理条件更可见。
AI.theory_contributions: 将JDO框架从传统司法部门扩展到劳动力重返职场领域，确立其为正式的执行层治理应用领域，为未来学术研究和制度应用提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府、雇主、非营利组织和慈善机构在设计和改善二次就业的组织决策环境方面提供治理视角的指导。

title: Platform Dependency in Social Media: A Comparative Study of User Engagement Across Major Social Media Applications
affiliations: Quinnipiac University

detail.title: Platform Dependency in Social Media: A Comparative Study of User Engagement Across Major Social Media Applications

keywords.keywords: Social media platformsPlatform dependencyDigital technologiesUser engagementTechnology affordances

detail.abstract: Social media platforms have become deeply embedded in contemporary social, professional, and economic life, shaping how individuals communicate, consume information, build relationships, and participate in digital society. As concerns about problematic social media use and platform dependency continue to intensify, it is increasingly important to recognize that social media is not a monolithic technological phenomenon. Different platforms employ distinct technological affordances, interaction designs, and engagement mechanisms that may influence users’ susceptibility to addictive behaviors in different ways. Despite the growing societal significance of platform-mediated communication, comparative research examining the addictive potential of individual social media technologies remains limited. Addressing this gap, this study compares user addiction across eight major social media platforms: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, Snapchat, TikTok, X, and YouTube. The findings indicate significant differences among platforms, with TikTok and Snapchat emerging as the most addictive environments in the sample. At the same time, the results suggest that platform addiction is shaped by complex and heterogeneous user–technology relationships rather than uniform technological effects. By highlighting variations in addictive tendencies across social media platforms, this study contributes to broader discussions about the societal implications of digital platform design, user engagement technologies, and the role of social media in shaping contemporary patterns of technology use

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了Facebook、Instagram、LinkedIn、Reddit、Snapchat、TikTok、X和YouTube八个主要社交媒体平台上的用户成瘾差异，发现TikTok和Snapchat是样本中最具成瘾性的平台，并表明平台成瘾是由复杂的、异质性的用户-技术关系所塑造，而非统一的技术效应。
AI.research_question: 不同社交媒体平台在用户成瘾倾向方面是否存在显著差异？平台的技术可供性、交互设计和参与机制如何影响用户对不同社交媒体的成瘾易感性？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体平台已深度嵌入当代社会、职业和经济生活，人们对问题性社交媒体使用和平台依赖的担忧日益加剧。然而，社交媒体并非单一的技术现象，不同平台拥有不同的技术可供性、交互设计和参与机制。尽管平台中介传播的社会意义日益增长，但对个体社交媒体技术成瘾潜力的比较研究仍然有限，因此亟待填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于平台技术可供性理论和用户-技术关系框架，考察不同社交媒体平台的技术设计特征如何影响用户的成瘾易感性。
AI.method: 比较研究设计，对八个主要社交媒体平台（Facebook、Instagram、LinkedIn、Reddit、Snapchat、TikTok、X和YouTube）的用户成瘾水平进行跨平台比较分析。
AI.findings: 不同平台之间存在显著成瘾差异，其中TikTok和Snapchat是样本中最具成瘾性的平台。此外，平台成瘾受复杂的、异质性的用户-技术关系塑造，而非统一的技术效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究揭示了社交媒体平台并非同质化技术现象，平台成瘾由异质性的用户-技术关系塑造，挑战了将社交媒体视为统一技术效应进行研究的传统视角，丰富了数字平台设计与用户行为关系的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果有助于理解数字平台设计的 societal 影响，为政策制定者、平台设计者和用户提供关于不同社交媒体成瘾风险的差异化认识，促进关于用户参与技术和健康技术使用模式的讨论。

title:
TEMPO: A Chunk-Level Workload Memoization Architecture for Thermal and Reversible-Computation Reuse in AI Compute Clusters 
A Position Paper and Design Proposal

detail.title:
TEMPO: A Chunk-Level Workload Memoization Architecture for Thermal and Reversible-Computation Reuse in AI Compute Clusters 
A Position Paper and Design Proposal

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a systems architecture design proposal; it involves no human participants, patients, animal subjects, or case studies requiring ethics approval or consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author, with no external funding, grants, or institutional sponsorship.

detail.abstract: Thermal management in AI compute clusters is dominated by two established but largely separate research traditions: predictive, telemetry-driven scheduling that reacts to or forecasts heat from live workload signals, and materials-level bio-inspired cooling actuators. This paper does not propose a new physical cooling mechanism or a new control-theoretic technique in isolation; both are already well developed in the literature reviewed in Section 3. Instead, it proposes a narrower architectural component, termed TEMPO (Thermal-Evidence Memoized Path Orchestration), which applies content-defined chunking and deduplication-a mature storage-engineering technique-to index and reuse thermal behavior profiles and, where structurally applicable, reversible-computation ("uncompute") paths for recurring sub-structures of AI compute graphs. The central premise is that a substantial share of production AI compute recurs at the sub-graph level even when whole jobs differ, and that this recurrence is not currently exploited by either the predictive-scheduling or the reversible-computing literature. This paper positions the proposal relative to prior art across five adjacent fields, states explicitly what it does not claim, and proposes a minimal empirical validation plan. No prototype, simulation, or professional patent-clearance search has been conducted; this is a design proposal offered for review, critique, and replication, not a report of results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TEMPO（热证据记忆化路径编排）架构组件，将存储工程中的内容定义分块和去重技术应用于AI计算图的子结构热行为管理，通过索引和复用热行为配置文件及可逆计算路径，来弥补预测性调度和可逆计算两大研究传统在子图级热复用方面的空白。本文是一份设计提案，尚无原型或实验结果。
AI.research_question: 如何利用AI计算图中子结构级别的重复性，通过内容定义分块和去重技术来索引和复用热行为配置文件与可逆计算路径，以改进AI计算集群的热管理？
AI.motivation: AI计算集群的热管理长期被两个独立的研究传统主导（预测性遥测调度和材料级仿生冷却执行器），但两者都未利用生产AI计算在子图层面的大量重复性——即使整个作业不同，子结构仍会反复出现。这种重复性既未被预测性调度文献利用，也未被可逆计算文献利用，形成研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内容定义分块与去重（存储工程）、可逆计算（uncompute路径）、热行为配置文件索引与复用、AI计算图子结构分析
AI.method: 设计提案方法：提出TEMPO组件，将内容定义分块和去重技术应用于AI计算图的子结构热管理，并规划了最简实证验证方案；尚未进行原型构建、仿真或专利清查。
AI.findings: 本文无实证结果，核心主张是：生产AI计算在子图层面存在大量重复，这一重复可通过成熟的内容定义分块和去重技术加以利用；并明确定位了与五个相邻领域的关系及其不声称的内容。
AI.theory_contributions: 将存储工程中的内容定义分块与去重方法引入AI计算热管理领域，弥合预测性调度与可逆计算两大研究传统之间的空白，提出子图级热行为复用这一新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了TEMPO作为可审查、可复制、供评审和批评的设计提案，为AI计算集群热管理提供了新的架构组件方向，并规划了最小化实证验证路径。

title: Store, Material Management, Inventory & Warehouse Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)

detail.title: Store, Material Management, Inventory & Warehouse Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)
detail.abstract:
The efficient management of stores, materials, inventory, and warehousing is the
backbone of every manufacturing, trading, service, and project-oriented organization. In
today's competitive business environment, cost leadership, timely delivery, and financial
integrity depend on how effectively these functions are planned, executed, controlled, and
audited.
This handbook has been written as a practical, hands-on Standard Operating Procedures
(SOP) manual for professionals working at the level of Manager, Senior Manager, Assistant
General Manager (AGM), Deputy General Manager (DGM), and General Manager (GM). It
also addresses the cross-functional interfaces with Accounts, Finance, Tax, Audit,
Procurement, Production, Quality, Logistics, HR, IT, and Compliance departments.
The content draws on years of professional experience in accounts, finance, taxation, and
audit, and combines that perspective with modern warehousing, ERP-driven inventory
control, and lean supply-chain principles. Every chapter has been designed so that a reader can lift a procedure and implement it in a real organization with minimum adaptation.

AI.tldr: 这是一本面向制造业、贸易、服务和项目型组织的标准化操作程序（SOP）实务手册，旨在帮助中高层管理者高效管理门店、物料、库存和仓储，涵盖与财务、税务、审计、采购、生产、质量、物流、人力资源、IT和合规等跨职能部门的接口协作。
AI.research_question: 如何通过标准化操作程序（SOP）手册，帮助组织中高层管理者有效规划、执行、控制和审计门店管理、物料管理、库存管理和仓储管理，以实现成本领先、准时交付和财务完整性？
AI.motivation: 在当前竞争激烈的商业环境中，门店、物料、库存和仓储的高效管理是各类组织（制造、贸易、服务、项目型）的运营支柱，直接影响成本领先、及时交付和财务诚信。现有文献缺乏一本兼具实务操作性和跨部门接口视角的标准化操作手册。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于现代仓储管理理论、ERP驱动的库存控制理论以及精益供应链管理原则，结合多年的会计、财务、税务和审计实务经验。
AI.method: 基于作者多年在会计、财务、税务和审计领域的专业实践经验，撰写的实践导向型标准化操作程序（SOP）手册。
AI.findings: 本手册每个章节均设计为可被读者直接提取并在实际组织中实施，所需适应性修改最小化，为经理、高级经理、助理总经理、副总经理和总经理等各级管理人员提供即用型操作指引。
AI.theory_contributions: 将现代仓储管理、ERP库存控制与精益供应链原则融合到统一的标准化操作框架中，为管理学文献提供了实务导向的操作程序体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为门店、物料、库存和仓储管理者提供了一本即取即用的SOP实务手册，覆盖与会计、财务、税务、审计、采购、生产、质量、物流、人力资源、IT和合规等跨职能部门的协作接口，帮助组织实现成本领先、准时交付和财务完整性。

title: You Cannot Read the Value of a Token Off Your Own Logs: Why Cost per Outcome Is a Confounded Number in Agentic AI

detail.title: You Cannot Read the Value of a Token Off Your Own Logs: Why Cost per Outcome Is a Confounded Number in Agentic AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed by IBM. The views expressed are the author's own and do not represent the positions of IBM. This paper reflects the author's independent professional analysis; it was not commissioned, funded, or reviewed by IBM, and no confidential or client information informed it.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Enterprise AI has reached a genuine consensus: the token is the bill, not the value, and "cost per accepted outcome" is the metric that should replace raw token counting. This paper accepts that consensus and identifies the error inside it. In any agentic system that routes hard cases to expensive models and easy cases to cheap ones — that is, any system worth building — cost per outcome is a confounded ratio that cannot be read off production logs. Because a competent router assigns the difficult, failure-prone cases to the frontier tier, expensive routes show worse cost per outcome in the data, and the naive comparison concludes the frontier model is inefficient. That conclusion is backwards: the metric reflects the routing policy, not model performance. Computed naively, it recommends sending hard cases to the cheap model that will fail them — in a regulated setting, manufacturing wrongful denials and compliance failures with a spreadsheet that reports savings. The paper separates the five distinct objects that "cost" conflates, shows why the useful ones are unobservable, and argues that measuring agentic economics honestly is a problem of causal identification — requiring logged routing propensities, shadow or randomized routes, and counterfactual estimation — not of better dashboards. Written from regulated financial-services deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑企业AI领域中"每成功结果成本"这一核心指标。在智能路由系统中，该指标被路由策略污染：困难案例被分配给昂贵模型，导致昂贵模型在数据上显示更差的成本表现，但这反映的是路由策略而非模型性能。本文主张衡量智能体经济性本质上是因果识别问题，需要记录路由倾向、影子路径或随机化路由以及反事实估计，而非更好的仪表盘。
AI.research_question: 在采用分层路由的企业智能体系统中，"每成功结果成本"这一指标为何是混杂的比率，以及如何正确衡量智能体的经济价值？
AI.motivation: "成本每成功结果"已成为企业AI的共识性指标，但在智能路由系统中，该指标被路由策略混淆：困难案例被路由到昂贵模型，导致昂贵模型显示出更差的成本表现，从而产生误导性结论（如建议将困难案例交给会失败的廉价模型），尤其是在受监管场景下会引发错误拒赔和合规失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果识别理论、混杂因素理论、路由策略与模型性能的分离框架
AI.method: 概念分析/理论论证：识别"成本"所混淆的五个不同对象，论证其中有用对象为何不可观测，提出需要进行因果识别（记录路由倾向、影子/随机路由、反事实估计）。基于受监管金融服务部署场景写作。
AI.findings: 1. 每成功结果成本在智能路由系统中是混杂比率，无法直接从生产日志读取；2. 昂贵路由显示更差的每成功结果成本，反映的是路由策略而非模型性能；3. 朴素的比较会错误建议将困难案例交给会失败的廉价模型；4. 衡量智能体经济性需要因果识别方法而非更好的仪表盘。
AI.theory_contributions: 将因果识别框架引入智能体经济性衡量，识别并分离"成本"所混淆的五种对象，论证该指标的可观测性与混杂问题，为智能体经济学提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管的金融服务等企业AI部署提供方法论指引：需要记录路由倾向、采用影子或随机化路由、进行反事实估计，以避免因错误指标导致错误拒赔与合规失败。

title: Constitutional Compression: The Emergence of Minimal Governance at Machine Speed

detail.title: Constitutional Compression: The Emergence of Minimal Governance at Machine Speed

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the originator of the architectural concepts discussed in this manuscript and has an intellectual interest in their development and dissemination. No external organization funded, directed, or influenced the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This manuscript is a theoretical and architectural analysis and does not involve human participants, animal subjects, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently conceived, conducted, and funded by the author. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract: Autonomous systems are increasingly authorized to make and execute consequential decisions at machine speed. Existing governance approaches emphasize policy, oversight, explainability, and post-hoc accountability but provide little insight into the minimal runtime functions required before execution may safely occur. This paper derives a constitutional kernel for machine-speed governance from first principles. Beginning with the requirements of admissibility rather than implementation, the analysis identifies a minimal set of governance primitives that must exist whenever execution authority is delegated to autonomous systems. The resulting model is independent of specific technologies, vendors, or regulatory frameworks and demonstrates that governance converges toward a small executable constitutional core as execution latency approaches real-time. The paper argues that governance is fundamentally a runtime property rather than a documentation exercise, providing a theoretical foundation for future architectures supporting autonomous execution.

AI.tldr: 本文从第一性原理出发，为机器速度治理推导出一个"宪法内核"（constitutional kernel），识别出在将执行权委托给自主系统时需要存在的最小组治理原语。该模型独立于特定技术、供应商或监管框架，并论证当执行延迟趋近实时时，治理会收敛为一个小的可执行宪法核心。论文主张治理本质上是一种运行时属性（runtime property），而非文档编制工作。
AI.research_question: 在执行权被委托给自主系统时，在安全执行之前必须存在哪些最小的运行时治理功能？
AI.motivation: 现有治理方法侧重于政策、监督、可解释性和事后问责，但对执行前所需的最小运行时功能缺乏洞察。随着自主系统被授权以机器速度做出和执行重大决策，需要一种从第一性原理出发的治理框架来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 从可接受性（admissibility）而非实施（implementation）的要求出发，推导治理原语的宪法内核；治理收敛理论——当执行延迟趋近实时时，治理功能收敛为最小可执行核心。
AI.method: 理论推导/分析性研究：从第一性原理出发，通过逻辑演绎识别自主系统执行授权所需的最小治理原语集，不依赖特定技术或监管框架。
AI.findings: 治理可以收敛为一个小的可执行宪法核心，该核心独立于具体技术、供应商和监管框架。治理本质上是一种运行时属性，而非文档编制工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 为机器速度治理提供了理论基础；将治理从"文档练习"重新概念化为"运行时属性"；建立了技术无关的治理模型框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来支持自主执行架构提供理论基础；帮助设计者在构建自主系统时明确需要内置的最小运行时治理功能；指导政策和监管框架的制定。
