Formal ethics committee approval was therefore not required, and no participant consent was applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for conducting this study or for the preparation of this manuscript.

detail.abstract: Scholarship on generative artificial intelligence (AI) in higher education has concentrated on studentfacing applications and prominent corporate services functions, with limited attention to AIaugmented professional work in specialised compliance domains. This paper addresses that gap through an analytic autoethnography of a report governance system developed for multijurisdictional government compliance reporting at an Australian public university. Drawing on a documentary audit trail, the analysis maps five dimensions of the System across three analytical layers: the inherited reporting context, the AI capabilities deployed and the governance design developed. The paper is grounded in organisational knowledge codification, boundary objects, infrastructure and articulation work. The case shows how the requirements of AI-augmented work prompted tacit institutional knowledge to be articulated, structured and verified in explicit governance artefacts. It identifies partial AI-mediated externalisation as the central theoretical contribution and presents the two-surface AI workflow and AI model-agnostic design as potentially transferable design logics. The analysis also demonstrates how conventional outputs obscure the sophisticated design work supporting them, with implications for institutional recognition, professional development, system ownership and maintenance. The findings are bounded by a single-practitioner, single-institution case, with successor operation and accountability infrastructure identified as priorities for further inquiry.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析性自我民族志方法，研究了一个为澳大利亚公立大学多法域政府合规报告开发的报告治理系统，考察AI增强的专业工作在专门合规领域中的应用，提出了"部分AI中介外部化"作为核心理论贡献。
AI.research_question: AI增强的专业工作如何在专门合规领域（特别是多法域政府合规报告）中被设计、实施和治理？
AI.motivation: 现有高等教育中生成式AI的研究主要集中在学生端应用和企业服务功能，对AI增强的专业工作在专门合规领域的关注不足，存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织知识编码化、边界对象、基础设施、衔接工作（articulation work）
AI.method: 分析性自我民族志（analytic autoethnography），基于文档审计追踪，从三个分析层面（继承的报告情境、部署的AI能力、发展的治理设计）和五个维度进行映射分析。
AI.findings: AI增强工作的需求促使隐性制度知识被表达、结构化并在显性治理工件中得到验证；提出了"部分AI中介外部化"作为核心理论贡献；识别出"双面AI工作流"和"AI模型无关设计"作为可转移的设计逻辑；传统产出掩盖了支撑其的复杂设计工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"部分AI中介外部化"理论概念，丰富了组织知识编码化理论在AI增强工作情境下的理解；揭示了AI增强工作与隐性知识显性化之间的动态关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构认可、专业发展、系统所有权和维护提供实践启示；提出"双面AI工作流"和"AI模型无关设计"作为可转移的设计逻辑，可供类似合规报告环境借鉴。

title: The Prompt Tax: Why AI Companies Profit From Your Bad Prompts -and Who Will Fix them Instead

detail.title: The Prompt Tax: Why AI Companies Profit From Your Bad Prompts -and Who Will Fix them Instead
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are priced per token, which creates a structural tension: the vendors that sell intelligence are also compensated for every unit of inefficiency in how that intelligence is consumed. This paper argues that this incentive structure will prevent frontier model providers from fully closing the gap between how users prompt and how models could be prompted, and that this gap will instead be filled-within roughly two to three years-by an independent commercial layer of prompt-optimization and orchestration software. The paper develops three claims. First, an incentive-misalignment hypothesis: token-metered providers will ship efficiency features only at the margin, because complete optimization would compress their own revenue per task. Second, a market-structure prediction: the gap will be captured by multiagent "package products" that route work across specialized models and compile user intent into machine-optimized prompts, removing the human from the prompt-engineering loop. Third, an economic consequence: as access to optimized inference becomes a paid differentiator, tokens begin to function as a productivity currency, creating a stratified market in which paying more does not merely buy more output but a higher fraction of the model's attainable capability. The paper situates these claims against existing evidence-automated prompt engineering research, firstparty optimization tools, and early orchestration products-and identifies the observable milestones that would confirm or falsify the prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了大语言模型按token计费的商业模式会产生激励错位：模型供应商不愿完全优化用户的提示词（因为这会压缩其收入），因此这一优化缺口将在2-3年内由独立的提示优化与编排软件层填补。文章提出三个核心论断：激励错位假说、多智能体"打包产品"将主导市场的预测，以及token将演变为"生产力货币"导致市场分层化的经济后果。
AI.research_question: LLM按token计价的激励结构如何影响提示优化市场的形成与发展？谁将填补用户提示方式与模型最佳提示方式之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 大语言模型按token定价造成了结构性矛盾：出售智能的供应商同时也从智能消费的低效中获得补偿，因此模型供应商缺乏动力去完全优化用户的提示方式。这一激励错位将催生独立的商业优化层，但现有文献尚未系统分析这一市场结构的演化路径与经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于激励错位假说（incentive-misalignment hypothesis）、市场结构预测（market-structure prediction）和经济后果分析（economic consequence）三个理论框架展开论证。
AI.method: 本文为理论论证与预测性分析论文，采用演绎推理方法，将三个核心论断与现有证据（自动化提示工程研究、第一方优化工具、早期编排产品）进行对照，并识别了可验证或证伪预测的经验里程碑。
AI.findings: 三个核心发现：（1）token计费的模型供应商只会在边际上提供效率功能，因为完全优化会压缩其每次任务的收入；（2）优化缺口将由跨专业模型路由工作、将用户意图编译为机器优化提示的多智能体"打包产品"填补；（3）优化推理的获取成为付费差异化因素后，token成为"生产力货币"，形成分层市场——付费更多不仅购买更多产出，还购买模型可达能力的更高比例。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次系统揭示了LLM定价机制与模型能力利用之间的结构性矛盾，提出了"激励错位假说"这一分析框架，并预测了一个全新的中间市场层（提示优化与编排软件层）的兴起，为理解AI产业价值链演化提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者指明了提示优化与编排软件的市场机会窗口（约2-3年）；为模型供应商提示了定价策略的潜在风险；为企业和用户提供了关于token成本与模型能力获取效率之间关系的市场认知。

title: Beyond Disinformation: Disinformation as a Complex Adaptive Information Ecosystem A State-Based Modeling Framework

detail.title: Beyond Disinformation: Disinformation as a Complex Adaptive Information Ecosystem A State-Based Modeling Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or other conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical concept paper and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental procedures requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Research on disinformation has so far focused primarily on individual false claims, narratives, and actors. Consequently, most research approaches seek to identify, classify, and counter misleading content through fact-checking, content moderation, or information campaigns. This concept paper proposes an alternative modeling perspective. Rather than treating disinformation primarily as a collection of isolated falsehoods, it suggests modeling it as a Complex Adaptive Information Ecosystem. From this perspective, individual false claims represent observable system states within a dynamic adaptive system rather than the system itself. Measures such as fact-checking remain valuable but function primarily as local interventions. The overall dynamics emerge from recursive interactions among social actors, digital platforms, algorithmic selection mechanisms, institutional frameworks, and the cognitive states of participating individuals. This paper does not propose a new theory of disinformation or complexity. Instead, it introduces an alternative modeling framework that complements existing approaches through a systems-theoretical perspective while providing a common theoretical foundation for the previous contributions of the Beyond Disinformation research programme.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将虚假信息从"孤立虚假声称的集合"重新建模为"复杂适应性信息生态系统"的概念框架，认为个体虚假声明只是动态系统中的可观察状态，事实核查等措施属于局部干预，系统整体动态源于社会行动者、数字平台、算法选择机制、制度框架和个体认知状态之间的递归互动。
AI.research_question: 如何从系统性视角重新建模虚假信息，以弥补现有研究仅关注个体虚假声称、叙事和行动者的局限性？
AI.motivation: 现有虚假信息研究主要聚焦于个体虚假声称、叙事和行动者，采取事实核查、内容审核或信息宣传等手段来识别、分类和抵制误导性内容，但缺乏对整体系统动态的把握。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂适应性信息系统理论（Complex Adaptive Information Ecosystem），系统论视角
AI.method: 概念性论文，提出替代性建模框架，不提出新理论，而是整合系统论视角为现有方法提供共同理论基础。
AI.findings: 虚假信息应被建模为复杂适应性信息生态系统，个体虚假声称是系统状态而非系统本身；事实核查等措施是有价值的局部干预；系统动态源于社会行动者、数字平台、算法选择机制、制度框架与个体认知状态之间的递归互动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个替代现有方法的系统论建模框架，为虚假信息研究补充了系统层面的理论视角，并为Beyond Disinformation研究计划提供了共同的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为事实核查、内容审核等信息干预措施提供了在系统语境中的定位与理解，帮助政策制定者和实践者认识到局部干预在复杂系统中的角色与局限。

title: When LLM Agents Negotiate: Private Information and Dynamic Bargaining in Supply Chains
affiliations: University of Connecticut - School of Business and University of Connecticut - Department of Operations & Information Management

detail.title: When LLM Agents Negotiate: Private Information and Dynamic Bargaining in Supply Chains
detail.abstract: As LLM agents enter autonomous procurement, we examine whether they create value, divide it predictably, and avoid loss-making contracts. We benchmark 9,840 LLM-to-LLM negotiations involving nine models from OpenAI, Google, and Alibaba against a validated Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium in dynamic supply chain bargaining with private buyer information. In the main self-play experiment, capability governs value creation and reliability. Agents agree in 98.9% of negotiations and capture 95.4% of first-best surplus in undiscounted terms, but average 2.98 rounds against the benchmark’s 1.25; depending on patience, discounting reduces realized surplus by 21–34% of first-best. Baseline models accept individually irrational contracts in 19.2%of completed agreements, versus 0.0–0.6% for mid-tier and flagship models. Second, surplus capture is relational. Among tested models, provider identity predicts who captures surplus more reliably than capability rank. Under common prompts, self-play buyer shares average 40% for OpenAI, 50% for Google, and 70%for Alibaba’s Qwen; reversing which provider sells shifts surplus division by 7–18 percentage points, comparable to a within-family capability reversal. Third, configuration matters. Restricting communication shifts surplus in provider-specific directions; removing the discounting framework preserves the main regularities but lengthens bargaining. Delegation separates economic patience, the principal’s real delay cost, from the agent’s prompted strategic patience; the prompted value with the highest observed mean payoff varies by role, model, and economic patience. Together, the results provide an equilibrium-referenced audit of strategic AI agents along discounted efficiency, distributional profile, and operational reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文对LLM智能体在自主采购谈判中的表现进行了基准审计，通过9840场LLM对LLM谈判实验，对比了九个模型（来自OpenAI、Google和Alibaba）与完美贝叶斯均衡的理论基准。研究发现：能力决定价值创造和可靠性（98.9%达成协议，捕获95.4%的最优剩余）；剩余分配具有关系性（供应商身份比能力排名更能预测剩余分配）；配置方式（通信限制、折扣框架、委派机制）显著影响谈判结果。文章提供了对战略AI智能体在折扣效率、分配特征和操作可靠性方面的均衡参照审计。
AI.research_question: LLM智能体在自主采购谈判中是否能创造价值、是否能可预测地分配价值、以及是否避免亏损合同？
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体进入自主采购领域，需要评估这些AI代理在真实经济谈判中的表现，特别是它们相对于理论最优均衡的偏差，以及供应商身份、模型能力和配置选择如何影响价值创造与分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态供应链讨价还价模型中的完美贝叶斯均衡（PBE），该模型包含买方私人信息，用于衡量LLM智能体的谈判效率与分配公平性。
AI.method: 大规模基准实验：9840场LLM对LLM谈判，涵盖OpenAI、Google和Alibaba的九个模型；在自博弈实验中对代理行为与理论PBE基准进行量化比较；系统性地操纵供应商身份、通信限制、折扣框架和委派机制以识别影响因素。
AI.findings: （1）能力主导价值创造：98.9%谈判达成协议，捕获95.4%最优剩余（未折现），但平均需2.98轮（基准为1.25轮），折现使实际剩余损失21-34%；基线模型有19.2%接受非理性合同，而中高端模型仅0.0-0.6%。（2）剩余分配具有关系性：供应商身份比能力排名更能预测剩余分配（OpenAI买方40%、Google 50%、Qwen 70%），供应商身份转换造成7-18个百分点的分配偏移。（3）配置影响结果：通信限制产生供应商特定的分配偏移；折扣框架移除后主要规律保持但谈判延长；委派机制将经济耐心与策略性耐心分离，最优期望收益提示值因角色、模型和经济耐心而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提供了一种以均衡为参照的AI代理审计方法论，建立了LLM代理谈判行为与理论均衡之间的系统性比较框架，揭示了AI代理在实际谈判中偏离理性均衡的系统性模式（包括供应商身份效应和配置效应），拓展了将博弈论均衡作为AI系统行为基准的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业选择LLM代理进行自主采购提供实证指导：不同模型供应商在剩余分配上存在系统性差异，配置选择（通信限制、折扣框架、委派方式）可显著影响谈判结果；同时警示基线模型存在接受亏损合同的高风险（19.2%），需要谨慎选择模型等级。

title: AI-Augmented Business Operations An Integrated Decision Intelligence Framework for Business Analytics, GTM Engineering, and CRM Automation

detail.title: AI-Augmented Business Operations An Integrated Decision Intelligence Framework for Business Analytics, GTM Engineering, and CRM Automation
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence has moved from an experimental technology to a mainstream operating requirement across enterprises, yet most organizations still struggle to convert AI adoption into measurable business value. This paper synthesizes current industry and analyst research on artificial intelligence in business analytics, go-to-market (GTM) engineering, customer relationship management (CRM) automation, and business process automation, and proposes an integrated conceptual framework referred to here as the Decision Intelligence Stack. The paper also introduces the AI Operating Maturity Model, a four-stage practitioner tool for assessing how deeply an organization has embedded AI into its decision-making processes. Drawing on secondary industry research together with the author's professional experience building CRM systems, GTM workflows, and a consumer wellness application, the paper argues that sustainable AI value depends less on which tools an organization buys and more on how deliberately it integrates data, analytics, automation, and decision governance. The paper closes with practical implications for business analysts, GTM and RevOps teams, market researchers, and export-oriented small and medium enterprises (SMEs). This is a conceptual and analytical synthesis grounded in secondary research and practitioner experience; it does not report an original empirical study, and its proposed framework is offered as a practical starting point for further testing rather than a statistically validated model.

AI.tldr: 本文综合行业与分析机构研究，提出"决策智能栈"（Decision Intelligence Stack）整合框架，并引入四阶段"AI运营成熟度模型"（AI Operating Maturity Model），用于评估组织将AI嵌入决策流程的深度。论文认为可持续的AI价值更多取决于如何有意地整合数据、分析、自动化和决策治理，而非购买何种工具。
AI.research_question: 组织如何将AI采用转化为可衡量的商业价值？可持续AI价值的决定性因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI已从实验技术转变为企业主流运营需求，但大多数组织仍难以将AI采用转化为可衡量的商业价值，缺乏系统的整合框架来指导AI在决策流程中的嵌入。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策智能栈（Decision Intelligence Stack）整合框架；AI运营成熟度模型（四阶段）
AI.method: 基于二手行业研究和作者实践经验的概念性分析综合方法，涉及CRM系统构建、GTM工作流和消费品健康应用等领域。
AI.findings: 可持续AI价值取决于组织如何有意地整合数据、分析、自动化和决策治理，而非购买何种AI工具；AI嵌入决策流程的深度（成熟度）是价值创造的关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出决策智能栈整合框架和四阶段AI运营成熟度模型，为理解和评估组织AI嵌入深度提供了概念性工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为业务分析师、GTM和RevOps团队、市场研究人员以及出口导向型中小企业提供实践指导；形成可操作的AI成熟度评估工具。

title:
Inventory Accounting & Material Management 

Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) — A Cross-Functional Guide for Finance & Accounts departments

detail.title:
Inventory Accounting & Material Management 

Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) — A Cross-Functional Guide for Finance & Accounts departments
detail.abstract:
Inventory is often the single largest asset on a manufacturing or trading company's balance sheet, and material cost is typically the largest component of Cost of Goods Sold (COGS). Yet in practice, inventory management fails not because of a single department's shortcoming, but because of weak coordination across Finance & Accounts, Procurement, Stores, Production, Quality, Sales, and Internal Audit.
This book bridges that gap. It presents inventory accounting and material management as an integrated, cross-functional discipline — anchored in the finance and accounts department, but touching every operational unit. Each chapter combines the why (accounting theory, statutory compliance) with the how (step-by-step SOPs, control checkpoints, documentation, KPIs).
The SOPs presented here have been shaped by years of hands-on experience in accounts, finance, tax and audit. They are designed to be practical, adaptable, and audit-ready — usable by small trading firms as much as by large manufacturing houses.

AI.tldr: 本书将存货会计与物料管理视为一个跨职能部门的综合学科，以财务与会计部门为核心，覆盖采购、仓储、生产、质检、销售和内部审计等所有运营单元，提供结合会计理论与法定合规的实用SOP、控制点、文档和KPI。
AI.research_question: 如何将存货会计与物料管理整合为一个跨职能学科，以解决企业库存管理中因部门间协调不足而导致的失败问题？
AI.motivation: 存货通常是制造或贸易企业资产负债表上最大的资产，材料成本是销售成本的最大组成部分；但库存管理失败往往源于财务与会计、采购、仓储、生产、质检、销售和内部审计等部门之间协调薄弱，而非单一部门的缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 存货会计理论、法定合规要求、跨职能整合管理框架
AI.method: 基于多年会计、财务、税务和审计实务经验，提出逐步操作程序（SOPs）、控制检查点、文档和KPI，设计为可实际应用、可适应且经得起审计检验的方法。
AI.findings: 该书提供了一套跨部门整合的存货管理与会计实务框架，适用于从小型贸易公司到大型制造企业的各类组织，兼顾理论解释与实际操作指导。
AI.theory_contributions: 将存货会计与物料管理从孤立的部门职能提升为以财务与会计部门为锚点的跨职能综合学科，将会计理论与法定合规与实际SOP相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可落地、可适应、经得起审计的SOP、控制检查点、文档和KPI，帮助企业在财务与会计、采购、仓储、生产、质检、销售和内部审计之间建立有效协调机制。

title: The Changing Landscape of Public Service Delivery in India: Key Insights from SAMPANN in Pension Disbursement
affiliations: Government of India - Department of Telecommunications,  and Government of India - Department of Telecommunications

detail.title: The Changing Landscape of Public Service Delivery in India: Key Insights from SAMPANN in Pension Disbursement
detail.abstract: Public Service Delivery (PSD) is a fundamental unit of nation-building. It serves as a critical interface between the government and the citizenry, reinforcing democratic values and public trust. The paper begins with a brief journey of PSD in India, from traditional administrative mechanisms to the contemporary, citizen-centric, and technology-enabled frameworks. It then presents a comprehensive multi-model descriptive analysis of the System for Accounting and Management of Pension (SAMPANN), an initiative of the Department of Telecommunications (DoT). SAMPANN is evaluated through four prominent complementary theoretical models of PSD: the Sevottam Model, New Public Management (NPM) and Service (NPS) Models, and Al-Ghazali's Checklist. The analysis highlights SAMPANN's convergence with the service standards and grievance redressal components of the Sevottam Model, NPM's efficient and cost-effective components, NPS's emphasis on citizen engagement and democratic participation, and Al-Ghazali's equity, accountability, and rights-based delivery. Through the multi-theoretical lens, rather than basing the evaluation on any one, SAMPANN's benefits for pensioners and the government are highlighted, demonstrating a transparent, responsive, and efficient digital pension management system. The paper concludes by reflecting on the role of digital public infrastructure in strengthening India's PSD and the need for further research on pension management systems of India.

AI.tldr: 本文对印度电信部（DoT）推出的养老金会计与管理系统（SAMPANN）进行了多理论模型综合分析，通过Sevottam模型、新公共管理（NPM）、新公共服务（NPS）和Al-Ghazali检查清单四个互补的理论框架，评估了该数字养老金管理系统在服务标准、申诉处理、效率、公民参与、公平问责等方面的表现，展示了其对养老金领取者和政府的双重益处。
AI.research_question: SAMPANN作为印度数字养老金管理系统，如何通过多种公共服务的理论模型来评估其绩效？它是否实现了透明、响应性和高效的公共服务交付？
AI.motivation: 公共服务交付（PSD）是国家建设的基本单元，是政府与公民之间的关键界面。随着印度公共服务从传统行政机制向以公民为中心的技术赋能框架转型，需要采用多种理论模型而非单一模型来全面评估数字公共服务系统的有效性，以弥补单一理论视角的局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究采用四个互补的公共服务交付理论模型：Sevottam模型（强调服务标准和申诉处理）、新公共管理（NPM）模型（强调效率和成本效益）、新公共服务（NPS）模型（强调公民参与和民主参与）以及Al-Ghazali检查清单（强调公平、问责和基于权利的服务交付）。
AI.method: 本文采用多模型描述性分析方法（multi-model descriptive analysis），对印度电信部开发的SAMPANN系统进行案例研究，运用四个理论框架分别评估其各维度表现，并进行综合比较分析。
AI.findings: SAMPANN系统与Sevottam模型的服务标准和申诉处理组件相契合，体现了NPM的高效和成本效益特点，展现了NPS对公民参与和民主参与的重视，并符合Al-Ghazali的公平、问责和基于权利的交付原则。通过多理论视角的综合评估，SAMPANN被证明是一个透明、响应性和高效的数字养老金管理系统，对养老金领取者和政府均有显著益处。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究提出了多理论透镜（multi-theoretical lens）的分析框架，突破了过去仅依赖单一公共服务理论模型评估的局限，展示了不同理论互补整合在数字公共服务评估中的价值，丰富了公共服务交付理论在数字政府背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 本研究为印度及其他发展中国家评估和改进数字公共服务系统提供了实践参考框架；证实了SAMPANN作为数字公共基础设施在加强印度公共服务交付中的作用；为数字养老金管理系统的进一步研究指明了方向，并为政策制定者提供了多维度评估工具的借鉴。

title: The Triple Demotion of the Nuclear Shell: The Shell Model, the Liquid Drop Model, and the Independent-Particle-Motion Axiom——Derivational Demotion Based on 2D Ising Exact Solution Calibration, Continuous Sphericity Weight Recovery, and the QCTI Index

detail.title: The Triple Demotion of the Nuclear Shell: The Shell Model, the Liquid Drop Model, and the Independent-Particle-Motion Axiom——Derivational Demotion Based on 2D Ising Exact Solution Calibration, Continuous Sphericity Weight Recovery, and the QCTI Index
detail.abstract:
The central axiom of the nuclear shell model—independent particle motion in a static mean field—has magic numbers as its corollary and the shell correction as its supplement. The liquid drop model has likewise achieved enormous success. For nine decades, the conceptual tension between these two frameworks has never been systematically resolved. Drawing on Tang (2026v, 2026w), this paper integrates five lines of evidence and completes a unified argument for a triple demotion of the nuclear shell: the shell model, the liquid drop model, and the independent-particle-motion axiom are each shown to be projections of a quantum-classical hybrid in specific limits.

Tier 1—2D Ising exact-solution calibration: Taking Tc as a fixed breakpoint, the intercept/slope ratio across five temperature intervals decreases monotonically from 875.75 in the deep ferromagnetic region to 2.67 near Tc (Spearman ρ = 1.0000), establishing the ratio as a rigorous physical metric of distance from the phase-transition critical point. It exhibits strict negative correlation with |dM/dT| (ρ = −1.0000) and with the mean-field error ε_MF (ρ = −1.0000). The nuclear-physics interpretation is independently anchored by the strong negative correlation with the shell-correction energy ΔR² (ρ = −0.87).

Tier 2—Quantum-classical hybrid empirical basis: The Quantum-Classical Transition Index (QCTI) decreases monotonically from +0.94 in the light-nucleus region to −0.81 in the heavy-nucleus region (ρ = −0.95). A simplified QCTI using only ΔR² yields ρ = −0.93. The double-track intersection N≈70.8 divides the N-axis into quantum-dominated and classical-dominated regions. The mid-shell region (N=50–100) is the common silence zone of all activation operators—Chow F drops to 6.8, only 1/15 of the light-nucleus region. The binary magic-number marker decays 132-fold across the N-axis (ρ = −0.57), while ΔR² peaks in the mid-shell region.

Tier 3—First demotion: the shell model. A continuous sphericity weight function based on distances to magic numbers is constructed. Weighted least squares shows that the Chow F of the five traditional magic numbers is amplified by a factor of 3.68–9.68; the amplification exceeds 1.5 for σ = 2.0–5.0, demonstrating that the shell model is the projection of the regime-switch network in the spherical-symmetry limit.

Tier 4—Second demotion: the liquid drop model. The QCTI tends to −0.81 in the heavy-nucleus region, the strict monotonic relationship between the intercept/slope ratio and ε_MF holds (ρ = −1.0000), and the uniformity of the liquid-drop masking effect supports the "absorption" hypothesis, proving that the liquid drop model is the projection of the regime-switch network in the classical limit.

Tier 5—Third demotion: the independent-particle-motion axiom. Five lines of evidence from four independent dimensions establish the incompleteness of the axiom as a statistical description framework for many-body systems. The shell correction is re-positioned as a "quantum residual"—compensating for the difference between quantum shell effects and classical liquid-drop behavior, peaking in the mid-shell region.

This paper refines six theorems (Theorems A–F), and all 8 conditions for the completion of derivational demotion are satisfied. All evidence derives from re-analyses of the same AME2020 dataset, satisfying statistical independence but not data-source independence. This paper completes the derivational demotion in nuclear physics, which, together with the demotion of gauge field theory and the demotion of the periodic law, constitutes the complete demotion argument of the Factor Hierarchy Law in the three hard-science disciplines.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Tang(2026v, 2026w)的后续工作，整合五条证据线，完成对核物理三大框架（壳模型、液滴模型、独立粒子运动公理）的"三重降级"统一论证。通过二维Ising精确解标定、量子-经典转变指数(QCTI)等工具，证明壳模型、液滴模型和独立粒子运动公理分别是"量子-经典混合体系"（相变机制切换网络）在特定极限下的投影。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地解决核壳模型与液滴模型之间长达九十年的概念张力？核壳模型、液滴模型和独立粒子运动公理三者之间是否存在统一的降级论证框架？
AI.motivation: 核壳模型与液滴模型在核物理中各自取得了巨大成功，但两者之间的概念张力九十年来从未被系统性解决。作者试图通过整合多条证据线，证明这两个模型及独立粒子运动公理都是更基本的"量子-经典混合"体系的极限投影，从而完成统一的降级论证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 核壳模型理论、液滴模型理论、独立粒子运动公理、相变理论（二维Ising模型精确解）、量子-经典转变框架、因子层级定律（Factor Hierarchy Law）、壳修正理论
AI.method: 多层级定量分析：（1）二维Ising精确解标定截距/斜率比作为相变临界距离度量；（2）构建量子-经典转变指数(QCTI)；（3）基于魔数距离的连续球对称权重函数加权最小二乘分析；（4）Chow F检验；（5）Spearman秩相关分析。数据来源为AME2020数据库的再分析。
AI.findings: 截距/斜率比随温度区间单调递减（875.75→2.67），与均值场误差严格负相关（ρ=−1.0000）。QCTI从轻核区+0.94单调降至重核区−0.81（ρ=−0.95），双轨交点N≈70.8划分量子主导与经典主导区域。壳模型的Chow F被放大3.68–9.68倍，证明其为球对称极限投影。液滴模型在经典极限下成立，独立粒子运动公理作为多体统计描述不完整，壳修正被重新定位为"量子残差"。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性完成核壳模型、液滴模型和独立粒子运动公理的三重降级论证；将壳修正重新概念化为"量子残差"；精化了六个定理（定理A–F），满足降级推导完成的8个条件；与规范场论降级和周期律降级共同构成因子层级定律在三大硬科学学科中的完整降级论证。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种基于截距/斜率比的新型相变临界距离度量指标；构建了可简化的QCTI指数（仅用ΔR²即可达ρ=−0.93），为核结构数据分析提供了新的定量工具。

title: When Are Quota-Bonus Contracts Optimal? A Minimax Approach to Salesforce Compensation
affiliations: Zhejiang University, University of British Columbia (UBC) - Sauder School of Business and University of Western Ontario - Ivey Business School

detail.title: When Are Quota-Bonus Contracts Optimal? A Minimax Approach to Salesforce Compensation
detail.abstract: The quota-bonus (QB) contract, a base salary plus a lump-sum bonus once realized sales cross a quota, is one of its most common contract forms. This raises a foundational question: is the QB contract the optimal sales contract, and can it be implemented as intended? Prior work answers affirmatively only in narrow settings. It typically requires the salesperson's participation (IR) constraint to bind, ruling out the skilled, rent-earning representative whom the contract matters most. It is also standard to assume the validity of the first-order approach (FOA), which may not hold in many economically relevant settings. We revisit the problem under two observations from selling practice: (1) the firm caps the salesperson's pay for budgetary, risk-control, and internal-equity reasons; and (2) at the margin, additional selling effort generates more expected revenue for the firm than expected payouts to the salesperson with compensation caps set at industry-standard levels. Incorporating these two observations into the model, we prove that an optimal contract always exists and takes the QB form in the regime prior work leaves open, where the salesperson earns rents and the FOA is invalid. On the methodology side, we recast salesforce compensation as a max-min program and analyze a relaxed minimax counterpart in which the infinitely many IC constraints collapse to a single hardest-to-deter deviation, and we show this minimax relaxation is tight. This demonstrates a novel route for analyzing salesforce compensation.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在销售员获得经济租金且一阶条件方法（FOA）失效的开放领域中，当考虑薪酬上限和边际努力收益大于薪酬支出的现实条件时，配额奖金（QB）合同始终是最优合同。方法论上，作者将销售队伍薪酬问题重构为最大-最小规划，并通过极小极大松弛将无限多激励约束压缩为单一最难抑制的偏离约束。
AI.research_question: 配额奖金（QB）合同是否是最优销售合同？在销售员获得租金且一阶条件方法（FOA）无效的一般情境下，能否实现该合同的最优性？
AI.motivation: 既有研究仅在狭窄条件下证明QB合同的最优性，通常要求销售员的参与约束（IR）紧绑（排除熟练且能赚取租金的销售员），并假设一阶条件方法（FOA）有效（在许多经济情境中可能不成立）。作者试图在更现实的条件（薪酬上限、边际努力收益大于薪酬支出）下填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 销售队伍薪酬理论、激励相容（IC）约束、参与约束（IR）、委托-代理模型、最大-最小（max-min）规划与极小极大（minimax）松弛方法
AI.method: 理论建模与数学证明。将销售补偿问题重构为max-min规划，分析松弛的minimax对应问题，将无限多IC约束压缩为单一最难抑制偏离约束，并证明该极小极大松弛是紧的（tight）。
AI.findings: 在销售员赚取租金且FOA无效的领域，若考虑薪酬上限（出于预算、风险控制和内部公平原因）以及补偿上限设定在行业标准水平时边际销售努力带来的期望收入大于期望支出这两个现实条件，最优合同始终存在且呈现QB形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将QB合同的最优性从狭窄设定扩展至销售员赚取租金且FOA无效的一般领域，填补了理论空白；2. 提出将销售队伍薪酬建模为max-min规划的新分析路径，通过证明minimax松弛的紧性，为销售补偿分析提供了新方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在实践中广泛采用的配额奖金合同提供了理论正当性证明，特别是在薪酬上限约束下，确认行业标准水平的补偿上限设定可以保证QB合同的最优实施。

title: Do Store Credit Card Discounts Pay Off?
affiliations: University of Houston - C.T. Bauer College of Business,  and Boston College - Carroll School of Management

detail.title: Do Store Credit Card Discounts Pay Off?
detail.abstract: Store credit card discounts are widely used to sustain usage among cardholders, yet there is little evidence on whether and how they pay off. Beyond stimulating product sales, these discounts can raise revenue through two channels unique to card-specific rewards: higher interest income and lower interchange fees. We study how discounts affect card usage and how all three channels jointly determine profitability, using a rich consumer panel with unique variation in discount levels and detailed data on payment choices, profit margins, and interest payments. Estimating the causal effect of discounts on payment choice, we find that they substantially increase card usage. Discount costs, however, outpace gains from incremental sales as discounts deepen. Profitability instead hinges on interest income from increased card usage, while interchange savings are negligible because cardholders switch primarily from cash and debit rather than from other credit cards. Overall profitability is inverted-U shaped in the discount level, with the optimal discount increasing in the share of cardholders holding other credit cards. These findings establish the financial channel as central to whether store card discounts pay off and yield practical insights for store credit card programs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了商家信用卡折扣对持卡人用卡行为及盈利能力的因果影响。研究发现折扣显著提升信用卡使用率，但折扣成本随折扣加深超过增量销售收益；盈利的关键在于利息收入渠道，而非刷卡手续费节省（因持卡人主要从现金和借记卡转换而来，而非其他信用卡）。总体盈利能力与折扣水平呈倒U型关系，最优折扣随持卡人持有其他信用卡比例的增加而上升。
AI.research_question: 商家信用卡折扣是否以及如何为商家带来回报？折扣通过哪些渠道（利息收入、互换费用节省、增量销售）影响盈利？
AI.motivation: 商家信用卡折扣被广泛用于维持持卡人的用卡行为，但缺乏关于其是否及如何带来回报的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用卡专属奖励的经济学逻辑，涵盖增量销售、利息收入和互换费用三个收入渠道的盈利机制分析。
AI.method: 利用丰富的消费者面板数据，结合折扣水平的外部变异和详细的支付选择、利润边际、利息支付数据，估计折扣对支付选择的因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）折扣显著增加信用卡使用；（2）随折扣加深，折扣成本超过增量销售收益；（3）盈利取决于增加用卡带来的利息收入，互换费用节省可忽略不计，因持卡人主要从现金和借记卡转换而来；（4）总体盈利性与折扣水平呈倒U型关系，最优折扣随持卡人持有其他信用卡比例上升而增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统识别了信用卡折扣影响盈利的三个渠道，证明金融（利息收入）渠道是决定商家信用卡折扣是否划算的核心因素，并揭示转换来源（现金/借记卡 vs 其他信用卡）对渠道效应的重要调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商家信用卡项目设计提供实践指导：折扣并非越深越好，需考虑持卡人的其他信用卡持有情况来设定最优折扣水平；强调利息收入渠道对盈利的重要性。

title: Borrowed Trust: Network Distance, Personalization Accuracy, and the Geometry of Belief Updating in Unsolicited B2B Outreach

detail.title: Borrowed Trust: Network Distance, Personalization Accuracy, and the Geometry of Belief Updating in Unsolicited B2B Outreach
detail.abstract: This paper studies borrowed trust, meaning that in a B2B outreach message, a sender may seem more trustworthy or legitimate because the message mentions a close professional-network connection. The evidence within this study was created in a computational manner, meaning the results came from a mathematical simulation rather than real people, profiles, leads, records, or sales outcomes. The study uses a 2 × 2 paired factorial simulation across 100,000 heterogeneous synthetic agents. It separately changes the sender’s true shortest-path network distance from the recipient, D ∈ {2, 4}, and the claimed distance in the message, C ∈ {2, 4}. Each synthetic agent considers three possible sender states: a researched legitimate sender who carefully studied the recipient, a mechanically personalized legitimate sender who used automated personalization without necessarily being dishonest, and a misrepresenting or unreliable sender whose network claim may be incorrect or untrustworthy. Each agent updates its beliefs twice: once after analyzing the sender’s claim and a second time after verifying the claim against the simulated network graph. Exact Bayesian posteriors are the benchmark for this experiment, while the bounded-rational agents differ in their starting beliefs, evidence weights, proximity halo, mismatch penalty, and decision temperature. Before verification, claiming a close rather than a distant network distance increased the probability that the message sender was viewed as legitimate and researched by 0.173. The model’s outcome was the probability that the synthetic recipient would reply to the message or even agree to a meeting, based on a defined utility matrix. The paired interaction was 0.908: when senders claimed closeness and were actually close, positive action increased by 0.510, but positive action decreased by 0.398 when the sender was actually distant. Claims of unsupported closeness resulted in the largest verification-stage Fisher–Rao displacement, equal to 1.640, representing the biggest change in agents’ beliefs after verification. Across 2,000 baseline-centered sensitivity points, the interaction remained positive. However, it disappeared when network cues gave no useful information about the sender or when the sender’s perceived type did not affect the value of replying. The results were reversed when unreliable senders were more likely to make accurate-looking claims. Within this computational model, network personalization operates as a contingent credibility signal, meaning its value depends on whether the claimed distance matches the verified graph distance. These findings explain how the model behaves under its stated assumptions, but they should not be treated as a universal rule for how B2B decision-makers behave.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过计算模拟（2×2配对阶乘设计，100,000个异构合成代理）探究B2B外联消息中的"借用信任"现象——即发件人声称与收件人有紧密的职业网络联系是否会影响收件人的信任判断与回应意愿。研究发现，声称近网络距离确实提高了发件人被感知为可信和经过研究的概率，但其实际价值取决于声称距离与验证后的真实图距离是否匹配。不匹配的声称会引发最大的信念变动，整体正效应在多个灵敏度检验中持续存在，但在特定条件下（网络线索无信息量、发件人类型不影响回复价值、不可靠发件人更可能做出准确外观的声称）会消失或逆转。研究强调结果是模型行为而非普适规则。
AI.research_question: 在B2B外联消息中，发件人声称与收件人存在紧密的职业网络连接（"借用信任"）如何影响收件人的信任判断和回应行为？这种效应在什么条件下成立、消失或逆转？
AI.motivation: B2B外联中，发件人常通过提及共同网络连接来增强可信度和合法性。然而，这种策略的真正效力及其条件依存性尚缺乏系统性研究。由于难以用真实数据进行控制实验，作者采用计算模拟方法，通过大规模合成代理来系统探索这一机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借用信任（borrowed trust）理论；贝叶斯信念更新（精确贝叶斯后验作为基准）；有界理性（bounded rationality）框架；声誉信号理论；格拉姆-拉奥（Fisher-Rao）距离用于衡量信念变动
AI.method: 2×2配对阶乘计算模拟，包含100,000个异构合成代理。自变量为声称距离C∈{2,4}和真实最短路径距离D∈{2,4}。每个代理考虑三种发件人状态（研究的合法发件人、机械个性化的合法发件人、虚假/不可靠发件人），进行两次信念更新（分析声称后与验证图后）。贝叶斯精确后验为基准，有界理性代理在起始信念、证据权重、邻近光环、不匹配惩罚、决策温度等维度异质。依赖变量为代理回复或同意会面的概率。另进行2,000个基线中心灵敏度检验。
AI.findings: （1）验证前，声称近距离（vs. 远距离）使发件人被感知为合法且经过研究的概率提高0.173；（2）配对交互效应为0.908：声称近且实际近时正向行动增加0.510，实际远时减少0.398；（3）无支撑的近距声称引发最大验证阶段Fisher-Rao信念位移（1.640）；（4）2,000个灵敏度点中交互保持正效应，但在网络线索无信息量或发件人类型不影响回复价值时消失；（5）不可靠发件人更可能做出准确外观声称时结果逆转。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并形式化了"借用信任"作为条件性可信度信号的概念，证明其价值取决于声称距离与验证后真实图距离是否匹配；将贝叶斯信念更新与有界理性模拟结合，为理解B2B外联中的声誉信号的边界条件提供了计算理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为B2B销售人员提供策略洞见：提及网络连接时应确保声称与实际关系一致，虚假声称不仅无效还会引发更大的信念负面偏移；为自动化外联工具的设计提供参考，指示"有意义的个性化"（真实研究收件人）优于"机械个性化"。

title: Extreme Temperatures, Peak Demand, and Electricity-System Adequacy
affiliations: Hankuk University of Foreign Studies and

detail.title: Extreme Temperatures, Peak Demand, and Electricity-System Adequacy
detail.abstract: Assessments of climate-related electricity demand typically emphasize energy consumption, although reliability also depends on maximum load and available supply headroom. Using a long monthly panel for the Republic of Korea, we combine contract-class electricity use, observed system peak load, supply capability, and temperature distributions. A distribution-to-scalar design estimates how extreme heat and cold affect consumption and peak demand, then maps the peak response into demand-side reserve-margin erosion and operating-headroom depletion while holding supply capability fixed. Heat more consistently raises the monthly system maximum relative to electricity sales in the residential, commercial, and industrial sectors; cold produces larger absolute demand shocks and headroom losses. Residential and commercial customers account for most weather-sensitive growth within the three principal sectors after industrial use is adjusted for production. The relative peak-energy comparison alone therefore cannot rank operational severity, which also depends on the available supply buffer. Adaptation investments and demand-side resources should be evaluated by the peak-relevant load and operating headroom they preserve, as well as by their energy savings.

AI.tldr: 本文利用韩国长期月度面板数据，将合同类别用电量、系统峰值负荷、供电能力与温度分布相结合，采用分布到标量的设计估计极端高温和低温对用电量及峰值需求的影响，并进一步评估需求侧备用容量的侵蚀与运行余量的消耗。研究发现：高温对月度系统最大负荷（相对于售电量）的影响在各行业更为一致；低温则产生更大的绝对需求冲击和余量损失；相对峰值与能耗的比较无法单独排序运营严重性，还取决于可用供电缓冲。适应性投资和需求侧资源应依据其保留的峰值相关负荷和运行余量以及节能效果来评估。
AI.research_question: 极端温度如何影响电力系统峰值负荷与运行余量，以及如何评估需求侧应对气候变化的优先级？
AI.motivation: 现有气候相关电力需求评估多聚焦于能源消耗，而忽略了系统可靠性同样取决于最大负荷与可用供电余量。为弥补这一缺口，本文引入峰值负荷与运行余量视角进行分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布到标量（distribution-to-scalar）设计框架，将温度分布与电力需求及峰值负荷响应联系起来，并结合需求侧备用容量侵蚀与运行余量耗竭的概念。
AI.method: 使用韩国长期月度面板数据，结合合同类别用电量、观测到的系统峰值负荷、供电能力与温度分布，采用分布到标量设计估计温度对用电量和峰值需求的影响，再在供电能力固定的假设下将峰值响应映射为需求侧备用容量侵蚀与运行余量耗竭。
AI.findings: 1）高温对月度系统最大负荷（相对于售电量）的影响在住宅、商业和工业三个部门中更为一致；2）低温产生更大的绝对需求冲击和余量损失；3）在工业用电经生产调整后，住宅和商业客户贡献了三大主要部门中大部分天气敏感增长；4）仅靠相对峰值与能耗比较无法排序运营严重性，还取决于可用供电缓冲。
AI.theory_contributions: 将电力气候风险评估从"能耗中心"拓展至"峰值负荷与运行余量"维度，提出分布到标量的分析设计，并阐明相对峰值能耗比较在评估运营严重性方面的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者与电网规划者提供评估适应性投资和需求侧资源的新标准——应依据其保留的峰值相关负荷和运行余量（而非仅节能效果）来排序投资优先级；为韩国电力系统应对极端温度提供实证依据。

title: Banking Market Segmentation: Methodological Principles, Hierarchical Frameworks, and Multi-Factor Models
affiliations: Kyiv National Economic University (KNEU)

detail.title: Banking Market Segmentation: Methodological Principles, Hierarchical Frameworks, and Multi-Factor Models
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the strategic utility and practical applicability of various market segmentation frameworks within the banking sector. Addressing the structural complexity of financial sub-markets, the study establishes a hierarchical methodology encompassing macro-, micro-, and niche-level segmentation. Furthermore, it outlines a structured framework for constructing an industry-specific segmentation grid tailored to retail banking operations. To advance customer targeting and competitive positioning, the paper substantiates the practical application of multi-attribute models, specifically detailing an Integrated Customer Loyalty Index alongside sequential grouping and cross-tabulation matrix methods. The research demonstrates that transitioning from single-criterion to multi-factor models allows financial institutions to automate customer profiling, optimize resource allocation, and strengthen client-centric strategies in a highly dynamic market environment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了银行业中各种市场细分框架的战略效用和实际适用性，建立了一个涵盖宏观、微观和利基层面的分层方法论，并提出了面向零售银行业务的行业特定细分网格构建框架。研究通过多属性模型（如综合客户忠诚度指数、序贯分组法和交叉表矩阵法）证明了从单一标准向多因素模型转变能够帮助金融机构实现客户画像自动化、优化资源配置并强化以客户为中心的战略。
AI.research_question: 在银行业中，各种市场细分框架的战略效用和实际适用性如何？如何从单一标准细分转向多因素模型以提升客户定位与竞争地位？
AI.motivation: 金融子市场具有结构性复杂性，传统的单一标准市场细分方法难以应对银行业高度动态的市场环境，需要探索更具层次性和多维度的细分框架以改进客户定位和资源配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场细分理论（宏观、微观和利基层面分层细分）、多属性客户细分模型、客户忠诚度理论。
AI.method: 本文采用概念性/方法论研究方法，建立了层次化细分方法论，提出了行业特定细分网格的构建框架，并详细阐述了多属性模型的实际应用，包括综合客户忠诚度指数（ICLI）、序贯分组法和交叉表矩阵法。
AI.findings: 研究表明，从单一标准向多因素模型转变能够使金融机构实现客户画像自动化、优化资源配置，并在高度动态的市场环境中强化以客户为中心的战略。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为银行业提供了从宏观、微观到利基层面的系统性市场细分理论框架，并整合了多属性模型（综合客户忠诚度指数等）以丰富客户细分的理论工具集。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售银行提供了可操作的行业特定细分网格构建方法，帮助金融机构实现客户画像自动化、资源优化配置以及更精准的客户定位与竞争战略制定。

title: The Algorithmic Transparency Obligation: Autonomous Cyber Weapons, IHL Targeting Principles, and the Indiscriminacy-by-Opacity Thesis

detail.title: The Algorithmic Transparency Obligation: Autonomous Cyber Weapons, IHL Targeting Principles, and the Indiscriminacy-by-Opacity Thesis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None declared.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted as part of doctoral research at the University of Cologne, Faculty of Law.

detail.abstract:
This article establishes the Algorithmic Transparency Obligation (ATO) — a binding legal
requirement under Article 57(2)(a) AP I that commanders possess sufficient understanding of an autonomous cyber weapon's targeting outputs to perform the legal verifications that Article 57 requires before and during attack. The ATO arises from three machine-learning failure modes — adversarial manipulation, distribution shift, and specification gaming — that collectively defeat the verification architecture on which IHL's civilian protection function depends. The article documents the ATO's violation across three operational case studies: the STM Kargu-2 in Libya (2020), the ZALA Lancet-3 in Ukraine (2022–present), and the US Project Maven AI targeting system. In each case, the autonomous system's design-inherent opacity structurally precluded the verification that Article 57(2)(a)(i) AP I requires, rendering the system indiscriminate by nature rather than indiscriminate by use. The article's core doctrinal contribution is the indiscriminacy-by-opacity thesis: an autonomous cyber weapon whose algorithmic architecture precludes commander understanding of targeting outputs is indiscriminate by nature under Article 51(4)(b)–(c) AP I and subject to the Article 36 weapons review prohibition, irrespective of any particular deployment. This thesis is grounded in ICRC 2026 authoritative guidance, the ICJ's Nuclear Weapons Advisory Opinion, and leading scholarship (Schmitt, Boothby), extended to autonomous systems through the ATO framework.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了"算法透明度义务"（ATO）作为一项有约束力的法律要求，主张拥有自主网络武器的指挥官必须充分理解其目标输出，才能履行《第一附加议定书》第57条所要求的法律核查义务。文章通过三个作战案例（利比亚STM Kargu-2、乌克兰ZALA Lancet-3、美国Project Maven）论证了自主系统的设计固有模糊性在结构上阻断了第57条第2款(a)(i)项所要求的核查，并提出了"因模糊性而不分皂白"的核心学说论断。
AI.research_question: 自主网络武器的算法不透明性是否以及在何种条件下构成《第一附加议定书》下其本性不分皂白的法律依据，从而触发第36条武器审查禁止？
AI.motivation: 自主武器系统日益广泛部署，但其算法不透明性在结构上妨碍了指挥官履行国际人道法要求的法律核查义务，现有法律框架未能充分回应这一新的技术现实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以《第一附加议定书》第57(2)(a)条和第51(4)(b)-(c)条为基础，结合ICRC 2026权威指引、ICJ核武器咨询意见以及Schmitt与Boothby等学者的国际人道法理论，构建ATO法律义务框架。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析方法，结合三种机器学习失效模式（对抗操纵、分布偏移、规格博弈）的技术分析，以及三个作战案例研究（利比亚、乌克兰、美国的自主武器系统）。
AI.findings: 三个案例中的自主武器系统均因设计固有的不透明性在结构上排除了第57(2)(a)(i)条所要求的核查，使其成为"本性不分皂白"而非"使用不分皂白"的武器系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"因模糊性而不分皂白"（indiscriminacy-by-opacity）核心理论：算法架构排除指挥官理解目标输出的自主网络武器，根据第51(4)(b)-(c)条在性质上即属不分皂白，无论具体部署情况如何均须受第36条武器审查禁止约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 为武装部队、武器制造商和国际法实践者提供了ATO作为可操作的法律义务标准，明确了自主武器系统在算法架构层面必须满足的透明度要求，并为第36条武器审查提供了具体的合规评估基准。

title: What Drives Brand Commitment? Antecedents and Behavioral Outcomes in Kazakhstan's Fashion Market
affiliations: Ton Duc Thang University

detail.title: What Drives Brand Commitment? Antecedents and Behavioral Outcomes in Kazakhstan's Fashion Market
detail.abstract: This study examines how consumers transition from being brand admirers to developing strong, enduring commitment toward fashion brands in the context of Kazakhstan's fashion market. Using survey data collected from fashion consumers, the results show that self-brand connection and relationship investment are significant drivers of brand commitment. Materialism and brand consciousness do not exert direct effects, but materialism influences commitment indirectly through self-brand connection, indicating that value orientations translate into commitment only when integrated into consumers' self-concepts. Brand commitment strongly predicts both behavioral loyalty and willingness to pay a premium. The study contributes to the literature by extending commitment-based frameworks to an underexplored emerging market and clarifying the identity-driven processes underlying brand relationships in fashion consumption.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于哈萨克斯坦时尚市场数据，发现自我品牌联结和关系投入是品牌承诺的关键驱动因素，物质主义通过自我品牌联结间接影响承诺，品牌承诺显著预测行为忠诚和溢价支付意愿。
AI.research_question: 消费者如何从品牌仰慕者转变为对时尚品牌形成强烈且持久的承诺？其驱动机制和结果是什么？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注成熟市场中的品牌承诺，对新兴市场（如哈萨克斯坦）时尚消费中品牌承诺的形成机制关注不足，尤其是价值导向（物质主义、品牌意识）与关系因素如何共同作用仍有待阐明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以品牌承诺为核心框架，整合自我品牌联结、关系投入、物质主义、品牌意识等构念，延伸承诺理论至新兴市场时尚消费情境。
AI.method: 问卷调查法，收集哈萨克斯坦时尚消费者数据，采用统计分析方法检验变量间关系。
AI.findings: ①自我品牌联结和关系投入显著驱动品牌承诺；②物质主义和品牌意识无直接效应，但物质主义通过自我品牌联结间接影响承诺；③品牌承诺显著预测行为忠诚和溢价支付意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: ①将承诺导向的品牌关系框架延伸至未被充分研究的新兴市场（哈萨克斯坦）；②阐明价值导向（物质主义）转化为品牌承诺需经由自我概念整合的身份驱动过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为时尚品牌在新兴市场制定消费者关系管理策略提供依据，提示品牌应注重强化消费者的自我品牌联结和关系投入，以培育持久的品牌承诺和忠诚。

title: Toward a Cognitive Enterprise
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Toward a Cognitive Enterprise

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no personal or financial interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: There are no patients or participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The research is not funded.

detail.abstract: The enterprise is a sociotechnical negentropic network of resources, processes, and stakeholders that converts environmental signal into ordered, exportable stakeholder value. This paper proposes a foundational architecture for understanding that system: the Cognitive Stack, a five-layer hierarchy of cognitive assets (Data, Information, Explicit Knowledge, Tacit Knowledge, Wisdom) divided by the Context Frontier, the line separating what can be processed symbolically and syntactically without context (in-silico) from what requires somatic, semantic (in-cerebro and in-viscera) reasoning. Central to this architecture is a precise, operational definition of wisdom as the capacity to choose and deploy reasoning modes – deductive, inductive, and abductive – each with a distinct relationship to AI augmentation. As the transaction costs of explicit-layer cognitive work approach zero – driven by the microprocessor, the internet, and a range of modern AI models, including LLMs – firm boundaries are no longer determined primarily by transactional friction or resource stocks, but by the preservation and governance of high-context tacit knowledge and wisdom, which remain unexportable. The paper extends and sharpens the existing theoretical tradition rather than displacing it, and introduces the Cognitive Enterprise as the organizational form that manages this architecture deliberately.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种理解企业系统的基础架构——"认知堆栈"（Cognitive Stack），这是一个五层认知资产层级（数据、信息、显性知识、隐性知识、智慧），由"情境边界"（Context Frontier）划分开来。论文将智慧精确定义为选择和使用演绎、归纳、溯因三种推理模式的能力，并论证了当显性认知层的交易成本趋近于零时，企业边界不再由交易摩擦或资源存量决定，而是由高情境隐性知识和智慧的保留与治理决定。论文引入了"认知型企业"作为有意识地管理这一架构的组织形式。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能（尤其是大语言模型）使得显性认知层交易成本趋近于零的新时代，企业的本质边界和竞争优势应由什么决定？企业如何系统地理解和管理其认知资产架构？
AI.motivation: 随着微处理器、互联网和现代AI模型（包括LLM）的发展，传统基于交易成本理论和资源基础观的企业边界理论面临挑战，因为这些理论主要关注交易摩擦和资源存量，而忽略了认知资产的层级结构和情境依赖性。论文旨在提供一个更基础、更完整的架构来理解企业作为社会技术系统的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交易成本经济学、资源基础观和知识基础观的理论传统，论文提出了认知堆栈（Cognitive Stack）五层架构——数据、信息、显性知识、隐性知识、智慧，并以情境边界（Context Frontier）区分可符号化处理（in-silico）和需要体知/语义推理（in-cerebro/in-viscera）的认知层。同时提出将智慧定义为选择演绎、归纳、溯因三种推理模式的能力。
AI.method: 概念性/理论构建研究：通过架构提出和理论整合的方式，构建企业认知资产的分层模型，并对智慧给出操作性定义，分析AI技术进步对企业边界的影响。
AI.findings: 当显性认知层（数据、信息、显性知识）的交易成本趋近于零时，企业边界不再主要由交易摩擦或资源存量决定，而是由不可输出的高情境隐性知识和智慧的保留与治理所决定。认知型企业成为有意识地管理这一认知堆栈架构的组织形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 论文扩展和精炼了现有的理论传统（交易成本理论、资源基础观、知识基础观），而非取代它们。首次提出了认知堆栈五层架构和情境边界概念，为理解企业认知资产提供了系统化框架；并为"智慧"提供了精确的、可操作的定义，建立了其与AI增强的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了认知型企业的组织范式，帮助企业在AI时代明确哪些认知能力是其核心竞争力的不可输出部分（隐性知识和智慧），从而指导企业在技术投资、人才保留和知识治理方面的战略决策。

title: Legal Streaming and Piracy: Quasi-Experimental Evidence from a Multi-Platform Market
affiliations: University of Missouri, University of Notre Dame and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Kenan-Flagler Business School

detail.title: Legal Streaming and Piracy: Quasi-Experimental Evidence from a Multi-Platform Market
detail.abstract: Digital piracy persists as a major concern for media industries, and the rapid expansion of subscription video-ondemand services has raised new questions about whether legal streaming substitutes for or expands piracy. While prior research, largely set in early-stage streaming markets, has documented substitution or null effects, industry accounts increasingly suggest that legal and illegal supply may grow together in competitive, multi-platform environments. We examine this tension using Disney's April 2020 integration of Disney+ into India's leading platform, Hotstar, which created a discrete increase in legitimate content availability in an already-competitive market. Using daily title-level piracy data for 99 affected movies and five neighboring countries as controls, we apply a synthetic difference-indifferences design, complemented by alternative estimation approaches, and find that piracy in India rose by about 9% after the integration. On the demand side, piracy falls during the announcement window and rises after launch, consistent with intertemporal substitution. On the supply side, the remaining increase is consistent with a content-availability channel through which expanded legal access may facilitate pirated-content creation and distribution. The increase is concentrated in torrents, with no significant change in illegal streaming, and is stronger for higher-rated and less commercially popular titles.

AI.tldr: 本研究聚焦数字盗版与合法流媒体服务之间的关系，利用迪士尼于2020年4月将Disney+整合进印度领先平台Hotstar这一自然实验，采用合成双重差分法，发现合法内容供给增加后，印度盗版活动反而上升了约9%，表明在竞争性多平台环境中，合法与非法供给可能共同增长。
AI.research_question: 在竞争性、多平台的流媒体环境中，合法流媒体服务究竟是替代了盗版，还是扩大了盗版？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多基于流媒体市场早期阶段，发现合法流媒体对盗版存在替代或无效效应；但行业报告显示在竞争性多平台环境中，合法与非法供给可能同步增长。本文旨在调和这一矛盾，检验合法内容供给增加对盗版的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 替代效应（合法流媒体替代盗版需求）与内容可得性渠道（合法内容供给扩大可能便利盗版内容的制作与分发）之间的竞争性理论视角。
AI.method: 利用Disney+整合进Hotstar作为外生冲击，收集99部受影响电影的日度标题级盗版数据，以五个邻国作为对照组，采用合成双重差分法（synthetic difference-in-differences），并辅以其他替代性估计方法进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）整合后印度盗版上升约9%；（2）需求侧：盗版在公告窗口期下降，上线后上升，符合跨期替代；（3）供给侧：剩余增长符合内容可得性渠道，即合法内容的增加便利了盗版内容的制作与传播；（4）增长主要集中在种子文件（torrents），非法流媒体无显著变化；（5）高评分和商业上不太受欢迎的电影，盗版增幅更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了既有研究中"合法流媒体替代盗版"的主流结论，揭示在竞争性多平台环境下，合法内容供给的扩张可能通过内容可得性渠道放大盗版，丰富了数字盗版与合法供给关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为媒体行业和流媒体平台提供了关于内容供给策略与盗版治理的实证依据，提示在竞争性市场中扩大合法内容供给可能带来意想不到的盗版扩张后果，对版权保护和平台内容规划具有实践参考价值。

title: Does AI Disclosure Cost Brands Trust in Emerging Markets?

detail.title: Does AI Disclosure Cost Brands Trust in Emerging Markets?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or conflicts of interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study involved voluntary participation by adult respondents recruited through online Google forms survey. Informed consent was obtained from all participants before they completed the questionnaire. Participation was voluntary, respondents could withdraw at any time, and no personally identifiable information was collected. The research was conducted in accordance with accepted ethical principles for research involving human participations. No formal institutional ethics approval was obtained for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was independently conceived , conducted and fully self funded by the author.

detail.abstract: The rapid adoption of generative artificial intelligence in brand communication has outpaced the evidence base available to guide disclosure decisions, a gap made more urgent by the European Union's AI Act (Article 50) and the U.S. Federal Trade Commission's 2026 disclosure enforcement position. Prior research conducted in the United States, Vietnam, Australia, and comparable markets has documented an authenticity penalty when consumers learn that brand content was AI-generated, though the magnitude and mechanism of this penalty vary across at least five independently identified moderating conditions. Whether this penalty holds among Nigerian consumers, absent from every study reviewed, was untested. This study addresses that gap through a between-subjects survey experiment (N=156 collected; clean analytic sample n=71) in which Nigerian adult consumers viewed identical brand content under one of three conditions: AI-disclosed, human-disclosed, or no-disclosure control. Perceived authenticity was significantly lower in the AI-disclosed condition than in either the human-disclosed or control conditions (F=8.26, p<.001), which did not differ from one another, indicating the penalty attaches specifically to confirmed AI origin rather than informational ambiguity in general. Authenticity, trust, and purchase intention were strongly interrelated (all r>.89); a Harman's single-factor test found evidence of substantial common method variance, tempering an independent reading of these relationships. The observed effect size (d=-0.97) numerically exceeded, in a post-hoc descriptive comparison, the one precisely verified benchmark identified in the reviewed literature. A hypothesized digital-literacy moderation was not confirmed, likely due to restricted variance in a sample skewed toward high AI familiarity. Findings provide the first empirical evidence of AI-disclosure effects on brand perception in a Nigerian and West African context, extending brand authenticity theory into a market the existing literature has not yet examined.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次在尼日利亚消费者中检验生成式AI内容披露对品牌感知真实性的影响。通过组间实验（N=156，有效样本n=71），发现AI披露条件下感知真实性显著低于人类披露和无披露控制条件，效应量（d=-0.97）甚至超过已有文献基准。但数字素养的调节作用未获支持，且存在显著共同方法偏差。
AI.research_question: AI生成内容的披露是否会对尼日利亚消费者产生品牌真实性惩罚？其机制和边界条件如何？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在品牌传播中的快速采用已超越现有证据基础，欧盟AI法案（第50条）和美国FTC 2026年执法立场使披露决策问题更加紧迫。已有研究覆盖美国、越南、澳大利亚等市场，却发现AI真实性惩罚的程度和机制存在至少五种调节条件，但尼日利亚消费者完全未被研究覆盖。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌真实性理论；AI披露的"真实性惩罚"效应框架
AI.method: 组间实验设计（between-subjects survey experiment）：尼日利亚成年消费者在AI披露、人类披露、无披露对照三种条件下观看相同品牌内容。收集156份样本，有效分析样本71份。采用方差分析（ANOVA）、相关分析、Harman单因素检验及事后描述性比较。
AI.findings: 1. AI披露条件下感知真实性显著低于人类披露和控制条件（F=8.26, p<.001），后两者无显著差异；2. 真实性、信任和购买意愿高度相关（r>.89）；3. Harman单因素检验显示存在大量共同方法偏差；4. 效应量d=-0.97，数值上超过文献中已验证的基准；5. 数字素养的调节作用未获证实，可能因样本偏向高AI熟悉度。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供尼日利亚及西非情境下AI披露对品牌感知影响的实证证据，将品牌真实性理论扩展到现有文献尚未覆盖的市场，验证了AI真实性惩罚在该文化背景下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚及西非市场的品牌管理者在AI内容披露决策中提供实证依据，对遵守欧盟AI法案和FTC披露要求的企业在进入或运营非洲市场时提供策略参考。

title: Peeking as Consumer Practice on Virtual Reality Platforms: How Access to the Physical Environment Affects Immersive Consumer Experiences
affiliations: University of Münster,  and University of Muenster

detail.title: Peeking as Consumer Practice on Virtual Reality Platforms: How Access to the Physical Environment Affects Immersive Consumer Experiences

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study received ethical clearance from the business ethics committee of the University of Münster's School of Business and Economics .

detail.abstract: Virtual reality (VR) platforms such as Meta’s Quest ecosystem promise to transport consumers into virtual environments, but doing so can eliminate visual access to the physical environment. We examine how consumers manage this trade-off through the practice of peeking, where consumers make creative use of a VR headset to regain visual access to the physical environment without ending an immersive experience. We develop a dual-environment model which we test with a framed field experiment where we manipulate whether a headset affords peeking in an experiential setting. We find that peeking increases perceived control but reduces spatial presence, and these countervailing mechanisms shape consumers’ performance, satisfaction, and recommendation. The control-based benefits of peeking can outweigh the presence-based costs, but weaken as consumers become more familiar with the setting. We contribute by introducing peeking as a consumer practice on VR platforms and showing how access to physical reality shapes immersive experiences.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了VR用户通过"偷看"（peeking）行为来在虚拟环境和物理环境之间取得平衡的实践。通过双环境模型和实地框架实验，发现偷看能提升感知控制但降低空间临场感，这两种相反的机制共同影响消费者表现、满意度和推荐意愿。
AI.research_question: 消费者如何在VR平台中管理虚拟环境与物理环境的权衡？偷看（peeking）行为如何影响消费者的沉浸体验和后续行为结果？
AI.motivation: VR平台虽然能将消费者带入虚拟环境，但代价是失去对物理环境的视觉感知。现有研究尚未系统探讨消费者如何通过创造性实践（如偷看）来应对这一权衡，以及这种行为对体验结果的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双环境模型（dual-environment model），整合感知控制理论和空间临场感理论，揭示偷看行为通过提升感知控制与降低空间临场感两条相反路径影响消费者结果。
AI.method: 实地框架实验（framed field experiment），操控VR头显是否允许偷看行为，在体验式环境中进行测试。
AI.findings: 偷看提升感知控制但降低空间临场感；两种相反机制共同影响消费者表现、满意度和推荐意愿；控制带来的收益在多数情况下可超过临场感损失的成本，但随着消费者对环境的熟悉度增加，这一优势会减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将"偷看"引入作为VR平台上的消费者实践概念；揭示物理现实的可及性如何塑造沉浸式体验；拓展了感知控制与空间临场感在VR情境下的理论整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为VR平台设计者和内容开发者提供关于头显设计和界面优化的启示；帮助理解消费者在VR体验中的实际行为模式；为平衡沉浸感与控制感的产品决策提供实证依据。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Human Capital Risk and Household Portfolio Choice
affiliations: , University of Oregon - Department of Finance,  and University of Cambridge

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Human Capital Risk and Household Portfolio Choice
detail.abstract: For most households, human capital is the largest asset they own, and rapid advances in artificial intelligence (AI) may change its value. This paper studies whether workers whose occupations are more exposed to AI use financial and labor markets to hedge this risk, by investing in firms that gain from the new technology. We develop a portfolio-choice model with nontradable human capital in which AI-related equity pays off in states where exposed workers' labor income falls through technological unemployment. The model predicts that more exposed workers should hold more equity, especially when human capital is large relative to financial wealth. We test these predictions using linked Norwegian administrative data on workers' occupations, employers, income, wealth, and equity holdings. Workers in more AI-exposed occupations are more likely to participate in equity markets and, conditional on participation, hold more equity, especially from firms located in countries with firms more exposed to the AI boom. The exposure-equity relationship is stronger for younger workers, consistent with life-cycle hedging. Following the release of ChatGPT, workers with greater AI exposure also become more likely to move into lower-exposure industries and senior management roles. Our results highlight a channel through which financial markets may partially insure workers against technological unemployment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了工人是否会利用金融市场对冲其人力资本因人工智能（AI）快速进步而面临的风险。通过构建一个包含不可交易人力资本的投资组合选择模型，模型预测AI暴露度更高的工人应持有更多股票，尤其是持有那些从AI技术中受益的公司股票。利用挪威行政数据，研究发现AI暴露度更高的工人更可能参与股市并持有更多股票，尤其是在AI获益企业所在地的公司股票。ChatGPT发布后，高暴露工人更倾向于转向低暴露行业和管理岗位。
AI.research_question: 面临AI技术冲击（人力资本价值下降风险）的工人，是否会通过金融市场（投资AI受益企业股票）来对冲这一风险？
AI.motivation: 对大多数家庭而言，人力资本是最大的资产，而AI的快速进步可能改变其价值。理解工人是否以及如何利用金融市场对冲技术性失业风险，对于理解金融市场的风险分担功能和技术进步的分配效应具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资组合选择模型（portfolio-choice model），包含不可交易的人力资本；科技失业（technological unemployment）状态下的对冲逻辑；生命周期对冲（life-cycle hedging）理论。
AI.method: 理论建模 + 实证检验：构建投资组合选择模型得出理论预测，利用挪威行政数据（工人职业、雇主、收入、财富和股票持有数据）进行实证分析，并使用ChatGPT发布作为外生冲击进行事件研究。
AI.findings: （1）AI暴露度更高的工人更可能参与股票市场，且参与后持有更多股票；（2）高暴露工人更倾向持有AI受益国家（地区）企业的股票；（3）暴露-持股关系在年轻工人中更强，符合生命周期对冲逻辑；（4）ChatGPT发布后，高暴露工人更可能转向低暴露行业和高管岗位。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将AI技术冲击纳入投资组合选择理论，拓展了人力资本不可交易条件下的资产配置研究；（2）首次实证检验了金融市场对技术性失业的对冲渠道；（3）丰富了人力资本与金融决策关系的文献，特别是生命周期视角下的对冲行为。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供了金融市场如何部分缓解技术性失业风险的证据；（2）对个人投资者的资产配置和职业选择决策具有指导意义；（3）为企业高管和投资者理解AI冲击下的市场行为提供了洞见。

title: Certification, Not Transformation: The Performance Signature of Italy's Innovative-Firm Status and Its Regional Contingency
affiliations: Lum University Giuseppe Degennaro - Lum Enterprise s.r.l., Lum University Giuseppe Degennaro - Lum Enterprise s.r.l., Lum University Giuseppe Degennaro - Lum Enterprise s.r.l., Lum University Giuseppe Degennaro - Lum Enterprise s.r.l. and LUM University Giuseppe Degennaro

detail.title: Certification, Not Transformation: The Performance Signature of Italy's Innovative-Firm Status and Its Regional Contingency
detail.abstract: Italy's special legal status for "innovative" small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) grants fiscal, financial and administrative benefits intended to strengthen competitiveness, yet whether the status marks a distinctive profile of realised firm performance remains empirically underexplored. Using ten years of balance-sheet data assembled within the LUCE (LUtech Campus Ecosystem) research project on 4,043 firms (2,873 innovative and 1,170 ordinary), we compare the two populations across six performance dimensions-performance persistence, revenue growth, labour productivity, operating profitability, earnings volatility and financial stability. Because the populations differ systematically in size, sector and location, we use propensity-score matching (1,031 balanced pairs) and interpret the resulting differential as a conditional innovative-status premium rather than as a causal effect. Innovative SMEs display a large and robust revenue-growth premium-a median growth rate roughly three-and-a-half times that of matched ordinary peers (+17.3 percentage points per year; rank-biserial 0.53)-coexisting with a fragility penalty of higher earnings volatility and lower financial stability; operating profitability is higher but does not survive our robustness battery, and labour productivity is marginally lower. A within-firm event study around the registration date shows that the growth advantage largely predates registration, indicating that the status certifies and renders visible already-dynamic firms rather than causally upgrading them. The premium is strongly and significantly heterogeneous across space-broadest in the South, where local institutions are weakest-consistent with an institutional-substitution boundary condition that a formal region-bystatus interaction confirms. The results are robust to nine alternative estimators, multiple-testing correction and hidden-bias diagnostics. We read the innovative-firm register as an informative screening and monitoring device rather than as a policy whose causal returns we measure.

AI.tldr: 本文利用LUCE研究项目中10年资产负债表数据（4,043家企业），通过倾向得分匹配对比意大利"创新性"中小企业与普通中小企业在六个绩效维度上的差异。研究发现创新型企业表现出强劲的收入增长溢价（中位数年增长率约为匹配普通企业的3.5倍），但同时伴随更高的盈利波动性和更低的财务稳定性。事件研究显示增长优势主要源于注册前就已存在的动态特性，表明该身份更多是"认证"而非"因果升级"。创新溢价在南方（制度最薄弱地区）最为显著，符合制度替代边界条件。
AI.research_question: 意大利创新性中小企业的特殊法律身份是否对应着可观察到的差异化企业绩效特征？该身份的实际作用是什么——是因果性地提升企业绩效，还是仅仅认证和凸显了本身就已具有动态特征的企业？
AI.motivation: 意大利为"创新性"中小企业提供了税收、金融和行政等多项优惠政策，旨在增强竞争力，但这一身份是否确实对应着差异化的企业绩效表现在实证上尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度替代理论（institutional-substitution）：创新身份溢价在制度最弱的地区（南方）最为显著，表明正式制度在薄弱环境中替代了本地制度的功能；筛选/信号理论：创新企业注册可视为一种信息筛选和监督机制。
AI.method: 使用LUCE（LUtech Campus Ecosystem）研究项目汇编的10年资产负债表数据，涵盖4,043家企业（2,873家创新型和1,170家普通型）。采用倾向得分匹配（1,031对平衡配对）控制规模、行业和区位差异，将差异解读为条件性创新身份溢价而非因果效应。辅以注册日期的企业内事件研究、空间异质性分析、九种替代估计量、多重检验校正和隐藏偏差诊断。
AI.findings: （1）创新型企业具有显著且稳健的收入增长溢价，中位数年增长率约为匹配普通企业的3.5倍（+17.3个百分点/年，秩双列相关0.53）；（2）同时存在脆弱性惩罚：盈利波动率更高、财务稳定性更低；（3）营业利润率较高但未通过稳健性检验，劳动生产率略低；（4）事件研究显示增长优势主要存在于注册之前，表明身份主要起认证作用而非因果升级作用；（5）溢价在南方（地方制度最弱地区）最为广泛和显著，支持制度替代边界条件。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）为制度替代假说提供了微观企业层面的实证证据：创新身份的制度认证价值在制度环境薄弱地区更大；（2）区分了"认证效应"与"因果效应"，通过事件研究揭示了政策身份的信号功能而非因果提升功能；（3）将创新企业注册制度重新概念化为一种信息筛选和监督装置，而非传统意义上的激励政策。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者评估创新型中小企业认证制度提供实证参考——该制度更多是筛选和信号工具而非绩效提升工具；（2）揭示制度环境对企业身份认证价值的调节作用，提示政策设计需考虑区域制度差异；（3）为银行、投资者等利益相关方提供创新型企业真实风险收益特征的证据，特别是高增长伴随的脆弱性特征。

title: The Architecture of AI Circular Financing: Capital Formation, Leverage, and Systemic Risk in the 2026 Infrastructure Buildout
affiliations: University of Lausanne - School of Economics and Business Administration (HEC-Lausanne)

detail.title: The Architecture of AI Circular Financing: Capital Formation, Leverage, and Systemic Risk in the 2026 Infrastructure Buildout
detail.abstract: Since 2023, the artificial intelligence infrastructure sector has constructed a financing architecture in which chip manufacturers, cloud providers, and AI laboratories fund one another in closed loops exceeding $800 billion in disclosed commitments. This buildout is increasingly financed not by operating cash flow but by an escalating and diversifying stack of leverage-investment-grade bonds, private credit, off-balance-sheet special purpose vehicles, and GPU-collateralized loans-layered on top of capital expenditure that has grown from approximately $165 billion (2023) to a projected figure in excess of $1 trillion (2027E) among the four largest hyperscalers alone. This paper documents the mechanics of the circular financing structure, quantifies the leverage stack, traces the early repricing of credit risk (notably at Oracle Corporation), and constructs a transmission scenario in which an exogenous macro shock-specifically the oil-price and inflation shock associated with the 2026 Iran war-interacts with an already-stretched credit structure to produce the conditions for a broader financial dislocation. Both the constructive counter-case (a coordinated response to genuine, capacity-constrained demand) and the adverse case (financial engineering manufacturing the appearance of demand faster than it materializes) are documented; the balance of evidence assembled here weighs toward the latter.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了自2023年以来AI基础设施领域形成的超过8000亿美元闭环循环融资架构，量化了芯片制造商、云服务商和AI实验室之间的杠杆堆叠，并构建了外生宏观冲击（2026年伊朗战争引发的油价与通胀冲击）与已紧绷的信贷结构相互作用、引发更广泛金融动荡的传导情景。证据平衡倾向负面情景。
AI.research_question: AI基础设施的循环融资结构如何运作？其杠杆堆叠的规模有多大？这种结构在面临外生宏观冲击时是否会引发系统性金融风险？
AI.motivation: AI基础设施投资正以远超经营现金流的杠杆融资方式扩张，形成闭环循环融资架构，规模超过8000亿美元。这种结构可能隐藏系统性金融风险，但缺乏系统的文档化与量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环融资理论、杠杆堆叠分析、信贷风险传导机制、金融脆弱性分析、宏观冲击传导情景分析
AI.method: 对循环融资结构进行机制文档化，量化杠杆堆叠规模（包括投资级债券、私人信贷、表外SPV、GPU抵押贷款），追踪信贷风险早期重新定价（以Oracle为例），并构建外生宏观冲击与信贷结构交互的传导情景分析。
AI.findings: 四大超大规模云厂商的资本支出预计从2023年的约1650亿美元增长至2027年的超过1万亿美元；循环融资闭环超过8000亿美元；信贷风险已在Oracle等公司出现早期重定价迹象；在2026年伊朗战争引发的油价与通胀冲击情景下，已紧绷的信贷结构可能引发更广泛的金融动荡；证据平衡偏向"金融工程制造需求幻觉"的负面情景。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将AI基础设施融资描述为闭环循环融资架构，并量化其杠杆堆叠的规模与层次；提出了AI资本支出"需求真实性"的竞争性假说框架（真实容量约束需求 vs. 金融工程制造的需求表象），为后续研究提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、投资者和金融机构提供了AI基础设施融资风险的早期预警信号和传导路径分析；揭示了循环融资结构的脆弱性节点（如Oracle的信贷重定价），有助于识别系统性风险的前兆。

title: Costly Cues to Controllability: A Precision-Weighted Account of Self-Generated Expenditure as Evidence About Environmental Responsiveness (CCH v2.0 -Full Reconstruction)

detail.title: Costly Cues to Controllability: A Precision-Weighted Account of Self-Generated Expenditure as Evidence About Environmental Responsiveness (CCH v2.0 -Full Reconstruction)
detail.abstract:
How does an agent estimate the controllability of a situation when the external evidence required for that estimate is absent, sparse, or unreliable? This article develops and formalises one answer: that the felt, self-generated cost of one's
own action is treated as a low-precision internal cue about the magnitude of one's intervention, and that this cue is weighted into the agent's estimate of environmental responsiveness in inverse proportion to the precision of external
action–outcome evidence. I call this the Costly-Control Hypothesis  CCH , and I state it here as a precision-weighted cue-integration model rather than as a verbal conditional-mediation claim.
The formalisation is the substantive contribution. It converts the two conditions that the earlier verbal statement stipulated — control threat and evidential ambiguity — into consequences of the model: ambiguity is a reduction in the precision of external evidence, which automatically raises the relative weight
on the cost cue, and control threat is a shift in the prior or in the loss function governing motivated inference, which generates the cost × threat interaction as a derived rather than postulated effect. It further yields three predictions that
no adjacent account generates: (i) the cost-to-control effect should scale down monotonically and quantitatively with experimentally increased precision of external evidence; (ii) externally imposed cost of identical magnitude should be less informative about controllability than self-generated cost; and (iii) at high cost combined with high-precision evidence of null outcome change, the effect
should reverse in sign, because large expenditure with no observed
environmental change is evidence of low controllability. Prediction (iii) is a falsification test with a directional sign that self-signaling, effort justification, affect-as-information, arousal misattribution, and self-selection accounts cannot produce.
I also correct three defects of the earlier statement. First, the mediator is separated from the outcome: perceived magnitude of intervention concerns the agent's own output, perceived control concerns the environment's responsiveness to that output, and the model defines a case in which the first rises while the second falls — the discriminant-validity condition without which the model is untestable. Second, the literature review is extended to the two fields most directly engaged with the central claim, the sense-of-agency literature and the computational literature on controllability inference and learned helplessness, together with the labour-illusion, effort-paradox, expected-value-of-control, and ritual-under-uncertainty literatures; the novelty claim is correspondingly restated as a claim about derived predictions rather than about unoccupied conceptual territory. Third, the empirical program is rebuilt on random assignment of cost, double randomisation of the mediating path, explicit treatment of reverse causality and demand characteristics, named confounds with matched controls, and simulation-based power analysis.
The motor illustration is removed from the main text to Appendix B. The interpersonal-cost extension is removed entirely and reserved for separate development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化"昂贵控制假说"（Costly-Control Hypothesis, CCH）：当外部证据缺乏、稀疏或不可靠时，个体将自身行动的自生成成本视为关于干预幅度的低精度内部线索，并按照外部证据精度的反比将其加权到环境响应性估计中。该模型将控制威胁和证据模糊性从先验假定转化为模型推论，并产生三个独特预测，其中预测(iii)提供了一个方向性可证伪的检验。
AI.research_question: 当外部证据缺失、稀疏或不可靠时，行动者如何估计情境的可控性（controllability）？
AI.motivation: 外部行动-结果证据往往不可靠或缺失，但个体依然能形成可控性判断。已有口头理论（条件中介主张）缺乏形式化，无法将控制威胁与证据模糊性处理为可推导的后果，也无法产生独特可检验的预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精度加权线索整合模型（precision-weighted cue-integration model）：将自生成行动成本视为低精度内部线索，外部行动-结果证据视为外部线索，二者按精度加权整合；融合了动机推理（prior/loss function）、控制感（sense of agency）与可控性推断的计算文献。
AI.method: 理论形式化建模，并通过三个可检验预测及实验设计建议（成本随机分配、中介路径双重随机化、反向因果与需求特征的处理、命名混淆变量的匹配控制、基于模拟的功效分析）来支持该模型。
AI.findings: 三个独特预测：(i) 成本-控制效应应随外部证据精度增加而单调定量下降；(ii) 外部施加成本比自生成成本对可控性推断的信息量更低；(iii) 在高成本与高精度"零结果变化"证据组合下，效应方向应反转——大额支出未见环境变化反而是低可控性的证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化贡献：(1) 将控制威胁与证据模糊性从条件主张转化为模型推论；(2) 产生自我信号、努力合理化、情感即信息、唤醒错误归因和自我选择等相邻理论无法生成的方向性可证伪预测；(3) 区分中介变量（感知干预幅度）与结果变量（感知控制），确立判别效度条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 重建实证研究纲领：采用成本随机分配、中介路径双重随机化、明确处理反向因果与需求特征、命名混淆变量匹配控制及模拟功效分析，为检验该假说提供严格方法论框架。

title: The Second Storm Doesn't Find a Pristine Forest Why Near-term AI Augments Labor Rather than Replacing It

detail.title: The Second Storm Doesn't Find a Pristine Forest Why Near-term AI Augments Labor Rather than Replacing It
detail.abstract:
The prevailing forecasts say AI will displace much of office and physical work within a few
years, and firms are already budgeting their headcount against them. Those forecasts mistake
which work AI automates. What today’s models do reliably is the work with a clear right or
wrong answer, the kind whose errors are cheap to catch. Most of that was automated long ago,
by the office software and factory machines of the last century, and aggregate employment did
not fall. What is left is the work that turns on judgment: deciding what the task is and whether
the result is right. Generative AI has bought fluency, not judgment: a larger model writes more
convincingly but is no better at telling a right answer from a merely plausible one, most likely
because it learns from finished work and not the reasoning. Physical work asks for that same
judgment and, on top of it, the real-time adaptation to a constantly changing world that no fixed
program supplies, which is why a general-purpose robot is a far riskier bet than the specialized
machines already on the line. To automate the rest, a firm has to wrap the model in a harness,
expensive to build and to run, that in the near term adds more human labor instead of cutting it.
On the three-to-five-year horizon, little evidence supports large aggregate displacement: the
technology makes the work better, and the people who do it more capable, not fewer.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了关于AI将大规模替代就业的主流预测，指出当前生成式AI擅长的是有明确对错答案的工作（这类工作早已被自动化），而真正剩余的工作依赖于判断力。AI获得了流畅性而非判断力，通用机器人在物理工作领域也是高风险押注。在3-5年时间范围内，缺乏证据支持大规模就业替代。
AI.research_question: 当前AI技术是否会在短期内（3-5年）大规模替代就业？主流预测中关于AI自动化工作的假设是否存在根本性错误？
AI.motivation: 主流预测声称AI将在数年内取代大量办公室和体力工作，企业已据此缩减人员预算。但这些预测混淆了AI实际自动化的对象——AI可靠完成的是有明确对错答案的工作，而这类工作大多在上世纪就被办公软件和工厂机器自动化了。作者旨在纠正这一认知偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区分"判断性工作"（judgment-based work）与"有明确对错答案的工作"（work with clear right or wrong）；区分"流畅性"（fluency）与"判断力"（judgment）；AI学习机制（从成品学习而非推理过程）的局限性。
AI.method: 概念分析与论证性研究，基于对AI能力本质、自动化历史、就业数据分析和企业部署实践的逻辑推理。
AI.findings: 1）生成式AI提供的是流畅性而非判断力，大模型写作更令人信服但不擅长区分正确答案和貌似合理的答案；2）物理工作同样需要判断力和实时适应能力，通用机器人比专用机器风险更大；3）要自动化剩余工作，企业需要围绕模型构建"马具"（harness），短期反而增加而非减少人力；4）3-5年时间范围内，缺乏大规模就业替代的证据，技术反而使工作更好、工作者更有能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"AI替代的是有对错答案的工作而非判断性工作"这一核心论点，修正了现有的AI就业替代理论；引入"流畅性vs判断力"的概念区分，为理解AI能力边界提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了关于AI投资和人员规划的务实建议：不应依据盲目的大规模替代预测削减人力；企业在短期内部署AI反而需要更多人力来构建和维护"马具"；对通用机器人的投资应持谨慎态度。

title: Generative AI and the Homogenization of Brand Identity: Why AI-Generated Brands Struggle to Feel Original, and Why It Matters for the Future of Design
affiliations: Greenwich High School

detail.title: Generative AI and the Homogenization of Brand Identity: Why AI-Generated Brands Struggle to Feel Original, and Why It Matters for the Future of Design
detail.abstract: What happens when Artificial Intelligence models are asked to design a brand identity, a logo, a palette, a tagline, and the visual language for a company? When you look at them, they look polished and commercially ready. However, when you analyze them deeply, they show that they lack the historical, cultural, and real-world context that makes a brand feel original and authentic. This paper examines that gap by testing two hypotheses about the limitations of AI-generated brands. The first, the Convergence Hypothesis, argues that AI-generated brands often look alike. Across unrelated products such as cereal, soda, chocolate, jeans, or sneakers, AI returns similar outputs like warm cream backgrounds, earth-tone palettes, sans-serif fonts, and short taglines. AI produces the average visuals of the brands it has already seen. The second, the Surface Authenticity Hypothesis, argues that AI-generated brands mimic authenticity without the underlying context. They imitate heritage, logos, warmth, founder language, and origin cues, but they are not able to create the real, authentic substance like history, culture, rituals, or stories that have been built over time. The study uses a quantitative analysis with the UEQ tool to compare real and AI-generated brands across attractiveness, clarity, efficiency, dependability, stimulation, and novelty.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI生成品牌标识的局限性，提出并验证了两个假设：趋同假设（AI生成的品牌视觉上趋于相似）和表面真实性假设（AI生成的品牌只模仿真实性的表面特征而缺乏深层历史与文化内涵）。通过UEQ量化工具对比真实品牌与AI生成品牌的用户体验差异。
AI.research_question: AI生成的品牌在美学上看似精致成熟，但其是否缺乏历史、文化和现实世界背景的深度支撑？AI生成的品牌是否在视觉上趋同以及是否只能模仿表面真实性？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI生成的品牌标识和视觉语言看起来精美且具有商业可用性，但深入分析发现它们缺乏使品牌具有原创性和真实感的历史、文化和现实背景。这一差距值得系统性地检验和揭示。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出两个假设作为理论框架：(1) 趋同假设——AI生成的品牌趋于相似，因为AI输出的是已见品牌的平均视觉特征；(2) 表面真实性假设——AI生成的品牌模仿真实性的表面元素（如传承、标志、温暖感、创始人口吻、来源线索），但无法创造真实的历史、文化、仪式或故事等深层实质。
AI.method: 采用定量分析方法，使用UEQ（用户体验问卷）工具，对真实品牌与AI生成品牌在吸引力、清晰度、效率、可靠性、刺激性和新颖性六个维度上进行对比研究。研究涉及麦片、汽水、巧克力、牛仔裤、运动鞋等不同品类的产品。
AI.findings: AI生成的品牌呈现出趋同现象（如暖奶油背景、大地色调、无衬线字体、简短标语），并模仿真实性表面元素但缺乏深层历史、文化、仪式和故事等实质性内容。通过UEQ工具在六个维度上与真实品牌进行量化对比来验证这两个假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"趋同假设"和"表面真实性假设"两个新的理论概念，系统性地框架化了AI在品牌设计领域的本质局限，为理解AI生成内容与人类创造性工作的差异提供了理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌设计从业者、企业和AI工具开发者提供了重要启示：AI可以作为辅助工具但无法替代人类在品牌建设中对文化、历史和真实叙事的注入，提示在实际品牌设计中应警惕AI生成内容的同质化和浅层化问题。

title:
Where Urban Agglomerations Grow Next :
Build-Vintage as a Map for Service and Investment 
Evidence from 26 Global-South Countries

detail.title:
Where Urban Agglomerations Grow Next :
Build-Vintage as a Map for Service and Investment 
Evidence from 26 Global-South Countries
detail.abstract: A city's economic boundary, its contiguous built-up agglomeration, routinely outgrows the boundary that governs it. Dating every pixel of urban fabric in 27 Global-South countries by the decade it first urbanized (GHSL build-vintage), we split each agglomeration into a pre-1990 core and three decadal expansion rings and place georeferenced DHS households on the rings in 26 of them across two survey waves (334,091 households, 758 agglomerations). We report three findings. First, within the same city, deprivation falls with the age of the fabric; households on the 2010s ring are 0.37 SD poorer than their own core, with 10 to 12 pp less flush sanitation and clean cooking, while the 1990s ring is at the core. Second, following fixed rings across two waves, these deficits narrow on average, so the frontier is usually a transient cohort the city grows out of, but absorption takes about a decade and the delay is costly, in schooling gaps that persist, out-of-pocket spending on missing services, hours lost commuting, and private investment kept off unserviced land, so it drags on the whole city's productivity and not only the households on it. Third, catch-up is not universal; Dhaka and Dushanbe stay deprived across both waves and Amman inverts the pattern through refugee densification of its old core, while which cities diverge tracks neither region nor income and development-bank finance is neither necessary nor sufficient for closing the gap. Because DHS frames predate the newest fabric they undercover the frontier, so the estimates lean on the better-sampled cities and if anything understate the deficit. How fast a city closes its frontier gap, and why a few never do, is the causal question this design sets up.

AI.tldr: 本文利用27个全球南方国家的地块年代数据（GHSL build-vintage），将758个大都市区划分为1990年前核心区和三个十年扩张环带，结合334,091户DHS家庭数据，发现城市内部贫困随建成区年代递减：越新拓展的区域越贫困。跨两波调查显示多数城市会随时间吸收这些"前沿贫困带"，但吸收过程约需十年且成本高昂。少数城市（如达卡、杜尚别）未能追赶，安曼因难民致密化出现反转模式。
AI.research_question: 城市经济增长边界超出其治理边界时，新建城区（前沿扩张带）的贫困程度如何？这些贫困差距是否会随时间收敛？哪些城市无法实现追赶，原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 城市持续扩张但治理边界滞后，新城市化区域往往缺乏基础设施和公共服务。以往研究忽视城市内部时空维度的贫困异质性，缺乏对扩张前沿带贫困动态的系统性跨国分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市空间经济学与城市贫困地理学；城市前沿（urban frontier）理论与建成环境年代梯度模型；城市增长与基础设施收敛理论
AI.method: 利用GHSL build-vintage数据集对城市地块进行十年精度年代标注，将城市划分为核心区（1990年前）和三个十年环带；将DHS地理定位家庭分配到对应环带；跨两波调查进行固定环带的纵向比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）同一城市内，住宅区年代越新贫困程度越高：2010年代环带家庭比核心区贫困0.37个标准差，卫生设施和清洁烹饪覆盖率低10-12个百分点；（2）多数城市前沿贫困带会随时间被吸收收敛，但约需十年且代价高昂（教育差距、自付支出、通勤时间、私人投资损失）；（3）追赶并非普遍：达卡和杜尚别持续贫困，安曼因难民致密化旧核心而反转模式，且差距追赶与地区、收入和发展银行融资无系统关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"城市前沿贫困带"概念，将城市增长的时间维度（建成年代）引入城市贫困研究；识别了城市自我修复机制（追赶）及其异质性，丰富了城市贫困动态理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划和公共服务供给提供精确的贫困空间定位工具；揭示基础设施投资的滞后成本；提醒政策制定者关注特定无法追赶的城市（如达卡、杜尚别），为发展银行融资效果提供实证评估。
