AI.tldr: 本文探讨印度计划将核电容量从8.8吉瓦扩增至2047年的100吉瓦（其中向私营部门开放）所引发的破产风险问题。通过分析美国、英国、法国等国的核电破产案例（如华盛顿公共电力供应系统、英国能源公司、西屋电气、USEC等），指出核电行业在扩张周期中极易出现财务困境和破产。文章认为印度在20年内新增90吉瓦核电容量几乎必然导致企业破产，而现有的《2016年破产与清算法》不足以应对核电破产的特殊复杂性，可能引发大量诉讼。论文旨在向政策制定者和从业人员揭示核心问题，为完善该法律提供参考。
AI.research_question: 印度核电扩张计划（从8.8GW增至100GW）背景下，私营部门参与核电行业将面临哪些破产风险？现有的《2016年破产与清算法》能否有效应对核电行业特有的破产问题？
AI.motivation: 印度计划大幅扩张核电产能并向私营部门开放该行业，但核电行业历史上具有周期性的破产记录（每次扩张热潮后都伴随企业困境和破产）。现有破产法律框架可能无法应对核电行业破产的特殊复杂性，需要提前识别这些问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于核电行业案例研究的比较分析框架，涵盖政府所有制、私营参与、破产法律体系等维度，分析核电行业特有的风险特征与破产模式。
AI.method: 案例研究法：详细分析华盛顿公共电力供应系统、英国能源公司、西屋电气、USEC等核电企业的破产案例，并结合印度核电项目执行情况及《2016年破产与清算法》的制度分析。
AI.findings: （1）核电行业在每次扩张周期后都伴随着企业困境和破产，具有周期性特征；（2）政府所有制可保护企业免于正式破产，即使有私营参与的法国企业（如Areva和EDF）也被政府救助并重新国有化；（3）即使在美国这样最自由的市场，政府干预也在增加（包括股权和燃料供应安排）；（4）印度核电建设平均工期超过十年，20年内交付90吉瓦额外容量几乎必然导致沿途出现破产；（5）《2016年破产与清算法》不足以应对核电破产的复杂情况，可能引发大量诉讼。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了核电行业破产的周期性模式及其与政府所有制之间的关系，为理解基础设施行业在快速扩张过程中面临的风险提供了实证案例支持；分析了现有破产法律框架在应对战略性行业特殊风险时的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政策制定者和破产法从业人员提前识别核电行业扩张中可能面临的破产法律问题，为完善《2016年破产与清算法》提供政策建议，帮助在印度面临首个核电破产之前加强法律框架。

title: AI Adoption and Skill Demand
affiliations: , University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and University of Pennsylvania - Management Department

detail.title: AI Adoption and Skill Demand

declarations.funderStatement: The authors thank the Mack Institute for generous funding support.

detail.abstract: Technological change redistributes the division of labor between people and capital and thus changes the skills firms seek from their employees. In this research, we ask how the adoption of AI technologies changes jobs. We suggest that AI adoption may automate discrete and codifiable tasks, placing more emphasis on novel or ill-defined problems and intra-organizational coordination. Accordingly, we examine whether AI adoption is associated with greater demand for complex problem solving skills, process-and communication-oriented skills, and experience and breadth through which such skills are built. Using rich data on approximately 164 million job postings in the United States from January 2021 to March 2026, we find that firm-level AI adoption is associated with increased demand in problem-solving skills, process skills, and social skills, as well as increased demand for experience and skill breadth. We show that it is not just the result of changes in the composition of demand across occupations but instead reflects a reconfiguration of skills within roles. Our results highlight how technological change changes the bundle of skills firms seek even when they continue hiring for the same role and provide insights for workers seeking to understand what skills retain value following the emergence of novel generative AI technologies.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2021年1月至2026年3月期间美国约1.64亿条职位发布数据，探讨AI技术采用如何改变企业所寻求的员工技能组合。研究发现，企业层面的AI采用与对复杂问题解决技能、流程技能、社交技能以及经验和技能广度需求的增加相关，这种变化并非源于职业构成的变化，而是源于同一角色内技能组合的重新配置。
AI.research_question: AI技术的采用如何改变企业从员工身上寻求的技能？即AI采用是否会重新分配人机劳动分工，从而改变企业对员工技能的需求？
AI.motivation: 技术变革会重新分配人与资本之间的劳动分工，从而改变企业从员工身上寻求的技能。生成式AI的兴起引发了关于哪些技能将保留价值的广泛讨论，但缺乏大规模实证证据来检验AI采用如何实际改变企业招聘中的技能需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务自动化理论/劳动分工理论：AI采用可能自动化离散且可编码的任务，从而使企业更加重视新颖或定义不明确的问题解决，以及组织内协调相关的技能。
AI.method: 利用美国2021年1月至2026年3月约1.64亿条职位发布的大规模数据，进行企业层面的AI采用与技能需求之间关系的实证分析，并通过区分职业构成变化与角色内技能重新配置来识别机制。
AI.findings: 企业层面的AI采用与对问题解决技能、流程技能和社交技能的需求增加相关，同时也与对经验和技能广度的需求增加相关。这种变化并非由职业构成变化驱动，而是反映了同一角色内技能组合的重新配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了技术变革如何改变企业所寻求的技能组合，表明即使企业继续招聘同一角色，技术变革也会重新配置该角色的技能需求，深化了对技术变革与劳动分工关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为员工提供了关于在生成式AI技术出现后哪些技能仍保有价值的重要见解，帮助劳动者理解技能发展方向；也为企业和管理者理解AI采用对人才需求的影响提供实证依据。

title: MARLEY: A waste-free autonomous observatory for long-term monitoring of cold-water coral health and behaviour
affiliations: Ifremer, Ifremer, Ifremer, Ifremer, Ifremer and IFREMER

detail.title: MARLEY: A waste-free autonomous observatory for long-term monitoring of cold-water coral health and behaviour
detail.abstract: Cold-water coral reefs, classified as vulnerable marine ecosystems, and as such, their good conservation status is a target for an increasing number of regional and international regulations. Beyond present-day anthropogenic disturbances, deep-sea corals are under long-term threat from ocean warming and acidification. These ecosystem changes call for the implementation of long-term and high frequency ocean monitoring systems.,Here we present the design, implementation, and operational performance of the MARLEY observatory (Monitoring deep-seA coRaL EcosYstems), an autonomous, multi-parameter platform deployed in the Lampaul Canyon (Bay of Biscay) at 776 metres depth to monitor cold-water coral health with minimal environmental footprint. A primary design objective was to eliminate the deposition of dead weight on the seafloor, which represents a significant source of cumulative waste. To achieve this, MARLEY incorporates reversible ballasts enabling dynamic buoyancy adjustment during deployment and recovery. The platform features a decoupled camera module that allows flexible positioning of sensors relative to coral colonies while maintaining the main lander on sedimented peripheries.,For its first deployment in the Lampaul Canyon (Bay of Biscay), MARLEY successfully monitored Madrepora oculata polyp behaviour, associated fauna, and environmental parameters over a five-month operational period. Video data processing employed convolutional neural networks to classify polyp behaviour. Associated fauna was annotated via the Ocean Spy citizen science platform, demonstrating effective public engagement. Despite current limitations in real-time automated analysis, MARLEY demonstrates the feasibility of long-term, waste-free deep-sea observatories capable of generating essential variables for coral ecosystem health assessment and conservation management.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MARLEY观测站（监测深海珊瑚生态系统的自主多参数平台）的设计、实施和运行性能。该平台部署在比斯开湾Lampaul峡谷776米深处，采用可逆压载系统实现无废物海底部署，通过解耦相机模块灵活监测珊瑚群落，在五个月运行期内成功监测了Madrepora oculata珊瑚虫行为、相关动物群及环境参数。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和实施一个长期、高频、对环境足迹最小化的自主深海观测平台，以监测冷水珊瑚生态系统的健康状况？
AI.motivation: 冷水珊瑚礁被列为脆弱海洋生态系统，面临全球变暖和海洋酸化的长期威胁，需要长期高频的海洋监测系统；但现有深海底栖观测站通常会在海底沉积死重，造成累积性废物污染。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脆弱海洋生态系统监测理论、卷积神经网络（CNN）图像分类、公民科学参与框架
AI.method: 设计并部署自主多参数观测平台MARLEY，包含可逆压载系统（动态浮力调节）和解耦相机模块；采用卷积神经网络对珊瑚虫行为进行分类，通过Ocean Spy公民科学平台注释相关动物群。
AI.findings: MARLEY在Lampaul峡谷首次部署中成功运行五个月，监测了Madrepora oculata珊瑚虫行为、相关动物群和环境参数；CNN成功用于珊瑚虫行为分类，公民科学平台有效实现了公众参与；但实时自动化分析仍存在局限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了无废物深海观测站的设计理念，通过可逆压载消除海底死重沉积，为长期深海生态系统监测提供了新的技术范式。
AI.practical_contributions: MARLEY证明了对珊瑚健康评估和保护管理所需关键变量进行长期采集的可行性，为区域及国际法规框架下脆弱海洋生态系统的保护管理提供数据支撑，同时通过公民科学平台促进了公众参与。

title: From Skeletons to Brains: Artificial Intelligence, Mineral Intensity of Use (MIOU), and Critical Mineral Intensity of Use (CMIOU) in an Endogenous Growth Framework

detail.title: From Skeletons to Brains: Artificial Intelligence, Mineral Intensity of Use (MIOU), and Critical Mineral Intensity of Use (CMIOU) in an Endogenous Growth Framework

declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether the diffusion of artificial intelligence (AI) and AIintensive digital capital alters the composition-rather than merely the level-of mineral demand. Drawing on the mineral intensity of use literature, endogenous growth theory, and recent research on critical minerals, we argue that AI induces a structural transition from bulk industrial minerals ("skeleton minerals") toward critical digital-energy minerals ("brain minerals"). We formalize this distinction through two complementary intensity measures: Mineral Intensity of Use (MIOU), which captures the economywide consumption of bulk skeleton minerals per unit of output, and Critical Mineral Intensity of Use (CMIOU), which captures the consumption of critical brain minerals per unit of output. Using a balanced country-year panel covering sixteen economies over 2005-2025, we estimate two-way fixed-effects and difference-indifferences specifications with a calibrated empirical dataset. The results indicate that post-2015 AI exposure is associated with a statistically significant decline in MIOU and a commensurate rise in CMIOU, with a widening divergence between the two. The evidence supports what we term the structural inversion hypothesis: AI does not simply dematerialize production but reorganizes its mineral foundations-compressing MIOU while expanding CMIOU. We discuss implications for industrial policy, mineral security, and downstream industrial development in resource-endowed economies, and we outline a roadmap for future estimation using observed mineral consumption, semiconductor trade, and datacenter capacity data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究人工智能扩散是否改变了矿产需求的构成（而非仅改变水平），提出AI促使矿产需求从大宗工业矿产（"骨架矿产"）向关键数字能源矿产（"大脑矿产"）结构性转型的"结构倒置假说"。基于16个经济体2005-2025年的平衡面板数据，采用双向固定效应和双重差分方法，发现2015年后AI暴露与MIOU显著下降和CMIOU显著上升相关。
AI.research_question: 人工智能的扩散及其密集型数字资本是否改变了矿产需求的结构构成，而非仅改变整体需求水平？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注AI对整体矿产需求的水平影响，忽视了AI可能引发的矿产需求结构性转变。作者结合矿产使用强度文献、内生增长理论和关键矿产研究，试图揭示AI如何重构矿产基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 矿产使用强度（MIOU）理论、内生增长理论、关键矿产研究文献，并提出两个互补的强度测度：MIOU（大宗骨架矿产使用强度）和CMIOU（关键大脑矿产使用强度）。
AI.method: 构建覆盖16个经济体2005-2025年的平衡国家-年份面板，使用校准经验数据集，采用双向固定效应和双重差分（DID）估计规范。
AI.findings: 2015年后AI暴露与MIOU的统计显著下降和CMIOU的相应上升相关，二者差距持续扩大，支持"结构倒置假说"——AI不是简单地使生产去物质化，而是重组了其矿产基础：压缩MIOU同时扩张CMIOU。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证"结构倒置假说"（structural inversion hypothesis），将矿产需求研究的视角从水平效应拓展至构成效应，并提出了MIOU和CMIOU两个新的理论测度概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为产业政策、矿产安全和资源型经济体的下游产业发展提供政策启示，并提出了利用实际矿产消费、半导体贸易和数据中心容量数据估算的未来研究路线图。

title: Expected Credit Loss Framework -Implications on Profitability and Viability of Indian Banks

detail.title: Expected Credit Loss Framework -Implications on Profitability and Viability of Indian Banks

detail.abstract: India's banking sector has long operated under an incurred loss provisioning regime, recognising credit losses only upon observable evidence of default-a design that systematically delays loss recognition and encourages the accumulation of unacknowledged risk. In response, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) issued a Discussion Paper on Introduction of the Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Framework for Provisioning by Banks in January 2023, followed by Draft Directions on Asset Classification, Provisioning and Income Recognition in October 2025, with implementation targeted from 1 April 2027. This paper investigates how the transition to forward-looking ECL provisioning is likely to affect the profitability and financial viability of Indian scheduled commercial banks. Because the framework is not yet in force, the Provisions-to-Gross Advances Ratio is used as a theoretically grounded proxy for ECL recognition intensity-a substitution justified both by the structural equivalence between IRACP and ECL mechanics, and by the RBI's explicit anchoring of ECL prudential floors to existing IRACP rates. Using a panel of 587 bank-year observations drawn from the RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE) over 2016-2023, a pooled OLS model is estimated with Net Profit Ratio as the dependent variable and Gross NPA Ratio and CRAR as controls. The results reveal a statistically significant positive association between provisioning intensity and profitability (β = 1.243, p < 0.001), while asset quality deterioration is robustly negative (β =-0.0052, p < 0.001) and capital adequacy is positively linked to earnings (β = 0.0071, p = 0.044). The model accounts for 88.9% of profitability variation (R² = 0.889). These findings carry a clear implication: banks that enter the ECL era with stronger balance sheets and disciplined provisioning practices are well-placed to absorb the transition, while those burdened by legacy NPAs and thin capital buffers face a materially harder path. The paper makes an original empirical contribution to the emerging Indian ECL readiness literature and offers actionable pre-implementation insights for regulators, bank boards, and investors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度银行业从已发生损失（incurred loss）拨备制度向预期信用损失（ECL）框架过渡对商业银行盈利能力和财务稳健性的影响。利用2016-2023年印度储备银行数据库中的587个银行-年度观测值，以拨备强度（Provisions-to-Gross Advances Ratio）作为ECL认可强度的代理变量，通过混合OLS回归发现拨备强度与盈利能力显著正相关（β=1.243），资产质量恶化与盈利能力显著负相关，资本充足率与盈利正相关，模型解释了88.9%的盈利变动。
AI.research_question: 印度商业银行向前瞻性ECL拨备框架过渡将如何影响其盈利能力和财务可行性？
AI.motivation: 印度银行业长期采用已发生损失拨备制度，该制度系统性延迟损失确认并鼓励未认可风险的积累。RBI于2023年和2025年分别发布ECL框架讨论文件和指导草案，计划于2027年4月1日实施。由于新框架尚未生效，需要评估银行向ECL过渡的潜在财务影响，为监管机构、银行董事会和投资者提供预实施洞察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以拨备占毛贷款总额比率（Provisions-to-Gross Advances Ratio）作为ECL认可强度的理论代理变量，其合理性基于IRACP与ECL机制之间的结构等价性，以及RBI将ECL审慎下限锚定于现有IRACP利率这一明确安排。
AI.method: 采用2016-2023年印度储备银行DBIE数据库中587个银行-年度观测值的面板数据，构建以净利润率为因变量、拨备强度为核心自变量（Gross NPA Ratio和CRAR为控制变量）的混合OLS回归模型。
AI.findings: 拨备强度与盈利能力之间存在统计显著的正相关关系（β=1.243, p<0.001）；资产质量恶化对盈利具有稳健的负向影响（β=-0.0052, p<0.001）；资本充足率与盈利正相关（β=0.0071, p=0.044）；模型解释了88.9%的盈利变动（R²=0.889）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴的印度ECL准备度文献提供了原创的实证贡献，通过结构性等价论证建立了拨备强度作为ECL认可强度代理变量的理论基础，并实证检验了拨备制度过渡对银行盈利能力的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、银行董事会和投资者提供了可操作的预实施洞察：资产负债表实力强、拨备纪律良好的银行能够更好地吸收ECL过渡带来的冲击，而受遗留不良资产和薄弱资本缓冲困扰的银行将面临更艰难的道路。

title: The Relevance of Catholic Social thought for Law
affiliations: Seattle University School of Law

detail.title: The Relevance of Catholic Social thought for Law
detail.abstract: I have been explicit in some of my scholarship in considering principles, methods and insights from the tradition of Catholic Social Thought, but, more often than not, the consideration is implicit, serving as the motivation for addressing particular research questions. There are a variety of ways to consider Catholic social teaching and its implications for law. Scholars have identified various core principles rooted in scriptures and the teaching of the Church. Many summaries begin with the Papal Encyclical Rerum Novarum (On the Rights and Duties of Capital and Labor) issued by Pope Leo XIII in 1891.2 I will get there eventually, but I want to begin with a method that is deeply embedded in Catholic Social Thought and gives it the potential to be more generalizable outside of explicitly Catholic or Christian contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了天主教社会思想（Catholic Social Thought）在法律研究中的应用方式，作者指出其研究虽不总是明确引用该传统，但常以其作为研究动机。文章强调天主教社会思想中蕴含的方法论——而非仅关注其核心原则——具有超越天主教或基督教语境的更广泛适用潜力。
AI.research_question: 天主教社会思想如何作为方法论（而不仅是教义原则）应用于法律研究，并在非天主教语境中保持其适用性与推广性？
AI.motivation: 作者注意到天主教社会思想在法律研究中常被隐含地使用，但其方法论层面的价值尚未被充分挖掘。作者希望从Rerum Novarum等传统出发，提炼出可广泛推广的方法论工具，使其超越宗教语境的局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 天主教社会思想（Catholic Social Thought），包括其核心原则（源自圣经和教会训导），以及从教宗利奥十三世1891年通谕《新事》（Rerum Novarum）以来的社会训导传统。
AI.method: 理论性/反思性论文方法：作者回顾自身学术研究中对天主教社会思想的运用，分析其显性与隐性使用方式，并从该传统中辨识和阐述一种具有普遍化潜力的方法论。
AI.findings: 天主教社会思想中嵌含着一种方法论，该方法论赋予其在明确的天主教或基督教语境之外实现更广泛推广的潜力。作者主张应从方法论而非仅从教义原则层面来理解天主教社会思想对法律研究的意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 将天主教社会思想从"教义原则集合"重新定位为"可推广的方法论框架"，扩展了该理论传统在法律学术中的适用边界，为跨语境、跨信仰的研究对话提供了新路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律学者提供了一种不依赖宗教认同即可运用天主教社会思想方法论的研究进路，有助于在多元社会中就法律正义等问题展开更具包容性的学术对话。

title: Non-Asymptotic Stability and Turnover of Risk-Parity Allocations: ERC Smoothness and Hierarchical Boundary Effects

detail.title: Non-Asymptotic Stability and Turnover of Risk-Parity Allocations: ERC Smoothness and Hierarchical Boundary Effects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial, personal, professional, or institutional relationships that could have influenced, or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced, the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is theoretical and methodological, uses no human participants, patient data, personal data, animal subjects, interviews, surveys, or experimental interventions requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently within Alpha Stochastic Research.

detail.abstract: We study the sensitivity of two long-only covariance-based allocation rules: Equal Risk Contribution (ERC) and a precisely specified single-linkage, tree-recursive hierarchical allocator using equal-weight cluster variances, which we denote by EW-HRP. The distinction between a fixed tree and an estimated tree is central. First, the normalized ERC map is shown to be C∞ on the cone of positive-definite covariance matrices and uniformly Lipschitz on every spectral set {Σ : Σ ⪰ λI}, with the explicit bound ∥wERC(Σ1) − wERC(Σ0)∥2 ≤ 2 √ N λ ∥Σ1 − Σ0∥F . Second, for every fixed binary tree T , the corresponding hierarchical allocation map is smooth. On Kλ,Λ := {Σ : λI ⪯ Σ ⪯ ΛI}, its derivative is bounded explicitly in terms of the tree depth. Third, the estimated-tree allocation is locally smooth away from distance ties but can be discontinuous at topology boundaries. We give an exact three-asset example in which the one-sided portfolio limits differ by 38/71 in ℓ1 norm, and a second exact example showing that no strictly positive jump can hold uniformly over all topology boundaries. Finally, for ridge-regularized rolling covariance matrices and bounded independent returns, we derive deterministic and expected finite-sample turnover bounds. The smooth component scales as √ n/T in expectation for two windows separated by n observations, while topology changes contribute an additional term bounded by their crossing probability. The results isolate boundary crossings as a distinct turnover mechanism without asserting a universal ordering between ERC and hierarchical allocations.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了两种仅做多头的协方差型资产配置规则——等风险贡献（ERC）和等权重聚类方差的层次风险平价（EW-HRP）——的敏感性。文章区分固定树与估计树两种情况：固定树下分配映射是光滑的，而估计树在拓扑边界处可能不连续。作者给出了导数界的显式表达式和精确的资产数例子，并推导了岭正则化滚动协方差矩阵下的确定性及期望换手率上界。
AI.research_question: 两种长期多头协方差型配置规则（ERC与EW-HRP）对协方差矩阵扰动的敏感性如何？特别是固定树与估计树在拓扑边界处的不连续性和换手率表现如何量化？
AI.motivation: 层次风险平价（HRP）等配置规则在实践中广泛使用，但其对协方差估计扰动和树结构变化的敏感性缺乏严格的理论刻画。理解这些规则的敏感性有助于量化组合换手率、识别换手率的主要驱动机制，并指导实务中的参数选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协方差矩阵流形上的Lipschitz分析与光滑性理论；谱集上的算子范数界；层次聚类拓扑结构的状态空间分析；换手率分解框架（光滑成分+拓扑跳跃成分）。
AI.method: 理论推导：证明ERC映射在正定锥上的C∞光滑性和谱集上的均匀Lipschitz性；对固定树推导层次分配映射的导数界；对估计树分析局部光滑性与拓扑边界不连续性，给出精确三资产反例。对岭正则化滚动协方差矩阵，推导确定性及期望换手率上界。
AI.findings: (1) 归一化ERC映射在正定协方差矩阵锥上是C∞的，且在谱集{Σ:Σ⪰λI}上均匀Lipschitz，界为2√N/λ·‖Σ1−Σ0‖F。(2) 固定二元树T下，层次分配映射光滑，在Kλ,Λ上导数界可由树深度显式给出。(3) 估计树分配在距离平局外局部光滑，但在拓扑边界处可能不连续，给出三资产精确例子显示单侧组合极限在ℓ1范数下相差38/71，且不存在对全拓扑边界一致成立的严格正跳跃下界。(4) 对岭正则化滚动协方差与有界独立收益，换手率的平滑成分期望为O(√n/T)（相隔n个观测），拓扑变化额外贡献由其穿越概率界定。边界穿越被识别为独立于平滑成分的换手率机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次严格证明ERC映射的光滑性与Lipschitz常数；建立固定树层次分配映射的导数显式上界（与树深度相关）；刻画估计树拓扑边界处的不连续性，并给出精确反例显示不存在均匀跳跃下界；将换手率分解为平滑成分与拓扑边界穿越效应两个独立机制，并分别给出上界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实务中ERC与HRP配置的换手率管理提供理论依据：明确了拓扑边界穿越是换手率的独立驱动机制，实务中可通过降低树结构对噪声的敏感性（如正则化、稳定聚类）控制换手率；提供了换手率期望规模的量级估计（√n/T），为滚动窗口长度选择与调仓频率设计提供指导。研究不试图断言ERC与层次分配孰优孰劣，为实践者提供更客观的量化框架。

title: Media Attention Structural Inequality: A Comparative Analysis of Parasport and Traditional Sport Coverage

detail.title: Media Attention Structural Inequality: A Comparative Analysis of Parasport and Traditional Sport Coverage
detail.abstract: This study presents a systematic empirical investigation of structural inequality in the media representation of adaptive (Paralympic) sport relative to conventional sport across Russia's two dominant digital sports platforms, Championat.com and Sports.ru. Employing a concurrent mixed-methods research design that integrates quantitative content analysis of website and social media output with a sociological survey instrument administered to 290 respondents, the research generates precise, triangulated measurements of the informational asymmetry between these two categories of sport coverage. Findings reveal a publication ratio of 528:0.07 (Championat.com) and 80:0 (Sports.ru) in average daily terms during non-Paralympic periods, providing full empirical confirmation of both the structural inequality hypothesis (H₁) and the audience perception hypothesis (H₂). Theoretical interpretation proceeds through the analytical frameworks of agenda-setting theory, framing theory, cultural hegemony, the social construction of reality, and Bourdieuian symbolic inequality. The study makes an original contribution to the underexplored intersection of disability media studies and Russian sports journalism scholarship, offering a replicable methodological framework and a set of evidence-based recommendations addressed to editorial boards, sports governing bodies, and relevant state authorities.

AI.tldr: 本研究对俄罗斯两大数字体育平台（Championat.com和Sports.ru）上适应性（残奥）体育与常规体育的媒体呈现结构性不平等进行了系统性实证研究。通过整合定量内容分析和社会学调查（290名受访者）的混合研究方法，研究精确测量了这两类体育报道之间的信息不对称性，完全证实了结构性不平等假说（H₁）和受众感知假说（H₂）。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯主要数字体育平台在残奥体育与常规体育的媒体呈现上存在怎样的结构性不平等？这种不平等如何被受众感知？
AI.motivation: 残奥体育与常规体育在媒体覆盖上的结构性不平等长期存在，但这一现象在俄罗斯体育新闻学与残障媒体研究交叉领域尚缺乏系统的实证调查。
AI.theoretical_framework: 议程设置理论（agenda-setting theory）、框架理论（framing theory）、文化霸权（cultural hegemony）、社会现实建构（social construction of reality）、布迪厄符号不平等（Bourdieuian symbolic inequality）
AI.method: 并行的混合研究方法（concurrent mixed-methods）：对网站和社交媒体内容进行定量内容分析，并结合对290名受访者施行的社会学调查问卷，采用三角互证（triangulation）方式获取精确测量。
AI.findings: 在非残奥会期间，Championat.com的平均每日发布比例为528:0.07，Sports.ru为80:0，完全证实了结构性不平等假说（H₁）和受众感知假说（H₂）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将残障媒体研究与俄罗斯体育新闻学这一未充分探索的交叉领域进行了原创性结合，并通过议程设置、框架理论、文化霸权和布迪厄符号不平等等多重理论框架提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复制的（replicable）方法论框架，并向编辑委员会、体育管理机构及相关国家政府部门提出了一系列基于证据的建议。

title: Debt Recovery and Bank Performance in Nigeria: Evidence from Panel Data Analysis
affiliations: University of Calabar- Department of Banking & Finance, University of Calabar, University of Calabar, Calabar Nigeria and University of Calabar, Calabar Nigeria

detail.title: Debt Recovery and Bank Performance in Nigeria: Evidence from Panel Data Analysis
detail.abstract: High non-performing loan levels continue to threaten the profitability and stability of Nigerian banks, yet the empirical link between debt recovery practices and bank performance over an extended period remains underexplored. Anchored in credit rationing theory of Stiglitz and Weiss and the psychological theory of credit recovery, the study used panel data from seven Nigerian banks (2004-2023, 140 observations). Four credit recovery indicators, NPL ratio, loan loss provisions, debt recovery rate, and write-off ratio-were regressed against net income and ROE using a Random Effects panel model, selected via Hausman and unit root tests. Loan recoveries (β = 0.106, p = 0.047), write-offs (β = 0.145, p = 0.002), and loan loss provisions (β = 0.419, p = 0.000) all had significant positive effects on net income, with the model explaining 42.7% of the variation (R² = 0.4272). it concludes that credit recovery, write-offs, and provisioning practices significantly enhance Nigerian bank performance, confirming that credit risk management is a key driver of profitability rather than a mere compliance exercise. The study offers rare two-decade panel evidence jointly assessing recoveries, write-offs, and provisioning in Nigerian banking, provides empirical support for credit rationing theory in an African context, and reveals a strategic role for write-offs in balance-sheet management, an area prior studies have largely overlooked.it is recommended that Nigerian banks should strengthen proactive loan recovery mechanisms, such as enhanced credit monitoring systems, dedicated recovery units, and data analytics for tracking delinquent loans, while adopting transparent, strategic write-off policies and maintaining forward-looking, IFRS 9aligned provisioning standards to sustain profitability and manage credit risk effectively.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用尼日利亚七家银行2004-2023年的面板数据（140个观测值），基于Stiglitz和Weiss的信贷配给理论及信贷回收心理学理论，考察债务回收实践对银行绩效的影响。研究发现贷款回收、核销和贷款损失拨备均对净利润有显著正向影响，模型解释了42.7%的变异，证实信用风险管理是银行盈利的关键驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚银行的债务回收实践（贷款回收率、核销率、贷款损失拨备等）与银行绩效（净利润和净资产收益率）之间存在怎样的实证联系？
AI.motivation: 高的不良贷款水平持续威胁尼日利亚银行的盈利能力和稳定性，但债务回收实践与银行绩效之间长期的实证联系仍未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: Stiglitz和Weiss的信贷配给理论（Credit Rationing Theory）以及信贷回收心理学理论（Psychological Theory of Credit Recovery）
AI.method: 采用尼日利亚七家银行2004-2023年的面板数据（140个观测值），使用随机效应面板模型，通过Hausman检验和单位根检验选择模型。将四个信贷回收指标（不良贷款率、贷款损失拨备、债务回收率、核销率）对净利润和净资产收益率进行回归分析。
AI.findings: 贷款回收（β=0.106，p=0.047）、核销（β=0.145，p=0.002）和贷款损失拨备（β=0.419，p=0.000）均对净利润有显著正向影响，模型解释了42.7%的变异（R²=0.4272）。信贷回收、核销和拨备实践显著提升了尼日利亚银行的绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提供了罕见的二十年面板证据，联合评估了尼日利亚银行业的回收、核销和拨备；2）为信贷配给理论在非洲背景下的应用提供了实证支持；3）揭示了核销在资产负债表管理中的战略作用，这一领域此前的研究大多忽视。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议尼日利亚银行加强主动贷款回收机制，如强化信用监控系统、设立专门的回收部门和使用数据分析追踪违约贷款，同时采取透明、战略性的核销政策，并维持前瞻性、符合IFRS 9的拨备标准，以维持盈利能力并有效管理信用风险。

title:
Beyond Unemployment: Measuring Graduate Labour Underutilization in Nigeria 
Informality and Occupational Mismatch Among Nigeria's Tertiary-Educated Workforce

detail.title:
Beyond Unemployment: Measuring Graduate Labour Underutilization in Nigeria 
Informality and Occupational Mismatch Among Nigeria's Tertiary-Educated Workforce

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is based exclusively on anonymized secondary survey data from the Nigeria Labour Force Survey.

detail.abstract: Across much of the developing world, headline unemployment is a poor measure of how well the labour market serves its most educated workers. Nigeria illustrates the problem starkly. Official statistics report modest unemployment among the tertiary-educated: 9.0 percent for postsecondary and 2.0 percent for postgraduate holders in the first quarter of 2024. Two decades of Nigerian scholarship have nonetheless described graduate unemployment and underemployment as a national crisis. This paper argues that the two accounts are not in conflict once graduate labour underutilization, defined jointly through informality, occupational skill mismatch, and time-related underemployment, is measured directly rather than inferred from the unemployment rate. Using individual-level microdata from all six quarters of the Nigeria Labour Force Survey currently available, the first quarter of 2024 through the second quarter of 2025, we construct and validate these three indicators against official benchmarks, estimate their association with education tier net of demographic and geographic composition, and decompose overall underutilization into the share attributable to each condition. Composite informality and occupational mismatch both decline sharply and significantly with education tier, a relationship that survives controls for age, sex, urban or rural residence, state, and quarter. Time-related underemployment shows no significant tier gradient once the same controls are applied, indicating that its raw association with education level in the descriptive data reflects demographic and geographic composition rather than a genuine effect of credential level. A Shapley decomposition shows that informality accounts for roughly half of overall graduate underutilization at every education tier, with occupational mismatch accounting for most of the remainder and time-related underemployment a consistently minor contributor. Even among postgraduate degree holders, more than a quarter remain informally employed and roughly a quarter remain occupationally mismatched, at a point in the education distribution where headline unemployment is close to zero. This paper is the first in a planned sequence: it establishes the measurement and documents the pattern; a second paper will examine how employment quality mediates the wage returns to tertiary education, and a third will test competing theoretical accounts of why mismatch and informality persist using richer, cohortaware modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文使用尼日利亚劳动力量调查（NLFS）2024年Q1至2025年Q2的全部六个季度微观数据，直接测量毕业生劳动力利用不足的三种维度（非正规就业、职业技能错配、时间性就业不足），发现非正规就业和职业错配随教育层次显著下降，但即便在研究生学历者中仍有超过四分之一处于非正规就业、约四分之一存在职业错配。Shapley分解显示非正规就业占整体利用不足的近一半。该文是对官方失业率指标的补充修正，为后续研究提供测量基础。
AI.research_question: 如何直接测量毕业生劳动力利用不足（而非仅通过失业率推断），并估计其与教育层次的关联及构成？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚官方失业率数据显示高等教育者失业率较低（本科9.0%、研究生2.0%），但二十年学术文献反复将毕业生失业与就业不足描述为全国性危机，两者存在明显矛盾，需要直接测量劳动力利用不足来解决这一分歧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力利用不足的三维框架：非正式就业（informality）、职业技能错配（occupational skill mismatch）、时间性就业不足（time-related underemployment），三者联合定义毕业生劳动力利用不足。
AI.method: 使用尼日利亚劳动力量调查2024Q1-2025Q2共六个季度的个体层面微观数据，构建并验证三个指标，运用控制人口与地理构成的回归模型估计其与教育层次的关联，并采用Shapley分解法量化各维度对整体利用不足的贡献。
AI.findings: （1）非正规就业和职业错配均随教育层次显著下降，且控制年龄、性别、城乡、州别和季度后关系依然稳健；（2）时间性就业不足在教育层次上无显著梯度，其原始关联源于人口与地理构成而非学历的真实效应；（3）Shapley分解显示非正规就业占各教育层次整体利用不足的约一半，职业错配占大部分其余部分；（4）即使研究生学历者仍有超过25%非正规就业、约25%职业错配，而此时官方失业率接近零。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了"毕业生劳动力利用不足"作为多维构念的直接测量框架，证明官方低失业率与学术"危机论"并不矛盾，关键在于测量视角的转换；揭示了时间性就业不足的梯度效应是构成性假象而非学历真实效应，甄别了不同维度对利用不足的相对贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚（及类似发展中国家）提供了超越失业率的劳动力市场监测指标，使政策制定者能够识别毕业生就业质量问题的真实症结（非正规就业为主）而非被低失业率误导；该测量框架可作为后续政策评估和系列研究的基础。

title: The Algorithm as Congestion: Navigation Systems, Information Homogenisation, and the Self-Defeating Forecast
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Algorithm as Congestion: Navigation Systems, Information Homogenisation, and the Self-Defeating Forecast

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, in connection with the research presented in this paper. No funding was received for this work from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding body. The research was conducted independently, and the views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not involve human subjects, animal subjects, clinical trials, or the collection of personal data. Accordingly, ethics approval was not required for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The standard economic account of information holds that providing agents with better information moves equilibrium outcomes closer to the social optimum. Centralised navigation algorithms appear to instantiate this logic, yet urban congestion has worsened in precisely the cities where algorithmic routing penetration is highest. This paper identities two structural design failures that explain this paradox. The first is information homogenisation: broadcasting a common routing signal causes rational agents to discard heterogeneous private local knowledge, collapsing the natural route diversity that had functioned as a decentralised co ordination mechanism approximating the social optimum. The second is the self defeating forecast: any estimated time of arrival computed from current traffic conditions without internalising the algorithm’s own routing effect is structurally downward biased, with bias increasing in the number of simultaneous users and the congestion sensitivity of the recommended route- a form of the Lucas (1976) critique applied to navigation systems. We prove that these two failures com pound- the Compounded Ineficiency Theorem- to produce an equilibrium that can be welfare-inferior to the no-information benchmark of Part III, under conditions empirically plausible for major urban corridors. The key prior result in this area, Acemoglu et al.’s (2018) Informational Braess Paradox, shows that more information can harm welfare in routing games. We extend this finding by identifying the precise mechanism- algorithm design failure rather than information provision per se- and by characterising a truth-telling algorithm that corrects both failures through internalised ETA formation and stochastic route diversification, achieving the social optimum in expectation. Empirical grounding is provided by Cabannes et al. (2019) on the I-210 corridor, Bagabaldo et al. (2024) on optimal partial adoption, and Monnot et al. (2017) on the empirical Price of Anarchy in Singapore.

AI.tldr: 本文指出集中式导航算法通过两个结构性设计缺陷（信息同质化和自我挫败的预测）导致了城市拥堵悖论，并证明这两种缺陷会相互叠加，产生比无信息基准更差的福利结果。作者提出一个能同时纠正这两种缺陷的"真实告知算法"，通过内化的ETA形成和随机路线多样化，在期望意义下达到社会最优。
AI.research_question: 为什么集中式导航算法在提供更多信息的情况下反而恶化了城市交通拥堵？其内在机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 标准经济学理论认为更多信息会推动均衡趋向社会最优，但现实中算法导航渗透率最高的城市拥堵反而最严重，这一悖论需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Lucus (1976)批判——预测必须内化自身影响；2. Acemoglu等人的信息Braess悖论——更多信息可能损害路由博弈中的福利；3. 标准信息经济学中关于信息改善均衡的传统观点。
AI.method: 理论建模与定理证明：构建路由博弈模型，证明"复合无效率定理"（Compounded Inefficiency Theorem），并设计可达到社会最优的"真实告知算法"。
AI.findings: 1. 信息同质化导致理性代理人放弃异质性本地知识，破坏自然路线多样性；2. 自我挫败的ETA预测存在结构性下偏，偏差随用户数和拥堵敏感性增加；3. 两种失败会复合叠加，在经验上合理的城市主干道条件下产生比无信息基准更差的均衡福利；4. 提出真实告知算法可同时纠正两种失败并达到期望社会最优。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Acemoglu等人（2018）的信息Braess悖论，识别出精确机制——算法设计失败而非信息提供本身导致福利损害，并通过Lucas批判视角为导航系统提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为导航算法设计提供了明确的改进方向：ETA必须内化算法自身对交通的影响，且需要引入随机化路线以维持路线多样性；对城市规划者和平台运营者具有直接的政策与工程启示。

title: Challenges in Implementing ICAO TRAINAIR PLUS Standards in National Aviation Training Institutions: The Case of DHMI Türkiye

detail.title: Challenges in Implementing ICAO TRAINAIR PLUS Standards in National Aviation Training Institutions: The Case of DHMI Türkiye
detail.abstract: Implementing ICAO's TRAINAIR PLUS standards in national aviation training institutions demands significant organizational, regulatory, and capacity-building efforts. This study examines the case of Türkiye's State Airports Authority (DHMİ) as it works to align its Aviation Academy with TRAINAIR PLUS. Using a qualitative case study approach, we analyze DHMİ directives, ICAO documents, and academic literature to identify key challenges-such as regulatory restructuring, adopting competency-based training, developing STPs, enhancing instructor capacity, and integrating e-learning. Comparative examples from South Korea, Thailand, and Ukraine show these challenges are globally shared. The study also explores opportunities like international recognition, course sharing, and revenue generation. We conclude with strategic recommendations for DHMİ and similar institutions to strengthen ICAO alignment through improved management support, instructor development, and quality assurance.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定性案例分析法，考察土耳其国家机场管理局（DHMİ）航空学院与国际民航组织（ICAO）TRAINAIR PLUS标准对接的过程，识别出监管重组、能力本位培训、标准培训包（STP）开发、教员能力提升和电子学习整合等核心挑战，并结合韩国、泰国、乌克兰的跨国比较案例提出战略建议。
AI.research_question: 国家航空培训机构在实施ICAO TRAINAIR PLUS标准过程中面临哪些关键挑战与机遇？以土耳其DHMİ航空学院为案例，如何实现与国际标准的有效对接？
AI.motivation: 实施TRAINAIR PLUS标准需要大量组织、监管和能力建设方面的投入，各国航空培训机构普遍面临类似的系统性挑战，但缺乏系统的跨国比较研究来指导此类改革进程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ICAO TRAINAIR PLUS标准框架，涉及能力本位培训理论（CBT）、组织变革理论、国际标准采纳与本土化理论等。
AI.method: 定性案例研究方法，分析DHMİ指令文件、ICAO官方文件和学术文献，并采用跨国比较分析（韩国、泰国、乌克兰）增强外部效度。
AI.findings: 研究发现五大核心挑战：监管重组、采纳能力本位培训、开发标准培训包（STPs）、提升教员能力、整合电子学习。这些挑战具有全球共性（韩国、泰国、乌克兰同样面临）。同时存在三大机遇：国际认可、课程共享和收入创造。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了国际航空培训标准采纳的理论文献，揭示了发展中国家/新兴经济体国家航空培训机构对接国际标准时的共同障碍模式与应对路径，为组织变革理论在航空培训领域的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DHMİ及其他类似国家航空培训机构提供了具体的战略建议，包括加强管理层支持、教员发展体系和质量保障机制，并为各国航空培训标准化改革提供了可参照的实践路径。

title: Why Traditional Private Equity Return Metrics Systematically Mislead Institutional Allocators A Mathematical Critique

detail.title: Why Traditional Private Equity Return Metrics Systematically Mislead Institutional Allocators A Mathematical Critique

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human subjects, primary data collection, or any material requiring ethical review. It relies solely on publicly available secondary sources and mathematical/theoretical analysis. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author

detail.abstract:
The Internal Rate of Return has long served as the anchor metric for evaluating private equity
performance, yet this near-universal adoption conceals a signicant algebraic fragility. This paper
examines IRR's embedded bias arising from subscription-line-of-credit distortion, cash ow timing
sensitivity, and the risk of multiple solutions within its polynomial function. Using an axiomatic
approach, it analyzes the scale-insensitivity anomaly, examining how performance metrics respond
to changes in capital scale.
The central nding formally demonstrates that blindness to capital scale is not a defect unique
to IRR, but a mathematical property inherent to ratio-based metrics as a category  including
the Kaplan-Schoar Public Market Equivalent (KS-PME). The implication is signicant: pursuing
an impressive return percentage without measuring real capital-absorption capacity can undermine
portfolio eciency for large institutional limited partners.
As a policy recommendation, this paper proposes an industry reporting standard that pairs KS-
PME as a benchmark for external alpha quality with TVPI/DPI as the anchor for absolute dollar
scale. The goal is a reporting standard that is more transparent and accountable to the limited
partners whose capital the industry manages.

AI.tldr: 本文通过公理化方法系统分析了IRR（内部收益率）在私募股权投资绩效评估中存在的固有偏差，包括信用额度扭曲、现金流时间敏感性和多项式多解风险，并正式证明了对资本规模不敏感是所有比率型指标（包括KS-PME）共有的数学属性，而非IRR独有缺陷。基于此，论文提出将KS-PME与TVPI/DPI结合的双指标行业报告标准。
AI.research_question: IRR作为私募股权绩效评估的锚定指标，其内在偏差（信用额度扭曲、现金流时间敏感性、多项式多解）如何影响绩效判断？比率型绩效指标对资本规模不敏感这一"异常"是否具有普遍性？
AI.motivation: IRR虽被广泛采用，但存在显著的代数脆弱性；同时大型机构有限合伙人（LP）追求高回报百分比却忽视资本吸收容量的现实问题迫切需要解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公理化方法（axiomatic approach）；比率型指标数学属性分析；规模不敏感性异常（scale-insensitivity anomaly）分析框架。
AI.method: 采用公理化方法（axiomatic approach），对IRR及KS-PME等绩效指标进行数学性质分析，研究指标对资本规模变化时的响应特征。
AI.findings: 1. IRR存在订阅信用额度扭曲、现金流时序敏感性和多解风险三类固有问题；2. 对资本规模不敏感不是IRR独有缺陷，而是所有比率型指标（含KS-PME）的数学共性；3. 仅追求回报百分比而忽视实际资本吸收能力，会损害大型机构LP的投资组合效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将"规模不敏感性"从IRR特例提升为比率型指标类别的普遍数学属性，通过公理化方法给出了形式化证明，为绩效评估理论提供了新的分类学视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出双指标报告标准：以KS-PME作为外部alpha质量的基准，以TVPI/DPI作为绝对美元规模的锚定指标，旨在建立对LP更透明、更负责任的行业报告规范。

title: Towards a Sustainable Future: The Impact of Green Finance, Governance, and Digitalization on Global Emissions

detail.title: Towards a Sustainable Future: The Impact of Green Finance, Governance, and Digitalization on Global Emissions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this research as it relies entirely on secondary, publicly available macroeconomic data and does not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no specific funding for this work.

detail.abstract: This research empirically investigates the macroeconomic factors that are driving carbon dioxide (CO2) emission among the top 30 emitting nations (2000-2021). This study uses an augmented STIRPAT framework employing a second-generation Autoregressive Distributed Lag using Pooled Mean Group estimator (PMG-ARDL) model, further cross validated using FMOLS and DOLS estimators. This research simultaneously evaluates green finance, institutional governance, technological innovation and digitalization. The findings confirm the Environmental Kuznets Curve's technique effect, as green finance significantly reduces longrun emissions. However, this study unveils a critical "institutional governance paradox", demonstrating that strong governance structures currently prioritize carbon-intensive economic expansion over ecological constraints. Furthermore, the analysis also quantifies a "digital rebound effect" and the macroeconomic Jevons Paradox, which proves that generalized technological innovation and digital innovation expansion actively increase absolute emissions. To achieve global carbon neutrality requires abandoning the growth-first paradigm, enforcing strict environmental policy stringency, and decoupling the digital economy from fossil fuel dependent grids.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2000-2021年全球前30大排放国的面板数据，基于扩展的STIRPAT框架，采用第二代PMG-ARDL模型（并以FMOLS和DOLS交叉验证），同时考察绿色金融、制度治理、技术创新和数字化对二氧化碳排放的影响。研究发现绿色金融能显著降低长期排放（验证EKC技术效应），但存在"制度治理悖论"（强治理结构优先支持碳密集型经济增长）、"数字反弹效应"及宏观经济杰文斯悖论（技术创新和数字化扩张反而增加绝对排放量）。
AI.research_question: 哪些宏观经济因素驱动全球前30大排放国的二氧化碳排放？绿色金融、制度治理、技术创新和数字化如何同时影响碳排放？
AI.motivation: 全球碳减排面临严峻挑战，现有研究多孤立考察单一因素对碳排放的影响，缺乏对绿色金融、制度治理、技术创新和数字化等多重宏观经济因素的综合实证分析，尤其对这些因素之间的交互效应（如治理悖论和数字反弹效应）缺乏系统认识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的STIRPAT框架（随机环境影响评估模型）；环境库兹涅茨曲线（EKC）理论；杰文斯悖论（Jevons Paradox）
AI.method: 第二代自回归分布滞后模型结合池化均值组估计（PMG-ARDL），并以完全修正最小二乘法（FMOLS）和动态最小二乘法（DOLS）进行交叉验证；数据覆盖2000-2021年全球前30大排放国。
AI.findings: 1) 绿色金融显著降低长期碳排放，验证了EKC的技术效应；2) 存在"制度治理悖论"——强有力的治理结构目前优先促进碳密集型经济增长而非生态约束；3) 存在"数字反弹效应"和宏观经济杰文斯悖论——泛化的技术创新和数字化扩张反而增加绝对碳排放量。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次同时整合绿色金融、制度治理、技术创新和数字化四重宏观经济因素于STIRPAT框架中；揭示"制度治理悖论"这一新概念，挑战了"强治理必然有利于环保"的传统假设；将杰文斯悖论从微观经济层面扩展到宏观经济实证层面，量化了数字经济的反弹效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球碳中和政策提供实证依据：需放弃增长优先范式、强化环境政策严格度、将数字经济与化石燃料依赖的电网脱钩；为各国制度设计与绿色金融政策提供差异化参考。

title: From Newman to Salman: Informed Trading Penalties and Management Disclosure
affiliations: University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business and University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business

detail.title: From Newman to Salman: Informed Trading Penalties and Management Disclosure
detail.abstract: When prices are noisy, the presence of a few informed investors can cause other investors to demand additional costly disclosures from management. However, it is difficult to empirically identify informed traders' information advantage. This paper exploits the Second Circuit's decision in United States v. Newman (2014), which raised the evidentiary standard for prosecuting certain forms of insider trading by outside investors and increased their ability to trade on material, nonpublic information. This ruling is thus a shock that increased informed traders' trading ability while leaving uninformed traders' information sets unchanged. Post-ruling increases in managerial disclosures can then be attributed to uninformed investor concerns about the increased ability of informed traders to exploit their information advantage. We find that firms subject to Newman significantly increase voluntary public disclosure, particularly management earnings guidance and firm-initiated press releases, by 13% compared to control firms not subject to Newman. These effects reverse when Newman was reversed by the Supreme Court in Salman v. United States (2016). The disclosure effects are stronger in firms with both hedge funds, our proxy for informed investors, and non-hedge fund institutional investors, who are likely both concerned about being at an information disadvantage relative to hedge funds and also have influence over management. These results are also stronger when disclosure is a salient governance practice for the firm's nonhedge fund institutional investors, i.e., when they have other disclosing firms in their portfolio. Finally, the disclosure effects are also stronger when CEOs have higher pre-period stock pricebased incentives, consistent with the idea that investors employ both direct and incentive-based governance practices to induce management to make costly voluntary disclosures.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国第二巡回法院在United States v. Newman (2014)案中的判决作为外生冲击，发现当知情交易者（如对冲基金）的交易能力增强时，非知情投资者会要求管理层增加自愿性信息披露。受Newman判决影响的公司自愿公开披露（尤其是管理层盈利指引和公司主动发布的新闻稿）增加了13%，且这一效应在最高法院Salman案推翻Newman后被逆转。
AI.research_question: 当知情交易者利用信息优势的能力增强时，非知情投资者是否会要求管理层增加自愿性信息披露？
AI.motivation: 价格嘈杂时，少数知情投资者的存在可能促使其他投资者要求管理层增加披露成本较高的信息。然而，实证上难以识别知情交易者的信息优势，本文利用Newman判决这一外生冲击来解决识别问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、知情交易者与非知情投资者之间的信息劣势问题、公司自愿披露的投资者需求理论、委托代理及治理机制理论（直接治理与基于股权的激励机制）
AI.method: 利用Newman判决作为准自然实验的差异中差异（DID）设计；通过比较受Newman约束的公司与不受其约束的控制公司，检验自愿披露的变化；并利用Salman案逆转进行反向验证。
AI.findings: (1) 受Newman影响的公司自愿公开披露增加13%，主要体现在管理层盈利指引和公司主动新闻稿；(2) 最高法院Salman案推翻Newman后效应逆转；(3) 披露效应在对冲基金（知情投资者代理）与非对冲基金机构投资者同时存在的公司中更强；(4) 当披露是公司非对冲基金机构投资者的突出治理实践（投资组合中有其他披露公司）时效应更强；(5) 当CEO持有较高的基于股价的激励时效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 为知情交易者的信息优势如何影响公司自愿披露决策提供了因果证据；揭示了投资者会同时运用直接治理手段（要求披露）和基于激励的治理机制来促使管理层进行成本高昂的自愿披露；区分了知情与非知情投资者的不同角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 对监管机构评估内幕交易执法标准变化对公司信息披露实践的影响具有政策含义；对管理层理解机构投资者结构（对冲基金与非对冲基金并存）如何影响披露策略提供实践指导；对投资者而言，揭示了信息劣势如何驱动对披露的需求。

title: Managerial Tax Attention and Corporate Tax Outcomes
affiliations: University of South Carolina and

detail.title: Managerial Tax Attention and Corporate Tax Outcomes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: We construct a measure of corporate tax attention from the text of quarterly earnings calls for U.S. public firms over 2007 to 2023 using an unsupervised topic model. The measure captures within-firm deviations in the attention corporate executives pay to tax related issues from the firm's own historical same-quarter baseline. We find that elevated tax attention predicts lower cash effective tax rates over horizons of up to three years and generates positive announcement returns. A triple difference-indifferences design exploiting the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 shows that firms with high pre-reform tax attention and high effective tax rates captured the largest post-reform reductions in effective tax rates. Analysts revise earnings forecasts upward and realized earnings subsequently exceed their revised forecasts, consistent with partial incorporation of a signal that is available but costly to extract.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过无监督主题模型，从2007至2023年美国上市公司季度盈利电话会议文本中构建了一个"企业税务关注度"指标，发现税务关注度升高能预测未来三年内更低的现金有效税率，并带来正向公告收益。利用2017年《减税与就业法案》的三重差分设计表明，改革前税务关注度高且有效税率高的企业获得了最大税改后的有效税率降幅。分析师会上调盈利预测，但实际盈利仍超过修正后的预测，表明市场只是部分吸收了这一可得但提取成本较高的信号。
AI.research_question: 企业管理层在电话会议中对税务问题的关注程度（税务关注度）能否预测企业未来的税收规避行为（有效税率下降）及资本市场反应？
AI.motivation: 税务筹划信息通常难以直接观测，现有研究缺乏能够捕捉企业管理层税务关注程度的量化指标。电话会议文本为研究管理层对税务议题的关注提供了丰富的叙事数据，但此前未被系统利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文本分析与主题模型的信息提取理论，结合税收筹划的信号传递理论，以及市场效率理论（信息部分吸收假说）。
AI.method: 使用无监督主题模型（topic model）从美国上市公司2007-2023年季度盈利电话会议文本中构建税务关注度指标，采用企业自身历史同季度基线的组内偏差进行度量；运用三重差分（triple difference-in-differences）设计，利用2017年《减税与就业法案》作为外生冲击。
AI.findings: （1）税务关注度上升能预测未来长达三年的现金有效税率下降；（2）税务关注度公告产生正向的股票收益；（3）在《减税与就业法案》冲击下，改革前税务关注度高且有效税率高的企业获得了最大税改后的有效税率降幅；（4）分析师上调盈利预测但实际盈利仍超过修正后预测，表明信号被部分吸收但提取成本较高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将电话会议文本中的税务关注度作为可量化的预测指标引入税收与资本市场研究，为"管理层口头关注度"到"实际税收筹划行为"之间的传导机制提供了新的理论视角，并验证了市场对高成本信号存在部分吸收的理论预期。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和分析师提供了从公开文本信息中识别企业税收规避潜力的新工具；为政策制定者理解企业税务关注度与税收政策反应之间的关联提供了实证证据。

title: Inferring the Political Weights of Presidential Candidates from Their Tax Policy Proposals
affiliations: and  University of Wisconsin

detail.title: Inferring the Political Weights of Presidential Candidates from Their Tax Policy Proposals

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: We use the method of inverse optimal taxation to infer political weights from the tax policy proposals of recent presidential candidates in the United States. This method allows us to recover the implicit weights these candidates place on taxpayers across the income distribution. We find generally decreasing weights beyond modal income with significant similarities across candidates over time, with the only notable difference at the very high end of the income distribution. Democratic candidates generally place lower weight on highincome taxpayers than Republican candidates. From 2012 to 2024, we note that both parties reduce the political weight they attribute to taxpayers with incomes above $400,000. We also ask whether differences in policy proposals can be explained by heterogeneous beliefs about the behavioral responses to taxes, and find that modest differences in beliefs about taxpayer responses, within the range of credible empirical estimates, can explain significant differences in policies across most of the income distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文运用逆向最优税收方法，从美国近年总统候选人的税收政策提案中推断政治权重，发现候选人对不同收入阶层纳税人的隐含权重总体上随收入超过众数后递减，民主党和共和党候选人在高收入端的权重存在显著差异，且两党在2012至2024年间均降低了对年收入40万美元以上纳税人的政治权重。研究还发现，对纳税人行为反应的信念差异可以在很大程度上解释政策分歧。
AI.research_question: 从美国近年总统候选人的税收政策提案中，能否推断出候选人对不同收入阶层纳税人的政治权重？这些权重有何规律和差异？信念差异能否解释政策分歧？
AI.motivation: 税收政策提案反映了政客对不同群体的政治偏好，但直接的意图难以观测。通过逆向最优税收方法，可以从可观察的政策提案中反推隐含的政治权重，从而揭示不同政党候选人对不同收入群体的重视程度及其演变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 逆向最优税收（inverse optimal taxation）方法，基于最优税收理论框架（Mirrlees模型），从实际税收政策倒推社会福利函数中的政治权重参数。
AI.method: 逆向最优税收方法：从2012至2024年美国总统候选人的税收政策提案出发，利用最优税收理论的反向推导，恢复候选人对不同收入分布上纳税人的隐含政治权重，并检验信念差异对政策分歧的解释力。
AI.findings: （1）所有候选人的政治权重在收入超过众数后普遍递减；（2）不同时期候选人之间的权重模式高度相似；（3）唯一显著差异出现在收入分布的最高端——民主党候选人给予高收入纳税人的权重低于共和党候选人；（4）2012至2024年间，两党均降低了年收入40万美元以上纳税人的政治权重；（5）对纳税人行为反应的适度信念差异（在可信的实证估计范围内）即可解释大多数收入区间内显著的政策分歧。
AI.theory_contributions: 将逆向最优税收方法应用于总统候选人税收提案分析，为政治经济学中理解政党对不同收入群体的偏好提供了新的量化工具和实证证据，并揭示了信念差异在解释政党间政策分歧中的重要理论作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国两党税收政策差异及其演变提供了系统量化证据；揭示了政党在选民权重分配上的结构性模式；为预测未来税收政策走向和评估政策提案背后的政治动机提供了参考。

title: Is Net Inflation the Right Statistic for Credit Spreads, or Are the Two Sides of Inflation Better?
affiliations: Universidad del Pacifico and Pontificia Universidad Católica de Perú

detail.title: Is Net Inflation the Right Statistic for Credit Spreads, or Are the Two Sides of Inflation Better?
detail.abstract: Headline inflation is the difference between the prices that rose and the prices that fell. For credit spreads, that subtraction discards information the two sides carry separately. Using the directional pressure decomposi tion of Quineche and Zapata (2026), we show that both the contribution of sectors raising prices (inflationary pressure) and the contribution of sec tors cutting them (deflationary pressure) enter the U.S. default spread with the same positive sign, each statistically significant, over 1960–2025. The restriction that net inflation is a sufficient statistic—exactly the hypothesis embedded in the empirical work relating credit spreads to inflation—is re jected at p < 0.0001, and entering the two pressures separately rather than as the net rate raises the adjusted R2 of the spread regression from 11 to 35 percent without controls, and from 41 to 51 with them. Both findings are stable across rolling twenty-year windows: the rejection holds in most and the fit gain in all nine. Because any regression with inflation on the right-hand side embeds the netting restriction, the same test is worth running wherever inflation is priced.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Quineche和Zapata(2026)的方向性压力分解方法，证明美国信用利差同时受"通胀压力"（涨价部门的贡献）和"通缩压力"（降价部门的贡献）正向影响（1960-2025年）。检验强烈拒绝"净通胀是充分统计量"的传统假设（p<0.0001），分别纳入两个压力而非净通胀率可将回归R²从11%提升至35%（无控制变量）以及从41%提升至51%（有控制变量）。滚动二十年窗口检验显示结论稳健。
AI.research_question: 信用利差是否应区分通胀压力与通缩压力分别定价，而非将净通胀率作为唯一的充分统计量？
AI.motivation: 传统实证研究将净通胀率作为信用利差的解释变量，隐含假设"涨价与降价信息相互抵消后保留的净值是充分统计量"。但作者指出这一减法丢弃了两方面各自携带的独立信息，可能低估通胀对信用利差的解释力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 方向性压力分解（Quineche & Zapata, 2026）；净通胀充分统计量假设（即净利率为充分统计量的限制性假设）；通胀定价的经典实证框架。
AI.method: 运用方向性压力分解将总通胀拆分为通胀压力与通缩压力两部分；在美国违约利差上进行回归分析（1960-2025年）；通过Wald检验验证"净通胀为充分统计量"的原假设；并采用滚动二十年的窗口进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）通胀压力与通缩压力对违约利差均呈显著正向影响；（2）净通胀充分统计量的限制被强烈拒绝（p<0.0001）；（3）将两部分分别纳入模型显著提升解释力：R²从11%升至35%（无控制变量），从41%升至51%（有控制变量）；（4）稳健性检验显示，拒绝在大部分窗口成立，拟合度提升在全部九个二十年窗口中成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战并拒绝了资产定价/信用利差研究中"净通胀为充分统计量"的传统隐含假设；拓展了通胀定价的理论边界，指出任何以通胀为右侧变量（即从价差中提取净效应）的回归都可能嵌入同样的净化限制而需重新检验。
AI.practical_contributions: 为信用利差建模和预测提供了更精细的通胀分解方法，可显著提升模型拟合度；提示实务界在通胀定价场景中应纳入方向性通胀/通缩压力信息，而非仅依赖净通胀率。

title: Collective Intelligence of Coalitions

detail.title: Collective Intelligence of Coalitions
detail.abstract: We develop Coalition Intelligence Theory, a framework for value creation and vulnerability in coalitions. Each agent carries a capability vector decomposed into magnitude and profile; a coalition is summarized by its profile density matrix, whose spectrum encodes diversity. Coalition value is v(F) = D(F) • R(F), rank diversity times an aggregate resource function. We prove an exact Shapley value decomposition into a rank-weighted base and span-expansion bonus, separating the return on own resources from the premium for expanding the coalition's span. Blind spots are an exact consequence of rank deficiency: the collapse threshold is positive if and only if profiles span capability space. A Spectral Invariance Theorem separates a structural layer-density matrix, entropy, null space, collapse threshold, adaptive capacity-from an economic layer determined by R. Applications to extractive institutions and trade follow: extraction drives diversity toward rank-deficient limits, and profile non-parallelism unifies Ricardian comparative advantage with Heckscher-Ohlin factor endowments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出联盟智能理论（Coalition Intelligence Theory），用能力向量和谱密度矩阵刻画联盟的价值创造与脆弱性，证明Shapley值的精确分解，并揭示盲点源于秩亏缺，进而统一了制度提取、贸易比较优势与要素禀赋等经济学现象。
AI.research_question: 如何从数学上刻画联盟的价值创造机制与脆弱性根源，并解释提取性制度、贸易比较优势与要素禀赋等经济现象？
AI.motivation: 现有联盟理论与经济模型缺乏统一的数学框架来同时解释价值创造、脆弱性（盲点）、制度提取与贸易模式，需要构建一个普适性的联盟分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联盟智能理论（Coalition Intelligence Theory）；谱理论（Spectrum Theory）；Shapley值分解；谱不变定理（Spectral Invariance Theorem）；理嘉图比较优势与赫克歇尔-俄林要素禀赋理论。
AI.method: 数学建模与理论证明。通过能力向量分解（幅值与轮廓）、构建联盟轮廓密度矩阵、利用矩阵谱分析刻画多样性，并严格证明Shapley值的精确分解公式与谱不变定理。
AI.findings: （1）联盟价值可分解为秩多样性乘以聚合资源函数；（2）Shapley值可精确分解为秩加权基数与跨度扩展溢价；（3）盲点是秩亏缺的精确后果，崩溃阈值仅在轮廓张成能力空间时为正；（4）提取性制度使多样性趋向秩亏缺极限；（5）轮廓非平行性统一了理嘉图比较优势与赫克歇尔-俄林要素禀赋理论。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出联盟智能理论，构建了统一的价值创造与脆弱性分析框架；（2）通过谱不变定理将结构层与经济层分离，实现理论上的清晰切割；（3）从数学上证明了盲点与崩溃的秩亏缺本质；（4）用统一的谱框架整合了贸易理论与制度经济学。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为联盟设计与管理提供量化评估工具（通过谱密度矩阵诊断多样性健康度）；（2）为识别组织/制度盲点与崩溃风险提供可操作的数学判据（秩亏缺检测）；（3）为贸易政策与制度设计提供统一的理论指导，帮助理解提取性制度的危害并设计更具韧性的联盟结构。

title: Voluntary but Voidable? Consent, Coercion, and the Limits of Contractual Freedom

detail.title: Voluntary but Voidable? Consent, Coercion, and the Limits of Contractual Freedom
detail.abstract: This Article examines the treatment, across several legal systems, of promises obtained through pressure-in cases of duress and of the exploitation of a state of necessity-and asks to what extent that treatment can be understood as designed to promote economic efficiency. As an operational tool, it proposes the criterion of the invalidity of the extorted contract. Under this criterion, an extorted contract should be held legally valid if the threatening party would carry out the contemplated act if the resulting contract were unenforceable. Unlike the criterion founded on the no-threat world, this criterion makes the legal rule an explicit variable in the analysis, which is its principal contribution. Where the no-threat world locates the rule implicitly within the notion of the "impossibility of threatening," the proposed criterion treats it as an explicit variable and directly identifies its effect on incentives. This reveals the strategic threatener's incentive to conceal from the court, at trial, his own lack of resoluteness by simulating genuine resoluteness. It is this behavior that explains why legal systems in some cases invalidate without exception the contracts arising from a threat, even where doing so harms the victim. The same difficulty of proof, moreover, has two dimensions: alongside the problem of establishing whether the threatener was authentically resolute stands the problem of establishing whether the threat was not engineered-that is, whether the coercive leverage had not been deliberately arranged. These questions bear on conduct never undertaken or on prior intentions that cannot be verified at trial, and both arise in threats of unlawful acts as well as in blackmail, where they converge in justifying the second-best rule of invalidity in every case.

AI.tldr: 本文考察多个法律体系中对通过胁迫（duress）和利用紧急状态（necessity）获得的承诺的处理方式，探讨这种处理在多大程度上可以被理解为旨在促进经济效率。文章提出"被胁迫合同无效性"标准作为操作工具：如果威胁方在合同不可执行时仍会实施其威胁的行为，则该被胁迫合同应被视为有效。与基于"无威胁世界"的标准不同，该标准将法律规则作为分析中的显性变量，这是其主要贡献。该标准揭示了策略性威胁方在审判中隐藏自身缺乏决心的动机，从而解释了为何法律体系在某些情况下即使伤害受害者也要一律废除胁迫合同。证明困难的两个维度（威胁者是否真正决心实施，以及威胁杠杆是否被蓄意安排）共同证明了"一律无效"的二阶最佳规则的合理性。
AI.research_question: 各法律体系对通过胁迫和利用紧急状态获得的承诺的处理方式，在多大程度上可以被理解为旨在促进经济效率？如何设计一个操作性的法律有效性标准来评估这一处理？
AI.motivation: 现有基于"无威胁世界"的效率分析标准将法律规则隐含地置于"威胁不可能性"的概念之中，未能将法律规则本身作为分析中的显性变量，从而无法充分解释法律实践中出现的各种现象（如即使伤害受害者也要一律宣告胁迫合同无效的规定）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济效率分析框架，交易成本与信息经济学（特别是"隐藏决心"的博弈论/信息不对称分析），法律与经济学（Law and Economics）范式。
AI.method: 比较法分析（对比多个法律体系对胁迫和紧急状态利用的处理），结合经济学分析（提出"被胁迫合同无效性"标准作为操作性工具），通过博弈论/激励分析揭示策略性威胁方的行为模式。
AI.findings: （1）提出"被胁迫合同无效性"标准：若威胁方在合同不可执行时仍会实施威胁行为，则被胁迫合同应有效；（2）该标准将法律规则作为显性变量，优于将规则隐含于"无威胁世界"之中的传统标准；（3）揭示了策略性威胁方有动机在审判中通过伪装决心来误导法庭；（4）证明困难的二维性——既需证明威胁者是否真正决心实施威胁，也需证明威胁杠杆是否被蓄意安排——共同解释了为何法律体系在部分情形下一律宣告胁迫合同无效；（5）在非法行为威胁和敲诈勒索情形中，两个证明困难维度趋同，共同证成"一律无效"的二阶最佳规则。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出"被胁迫合同无效性"标准，将法律规则作为分析中的显性变量，弥补了基于"无威胁世界"标准将规则隐含处理的不足；（2）从信息不对称和证明困难角度为"一律宣告无效"的法律规则提供了经济效率上的正当化解释；（3）将敲诈勒索与非法行为威胁统一在同一个效率分析框架之下。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和司法者提供了评估胁迫合同有效性的操作性标准（即考察威胁方在合同不可执行时是否仍会实施威胁行为），并揭示了司法证明中面临的两个关键困难维度（威胁者决心与威胁杠杆的蓄意安排），为法律实践中"一律无效"规则的设计提供了经济效率上的理论依据。

title: The Urban Rent Trap: Education and the Paradox of Homeownership in Ghana

detail.title: The Urban Rent Trap: Education and the Paradox of Homeownership in Ghana
detail.abstract: Higher educational attainment is generally expected to promote homeownership by raising lifetime income, savings and creditworthiness. This relationship depends, however, on housing institutions capable of converting labour-market advantage into ownership. Using a nationally representative 10% sample of Ghana's 2021 Population and Housing Census, comprising 322,044 urban household heads aged 30 and above, we find the opposite pattern. University graduates have a 6.4 percentage-point lower adjusted probability of owner-occupation than household heads with no formal education, after controlling for demographic, socioeconomic, housing and spatial characteristics. A Fairlie decomposition shows that observed characteristics account for 51% of the 10.1 percentage-point graduate ownership gap, even though graduates' wealth advantage should offset part of that difference. The disadvantage is largest at younger and middle ages and reverses only after age 60. We develop the concept of the Urban Rent Trap to explain this inverse gradient in a housing system where mortgage credit is negligible, rent is commonly paid in large advances, and ownership depends heavily on incremental self-building. The findings point to an institutional mismatch between the resources generated by education and those required to secure owner-occupation through Ghana's predominantly self-build housing pathway. They extend debates on education, Generation Rent and tenure inequality beyond mortgage-centred housing systems.

AI.tldr: 基于加纳2021年人口与住房普查10%全国代表性样本（30岁及以上城市户主322,044人），研究发现大学毕业生拥有自有住房的概率比无正规教育者低6.4个百分点，且这一劣势在60岁后才逆转。作者提出"城市租金陷阱"概念解释这一反向梯度，指出教育资源与以自建住房为主导的住房制度之间存在制度性错配。
AI.research_question: 在住房制度不具备将劳动力市场优势转化为住房所有权能力的背景下，高等教育程度与住房自有率之间呈现何种关系？
AI.motivation: 传统理论认为高等教育通过提高终身收入、储蓄和信用能力促进住房自有，但这一关系依赖于能够将劳动力市场优势转化为所有权的住房制度。现有研究主要聚焦于抵押贷款主导的住房体系，对以自建住房为主导的非西方住房制度的探讨不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度错配理论（institutional mismatch）、住房获取路径理论、代际住房不平等理论（Generation Rent）
AI.method: 使用加纳2021年人口与住房普查10%全国代表性样本（N=322,044），采用调整后概率模型（控制人口、社会经济、住房与空间特征），并运用Fairlie分解方法量化可观测特征对毕业生产权差距的贡献。
AI.findings: （1）大学毕业生拥有自有住房的调整后概率比无正规教育者低6.4个百分点；（2）Fairlie分解显示可观测特征解释了10.1个百分点毕业生产权差距的51%；（3）劣势在青年和中年阶段最大，60岁后逆转；（4）毕业生财富优势并未抵消其住房劣势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"城市租金陷阱"（Urban Rent Trap）概念，揭示在抵押信贷匮乏、租金预付额高、依赖渐进式自建住房的住房体系中教育优势难以转化为住房所有权，扩展了关于教育、Generation Rent和产权不平等的理论讨论，超越了以抵押贷款为中心的住房体系分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加纳及其他以自建住房为主导的发展中国家提供政策启示，指出需要改革住房制度（如抵押信贷供给、租金支付方式），以消除教育获得与住房获取之间的制度性障碍。

title: The Mathematics of Dominance: A Power-Function Analysis of Compute Concentration in U.S. Artificial Intelligence Policy, 2025-2026

detail.title: The Mathematics of Dominance: A Power-Function Analysis of Compute Concentration in U.S. Artificial Intelligence Policy, 2025-2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or non-financial conflicts of interest relevant to the subject matter of this manuscript. The theoretical constructs presented — the Power Function, Rule Function, Enforcement Probability Function, Automated Enforcement Equation, Tyranny Condition, Distributed Agency variable, Negotiation-Space Collapse Function, and STEM-EMCI workforce framework — are the author's original contributions, developed in parallel scholarly work in preparation. The author holds no equity, consulting, or advisory relationships with any of the corporate entities analyzed in the paper (including OpenAI, Oracle, SoftBank, MGX, NVIDIA, Intel, Cadence Design Systems, ASML, JLL, CBRE, or any other named firm).
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This manuscript is a theoretical and forensic policy analysis. It did not involve human subjects, animal subjects, patient data, clinical intervention, or any research activity requiring ethics-committee review or Institutional Review Board approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. No commercial, foundation, governmental, or institutional support was provided for the preparation of this manuscript.

detail.abstract: This paper formalizes a multiplicative power function, P_i = W_i · R_i · E_i, where W_i denotes force capacity, R_i denotes resource control, and E_i denotes enforcement capacity, and applies it to the forensic analysis of five major United States artificial intelligence policy instruments enacted between January 2025 and December 2025. The analysis is anchored empirically in two datasets: Epoch AI's longitudinal tracking of frontier-model training compute, which documents an approximately 4–5x annual growth rate since 2020, and the publicly disclosed scale of the Stargate infrastructure initiative, a $500 billion, four-year, 10-gigawatt buildout led by OpenAI, Oracle, SoftBank, and MGX. The paper argues that America's AI Action Plan, the Advancing Artificial Intelligence Education for American Youth executive order (EO 14,277), the Preparing Americans for High-Paying Skilled Trade Jobs of the Future executive order (EO 14,278), the Genesis Mission executive order (EO 14,363), Stargate, and federal AI research funding structures share a common mathematical signature: each instrument increases R_i and E_i for already-dominant actors while leaving a variable termed Distributed Agency (D_a) unchanged or in decline. A formal Enforcement Probability Function and an Automated Enforcement Equation are introduced to model how compute concentration translates into behavioral control at national scale. The paper closes by proposing distributed-agency countermeasures — operationalized through a STEM-EMCI (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics — Electronical, Mechanical, Clerical, Industrial) workforce framework — and specifying explicit falsifiability conditions for each major claim, consistent with a heuristic-modeling methodology rather than a calibrated predictive one.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了一个乘性权力函数 P_i = W_i · R_i · E_i（力量容量、资源控制、执行容量），并将其应用于2025年1月至12月间美国五项主要AI政策工具的取证分析，论证这些政策共同增强了既有主导行为者的R_i和E_i，而"分布式能动性"（D_a）则保持不变或下降。
AI.research_question: 美国2025年颁布的主要人工智能政策工具在权力分配结构上呈现怎样的共同数学特征？这些政策如何影响不同行为者的权力分布与分布式能动性？
AI.motivation: 随着前沿模型训练算力自2020年以来以约4-5倍的年增长率扩张，以及Stargate计划（5000亿美元、四年、10吉瓦）等大型基础设施项目的推进，AI权力急剧集中。需要对美国AI政策进行系统的取证分析，揭示其在权力结构层面的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 乘性权力函数（P_i = W_i · R_i · E_i）、分布式能动性（Distributed Agency, D_a）、执行概率函数（Enforcement Probability Function）、自动化执行方程（Automated Enforcement Equation）、启发式建模方法论（heuristic-modeling methodology）
AI.method: 形式化建模与政策取证分析。基于Epoch AI的前沿模型训练算力纵向数据和Stargate基础设施计划的公开披露规模，对五项美国AI政策工具进行数学框架下的系统分析，并提出STEM-EMCI劳动力框架作为反制措施。
AI.findings: 所有被分析的政策工具（AI行动计划、EO 14,277、EO 14,278、EO 14,363、Stargate及联邦AI研究资助结构）共享同一数学特征：增加了已主导行为者的R_i和E_i，同时使D_a保持不变或下降；算力集中通过执行概率函数转化为国家层面的行为控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了乘性权力函数的正式化框架，引入分布式能动性（D_a）概念，建立执行概率函数与自动化执行方程，为AI政策分析提供了可证伪的数学模型而非仅依赖于描述性叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了STEM-EMCI劳动力框架作为分布式能动性的反制措施，并指定了每项主要主张的明确可证伪条件，为政策制定者和社会行动者提供了可操作的应对路径。

title:
Pilar Cero: Methodological Foundations for an Instrument-by-Instrument Traceability Audit of Venezuelan Sovereign Debt 
An institutional, normative, and evidentiary architecture for the restructuring of Venezuela's public debt

detail.title:
Pilar Cero: Methodological Foundations for an Instrument-by-Instrument Traceability Audit of Venezuelan Sovereign Debt 
An institutional, normative, and evidentiary architecture for the restructuring of Venezuela's public debt

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial, personal, professional, or institutional conflicts of interest that could have influenced the analysis, methodology, or conclusions presented in this manuscript
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This manuscript develops a legal and methodological analysis of the ex ante traceability audit required in sovereign bond debt restructuring. The research is based exclusively on the analysis of legal sources, international standards, public documentation, and doctrinal materials. It does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental research requiring ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and received no external funding from any public, private, commercial, or non-profit organization

detail.abstract: This study introduces a methodological approach aimed at evaluating the traceability of the twenty-four Venezuelan sovereign debt instruments (Republic and PDVSA bonds) prior to any restructuring initiatives. The primary consideration is a gap in the judicial records: the penalties imposed in the Southern District of Florida target natural persons involved with the Venezuelan Treasury's management between 2007 and 2013, excluding specific financial instruments. This paper posits that the existing gap can only be bridged via a methodological framework anchored in three verifiable pillars, rather than through journalistic conjecture or political assumptions: (i) the institutional backing of the International Monetary Fund and the Egmont Group of Financial Intelligence Units; (ii) the normative guidelines of the Financial Action Task Force, specifically Recommendations 24 and 25 on beneficial ownership and Recommendations 4 and 38 on confiscation and asset recovery; and (iii) the evidentiary traceability standard articulated under United States civil forfeiture law, codified in Title 18, Section 981 of the United States Code. The study determines that restructuring Venezuelan national debt should not occur without an initial forensic traceability audit, facilitated by the Egmont Group, implementing these three core tenets across the entire spectrum of instruments.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种方法论框架，用于在委内瑞拉主权债务重组前评估24种主权债务工具（共和国债券和PDVSA债券）的可追溯性。该方法基于三大支柱：IMF和埃格蒙特集团机构背书、FATF建议24/25（受益所有权）和4/38（没收与资产追回）的规范指引、以及美国民事没收法（18 U.S.C. §981）的证据可追溯标准。研究结论认为，委内瑞拉国家债务重组不应在缺乏由埃格蒙特集团协助的初步法证可追溯审计的情况下进行。
AI.research_question: 如何在委内瑞拉主权债务重组之前，通过可验证的方法论框架来评估24种委内瑞拉主权债务工具（共和国债券和PDVSA债券）的可追溯性，以填补司法记录中的空白？
AI.motivation: 司法记录存在空白：佛罗里达南区法院对2007-2013年间参与委内瑞拉财政部管理人员的处罚仅针对自然人，未涵盖具体金融工具，因此需要通过方法论而非新闻猜测或政治假设来弥合这一差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三大支柱： (i) IMF和埃格蒙特集团金融情报单位的机构支持；(ii) FATF建议24/25（受益所有权）和建议4/38（没收与资产追回）的规范指引；(iii) 美国民事没收法（Title 18, Section 981）下阐述的证据可追溯性标准。
AI.method: 提出一种方法论方法，整合三大可验证支柱来评估债务工具的可追溯性，不依赖新闻猜测或政治假设。
AI.findings: 研究确定，委内瑞拉国家债务重组不应在没有由埃格蒙特集团协助的初步法证可追溯审计的情况下进行，该审计应在全部24种债务工具范围内实施三大核心原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种结合国际金融机构（IMF）、金融情报网络（埃格蒙特集团）、反洗钱金融行动特别工作组（FATF）规范和美国民事没收法标准的多层次方法论框架，为债务工具的可追溯性评估提供了制度化和规范化的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为委内瑞拉主权债务重组提供了实践指导，即必须先进行法证可追溯审计（由埃格蒙特集团协调），在所有24种债务工具中实施三大核心原则，以避免在不了解资金流向和受益所有权的情况下贸然进行债务重组。

title: Costs and Benefits of United States Data Centers for Host Communities and the Nation

detail.title: Costs and Benefits of United States Data Centers for Host Communities and the Nation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a partner at Gasilov Group, a US-based environmental and energy consultancy. The firm has no financial relationship with data center operators, developers, or utilities, and no client had any role in the design, analysis, or conclusions of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves no human subjects or participants and uses only publicly available secondary data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was conducted by the author using publicly available data.

detail.abstract: County boards approving data centers and the residents opposing them are reading the same facilities and reaching opposite conclusions, and both are correct about the evidence they can see. On the audited numbers a permitting hearing receives, meaning tax payments, water billings and reported emissions, the 590 host counties gain USD 8 billion per year with no negative draws. On the full set of measurable costs and benefits, evaluated against the comparison a siting decision involves, the same counties pay USD 1.49 in costs per USD 1.00 received and lose in 90 percent of 10,000 simulations. The comparison in question is the same facility built in another United States county, because the 2023 fleet was being built somewhere regardless of any single county's approval. The nation gains USD 24 billion per year from the 2023 fleet, roughly 3.6 times the local loss, and no existing mechanism returns any of that gain to the counties bearing the costs. The air pollution from powering the fleet concentrates on Black Americans, who face 1.18 times the average exposure, and on the poorest fifth of counties, which face 24 percent more than average. These results come from a ledger of 54 cost and benefit categories registered before analysis, monetized for 29 categories from 52 public datasets, and evaluated across three evidence standards, three alternatives and three geographic scales through 10,000 simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建包含54类成本收益类目的核算框架，评估了美国2023年590个数据中心所在县的净效益，发现从许可听证会所依据的审计数据看，这些县每年获益80亿美元且无负面项目；但若考虑全部可衡量的成本效益并与"设施建在其他县"的反事实情境比较，每获得1美元需付出1.49美元成本，在10,000次模拟中90%的情形下为净损失。然而从国家层面看，2023年数据中心舰队每年为国家带来240亿美元净收益，约为地方损失的3.6倍，但现有机制无法将国家收益返还给承担成本的地方县。空气污染负担不成比例地落在黑人群体（暴露量为平均值的1.18倍）和最贫困的五分之一县（高出平均24%）。
AI.research_question: 数据中心选址对所在县的净社会效益究竟如何？为什么地方政府批准与居民反对之间出现巨大分歧？
AI.motivation: 数据中心建设在美国各县引发激烈争议——县政府批准而居民反对，双方对同一设施得出相反结论。作者认为需要澄清这种分歧的根源，区分"许可听证会所见的审计数据"与"完整的可衡量成本效益"，并引入正确的比较基准（不在本县建则建在其他县），以评估数据中心对地方和国家的真实净效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本效益分析框架；反事实比较逻辑（边际选址决策）；外部性理论（空气污染的分配不均）；多层次福利核算（地方vs国家层面的效益归属与分配）
AI.method: 构建包含54个成本与效益类目的核算账本（在分析前预先登记），对其中29个类目利用52个公共数据集进行货币化，在三种证据标准、三种替代方案和三种地理尺度下，通过10,000次模拟进行稳健性评估。
AI.findings: (1) 从许可听证会依据的审计数据看，590个宿主县每年获益80亿美元且无负面项；(2) 从完整可衡量成本效益看，这些县每获得1美元承担1.49美元成本，10,000次模拟中90%为净损失；(3) 国家层面每年净获益240亿美元，约为地方损失的3.6倍，但无机制将国家收益返还地方；(4) 空气污染暴露不成比例：黑人群体为平均值的1.18倍，最贫困五分之一县高出24%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"审计数据vs完整账本"的双重视角来解释地方决策分歧；引入正确的反事实基准（边际选址决策）来评估数据中心的地方净效益；揭示了国家收益与地方成本之间缺乏再分配机制的制度性缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政策制定者提供完整核算框架，帮助理解数据中心批准决策的全成本效益图景；为环境公平政策提供证据（空气污染的环境不公分配）；为国家层面的补偿或再分配机制设计提供实证基础。

title: Endogenous Wrong-Way Risk: A Balance-Sheet-Consistent Model for Credit Valuation Adjustment

detail.title: Endogenous Wrong-Way Risk: A Balance-Sheet-Consistent Model for Credit Valuation Adjustment
detail.abstract: Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) is mandatory under Basel III, representing the market price of counterparty credit risk. A key challenge is wrong-way risk (WWR), where exposure increases as the counterparty's credit quality deteriorates. WWR is not explicitly captured in Basel III, and existing models either treat the correlation between exposure and default as exogenous or rely on adjustment. We eliminate this free parameter by embedding the counterparty's balance sheet in a stochastic accounting space that enforces double-entry identity pathwise. Asset subaccounts follow correlated geometric Brownian motions; the risk-neutral measure is obtained via an Esscher transform. We derive the correlation between the exposure-driving asset and the counterparty's total assets endogenously as a function of observable portfolio weights, segment volatilities, and cross-asset correlations. This endogenous correlation determines whether the counterparty exhibits wrong-way or right-way risk. The resulting CVA formula is fully specified by balance-sheet data, with no free correlation parameter. Numerical simulation via Monte Carlo validates the closed-form solution. Sensitivity analysis reveals threshold effects: the sign of the endogenous correlation changes with balance-sheet composition, and WWR magnification can exceed 150% for counterparties with strongly negatively correlated assets. These findings have direct implications for assessment of CVA capital charges under Basel III.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种消除信用估值调整（CVA）中错误方向风险（WWR）自由参数的新方法，通过将交易对手资产负债表嵌入满足复式记账恒等式的随机会计空间，利用Esscher变换获得风险中性测度，内生推导出敞口驱动资产与交易对手总资产之间的相关性。该内生相关性决定了交易对手呈现错误方向风险还是正确方向风险，由此得到的CVA公式完全由资产负债表数据确定，无需任何自由相关参数。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了解析解，敏感性分析揭示了阈值效应和强负相关资产下WWR放大效应可超过150%的现象。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖外生自由参数的情况下，在Basel III框架下准确刻画CVA中的错误方向风险（WWR）？
AI.motivation: Basel III强制要求CVA作为交易对手信用风险的市场价格，但WWR未被明确纳入且现有模型要么将敞口与违约的相关性视为外生参数，要么依赖调整因子。这种自由参数缺乏经济基础，可能导致资本计量的偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机会计框架（stochastic accounting space）、复式记账恒等式、几何布朗运动、Esscher变换、风险中性定价理论
AI.method: 将交易对手资产负债表嵌入随机会计空间，资产子账户遵循相关的几何布朗运动，通过Esscher变换获得风险中性测度，推导内生相关性的闭式解，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟进行数值验证和敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 内生相关性可完全由可观察的资产组合权重、分段波动率和跨资产相关性确定；相关性符号随资产负债表构成变化呈阈值效应；对于强负相关的资产，WWR放大效应可超过150%。
AI.theory_contributions: 消除了CVA模型中WWR自由参数的理论缺陷，将敞口-违约相关性从外生假设转变为基于资产负债表结构的內生推导，推进了随机会计与信用风险定价理论的融合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Basel III下的CVA资本计量提供了无需自由参数的实操方法，可直接依据资产负债表数据进行资本估算，有助于监管机构和金融机构更准确地评估WWR风险暴露。

title: Varying Status Quo Conditions in Stated Preference Surveys: Empirical Evidence for Water Quality
affiliations: and University of Saskatchewan

detail.title: Varying Status Quo Conditions in Stated Preference Surveys: Empirical Evidence for Water Quality
detail.abstract: This study examines how current conditions shape people's preferences for public policies that improve environmental quality. We use a stated preference survey with experimentally varied status quo levels in a setting with a spatially explicit freshwater health score across a wide geographic area. We provide causal evidence that people have a higher willingness to pay when status quo water quality levels are worse. These findings highlight the importance of accurately describing the status quo condition in stated preference studies. This study also provides empirical insights into the monetized economic benefits of landscape-wide water quality improvements in Canada. We find that the public's willingness to pay for water quality improvements varies by spatial scale and proximity to the policy site. Local improvements in home basins or sub-basins are estimated to have a higher willingness to pay than distant ones. Recreational users have substantially higher willingness to pay, underscoring the joint role of non-use and use values.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过陈述偏好调查（实验性操控现状水平）探究现状条件如何影响公众对改善水质公共政策的支付意愿。研究发现，当现状水质较差时，公众支付意愿更高；支付意愿还随空间尺度和距离而变化，当地改善的支付意愿高于远处改善，娱乐使用者支付意愿显著更高。研究为加拿大全景观水质改善的经济效益提供了实证估算。
AI.research_question: 当前（现状）条件如何影响人们对改善环境质量的公共政策的偏好？具体包括：现状水质水平如何影响支付意愿？支付意愿如何随空间尺度、距离以及使用者类型而变化？
AI.motivation: 陈述偏好研究中现状条件的设定可能显著影响公众偏好和支付意愿的估计，但现有研究对此关注不足；同时对景观层面（landscape-wide）水质改善的经济效益缺乏系统实证估算。
AI.theoretical_framework: 陈述偏好理论（stated preference）；支付意愿（WTP）理论基础（包含使用价值与非使用价值）；现状偏差/锚定效应相关理论。
AI.method: 采用陈述偏好调查方法，通过实验性操控现状水平（status quo levels），在加拿大广阔地理区域内使用空间显式淡水健康评分（spatially explicit freshwater health score）作为实验场景，收集并分析公众支付意愿数据。
AI.findings: 1) 现状水质越差，公众支付意愿越高（因果证据）；2) 支付意愿随空间尺度变化：本地（家庭流域或子流域）水质改善的支付意愿高于远处改善；3) 娱乐使用者的支付意愿显著更高；4) 研究揭示了使用价值与非使用价值的共同作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为现状条件如何影响陈述偏好研究中的支付意愿提供了因果证据，强调准确描述现状条件的重要性；深化了对使用价值与非使用价值在环境支付意愿中联合作用的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大景观级水质改善政策提供了货币化经济效益的实证估算，为政策制定者进行成本效益分析和资源配置提供了参考依据。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks Integrated with an SVIR Model for Influenza Forecasting in Mexico
affiliations: University of Dhaka, Department of Economics East West University A/2, Jahurul Islam Avenue, Jahurul Islam City, Aftabnagar, Dhaka-1212, Bangladesh - East West University, University of Dhaka and University of Dhaka

detail.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks Integrated with an SVIR Model for Influenza Forecasting in Mexico
detail.abstract: Neural network (NN) models are widely used at present for forecasting infectious diseases. However, NN models are primarily data-driven, making them less effective when the available data are insufficient or noisy. Physics-informed neural network (PINN) models are special type of NN models that integrate both data and underlying physical laws governed by differential equations, making them more suitable for incorporation into mathematical models and improving forecasting accuracy. The aim of this study is to integrate a Susceptible-Vaccinated-Infected-Recovered (SVIR) model into three NN models, namely feedforward neural network (FNN), long short term memory (LSTM), and convolutional neural network (CNN) to forecast influenza cases in Mexico. In the first part, a deterministic SVIR model is formulated and standard mathematical analyses are performed, including the determination of equilibrium points and the basic reproduction number. In addition, local and global stability criteria are analyzed and existence of transcritical bifurcation phenomenon is examined near the disease free equilibrium. Sensitivity analysis reveals that the transmission rate and the recovery rate are the most influential parameters in controlling influenza propagation. In the second part, influenza case data spanning 120 weeks are used to train and test the three PINN models in conjunction with the SVIR differential equations. The performance of the models is evaluated using RMSE and MAE as error metrics. The results show that CNN model achieves the lowest RMSE and MAE values in both training and testing phases, demonstrating superior performance compared to the other two models. Finally, the SVIR deterministic model and all three SVIR-PINN models are used to generate forecasts for an additional 10 weeks. The findings of this study can assist the policymakers make better decisions to control the spread of influenza.

AI.tldr: 本研究将SVIR流行病学模型与三种神经网络（FNN、LSTM、CNN）集成，构建物理信息神经网络（PINN）模型，用于预测墨西哥流感病例。研究首先对确定性SVIR模型进行数学分析（平衡点、基本再生数、稳定性及分岔分析），随后用120周流感数据训练和测试三种PINN模型，发现CNN模型在RMSE和MAE指标上表现最优，最后生成未来10周的预测。
AI.research_question: 如何将SVIR流行病学模型与神经网络模型（FNN、LSTM、CNN）集成，以提高流感病例预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统神经网络模型纯数据驱动，在数据不足或有噪声时效果不佳；物理信息神经网络（PINN）能融合数据和微分方程所描述的物理规律，有望提高传染病预测的准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: SVIR流行病学模型（易感-接种-感染-康复）、物理信息神经网络（PINN）、基本再生数理论、稳定性分析（局部与全局）、跨临界分岔理论、敏感性分析
AI.method: 首先构建确定性SVIR模型并进行数学分析（平衡点、基本再生数、局部与全局稳定性、跨临界分岔、敏感性分析）；然后将SVIR微分方程嵌入三种神经网络（FNN、LSTM、CNN）构建PINN模型，使用墨西哥120周流感数据进行训练和测试，以RMSE和MAE为评价指标。
AI.findings: CNN-PINN模型在训练和测试阶段的RMSE和MAE均最低，性能优于FNN和LSTM模型；敏感性分析表明传播率和恢复率是控制流感传播最关键的参数。
AI.theory_contributions: 将SVIR流行病学模型与三种不同架构的神经网络系统性地集成，扩展了物理信息神经网络在传染病预测领域的应用；通过严格的数学分析（稳定性、分岔、敏感性）为流行病学建模提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更精确的流感病例预测工具，帮助其在数据有限或存在噪声的情况下做出更好的防控决策，有效控制流感的传播。

title: Black-Scholes Option Pricing and An Instantaneous Isomorphism of the Feynman-Kac Path Limit
affiliations: University of Toledo and The John B. and Lillian E. Neff Department of Finance, University of Toledo

detail.title: Black-Scholes Option Pricing and An Instantaneous Isomorphism of the Feynman-Kac Path Limit
detail.abstract: Traditional option pricing orthodoxy relies on risk-neutral replication to eliminate real-world asset returns from the governing probability density function (PDF). This paper establishes that the true, unhedged option path is simultaneously driven by two distinct forces: actual expected stock and option returns, and strict contractual boundary constraints. Because this real-world system lacks a known, global analytical solution, we seek a structurally identical, isomorphic expression with an established solution domain. Building upon the foundational framework of Moore's R and the variable-drift Fokker-Planck density models (Moore, 2023a), we demonstrate that by solving the return-laden Feynman-Kac equation instantaneously, we create a valid, second-by-second isomorphism.
