title: Using Business Law to Build Labor Power
affiliations: Indiana University Maurer School of Law

detail.title: Using Business Law to Build Labor Power

publicationDetails.detailsText: Indiana Legal Studies Research Paper No. 591
publicationDetails.journalName: Indiana University Maurer School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This Essay seeks to initiate a conversation amongst scholars who study labor law and social movement lawyering regarding the role of business law in building labor power. Social movement lawyering literature tends to focus on how law shapes social movements. However, the use of business law as a tool for building worker power is under-explored. That is a mistake. This Essay brings insights from Law and Political Economy, social movement, and business law literature into conversation with each other. It then provides four concrete examples of how the labor movement can use business law, specifically bankruptcy and corporate law, as tools for building worker power.

AI.tldr: 本文呼吁劳动法与社会运动法律行动研究者关注商业法在构建劳工权力中的作用，提出将法律与政治经济学、社会运动及商业法文献相结合，并通过破产法和公司法四个具体案例展示劳工运动如何利用商业法增强工人权力。
AI.research_question: 商业法（特别是破产法和公司法）如何作为构建劳工权力的工具被劳工运动所利用？
AI.motivation: 社会运动法律行动文献主要关注法律如何塑造社会运动，但商业法作为构建工人权力的工具尚未得到充分探索，这是一个研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与政治经济学（Law and Political Economy）、社会运动理论、商业法文献的跨学科对话。
AI.method: 概念性文章（Essay），采用跨学科文献对话与规范性论证，辅以四个具体案例的例证分析。
AI.findings: 劳工运动可以运用商业法（特别是破产法和公司法）作为构建工人权力的工具，文中提供了四个具体示例加以论证。
AI.theory_contributions: 将劳动法、社会运动法律行动与商业法研究连接起来，填补了商业法在工人权力构建中的研究空白，拓展了社会运动法律行动的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为劳工运动实践者提供利用破产法和公司法构建工人权力的具体策略与方向，有助于推动劳工权益保障的实际行动。

title: Frozen-Fault Re-Injection: A Failure Regime in Unattended Agentic Loops

detail.title: Frozen-Fault Re-Injection: A Failure Regime in Unattended Agentic Loops

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and operator of BizBuilder, Inc., the customer-acquisition system described in this paper as Site A. The author also designed the corporate-memory system described as Site B and led its stabilization. The empirical observations from both sites are drawn from the author's direct experience building and operating those systems. Neither site is an independent replication of the other, and this dual role is disclosed and discussed in the paper at Sections 3.1, 8.3, and 9.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved no human participants and no patient data, so ethics approval was not required. Both sites are software systems, and the analyzed material consists of operational telemetry and engineering incident records produced in the course of the author's own work on those systems. All organizations and individuals appearing in the source records are tokenized, and no personal data is reported in the paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The author is the founder of BizBuilder, Inc., which operates the system studied as Site A. The Site B engagement is disclosed in the Declaration of Interest above.

detail.abstract: On the ninth day of a recurring failure in a production agentic pipeline, a scheduled routine's briefing produced a passage that labeled itself an "unattended-mode rule" and instructed the routine to skip the human-confirmation gate of its own procedure. The false context behind it had been re-injected by a frozen source on seven documented runs across a nine-day span: a trigger prompt authored once, edited once the next morning, never revisited, and replayed by a daily 03:00 cron. Downstream checks caught the falsehood on every documented run. None corrected the source. This paper names the regime frozen-fault re-injection and argues it is structurally distinct from the traveling cascades the multi-agent failure literature models: a traveling fault weakens or compounds as it crosses stages, and independent checkpoints arrest it; a frozen fault re-enters at undiminished strength on every cycle, re-rolling its consequences each time, and only distrust of the source arrests it. The evidence is an eighteen-day insider field case of a ten-step corporate-memory pipeline in production at a mid-size company (54 logged incidents, anonymized; the author designed the system, a fact disclosed and priced throughout). The case yields a measurable construct, the correction-latency gap: faults were detected in hours and corrected at their source in zero to eleven days, or never. A second site, a customer-acquisition pipeline instrumented as a pre-registered research apparatus, supplies validation machinery and one measured base rate: 50 of 114 real product profiles (44%) carry no pricing signal at all, on a field the pipeline's original interface silently assumed was always present, and without an explicit abstain state every one of them receives a fabricated confident price band. No proposition from the predecessor paper is claimed as confirmed. The paper contributes the named regime, its first documented specimen, the construct, and a pre-registered program for testing both.

AI.tldr: 本文命名并提出"冻结故障再注入"（frozen-fault re-injection）这一新的失效机制，与多智能体级联失效文献中的"旅行级联"（traveling cascade）形成结构性区分。文章基于一个18天的内部田野案例（54条记录、10步企业记忆流水线）提出"修正延迟缺口"（correction-latency gap）作为可测量构念，并以预注册的第二站点研究提供验证机制和基线数据（44%的产品档案缺少定价信号却仍被生成虚构定价区间）。
AI.research_question: 在周期性运行的智能体流水线中，由冻结源头反复注入的持续错误（frozen-fault re-injection）是否构成一种与既有文献中的旅行级联（traveling cascade）结构性不同的失效机制？其特征与可测度构念是什么？
AI.motivation: 生产环境中反复出现同一虚假上下文、下游检查反复拦截却从未修正源头——这种"冻结故障"现象无法被现有级联失效模型解释：旅行故障会随阶段传播而削弱或累积且可被独立检查点遏制，而冻结故障在每个周期以不减弱的强度重新进入系统并重新掷骰其后果，唯有对源头的不信任才能遏制。现有文献缺乏对这一机制的概念化、经验证据与度量化工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文以失效机制的类型学为基础，区分"旅行级联"（traveling cascade，跨阶段传播、被独立检查点遏制）与"冻结故障再注入"（frozen-fault re-injection，以完整强度周期性重入、仅对源头不信任可遏制）。引入"修正延迟缺口"（correction-latency gap）作为度量检测与源头修正之间时间差的构念，并引入"弃权状态"（abstain state）作为防止虚构输出的设计边界。
AI.method: 方法为双站点混合设计：（1）第一站点：18天内部田野案例，来自中型公司10步企业记忆流水线的生产环境，54条匿名日志事件，作者为该系统的设计者（该身份已披露并全程计价）；（2）第二站点：客户获取流水线，作为预注册研究装置进行仪器化，提供验证机制，并对114个真实产品档案测量定价信号缺失的基线率。
AI.findings: 关键发现：（1）冻结故障在9天7次运行中被下游检查全部拦截，但源头从未被修正——下游检测与源头修正之间存在"修正延迟缺口"（0至11天，或永不复正）；（2）第二站点测得44%的真实产品档案（50/114）完全没有定价信号，而原始接口静默假设该字段始终存在，导致无显式弃权状态时每个档案都生成虚构的"自信定价区间"。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：（1）命名并界定"冻结故障再注入"这一与旅行级联结构不同的失效机制，拓展多智能体失效文献的类型学；（2）提出并经验化"修正延迟缺口"构念，为检测与修正的分离提供可度量工具；（3）通过双站点设计与预注册程序，建立可检验该机制与构念的研究方案，且明确声明不宣称确认前任论文的任何命题。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：（1）为生产环境智能体流水线提供诊断性警示：周期性调度（如cron）会放大冻结故障的风险，下游检查无法取代源头治理；（2）提供可移植的测量方法（修正延迟缺口）评估系统的检测-修正闭环效率；（3）提供明确的工程建议——为系统中静默假设的字段显式设置弃权状态，避免为缺失数据生成虚构输出。

title: Strategic Water Resource Allocation Under Climate Change: An Economic Decision Framework for the Mediterranean and North African Region
affiliations: , University of Ain Temouchent and University of Ain Temouchent

detail.title: Strategic Water Resource Allocation Under Climate Change: An Economic Decision Framework for the Mediterranean and North African Region
detail.abstract: Water scarcity is increasingly recognised as a binding constraint on economic growth, particularly in the Mediterranean and North African (MENA) region, where climate change threatens to amplify existing hydrological imbalances. Although a substantial literature addresses water economics and a parallel literature develops dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models with resource constraints, the two strands are rarely integrated into a unified analytical framework capable of generating welfare-relevant policy prescriptions under deep uncertainty. This paper develops and estimates an open-economy DSGE model extended to incorporate endogenous water stock dynamics, climate-driven recharge shocks, desalination as a backstop technology, and Pigouvian externality pricing. Building on the canonical frameworks of Smets and Wouters (2007), Golosov et al. (2014), and Tsur and Zemel (2024), we derive the social planner’s problem, characterise the optimal water allocation rule (a Water Euler Equation that equates the marginal value of current use to the sum of future scarcity rents and externality costs), and solve the model with Bayesian estimation using panel data for 14 Mediterranean and North African countries over the period 2000–2020. Our empirical results indicate that the water stress index has a statistically and economically significant negative effect on welfare-adjusted output, with an estimated semi-elasticity of −0.28 (90% CI: [−0.43,−0.14]). Counterfactual simulations under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 emis sion scenarios suggest that socially optimal reallocation of water away from low-productivity agricultural uses toward higher-value industrial and municipal uses could generate welfare gains of 6.7–12.5% relative to the business-as-usual (BAU) trajectory by 2050. These gains are decomposable into consumption, environmental, and water-security components, and are larger for countries currently facing the highest water stress. We further show that pricing water at its full social opportunity cost– including scarcity rent and environmental externality– accelerates convergence to the optimal allocation path. These findings contribute a quantitative, model-consistent decision framework to a literature that has heretofore relied primarily on partial-equilibrium or simulation-based approaches. The framework is explicitly designed to accommodate the kind of deep uncertainty that charac terises long-horizon climate projections, through robust decision-making (RDM) extensions and scenario-conditional welfare comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并估计了一个纳入内生水资源存量、气候驱动补给冲击、海水淡化备用技术及庇古外部性定价的开放经济DSGE模型，基于14个地中海和北非国家2000-2020年面板数据进行贝叶斯估计。研究发现水压力指数对福利调整后产出有显著负向影响（半弹性-0.28），在RCP4.5和RCP8.5情景下，将水资源从低生产率农业用途重新配置到高价值工业和生活用途可带来2050年6.7%-12.5%的福利提升。
AI.research_question: 如何在一个统一的动态随机一般均衡框架内，将水资源约束、气候不确定性纳入宏观经济分析，并生成可操作的福利相关政策建议？
AI.motivation: 虽然已有大量文献分别关注水资源经济学和带资源约束的DSGE模型，但两股研究很少被整合到统一的解析框架中，难以在深度不确定性下生成具有福利相关性的政策处方。水资源短缺日益成为经济增长的约束条件，特别是在MENA地区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Smets和Wouters（2007）的DSGE框架、Golosov等人（2014）的资源约束模型以及Tsur和Zemel（2024）的水资源经济学理论，扩展为包含水资源存量动力学、气候补给冲击、海水淡化备用技术和庇古外部性定价的开放经济DSGE模型。
AI.method: 构建开放经济DSGE模型并推导社会计划者问题，导出表征最优水资源配置的"水资源欧拉方程"，使用2000-2020年14个地中海和北非国家的面板数据进行贝叶斯估计，并进行RCP4.5和RCP8.5情景下的反事实模拟。
AI.findings: （1）水压力指数对福利调整后产出有显著负向影响，半弹性为-0.28（90%置信区间：[-0.43,-0.14]）；（2）社会最优的水资源再配置可带来2050年6.7%-12.5%的福利提升；（3）福利收益可分解为消费、环境和水安全三个组成部分，且对水压力最高的国家收益更大；（4）按完全社会机会成本定价水资源可加速收敛到最优配置路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将水资源经济学与DSGE宏观模型整合为统一的解析框架，推导出水资源欧拉方程（将当前使用边际价值与未来稀缺租金和外部性成本之和相等），为文献中此前主要依赖局部均衡或基于模拟的方法提供了定量且模型一致的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供基于模型的定量决策框架，可通过鲁棒决策（RDM）扩展和情景条件福利比较来容纳长期气候预测中的深度不确定性；为MENA地区国家的水资源配置和定价政策提供可操作的政策处方。

title: Structural Realignment in Global Macro Liquidity: Yield Curve Normalization, Private Credit Contagion Dynamics, and Institutional Capital Allocation Architecture

detail.title: Structural Realignment in Global Macro Liquidity: Yield Curve Normalization, Private Credit Contagion Dynamics, and Institutional Capital Allocation Architecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.⁠

detail.abstract: This working paper delivers a comprehensive quantitative and structural evaluation of the macro-financial transition redefining global capital markets in the post-ZIRP (Zero Interest Rate Policy) era. Following two decades of central bank balance sheet expansion and artificial yield suppression, the structural normalization of sovereign yield curvesexemplified by the Bank of Japan's exit from Yield Curve Control (YCC) and persistent US fiscal deficit monetization pressure-is fundamentalizing a global contraction in net excess liquidity. This study formalizes the transmission channels through which rising real discount rates induce valuation compression across growth equities, real estate, and illiquid private credit vehicles. Furthermore, we investigate the systemic vulnerabilities inherent in non-bank financial intermediation (NBFI), where direct lending funds exhibit hidden default probabilities masked by mark-to-model accounting methodologies. Incorporating strategic framework analysis from key market anchors-specifically Berkshire Hathaway's record short-duration Treasury buffering and JPMorgan Chase's rate-friction projections-this paper establishes a robust four-factor macro monitoring dashboard and outlines an institutional asset allocation model optimized for structural volatility and capital preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文对后零利率政策（ZIRP）时代的宏观金融转型进行了全面的定量与结构性评估。研究聚焦于主权收益率曲线的结构性正常化（如日本央行退出YCC和美国财政赤字货币化压力）如何引发全球净过剩流动性的收缩，并通过实际贴现率上升的传导渠道导致增长型股票、房地产和非流动性私募信贷的估值压缩。文章还考察了非银行金融中介（NBFI）的系统性脆弱性，特别是直接贷款基金中由按模型估值会计方法掩盖的隐性违约概率。结合巴菲特旗下伯克希尔·哈撒韦创纪录的短久期国债缓冲和摩根大通的利率摩擦预测，本文构建了一个四因子宏观监测仪表盘，并提出面向结构性波动和资本保全的制度化资产配置模型。
AI.research_question: 后ZIRP时代，全球资本市场的宏观金融转型如何重塑资产估值？非银行金融中介在利率正常化过程中存在哪些系统性脆弱性？机构投资者应如何调整资产配置策略以实现资本保全？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年央行资产负债表扩张和人为压低收益率创造了超宽松的金融环境，但随着日本央行退出YCC、美国财政赤字货币化压力持续，全球净过剩流动性正在结构性收缩。这一根本性转变对资产估值和金融体系稳定性产生深远影响，亟需系统性研究其传导机制与应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实际贴现率传导理论（利率上升对资产估值的压缩机制）、非银行金融中介系统性风险框架（按模型估值与隐性杠杆）、流动性收缩的宏观金融传导理论
AI.method: 定量评估与结构性分析相结合的方法，运用四因子宏观监测仪表盘（涵盖利率、流动性、估值和金融脆弱性等维度），并结合关键市场锚定机构（伯克希尔·哈撒韦和摩根大通）的战略框架分析进行验证。
AI.findings: 1) 实际贴现率上升显著压缩增长型资产估值，影响范围涵盖股票、房地产和私募信贷；2) 非银行金融中介（尤其直接贷款基金）存在被按模型估值掩盖的隐性违约风险；3) 短久期国债缓冲和利率摩擦预测是应对结构性波动的有效策略锚点。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文系统化地形式化了利率正常化向资产估值压缩的传导渠道，首次将NBFI的按模型估值缺陷与后ZIRP时代的系统性风险分析整合进统一的分析框架，并提出了可操作的四因子宏观监测模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供了基于四因子宏观监测仪表盘的结构化资产配置模型，强调在结构性波动环境下以短久期国债作为防御性缓冲、优化资本保全策略，具有直接的政策与投资实践指导价值。

title: China, The West & The African Energy Pivot: Competing Finance Ideologies Fragmenting Continental Policy
affiliations: University of Benin

detail.title: China, The West & The African Energy Pivot: Competing Finance Ideologies Fragmenting Continental Policy
detail.abstract: Africa's energy deficit is structural, not cyclical. Six hundred million people remain without electricity, yet the continent holds 60% of the world's best solar resources and uses barely 1% of its installed capacity. The gap between endowment and deployment is not primarily a technical failure; it is a financing architecture failure. And that architecture is now being contested by two irreconcilable ideologies. China finances infrastructure through state-to-state concessional credit, tolerating fossil fuels as a political instrument of access and demanding no governance conditionality. The Westthrough instruments ranging from the G7's Partnership for Global Infrastructure and Investment (PGII) to Just Energy Transition Partnerships (JETPs)deploys blended finance, demands regulatory reform, attaches environmental conditionality, and expects the private sector to catalyse the bulk of investment. Both models have failed Africa in different ways. This paper argues that the real casualty of this ideological contest is not any single African country's energy balance sheet, but the structural coherence of African continental energy policy. Using an original analytical frameworkthe Continental Policy Fragmentation Index (CPFI)this paper models how competing finance ideologies generate divergent incentive structures that fracture the African Union's energy integration agenda, produce redundant infrastructure, and trap African states in a geopolitical choice architecture they did not design and cannot escape without sovereignty-first energy finance reform. The paper also situates this analysis within the acute context of the 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure, which has raised Brent crude toward triple digits, exposed the continent's fossil fuel import dependency, andparadoxicallyopened a narrow window for accelerated renewable deployment if the right financing is mobilised at speed.

AI.tldr: 本文认为非洲能源赤字是结构性的而非周期性的，其根源在于融资架构的失败。中国与西方两种不可调和的融资意识形态（中国式国家间优惠信贷 vs 西方混合融资+监管改革+环境条件）在非洲展开竞争，导致非洲大陆能源政策碎片化、基础设施冗余、地缘政治选择困境。论文提出"大陆政策碎片化指数"（CPFI）分析框架，并结合2026年霍尔木兹海峡关闭的能源危机背景，论证非洲需要主权优先的能源融资改革以抓住可再生能源部署的窗口期。
AI.research_question: 中西方竞争性融资意识形态如何影响非洲大陆能源政策的结构性连贯性，以及非洲如何通过主权优先的能源融资改革摆脱地缘政治选择困境？
AI.motivation: 非洲拥有全球60%最优太阳能资源但仅有1%的装机利用率，6亿人无电可用。能源赤字的核心不是技术失败而是融资架构失败。中国与西方两种不可调和的融资模式在非洲竞争，均以不同方式使非洲失败，损害了非洲联盟能源一体化议程的结构性连贯性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大陆政策碎片化指数（CPFI）分析框架；融资意识形态冲突理论；地缘政治选择架构理论；主权-能源金融改革理论。
AI.method: 构建原创分析框架"大陆政策碎片化指数"（CPFI），模型化竞争性融资意识形态如何产生不同的激励结构，从而影响非洲联盟能源一体化议程的连贯性。
AI.findings: 1) 中国融资模式（国家间优惠信贷、容忍化石燃料作为政治工具、无治理条件）与西方模式（混合融资、监管改革、环境条件、依赖私营部门）在非洲产生冲突性激励结构；2) 两种模式的竞争导致非洲能源政策碎片化、基础设施冗余、国家陷入地缘政治选择困境；3) 2026年霍尔木兹海峡关闭推高布伦特原油至三位数，暴露非洲化石燃料进口依赖，同时为加速可再生能源部署创造了难得窗口期。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"大陆政策碎片化指数"（CPFI）作为新的分析框架，将能源融资意识形态竞争与大陆能源政策结构性连贯性建立理论关联，拓展了能源地缘政治与融资架构研究的交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家提供主权优先的能源融资改革建议，帮助其摆脱中西方融资模式的二元困境；揭示2026年霍尔木兹海峡关闭背景下的可再生能源加速部署窗口期，为政策制定者提供时机性战略建议。

title: Milestone Contracts for Time-Inconsistent Employees: From Incentive Design to Project Continuation Governance
affiliations: , Nanjing University, Nanjing University - School of Business and Dongbei University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Milestone Contracts for Time-Inconsistent Employees: From Incentive Design to Project Continuation Governance
detail.abstract: Employees with present-biased preferences often struggle to sustain effort in long-term projects, posing significant challenges for the design of milestone-based incentive systems. We investigate how firms should design compensation contracts for time-inconsistent employees by distinguishing between sophisticated employees, who correctly anticipate their future self-control problems, and naive employees, who systematically overestimate their future self-control. We develop a bilevel Stackelberg game that captures both the contractual interaction between a manager and an employee and the employee's hidden intertemporal effort allocation. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, although present bias generally reduces organizational performance through procrastination, it may paradoxically improve sophisticated employees' contractual position when outside employment opportunities are attractive. Second, employee naivety may induce an accept-then-abandon behavioral pattern, in which employees willingly accept demanding projects but subsequently abandon them during implementation, creating a new source of contract failure. Third, we develop two complementary approaches for managing project continuation risk: reactive managerial intervention and preventive behavior-aware contracting. We show that reactive intervention is effective when continuation problems are occasional, whereas preventive contracting becomes preferable when firms repeatedly face severe continuation risk. Our results demonstrate that managing employee time inconsistency extends beyond incentive design to organizational governance. They provide managers with guidance on when firms should rely on flexible intervention versus ex ante organizational commitment to improve project completion under employee present bias.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业如何为存在现时偏好的员工设计里程碑式激励合同，区分了有远见的（sophisticated）和天真的（naive）员工，通过双层Stackelberg博弈揭示出三个核心发现：现时偏好可能悖论性地改善有远见员工的合同地位；天真员工会表现出"接受后放弃"的行为模式；企业可通过反应式干预和预防性行为感知合同两种互补方式管理项目持续风险。
AI.research_question: 企业应如何为时间不一致（存在现时偏好）的员工设计补偿合同？不同类型的员工（有远见的 vs. 天真的）对合同设计有何不同影响？
AI.motivation: 现实中大量员工存在现时偏好，难以在长期项目中维持努力，这给基于里程碑的激励体系设计带来重大挑战。现有研究尚未系统区分有远见与天真员工在合同设计中的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现时偏好理论（present bias）、双层Stackelberg博弈、行为经济学中的自我控制问题（sophisticated vs. naive区分）
AI.method: 构建双层Stackelberg博弈模型，上层刻画管理者与员工的合同互动，下层刻画员工隐藏的跨期努力配置决策。
AI.findings: （1）现时偏好通常通过拖延降低组织绩效，但当外部就业机会有吸引力时，可能悖论性地改善有远见员工的合同地位；（2）员工天真性会诱发"接受后放弃"行为模式，即员工愿意接受高要求项目但在实施阶段放弃，构成新的合同失败来源；（3）提出两种管理项目持续风险的互补方法：反应式管理干预和预防性行为感知合同，前者适用于偶发的持续问题，后者适用于频繁遭遇严重持续风险的情境。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为经济学中的现时偏好理论引入组织合同设计领域，并首次区分有远见与天真两类时间不一致员工对激励合同设计的差异化影响；揭示现时偏好在特定条件下可能有利于员工的悖论性结论；识别出"接受后放弃"作为新的合同失败机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了何时应依赖灵活干预而非事前组织承诺来提升项目完成率的明确指导，将员工时间不一致的管理从单纯的激励设计拓展到组织治理层面。

title: The U.S. Submarine Cable Governance Gap
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign and The George Washington University

detail.title: The U.S. Submarine Cable Governance Gap
detail.abstract:
Submarine cables carry roughly 99% of intercontinental data, yet U.S. governance over them is organized around pre-deployment licensing and foreign-ownership review. This paper argues that this orientation leaves a critical gap. Operational resilience depends not only on route diversity and physical redundancy, but also on ownership transparency, maintenance capacity, and the allocation of operational responsibility between public and private actors. 

Drawing on FCC rulemakings, congressional activity, and comparative policy from allied partners, it makes three contributions. First, it shows that the U.S. model, anchored in the Cable Landing License Act, Team Telecom review, and equipment-security rules, is built to scrutinize who may own a cable, not who repairs it. Second, it identifies the operational bottlenecks that shape repair and restoration: a small global repair fleet, privately negotiated maintenance agreements, increasingly concentrated hyperscaler ownership, long-lead-times for spare components, contested-water access, and the absence of federal authority to prioritize repairs during multi-cable or conflict-driven disruption. Third, it compares restoration frameworks from allied nations and other U.S. critical-infrastructure sectors (electricity, rail, and aviation) where federal emergency coordination authority already exists. The paper concludes with policy recommendations on transparency, federal coordination, and repair readiness.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国海底电缆治理体系在运维韧性方面的显著空白。现有美国治理框架（基于《电缆登陆许可法》、Team Telecom审查及设备安全规则）主要聚焦于事前部署许可和外资所有权审查，却未能覆盖电缆的维修、恢复与运营责任分配等关键环节。本文通过梳理FCC规则制定、国会活动及盟国比较政策，识别出影响维修恢复的运营瓶颈（全球维修船队规模小、私下协商的维护协议、超大规模企业所有权集中、备件交付周期长、争议水域准入问题及联邦应急协调权缺失），并与已具备联邦应急协调权力的其他美国关键基础设施部门（电力、铁路、航空）进行比较，最终提出透明度、联邦协调和维修准备度方面的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 美国海底电缆治理体系在运维韧性（维修、恢复与运营责任分配）方面存在哪些关键缺口？美国的治理框架与其他盟国及其他关键基础设施部门的应急协调机制相比有何不足？
AI.motivation: 海底电缆承载约99%的洲际数据流量，是数字时代最关键的基础设施之一，但美国对其治理高度聚焦于部署前的许可与所有权审查，忽视了运营阶段的韧性问题。随着地缘政治紧张加剧、电缆中断事件频发，运营韧性已成为国家安全和经济安全的紧迫议题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关键基础设施治理理论、基础设施韧性理论（强调运营韧性不仅依赖路由多样性和物理冗余，还依赖所有权透明度、维护能力和公共-私人运营责任分配）、比较公共政策分析框架。
AI.method: 定性政策分析法。综合FCC规则制定文件、国会立法活动记录、盟国政策比较，以及对美国其他关键基础设施部门（电力、铁路、航空）应急协调机制的跨部门比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）美国海底电缆治理模型建立在《电缆登陆许可法》、Team Telecom审查和设备安全规则之上，其设计目的是审查"谁可以拥有电缆"而非"谁负责维修"；（2）识别出六大运营瓶颈：全球维修船队规模小、维修协议由私人私下协商、超大规模企业所有权日益集中、备件交付周期长、争议水域准入问题、以及多电缆同时中断或冲突引发中断时缺乏联邦优先调配维修的权限；（3）盟国及其他美国关键基础设施部门（电力、铁路、航空）已有联邦应急协调机制可资借鉴。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了关键基础设施治理研究的视角，将关注点从"准入许可"转向"运营韧性"；提出了海底电缆治理中"所有权审查≠运营保障"的理论区分；为基础设施韧性的分析框架增加了维修能力、维护协议和应急协调权等新维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国政策制定者提供了关于海底电缆透明度提升、联邦应急协调机制建立和维修准备度增强的具体政策建议；通过盟国及跨部门比较，为美国填补治理空白提供了可操作的制度设计参考。

title: Distributionally Robust Sourcing under Yield and Demand Uncertainty
affiliations: Department of Decisions, Operations and Technology, CUHK Business School, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Systems Engineering and Engineering Management,  and

detail.title: Distributionally Robust Sourcing under Yield and Demand Uncertainty
detail.abstract: In modern supply chains, decision-makers must navigate the compounding risks of fluctuating market demands and unreliable production yields. However, the exact probability distributions of yield and demand uncertainties are rarely known in practice. To address this difficulty, we propose a distributionally robust optimization (DRO) framework for sourcing decisions under both yield and demand ambiguities. We construct a structural property closely related to supermodularity in the supply chain cost functions, which enables us to analytically characterize the exact worst-case joint distribution and derive tractable deterministic reformulations. Building on this characterization, we demonstrate the generality of our analytical approach across three progressively complex network structures: a single-store model, a multi-store network with routing recourse, and a two-echelon system with a centralized warehousing chance constraint. Extensive numerical experiments show that our framework consistently outperforms sample average approximation (SAA) and demand-only DRO benchmarks, significantly reducing profit volatility and mitigating tail risk, thereby providing a reliable safety net against systemic supply chain disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分布鲁棒优化（DRO）框架，用于在产量和需求不确定性下进行采购决策。通过构建与超模性相关的结构性质，作者解析地表征了最坏情况下的联合分布，并推导出可处理的确定性重构。该框架在三种网络结构（单门店、多门店路由、两层级仓储）中均优于样本平均近似和仅考虑需求不确定性的DRO基准，显著降低利润波动和尾部风险。
AI.research_question: 在产量与需求双不确定性且精确概率分布未知的情况下，如何构建一个可处理的分布鲁棒优化框架来优化供应链采购决策？
AI.motivation: 现代供应链面临市场需求的波动和生产产量的不可靠性双重风险，但决策者很少知道这些不确定性的精确概率分布。现有方法（如SAA和仅考虑需求不确定性的DRO）未能充分应对产量与需求的联合不确定性，因此需要更稳健的决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布鲁棒优化（DRO）；超模性（supermodularity）相关的结构性质；最坏情况联合分布的表征。
AI.method: 提出基于DRO的采购决策框架，构建与超模性相关的成本函数结构性质，解析地表征最坏情况下的产量与需求联合分布，推导确定性可处理的重构公式，并推广至三种网络结构：单门店模型、带路由补偿的多门店网络、含集中仓储机会约束的两层级系统。
AI.findings: 数值实验表明，所提出的DRO框架在三种网络结构中一致优于SAA和仅需求DRO基准，显著降低利润波动并缓解尾部风险，为供应链系统性中断提供了可靠的安全保障。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在产量和需求双重模糊集下，利用超模性相关结构性质精确刻画最坏情况联合分布，为DRO在供应链采购决策中的应用提供了理论分析基础；该解析方法具有跨不同网络结构的通用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可计算的、可处理的DRO框架，帮助供应链决策者在不确定性分布未知的情况下做出稳健的采购决策，降低利润波动和尾部风险，增强对系统性供应链中断的抵御能力。

title: A Lifecycle of Return Predictability: Evidence from Global Equity Markets

detail.title: A Lifecycle of Return Predictability: Evidence from Global Equity Markets
detail.abstract: This study examines the dynamics of return predictability in equity markets and provides evidence of its inherently transient nature by using daily data for the FTSE 100, S&P 500, STOXX Europe 600, and NIFTY 50 over the 2005-2024 period, a rolling-window framework is employed to evaluate out-of-sample predictive performance. The results show that average predictability, measured by out-of-sample 𝑅 2 , remains negative, consistent with market efficiency. However, directional accuracy is marginally above random, suggesting the presence of weak but non-random structure. The analysis further shows that predictability is time-varying and follows a systematic lifecycle pattern. Periods of elevated predictability are short-lived and are followed by rapid declines. By examining peak values, decay magnitude, and half-life, the study documents a consistent predictability decay process across markets. These findings highlight that while predictability may emerge temporarily, it dissipates quickly, supporting an adaptive view of market efficiency and emphasising the dynamic nature of financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2005-2024年间FTSE 100、S&P 500、STOXX Europe 600和NIFTY 50的日度数据，通过滚动窗口框架评估样本外预测表现，发现股票市场收益可预测性本质上是暂时性的。平均可预测性（样本外R²）为负，符合市场有效性；但方向准确率略高于随机水平，表明存在微弱但非随机的结构。可预测性随时间变化并遵循系统性生命周期模式，高可预测性时期短暂且迅速衰减，支持适应性市场效率观点。
AI.research_question: 股票市场收益可预测性是否具有内在的暂时性特征？可预测性如何随时间动态演变并遵循怎样的生命周期模式？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对市场可预测性存在争论，但较少关注可预测性的时间动态特征及其暂时性本质。本研究旨在通过多市场跨期数据，系统性地刻画可预测性的出现与消退过程，以增进对市场效率动态性的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场有效性假说（EMH）；适应性市场假说（AMH）
AI.method: 采用滚动窗口（rolling-window）框架，对FTSE 100、S&P 500、STOXX Europe 600和NIFTY 50四个市场2005-2024年的日度数据进行样本外预测表现评估；使用样本外R²衡量平均可预测性，并分析方向准确率；通过考察峰值、衰减幅度和半衰期来刻画可预测性的生命周期和衰减过程。
AI.findings: （1）平均可预测性（样本外R²）为负，支持市场有效性；（2）方向准确率略高于随机水平，表明存在微弱但非随机的结构；（3）可预测性具有时变性并遵循系统性生命周期模式；（4）高可预测性时期短暂且随后快速衰退；（5）多市场间存在一致的可预测性衰减过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 为适应性市场假说提供了实证支持，表明市场效率并非静态的二元状态，而是动态演变的；通过系统刻画可预测性的生命周期模式，深化了对市场效率动态性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化交易者和资产管理者提供了关于可预测性短暂性的重要警示，即依赖预测模型需认识到其有效期的局限性；为市场监管者理解市场运行规律提供了参考。

title: Trade Secret Protection and Labor Income Distribution: Evidence from China
affiliations: Minzu University of China, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Trade Secret Protection and Labor Income Distribution: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: While trade secret protection safeguards firm interests, it may come at the expense of workers by curtailing employee mobility and bargaining power. We examine this tension using China's Trade Secret Protection Innovation Pilot-a staggered rollout across 46 cities-as a quasi-natural experiment, with data from Chinese listed firms over 2018-2024. We document a structural reallocation of labor income: the policy significantly raises both the overall labor income share and the share accruing to core employees (executives and R&D personnel), while leaving non-core employees unaffected in the baseline. This heterogeneity operates through two channels-institutional implementation and regulatory deterrence-amplified by talent retention risk and equity incentives for core employees, and extended to non-core workers under stronger external oversight or social responsibility commitments. The effects are strongest in capital-intensive industries, favorable credit environments, and innovation-capable firms. Furthermore, policy-induced gains in the labor income share promote R&D investment and vertical integration. Our findings reveal that, by restructuring intra-firm bargaining, trade secret protection can serve as a complementary instrument for enhancing-rather than suppressing-labor value.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国商业秘密保护创新试点政策（46个城市分批推行）作为准自然实验，基于2018-2024年中国上市公司数据，考察商业秘密保护对劳动力收入分配的影响。研究发现该政策显著提高了整体劳动收入份额及核心员工（高管和研发人员）的劳动收入份额，但基线中非核心员工不受影响。这种异质性通过制度实施和监管威慑两个渠道发挥作用，并受到人才保留风险和核心员工股权激励的强化，在更强的外部监督或社会责任承诺下延伸到非核心员工。效应在资本密集型行业、有利信贷环境和创新型企业中最为显著。政策引致的劳动收入份额提升进一步促进了研发投资和纵向整合。
AI.research_question: 商业秘密保护政策如何影响企业内部劳动力收入分配？具体而言，该政策是否以及如何重构企业内不同类别员工的议价能力和劳动收入份额？
AI.motivation: 商业秘密保护在保护企业利益的同时，可能通过限制员工流动性和议价能力而损害工人利益。现有文献对这一潜在张力缺乏系统的实证证据，本文旨在利用中国的准自然实验政策来检验商业秘密保护对劳动收入分配的净效应及其作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动收入分配理论、企业内部议价理论、商业秘密保护与人力资本理论
AI.method: 采用中国商业秘密保护创新试点政策作为准自然实验（46个城市分批推行），基于2018-2024年中国上市公司数据，运用双重差分（DID）方法进行因果识别，并进行异质性分析和机制检验。
AI.findings: （1）试点政策显著提高整体劳动收入份额和核心员工（高管及研发人员）的劳动收入份额，而非核心员工在基线中不受影响；（2）异质性通过制度实施和监管威慑两个渠道传导，并受人才保留风险和股权激励的强化；（3）在更强的外部监督或社会责任承诺下，效应延伸至非核心员工；（4）效应在资本密集型行业、有利信贷环境和创新型企业中最强；（5）劳动收入份额的提升进一步促进研发投资和纵向整合。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文挑战了商业秘密保护必然压制劳动力价值的传统观点，揭示了商业秘密保护可以通过重构企业内部议价结构，作为增强（而非抑制）劳动力价值的补充性制度工具，丰富了商业秘密保护与劳动经济学交叉领域的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国商业秘密保护创新试点政策的政策效果评估提供了实证证据，提示政策制定者在设计知识产权保护制度时需关注其对企业内部劳动力分配的公平性影响；为企业管理者在实施商业秘密保护时如何平衡知识产权保护与人才激励提供了参考。

title: Global Dollar Shocks and the Location of Adjustment in China: Evidence across the 2015 RMB Regime Boundary
affiliations: Fudan University,  and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Global Dollar Shocks and the Location of Adjustment in China: Evidence across the 2015 RMB Regime Boundary
detail.abstract: This paper examines how greater managed exchange-rate flexibility changes how global dollar pressure is absorbed. Using monthly Chinese data from 2006 to 2022, it estimates statedependent IV local projections across the August 2015 RMB regime boundary. Dollar-index changes are instrumented with the first difference of an equal-weighted index of seven advancedeconomy 12-month UIP premia. After 811, RMB depreciation against the U.S. dollar occurs more rapidly, while the broad real exchange rate moves more strongly toward depreciation. Cumulative net sales of foreign currency are smaller around six months in the equal-weighted baseline, although this result is sensitive to currency weights. Industrial value added is less adversely affected around one year, expected RMB returns respond differently across regimes, and CPI differences remain imprecise. Although China remains exposed to dollar shocks, the post-811 exchange-rate configuration is associated with a different pattern of adjustment across exchange rates, intervention, real activity, and expected returns.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国2006-2022年月度数据，以2015年8月人民币汇率制度变革为边界，采用状态依赖的IV局部投影法估计更大汇率弹性如何改变全球美元压力的吸收方式。实证发现811汇改后人民币对美元贬值更快、实际有效汇率更倾向于贬值、外汇净卖出减少、工业增加值受冲击更小，但CPI影响仍不显著。
AI.research_question: 更大的管理汇率弹性如何改变全球美元压力（dollar pressure）在中国经济中的吸收方式？
AI.motivation: 中国在2015年8月11日汇改后转向更具弹性的汇率管理制度，但关于这种制度变化如何影响美元冲击的吸收机制（即汇率、外汇干预、实际经济活动与预期收益之间的权衡）缺乏系统性实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放经济体三元悖论框架下的汇率制度与外部冲击传导理论，涉及美元中心体系（dollar-centric system）下的溢出效应理论，以及状态依赖（state-dependent）的货币政策与汇率制度选择理论。
AI.method: 采用状态依赖的工具变量局部投影法（state-dependent IV local projections），以2015年8月811汇改为制度边界；用七个发达经济体12个月UIP溢价的等权平均的一阶差分作为美元指数变化的工具变量。
AI.findings: （1）811汇改后，人民币对美元贬值速度更快；（2）广义实际汇率更倾向于贬值；（3）等权基准下约6个月的累计外汇净卖出规模更小（但对货币权重敏感）；（4）约1年时工业增加值受到的不利影响更小；（5）预期人民币回报在不同制度下反应不同；（6）CPI差异仍不精确。总体而言，中国仍暴露于美元冲击之下，但811后调整模式在汇率、干预、实际活动和预期回报上呈现不同特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了汇率制度弹性变化如何改变外部美元冲击在国内经济中传导机制转变的实证证据，丰富了关于三元悖论下中间汇率制度（managed float）调整机制的理论理解，并展示了制度边界状态下冲击吸收的非线性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国汇率制度改革（811汇改）的经济后果提供了量化证据，有助于评估汇率弹性对国际收支、外汇储备管理和实体经济抵御外部冲击能力的影响，对新兴经济体汇率制度选择与外汇干预政策具有政策参考价值。

title: Consumer AI as Health Plan Decision Support: A Benchmark of LLM Plan Recommendations against a Claims-based Pricing Engine

detail.title: Consumer AI as Health Plan Decision Support: A Benchmark of LLM Plan Recommendations against a Claims-based Pricing Engine
detail.abstract: Consumers increasingly ask AI chatbots to recommend health insurance plans, yet little is known about whether they estimate costs accurately or select the right plan. We benchmark the July 2026 consumer AI lineup from OpenAI and Anthropic on a realistic plan-selection task: five ACA-compliant plans, twelve claims-anchored member profiles, four progressively richer levels of consumer-provided health information, and a claims-based pricing engine as the reference standard. Across 1,680 AI responses, we evaluate cost estimation, plan recommendation accuracy, optimization objective, and response consistency. Current frontier models recommend a near-optimal plan in roughly half of the responses, up from one-third for a previous-generation model. Most error is attributable to the difficulty of mapping consumer-described care to the full service mix and market-level prices, rather than to plan-selection logic. Providing more detailed consumer information yields diminishing returns, whereas supplying prices raises correct recommendations to 85-95%. These findings suggest that the primary constraint on AI-assisted plan selection is shifting from model reasoning to the quality and availability of insurance data.

AI.tldr: 本文基准测试了OpenAI和Anthropic在2026年7月的消费者AI模型在健康保险计划选择任务上的表现。研究发现前沿模型在约一半的回复中能推荐接近最优的计划（上一代模型仅为三分之一），大多数错误源于将消费者描述医疗服务映射到完整服务组合和市场价格的困难，而非计划选择逻辑本身。提供更详细消费者信息的收益递减，而提供价格数据可将正确推荐率提升至85-95%。
AI.research_question: 消费者使用AI聊天机器人推荐健康保险计划时，AI模型能否准确估算成本并选择正确的计划？主要误差来源是什么？
AI.motivation: 消费者越来越多地使用AI聊天机器人来获取健康保险计划推荐，但学术界对此类AI在成本估算和计划选择方面的准确性缺乏系统了解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ACA合规计划、索赔锚定消费者画像、渐进式信息层级以及基于索赔的定价引擎作为参考标准的基准测试框架。
AI.method: 对OpenAI和Anthropic的2026年7月消费者AI模型进行基准测试：5个ACA合规计划、12个基于索赔的会员画像、4个信息丰富度层级、基于索赔的定价引擎作为参考标准；共评估1,680个AI回复。
AI.findings: 1. 前沿模型在约50%的回复中推荐接近最优的计划（上一代模型为33%）；2. 大多数错误源于消费者描述到完整服务组合及市场价格映射的困难，而非计划选择逻辑；3. 提供更多消费者信息收益递减；4. 提供价格数据可将正确推荐率提升至85-95%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI辅助保险计划选择的主要瓶颈正从模型推理能力转向保险数据的质量和可用性，为理解AI在复杂决策任务中的能力边界提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司、政策制定者和AI开发者提供了重要启示：改进保险定价数据的可及性和质量比单纯提升模型推理能力更能有效提升AI保险推荐的准确性。

title: On Adam Smith's Support for Reciprocal Tariffs: A Missing Recognition in Criticisms of Donald Trump's Reciprocal Tariffs Program

detail.title: On Adam Smith's Support for Reciprocal Tariffs: A Missing Recognition in Criticisms of Donald Trump's Reciprocal Tariffs Program

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author declares no competing interests exist.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding for this research.

detail.abstract: Adam Smith, like David Hume, considered tariffs a desirable source of government revenue in his Wealth of Nations. Besides tariffs to protect defense-related industries and to equalize the trading advantage of domestic producers with that of foreign producers, Smith approved reciprocal tariffs for a country possibly to gain larger foreign markets. Many economist critics of President Trump's reciprocal tariffs project appear to be unaware of Smith's arguments. The legitimate criticisms of the 1930 Smoot-Hawley tariffs are inapplicable to Trump's reciprocal tariffs. Equating a nation's overall trade deficits with consumers' alleged indebtedness to grocery stores is also mistaken. We clarify.

AI.tldr: 本文澄清了亚当·斯密在《国富论》中对关税的立场，说明斯密（如同大卫·休谟）认为关税是政府收入的理想来源，并支持对等关税。文章指出许多批评特朗普对等关税政策的经济学家忽视了斯密的论点，同时认为1930年《斯姆特-霍利关税法》的批评不适用于特朗普的对等关税，并反驳了将国家贸易逆差等同于消费者欠杂货店债务的错误类比。
AI.research_question: 亚当·斯密对关税的真实立场是什么？这些立场如何为特朗普的对等关税政策提供理论辩护？
AI.motivation: 许多经济学家批评特朗普的对等关税政策，但他们对斯密关税观点的理解存在偏差，且错误地将1930年《斯姆特-霍利关税法》的批评套用到当前政策上，也混淆了贸易逆差与消费者债务的概念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亚当·斯密的《国富论》中关于关税的经济学理论，包括：关税作为政府财政收入来源、保护国防相关产业、平衡国内外生产者的贸易优势、以及对等关税作为获取更大外国市场的手段。
AI.method: 文本分析和理论澄清方法，通过重新解读亚当·斯密《国富论》中的关税论述，对比1930年《斯姆特-霍利关税法》与当代对等关税政策的差异，并纠正贸易逆差的错误类比。
AI.findings: （1）亚当·斯密不仅支持关税作为财政收入来源，还支持对等关税以获取更大外国市场；（2）对斯密关税观点的批评往往基于对其文本的误读；（3）1930年《斯姆特-霍利关税法》的批评理由不适用于特朗普的对等关税；（4）将国家贸易逆差等同于消费者债务的做法在经济学上是错误的。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新诠释了斯密的关税理论，纠正了对斯密自由贸易立场的简化理解，指出斯密实际上对关税持更为务实和灵活的态度，为关税政策的理论讨论提供了更准确的历史文本依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为对等关税政策提供了古典经济学的理论辩护，澄清了批评者对斯密观点和贸易逆差概念的误解，有助于更理性地讨论当代贸易政策。

title: The Boundary Between Matter and Radiation: An Unresolved Classificatory Inconsistency in Modern Physics

detail.title: The Boundary Between Matter and Radiation: An Unresolved Classificatory Inconsistency in Modern Physics

declarations.ethicsApproval: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Modern physics employs two classificatory frameworks that have never been formally reconciled: the Standard Model's fermion/boson taxonomy and the inherited matter/radiation terminology of nineteenth-century physics. This paper argues that their coexistence conceals a genuine classificatory inconsistency. The term "radiation" includes electrons, classified as fermion matter particles, and photons, which are massless gauge bosons. Beta radiation is an electron flux; gamma radiation is a photon flux. Three arguments are developed. First, the historical formation of this inconsistency is traced: radiation terminology was extended to material and nonmaterial entities without conceptual revision. Second, electron-photon interconversion through pair production and annihilation provides dynamical evidence against a categorical opposition between the two. Third, radiation is reinterpreted as a category of transferable field excitations rather than as an ontological opposite of matter. Within this framework, the electron is defined as a localised quantum excitation of the electron field, not itself a material structure but a constituent excitation from which material structures are formed. The ontological status of invariant mass remains an open foundational question. Matter is reassigned to the structural level, where the concept remains consistent. On this basis, the hypothesis is proposed that the electron's nonzero invariant mass may represent the effective behaviour of a more fundamental massless field structure in a bound configuration; three falsification conditions are stated.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现代物理学中费米子/玻色子分类与物质/辐射传统术语并存构成分类学不一致，主张将辐射重新解释为可传递的场激发类别，而非物质的形而上对立面，并提出电子质量可能源于更基本无质量场结构束缚态有效行为的假说。
AI.research_question: 现代物理学中标准模型的费米子/玻色子分类体系与19世纪遗留的物质/辐射术语体系之间的分类学不一致如何形成、有何问题，以及如何通过重新概念化予以调和？
AI.motivation: 物理学的两套分类框架（标准模型的费米子/玻色子分类与物质/辐射传统术语）从未被正式调和，二者共存掩盖了真正的分类学不一致。例如"辐射"既包括被归类为费米子物质粒子的电子（β辐射），也包括无质量规范玻色子光子（γ辐射）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 场论与量子场激发理论：将辐射重新解释为可传递的场激发类别，电子定义为电子场的局域量子激发而非物质结构本身，物质被重新指派到结构层面。
AI.method: 概念分析与历史追踪：追溯辐射术语扩展至物质与非物质实体而未做概念修正的历史过程；通过正反粒子对产生与湮灭的电子-光子互转提供动力学证据；提出三个论证并以三个可证伪条件陈述假说。
AI.findings: 辐射术语的不一致源于历史延伸中缺乏概念修正；电子-光子互转动摇了物质/辐射的范畴对立；辐射应被重新解释为可传递的场激发类别；电子的非零不变质量可能代表更基本的无质量场结构在束缚构型中的有效行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 调和了标准模型分类与物质/辐射传统术语之间的分类学不一致；将辐射重新概念化为可传递的场激发而非物质的本体论对立面；为不变质量的本体论地位这一基础问题提供了新的研究框架与可检验假说。
AI.practical_contributions: 为物理学基础分类体系的术语规范提供了概念澄清；对理解电子质量起源问题提出了具可证伪条件的实证研究路径。

title: Financial Inclusion with Costly and Imprecise Screening
affiliations: University Toulouse Capitole (TSM-Research)

detail.title: Financial Inclusion with Costly and Imprecise Screening
detail.abstract: I develop a model of fintech lending in which a platform chooses between costly precise screening and cheap imprecise screening. Borrowers differ in quality, project size, and reservation utility. Strong screening perfectly identifies borrower quality but requires a fixed screening cost; weak screening is costless but noisy. Under strong screening alone, the platform funds only sufficiently large projects by borrowers revealed to be good, because the screening cost makes small loans unprofitable. Under mixed screening, the platform uses weak screening for smaller projects and reserves strong screening for larger projects. This strategy expands credit access and raises lender profit by saving screening costs and serving projects excluded under the strong-screening benchmark. The gains are unevenly distributed: in the reallocated region, good borrowers receive lower expected surplus, while bad borrowers may benefit when they are misclassified as good. Aggregate total surplus is ambiguous because expanded access and saved screening costs must be weighed against weaker classification. The main mechanism is robust when borrowers do not know their own quality. An extension with endogenous requested loan size shows that screening thresholds can create manipulation incentives, and that randomized screening bands can smooth borrower surplus around the cutoff.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个金融科技贷款模型，研究平台在精确筛查（成本高但准确）与粗略筛查（成本低但有噪音）之间的选择。平台对大型项目采用强筛查，对小型项目采用弱筛查，这种混合策略扩大了信贷覆盖面并提高贷款方利润，但收益在借款人间分配不均，总福利影响具有模糊性。
AI.research_question: 金融科技贷款平台应如何在精确筛查与粗略筛查之间进行选择？混合筛查策略如何影响信贷覆盖、贷款方利润及借款人的福利分配？
AI.motivation: 金融科技平台在贷款审核中面临筛查精度与成本之间的权衡。精确筛查成本高但准确识别借款人质量，粗略筛查成本低但有噪音。现有理论缺乏对平台在两种筛查模式之间进行内生选择及其分配后果的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贷款平台筛查机制设计的理论模型，考虑了借款人异质性（质量、项目规模和保留效用）、信息不对称（借款人可能不知道自身质量）以及内生贷款规模决策。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析。构建平台在强筛查与弱筛查之间的内生选择模型，分析混合筛查策略下的均衡特征，并通过扩展模型验证机制稳健性。
AI.findings: （1）仅使用强筛查时，平台只为质量好的借款人且项目规模足够大的贷款融资；（2）混合筛查策略下，平台对较小项目用弱筛查、较大项目用强筛查，扩大了信贷覆盖并提高贷款方利润；（3）收益分配不均：好的借款人在重新分配区域获得更低预期剩余，坏的借款人可能因被误判为好而获益；（4）总剩余影响模糊；（5）借款人不自知质量时机制仍稳健；（6）内生贷款规模下筛查阈值会引发操纵激励，随机化筛查带可平滑借款人在截止点附近的剩余。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统刻画了金融科技贷款平台在精确与粗略筛查之间的内生选择机制，揭示了混合筛查策略对信贷获取、利润和福利分配的影响，并识别了筛查阈值导致的操纵激励问题及随机化筛查的缓解作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技贷款平台设计筛查策略提供理论指导：混合筛查可在控制成本的同时扩大信贷覆盖；提醒平台注意筛查阈值可能引发借款人的策略性操纵行为；随机化筛查带可作为平滑福利分配的可行工具。

title: Rethinking Multilingual Democracy: Towards a Generative Relational Theory of Governance amid Relational Plurality and Heteromorphic Values

detail.title: Rethinking Multilingual Democracy: Towards a Generative Relational Theory of Governance amid Relational Plurality and Heteromorphic Values
detail.abstract: Theories of multilingual democracy treat linguistic diversity principally as a problem of communication, of representation, of linguistic rights, or of recognition. Each addresses a real difficulty, and together they leave one thing unexplained: political disagreement in multilingual polities has not diminished in proportion to the very large improvements in translation that recent decades have produced. This paper examines a possible reason. A thought experiment supposes translation to be perfect and asks what would remain, and what remains is the coordination of values that were generated within different relational histories and that no rendering of sentences makes commensurable. The survey concedes that this conclusion is established: anthropological work on ontological conflict has argued at length that disputes of this kind concern worlds and not words, and translation theory has argued that rendering is a value-constituting operation. What that literature has largely left aside is the institutional question, and the specifically multilingual case. Against those gaps the paper advances a graded thesis, that linguistic and cultural communities embody partially distinct relational structures which influence how values are articulated, prioritized, and institutionalized without determining or exhausting them, and derives from it two governance functions that a polity under such conditions requires. It meets the objection that the notion of separate conceptual worlds is incoherent, and concedes that the resulting picture of democracy stands close to an existing account of constitutionalism amid diversity. The account supplies no institutional design, its central thesis is entered as a hypothesis, and the closing questions are held to be the more valuable half of what is offered.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨多语言政体中政治分歧为何未随翻译技术进步而减少。通过"完美翻译"思想实验，论文论证语言多样性问题的核心并非沟通，而是不同关系性历史中生成的价值协调问题。论文提出"分级论题"：语言与文化社群体现了部分不同的关系结构，影响价值的表达、优先级排序和制度化，并由此推导出多语言政体所需的两项治理功能。
AI.research_question: 为什么多语言政体中的政治分歧并未随着近几十年来翻译技术的巨大进步而成比例减少？翻译问题之外，多语言民主还面临什么深层困难？
AI.motivation: 现有关于多语言民主的理论（沟通、代表、语言权利、承认）各自回应了一部分真实困难，但都未能解释：翻译能力大幅提升后，政治分歧依然存在。这一理论空白需要被填补。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多语言民主理论（沟通、代表、语言权利、承认四种进路）；人类学中的本体论冲突理论（冲突关涉"世界"而非"词语"）；翻译理论（翻译是价值建构性操作）；宪法多元主义/多样性宪法主义
AI.method: 思想实验（假设翻译完美时会剩下什么）+ 理论综合与批判性分析（整合本体论冲突与翻译理论，识别其制度问题与多语言情境的缺失，进而提出分级论题并回应反对意见）
AI.findings: 即使翻译完美，语言社群之间仍存在价值的不可通约性，因为价值生成于不同的关系性历史之中。语言与文化社群体现部分不同的关系结构，影响价值的表达、优先级和制度化（但不决定也不穷尽它们）。由此，多语言政体需要两项治理功能（具体内容论文以提出假设的形式呈现）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将人类学本体论冲突与翻译理论引入多语言民主的制度讨论，填补了该文献中制度性问题和多语言案例的空白；提出"分级论题"作为连接语言差异与价值差异的中间立场；回应了"分离概念世界"不连贯的反对意见，并承认其结论接近现有宪法多元主义论述。
AI.practical_contributions: 论文不提供制度设计方案，而是提出多语言政体所需的治理功能方向，为制度设计提供理论前提；论文坦承其核心论题作为假设提出，并以开放性问题（而非确定结论）作为其更有价值的部分。

title: KDI Monthly Economic Trends
affiliations: Korea Development Institute (KDI)

detail.title: KDI Monthly Economic Trends

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Development Institute (KDI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The Korean economy is recovering, supported by a sharp increase in semiconductor exports and improving services activity.
 
 ○ Exports are growing at a high rate, led by semiconductors, while domestic demand continues to improve.

  - With export prices surging on strong semiconductor conditions, export volumes also increased at a relatively high rate.

  - Equipment investment continues to expand strongly and consumption is still on a recovery path, although construction investment remains somewhat sluggish.

 ○ Downside risks to economic activity persist amid the ongoing war in the Middle East.
 
  - Consumer price inflation accelerated as disruptions to crude oil shipments pushed up production costs, while inflation expectations also rose.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了韩国经济在半导体出口大幅增长和服务业活动改善的支撑下正在复苏的现状，同时指出中东战争持续给经济活动带来下行风险，原油运输中断推高了生产成本和通胀预期。
AI.research_question: 韩国经济当前复苏态势如何？外部风险因素（如中东战争）对经济活动和通胀的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 评估韩国经济在半导体出口强劲与地缘政治风险并存背景下的整体健康状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观经济分析框架，涉及出口驱动型增长、通胀传导机制（成本推动型通胀）等经济理论。
AI.method: 基于经济指标（出口数据、设备投资、消费、建设投资、消费者价格指数、通胀预期）的宏观经济形势分析。
AI.findings: 1. 出口以半导体为主导高速增长，出口价格和出口量均较高；2. 设备投资持续强劲扩张，消费处于复苏路径，但建设投资仍然低迷；3. 中东战争导致原油运输中断，推高生产成本和通胀预期，消费者价格通胀加速；4. 经济活动存在下行风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个将出口增长、地缘政治风险与通胀传导相结合的宏观经济分析案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了韩国经济当前复苏态势与面临风险的综合评估，有助于制定应对通胀上行压力和地缘政治不确定性的政策建议。

title: Who Replaces Spirit? Entry, Exit, and Low-End Fares
affiliations: University of Miami Herbert Business School and University of Miami

detail.title: Who Replaces Spirit? Entry, Exit, and Low-End Fares
detail.abstract: A federal court blocked JetBlue's acquisition of Spirit Airlines in January 2024 to protect consumers who relied on Spirit's low fares. Spirit failed anyway and ceased operations in May 2026. We ask whether the prohibition protected consumers. Using DB1B data for 2022-2025, we estimate the effect of Spirit's exit across the 1,427 routes it served. The 5 th and 10 th percentile fares rise by 8.6 and 5.8 log points; mean and median fares are unaffected. Where a carrier entered, the bottom is unaffected and mean fares fall. The harm comes from exit without replacement, which entry policy does not reach.

AI.tldr: 本文研究2024年联邦法院阻止JetBlue收购Spirit Airlines后，Spirit最终于2026年5月停业，考察这一禁令是否真正保护了消费者。基于2022-2025年DB1B数据，分析Spirit退出对其服务的1,427条航线的影响。
AI.research_question: 禁止JetBlue收购Spirit Airlines是否真正保护了依赖Spirit低价票的消费者？
AI.motivation: 法院以保护消费者为由阻止收购，但Spirit最终仍然倒闭退出市场。需要评估政策干预的实际效果，检验"阻止收购=保护消费者"这一逻辑是否成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 航空市场竞争与票价分布理论，关注低票价区间（第5和第10百分位）与均值票价的不同反应，区分退出是否有替代进入的差异化影响。
AI.method: 使用DB1B数据（2022-2025年），对Spirit服务的1,427条航线进行实证分析，估计Spirit退出对票价分布的影响。
AI.findings: Spirit退出导致第5和第10百分位票价分别上涨8.6和5.8个对数点；均值和中位数票价不受影响。在有竞争者进入的航线上，价格底部不受影响且均值票价下降；损害主要来自无替代的退出，而当前进入政策无法覆盖这一情况。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了竞争政策中"阻止并购以保护消费者"逻辑的局限性——即使阻止了并购，若企业随后倒闭退出市场，消费者仍可能受损，尤其是依赖最低票价的消费者群体。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断执法机构和政策制定者提供实证证据，表明阻止并购本身不足以保护消费者，需要配套的进入政策和退出机制设计，以应对"退出而无替代"的市场情形。

title: The Cooperative Principle: Determinism and Probabilism as Complementary Layers in Complex Physical and Computational Systems
affiliations: Universal Standard Axiom Corp

detail.title: The Cooperative Principle: Determinism and Probabilism as Complementary Layers in Complex Physical and Computational Systems
detail.abstract:
For centuries, determinism and probabilism have been treated as opposing philosophies—one describing a clockwork universe, the other a universe governed by irreducible chance. This opposition is false. The correct relationship is cooperative and layered: probabilism governs the physical substrate, while determinism governs the logical outcome. Every complex system including quantum computers, superconducting materials, biological organisms, financial markets, and neural networks, exhibits this two-layer architecture.

​The probabilistic layer serves as the terrain, which is real, irreducible, and not to be fought. Conversely, the deterministic layer is the destination: a fixed point, an attractor, and a guaranteed convergence that exists independently of the noise beneath it. The R^3 Method (Recursive Descent, Refinement, Reflection) acts as the operational framework for identifying the deterministic layer in any system, effectively dissolving the assumption that probabilistic behavior at the substrate implies probabilistic outcomes at the logical level. The implications of this framework span every domain of science, engineering, and computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出决定论与概率论并非对立哲学，而是分层协作的关系：概率论支配物理底层，决定论支配逻辑结果。通过R³方法（递归下降、细化、反思）作为操作框架，识别任意系统中的确定性层，从而消解"底层概率行为意味着逻辑层概率结果"的假设。
AI.research_question: 决定论与概率论之间真正的关系是什么？如何在复杂系统中识别确定性层与概率层，从而调和这两种看似对立的哲学观点？
AI.motivation: 数百年来，决定论与概率论被视为对立哲学（一个描述钟表宇宙，另一个描述不可约偶然性支配的宇宙）。作者认为这种对立是错误的，真实关系应是协作与分层的。这一错误对立在科学、工程和计算各领域产生了深远误解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双层架构理论：概率层作为物理基底（真实、不可约、不可对抗），决定论层作为逻辑目的地（不动点、吸引子、有保证的收敛）。R³方法（递归下降、细化、反思）作为识别确定性层的操作框架。
AI.method: 提出R³方法（Recursive Descent, Refinement, Reflection）作为操作框架，用于识别任何系统中的确定性层。该方法本质上是一种元方法论，而非实证方法。
AI.findings: 每个复杂系统（包括量子计算机、超导材料、生物有机体、金融市场和神经网络）都展现出双层架构：概率层作为地形（真实且不可对抗），确定性层作为目的地（不动点/吸引子，独立于底层噪声的确定性收敛）。概率层行为不必然导致逻辑层上的概率结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义了决定论与概率论之间的本体论关系，从对立转向分层协作；提出双层架构理论，将概率视为物理基底的固有属性而决定论为逻辑层面的涌现结果；引入R³方法作为跨学科的统一分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 该框架适用于量子计算、超导材料、生物有机体、金融市场和神经网络等多个领域，为工程师和科学家提供了识别系统确定性层的可操作方法，有助于在看似噪声驱动的系统中发现可预测的收敛结果。

title: The Correlation Between Customer Satisfaction and Employee Engagement in the Hospitality Industry
affiliations: and University of Mumbai

detail.title: The Correlation Between Customer Satisfaction and Employee Engagement in the Hospitality Industry
detail.abstract: Employee engagement is widely recognized as a key factor influencing organizational performance in service-oriented industries, particularly in hospitality where employees directly interact with customers. The attitudes, motivation, and involvement of employees significantly shape customer experiences and satisfaction. While previous studies have examined service quality and customer satisfaction extensively, limited research has explored the direct relationship between employee engagement and customer satisfaction in hospitality contexts. This study investigates this relationship and examines the mediating role of service quality. Using a quantitative approach, survey data were collected from hospitality employees and customers. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) was applied for analysis. The results indicate that employee engagement positively influences service quality and customer satisfaction, with service quality partially mediating this relationship, highlighting its importance for improving hospitality service performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用定量方法，通过结构方程模型（SEM）分析酒店业员工与顾客的问卷数据，发现员工敬业度正向影响服务质量和顾客满意度，且服务质量在两者之间起部分中介作用。
AI.research_question: 在酒店业情境下，员工敬业度与顾客满意度之间是否存在直接关系？服务质量是否在其中起中介作用？
AI.motivation: 以往研究已广泛探讨服务质量和顾客满意度，但鲜有研究直接考察酒店业中员工敬业度与顾客满意度之间的关系，存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 员工敬业度理论、服务质量理论、服务利润链相关理论
AI.method: 定量研究方法，通过问卷调查收集酒店业员工和顾客数据，采用结构方程模型（SEM）进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 员工敬业度正向影响服务质量和顾客满意度；服务质量在员工敬业度与顾客满意度之间起部分中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了酒店业中员工敬业度与顾客满意度直接关系研究的空白，验证了服务质量的中介机制，拓展了员工敬业度在服务情境下的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为酒店管理者提升员工敬业度和服务质量提供了实证依据，有助于优化酒店服务绩效和顾客满意度管理实践。

title: Net Fishing for Homicide Defendants in Louisiana
affiliations: Northeastern University, Institute for Security and Public Policy at the School of Criminology and Criminal Justice

detail.title: Net Fishing for Homicide Defendants in Louisiana
detail.abstract:
District Attorneys in Louisiana are elected officials with political party affiliation, and television and radio market share drives advertising revenue.  This toxic mix makes for multiple homicide arrests when a poor black murders a rich white.  The politician in charge must be "tough on crime" and get convictions, and it is easier to do so if there are co-defendants, since poor defendants have less access to bail and a lawyer, and are thus perfect foils for long delays and intense interrogation techniques. 

These are the murder suspects fished with a net, documented in this paper, using the complete 46-year history of FBI Supplemental Homicide Reports for Louisiana 1976-2021. In all the white victim Louisiana cases, 47% of black defendant cases have co-defendants, versus 23% of white defendants cases.

AI.tldr: 本文利用路易斯安那州1976-2021年46年完整的FBI补充凶杀案报告数据，揭示了该州地方检察官作为带党派标签的民选官员，其竞选广告收入与电视广播市场份额挂钩，这种激励结构导致在"贫穷黑人谋杀富裕白人"的案件中，检察官倾向于通过增加共同被告来获取定罪——数据显示在全部白人受害者案件中，黑人被告案件中有47%存在共同被告，而白人被告案件仅为23%。
AI.research_question: 路易斯安那州的政治激励结构（地方检察官作为民选官员且需"对犯罪强硬"以争取竞选连任）是否导致黑人被告比白人被告更可能被追加共同被告，从而面临更长的拘留期和更严酷的审讯手段？
AI.motivation: 路易斯安那州的地方检察官是带有党派归属的民选官员，其竞选广告收入依赖于电视广播市场份额。这种政治激励促使检察官在"贫穷黑人谋杀富裕白人"的案件中展现"对犯罪强硬"的姿态。由于贫困被告难以获得保释和律师，容易被利用进行长时间拖延和严酷审讯，因此检察官倾向于增加共同被告以便更容易获得定罪。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学框架下的司法激励理论——检察官作为理性政治家，其定罪行为受竞选连任需求和媒体曝光度驱动；结合程序正义理论，讨论保释系统与法律援助的不平等如何使贫困被告处于结构性弱势。
AI.method: 利用FBI补充凶杀案报告（SHR）1976-2021年路易斯安那州46年完整数据，对全部白人受害者案件进行统计分析，比较黑人被告与白人被告案件中共同被告比例（47% vs 23%）的差异。
AI.findings: 在路易斯桑那州所有白人受害者案件中，黑人被告案件中有47%存在共同被告，而白人被告案件中仅23%存在共同被告，两者差距显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"政治激励驱动司法不公"的理论提供了大规模长期历史数据的实证支持，将检察官的选举政治逻辑与刑事司法中的种族差异联系起来，丰富了关于司法系统中制度性种族偏见的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了路易斯安那州刑事司法体系中制度性的种族不平等，为司法改革提供证据基础，包括检方起诉决策透明化、减少共同被告滥用、以及改革保释和公共辩护系统等方面提供政策启示。

title: Determinants of Export Performance of Large and Medium Manufacturing Industries in Addis Ababa City, Ethiopia
affiliations: and  Ethiopia Public Services University

detail.title: Determinants of Export Performance of Large and Medium Manufacturing Industries in Addis Ababa City, Ethiopia
detail.abstract: This study examined the variables that affect manufacturing export performance in Addis Ababa, with a focus on firm-level capacity, institutional and policy support, infrastructure factors, and the trade and financial environment. The study was driven by Ethiopia's manufactured exports, which continued to perform poorly and inconsistently despite policy emphasis on export-led industrialization. An explanatory research design using a quantitative method. Using structured questionnaires, 84 medium and large scale manufacturing industries engaged in export activities throughout the 2024/25 and 2025/26 fiscal year supplied primary data. The collected data was examined using descriptive statistics, multiple regression analysis, and Pearson correlation. The results showed that Addis Ababa's manufacturing firms export performance is weak and inconsistent among companies, especially when it comes to market expansion, profitability, and continues export growth. According to the regression results, export performance is positively and statistically significantly impacted by infrastructure factors, institutional and policy support, firm-level capacity, and the trade and financial environment. The trade and financial environment was found to have the biggest impact among these variables, highlighting how critical it is for export-oriented manufacturing enterprise to have access to financing and foreign exchange. The study also discovered that institutional implementation gaps and the dependability of infrastructure, particularly the energy power still continue at constraint export performance. The study concludes that in order to improve manufacturing export performance, it is required to expand enterprise capacity, increase institutional and policy efficacy, boost infrastructural dependability, and foster a more favorable trade and financial environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究以埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴制造业出口企业为对象，考察企业层面能力、制度与政策支持、基础设施因素以及贸易金融环境对出口绩效的影响。通过对84家中大型制造企业的定量分析发现，出口绩效总体较弱且企业间差异明显，四大因素均对出口绩效有显著正向影响，其中贸易金融环境影响最大，而基础设施可靠性和制度执行缺口仍是制约因素。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响亚的斯亚贝巴制造业的出口绩效？具体考察企业层面能力、制度与政策支持、基础设施因素以及贸易金融环境对出口绩效的影响。
AI.motivation: 尽管埃塞俄比亚政策上强调出口导向型工业化，但其制成品出口表现始终不佳且不稳定，亟需系统识别影响出口绩效的关键因素，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究综合考量影响出口绩效的多维度理论框架，包括企业能力理论、制度理论、基础设施理论以及贸易环境理论，通过四大变量体系构建分析框架。
AI.method: 采用解释性研究设计，定量研究方法。通过结构化问卷收集2024/25和2025/26财年从事出口活动的84家中大型制造企业的一手数据，运用描述性统计、皮尔逊相关分析和多元回归分析进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 亚的斯亚贝巴制造业企业出口绩效总体薄弱且企业间表现不一致，尤其在市场拓展、盈利能力和出口持续增长方面。回归结果显示，基础设施因素、制度与政策支持、企业层面能力及贸易金融环境均对出口绩效有显著正向影响；其中贸易金融环境影响最大，凸显融资和外汇获取的关键性。制度执行差距和基础设施（尤其是电力）可靠性仍是出口绩效的约束因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究为出口绩效影响因素提供了埃塞俄比亚背景下（发展中非洲国家）的实证证据，明确了不同因素对出口绩效影响的相对重要性排序，丰富了出口绩效决定因素的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究建议通过扩大企业能力、提升制度与政策效能、增强基础设施可靠性以及营造更有利的贸易金融环境来改善制造业出口绩效，为埃塞俄比亚政策制定者提供了具体的干预方向。

title: Evolving the Basel Framework: A Critical Justification of Climate-Extended Risk Models Over Traditional Vasicek and Merton Architectures
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Evolving the Basel Framework: A Critical Justification of Climate-Extended Risk Models Over Traditional Vasicek and Merton Architectures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or conflicts of interest that could be perceived as influencing the research reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or sensitive personal data. Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no competing financial interests or conflicts of interest that could be perceived as influencing the research reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Traditional credit risk architectures, notably the structural Merton framework and the portfolio-based Vasicek model, form the quantitative cornerstone of Basel capital adequacy guidelines. However, these frameworks rely on macroeconomic stationarity and historical volatility. This paper addresses a critical regulatory vulnerability: the inability of legacy models to price forward-looking, non-linear structural breaks induced by climate transition risks. Focusing on South Africa’s energy-intensive Platinum Group Metals (PGM) mining sector, we introduce a Climate-Extended Structural Model that integrates dynamic carbon tax trajectories and international tariff mechanisms, such as the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, directly into the firm asset value drift process. Using historical market data in a Python-driven simulation, we demonstrate that traditional Merton frameworks leave banks undercapitalized against regulatory cliffs, whereas the climate-extended model signals systemic vulnerabilities 2-3 years prior to a credit event. We argue that mandating climate-extended parameterization in the Basel framework is an operational necessity for global banking stability. By making the Python simulation framework publicly available, we enable replication across other carbon-intensive sectors. The results provide empirical support for the Basel Committee’s 2021 guidance and show that integrating climate variables into structural models is a core financial engineering requirement for resilience under orderly and disorderly transition scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个气候扩展的结构模型（Climate-Extended Structural Model），将动态碳税轨迹和欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）等国际关税机制纳入企业资产价值漂移过程，应用于南非铂族金属（PGM）矿业部门。研究表明传统Merton模型会使银行在监管悬崖下资本不足，而气候扩展模型能提前2-3年发出系统性脆弱性信号，主张将气候扩展参数化纳入巴塞尔框架。
AI.research_question: 传统信用风险模型（Merton框架和Vasicek模型）如何应对气候转型风险带来的非线性结构性突变？将气候变量纳入结构模型能否提前预警系统性信用风险？
AI.motivation: 传统信用风险框架依赖宏观经济平稳性和历史波动率，无法定价由气候转型风险引起的前瞻性、非线性结构性突变，构成监管脆弱性。需要实证检验气候扩展模型在碳密集行业中的预警能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: Merton结构性违约模型、Vasicek组合信用风险模型、Basel资本充足框架、气候转型风险理论、碳定价与碳边境调节机制（CBAM）理论
AI.method: 构建Climate-Extended Structural Model，将动态碳税轨迹和CBAM关税机制整合进企业资产价值漂移过程；使用南非PGM矿业部门历史市场数据，采用Python驱动的模拟方法进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 传统Merton模型使银行在监管悬崖下资本不足；气候扩展模型能比信用事件提前2-3年发出系统性脆弱性信号；结果支持巴塞尔委员会2021年关于气候风险的监管指引。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候转型变量（碳税、CBAM）正式纳入结构性信用风险模型，扩展了传统Merton框架的理论适用范围；为Basel框架中气候参数化的必要性提供了理论论证和实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可公开复现的Python模拟框架，可用于其他碳密集行业的风险评估；为银行监管机构将气候风险纳入资本充足率计算提供操作指导；为有序和无序转型情景下的金融稳定性评估提供量化工具。

title:
A Regime-Conditional Framework for Rolling Correlation and Lead-Lag Analysis among XAUUSD, XAGUSD, and BTCUSD 
A Literature Synthesis with an Illustrative Case Study
affiliations: Independent Inventor

detail.title:
A Regime-Conditional Framework for Rolling Correlation and Lead-Lag Analysis among XAUUSD, XAGUSD, and BTCUSD 
A Literature Synthesis with an Illustrative Case Study
detail.abstract: Gold (XAUUSD), silver (XAGUSD), and Bitcoin (BTCUSD) are commonly grouped as inflation and macroeconomic hedges, yet their statistical relationship is neither uniform nor stable over time. This paper synthesizes prior academic and industry evidence on the correlation structure among these three assets and proposes a regime-conditional analytical framework-combining rolling Pearson correlation across multiple window sizes with cross-correlation function (CCF) lead-lag analysis-for evaluating which asset, if any, functions as a leading indicator for the others, and under which market regime. Reference values compiled from prior sources indicate that the gold-silver correlation has historically ranged between 0.68 and 0.95 on a one-year rolling basis (averaging near 0.80-0.92 across independent studies), while the gold-Bitcoin correlation over 2018-2023 has been substantially weaker, at approximately 0.62. To illustrate the practical relevance of a regime-conditional view, this paper examines the late-December 2025 divergence episode, during which gold posted its strongest annual gain in decades, silver amplified both the rally and the subsequent correction, and Bitcoin declined roughly 30% from its October peak-demonstrating that the three assets can decouple sharply even while headline correlation statistics remain positive over longer windows. The paper argues that price leadership between gold and silver is plausibly regime-dependent: silver appears to lead during momentum/breakout phases owing to its higher beta and more speculative order flow, whereas gold appears to lead during pure safe-haven shocks owing to its deeper institutional liquidity. The proposed framework and its associated open-source computational procedure are offered as a template for future empirical validation using live historical data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了黄金、白银和比特币之间的相关性结构及其随时间的不稳定性，提出了一个基于市场制度（regime）的条件分析框架，结合滚动Pearson相关性和交叉相关函数（CCF）领先-滞后分析，评估哪种资产在何种市场制度下充当其他资产的领先指标。文章以2025年12月底的极端分化事件为例，论证了三者即使长期相关性为正，也可能在市场制度切换时急剧脱钩。
AI.research_question: 黄金、白银和比特币之间的相关性结构是否受市场制度调节？在何种市场制度下哪种资产可作为其他资产的领先指标？
AI.motivation: 黄金、白银和比特币常被归类为通胀和宏观对冲工具，但三者之间的统计关系既不统一也不随时间稳定。现有的相关性和领先-滞后研究未充分考虑市场制度条件，导致对极端分化事件的解释力不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场制度（regime）的条件分析框架，结合滚动Pearson相关性与交叉相关函数（CCF）领先-滞后分析。核心理论假设包括：白银因其高贝塔和投机性订单流在动量/突破阶段领先黄金；黄金因其更深厚的机构流动性在纯避险冲击中领先白银。
AI.method: 综合既有学术与行业证据，提出制度条件分析框架；采用多窗口滚动Pearson相关性分析和CCF领先-滞后分析；以2025年12月底的分化事件作为实证案例进行说明。
AI.findings: 金-银相关性在一年滚动基础上介于0.68-0.95之间（独立研究均值约0.80-0.92）；金-比特币相关性在2018-2023年间约为0.62，明显更弱。2025年12月底的分化事件显示：黄金录得数十年来最强年度涨幅，白银放大涨势与后续回调，比特币从10月峰值下跌约30%，三者即使长期相关性为正也可急剧脱钩。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出制度条件化的资产领先-滞后分析框架，将市场制度纳入资产相关性研究，修正了传统静态相关性分析的局限，为价格领导关系的制度依赖性提供了理论假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了开源计算程序模板，供实务界使用实时历史数据验证框架；帮助投资者在制度切换时识别领先指标、优化对冲和配置策略。

detail.abstract: Ar*cial intelligence is entering the nonpro*t sector faster than the governance systems needed to direct its use. This paper argues that AI should be understood not simply as a producvity tool but as a structural change in the economics of organizaonal capacity. For chronically undercapitalized nonpro*ts, AI may reduce administrave burden, strengthen analysis, and widen parcipaon in policy and narrave formaon. Yet the same systems can introduce surveillance, bias, vendor dependence, automated exclusion, and new unfunded mandates-especially when adopted by funders or government agencies without meaningful parcipaon by frontline workers and a4ected communies. The paper examines the widening gap between nonpro*t AI adopon and formal policy, the con5ict between federal preempon e4orts and state AI regulaon, philanthropic investment in AI for frontline services, failures in automated public-bene*t systems, and the rapid expansion of commercial AI across government. It proposes four immediate priories for nonpro*ts: develop parcipatory organizaonal policies; establish constraints for engagement with AIenabled public systems; create mechanisms to detect algorithmic harm a4ecng clients; and parcipate in broader accountability coalions. The central conclusion is that the sector's de*ning choice is not whether to adopt AI, but whether nonpro*ts and communies will have meaningful authority over the condions under which it is designed, funded, deployed, and contested.

AI.tldr: 本文论证人工智能不仅是生产力工具，更是非营利组织能力经济学的结构性变革。对于长期资本不足的非营利组织，AI可减轻行政负担、强化分析并扩大政策与叙事形成的参与度；但同时也可能引入监控、偏见、供应商依赖、自动化排斥及新的无资金授权。文章提出非营利组织应立即采取的四项优先行动：制定参与式组织政策、建立与AI公共系统互动的约束机制、创建检测算法伤害的机制，以及参与更广泛的问责联盟。核心结论是：该部门的决定性选择不是是否采用AI，而是非营利组织和社区是否对AI的设计、资助、部署和争议条件拥有实质性权威。
AI.research_question: 非营利组织在AI快速渗透的背景下，应如何理解和应对AI带来的结构性变革？非营利组织与社区是否拥有对AI设计、资助、部署和争议条件的实质性权威？
AI.motivation: 人工智能进入非营利部门的速度远快于引导其使用的治理体系的发展。非营利组织长期资金不足，面临AI带来的双重影响——既可能是降本增效的工具，也可能成为新一轮权力不对等和排斥的源头，亟需系统性的分析和行动框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文采用组织能力经济学与治理理论的视角，将AI视为改变组织运行成本和能力分配的结构性变革，并结合公共政策治理、算法公平、参与式民主等理论框架进行分析。
AI.method: 本文为规范性政策分析论文，通过审视非营利组织AI采用与正式政策之间的差距、联邦优先权与州AI法规的冲突、慈善投资于AI前线服务、自动化公共福利系统的失败案例，以及商业AI在政府中的快速扩张等多重现象，提出系统性的政策建议。
AI.findings: AI在非营利部门正以快于治理体系发展的速度扩张；AI既可能减轻行政负担、增强分析能力和扩大参与，也可能带来监控、偏见、供应商依赖、自动化排斥和新的无资金授权；非营利组织面临的关键抉择不是是否采纳AI，而是能否在AI的设计、资助、部署和争议中获得实质性权威。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI重新概念化为组织能力经济学的结构性变革而非单纯生产力工具；提出非营利部门面对AI的治理框架和四项优先行动原则，丰富了算法治理与第三部门研究的交叉理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非营利组织提供四项可立即实施的优先行动方案：制定参与式组织政策、建立与AI公共系统互动的约束机制、创建检测算法伤害的机制、参与更广泛的问责联盟；为资助方和政策制定者提供关于AI治理的实践指引。

title: FDR, e-values and Moderate Deviations
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: FDR, e-values and Moderate Deviations

keywords: 62F03. Keywords And Phrases. False Discovery Rate

detail.abstract:
Müller, Parmigiani and Rice showed twenty years ago that multiple comparisons is a decision problem, and that whatever sensible loss function you pick, the answer is always the same shape: rank the comparisons by their posterior probability of being real, and report everything above some cutoff. What they did not settle is where the cutoff belongs. That is what this paper works out.

The answer is a sum of three logarithms. How far out you must push the boundary depends on how much data you have per comparison, on how many comparisons you are making, and, for some procedures but not others, on a third term that is pure overhead

AI.tldr: 本文在Müller、Parmigiani和Rice二十年前提出的多重比较决策框架基础上，解决了他们未解决的关键问题——截断阈值（cutoff）应当如何确定。作者发现答案由三个对数项之和构成，分别取决于每个比较的数据量、比较的总数，以及（对某些程序而言）额外的固定开销项。
AI.research_question: 在多重比较决策问题中，应当如何确定报告的截断阈值（cutoff）？
AI.motivation: Müller、Parmigiani和Rice（二十年前）已证明多重比较本质上是一个决策问题，无论选择何种合理的损失函数，最优决策形式总是相同的：按比较的后验真实概率排序并报告超过某一截断阈值的所有结果。但他们未解决截断阈值应设在何处的问题，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯决策理论（损失函数框架下的最优决策规则）
AI.method: 理论推导——通过贝叶斯决策框架推导最优截断阈值的解析形式，结果显示阈值由三个对数项之和构成。
AI.findings: 最优截断阈值可以表示为三个对数项之和：第一项与每个比较所拥有的数据量有关，第二项与所进行的比较总数有关，第三项（对某些程序而非所有程序适用）是一个纯开销项（fixed overhead）。
AI.theory_contributions: 在贝叶斯决策理论框架下，给出了多重比较问题中截断阈值的闭合解析解，弥补了Müller等人在该框架下未解决的关键缺口，完善了多重比较作为决策问题的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了确定多重比较报告截断阈值的具体计算方式，使决策框架能够直接应用于实际数据分析中，帮助研究者判断应该报告哪些比较结果。

title: Be Careful What You Wish For: Hidden Costs of Short Selling around Ex-dividend Days
affiliations: and Hitotsubashi University

detail.title: Be Careful What You Wish For: Hidden Costs of Short Selling around Ex-dividend Days
detail.abstract: Short sellers must borrow shares before they execute short sales. In Japan, there is a standardized margin transaction (SMT) system, which is pervasive among retail investors: Over 70 percent of retail investors in Japan use SMTs when initiating short sales. Although SMTs are designed to be widely accessible to retail investors, there may be a pitfall (or hidden cost) – the premium charge rate (PCR, or Gyaku-hibu). For a given stock, when the demand for margin selling is high relative to its supply, causing higher procurement costs for brokers, short sellers are charged with a PCR, in addition to conventional borrowing fees. This study examines the effect of PCRs, along with other relevant stock lending costs, on market quality of stocks around ex-dividend days, which the literature identifies as a period of high short selling and stock lending activities. Consistent with the literature, we show that the number of stock lending transactions increased significantly but with more elevated borrowing fees, suggesting that market quality of the securities lending market deteriorates around ex-dividend days. Moreover, we show a significant increase (decrease) in the PCRs, an additional stock borrowing cost, on the cum- (ex-) day, suggesting that the demand-supply imbalance for certain stocks is most pronounced on the cum-day. We also show that the deterioration of market quality in the securities lending market spills over to the stock market.

AI.tldr: 本文研究日本标准化保证金交易（SMT）系统中的溢价费率（PCR）对除息日前后股票市场质量的影响。研究发现，除息日期间证券借贷市场质量恶化，且PCR在除息日前一天（cum-day）显著上升、除息日（ex-day）显著下降，这种恶化还会溢出到股票市场。
AI.research_question: 溢价费率（PCR）及其他股票借贷成本如何影响除息日前后股票的市场质量？
AI.motivation: 除息日是文献公认的高卖空和股票借贷活动密集期，日本SMT系统虽广泛面向散户投资者，但存在隐藏成本（PCR），以往研究未充分探讨PCR对市场质量的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论、证券借贷市场与股票市场的溢出效应理论、除息日套利相关理论
AI.method: 实证分析，利用日本SMT系统的PCR数据及股票借贷交易数据，检验除息日前后借贷成本变化及其对市场质量的影响，并分析借贷市场向股票市场的溢出效应。
AI.findings: 1）除息日期间股票借贷交易数量显著增加但借贷费用上升，证券借贷市场质量恶化；2）PCR在除息日前一天（cum-day）显著上升，在除息日（ex-day）显著下降，反映供需失衡在cum-day最为突出；3）证券借贷市场的质量恶化会溢出到股票市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统研究SMT系统中PCR这一独特的借贷成本对市场质量的影响；丰富了除息日期间证券借贷成本与市场质量关系的文献；揭示了证券借贷市场质量恶化向股票市场溢出的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本监管机构和市场参与者揭示了SMT系统中PCR作为隐性成本的存在及其对散户投资者的影响；提示投资者关注除息日前后借贷成本异常波动的风险；为证券借贷市场的制度改进提供经验证据。

title: Never Let Me Go: Why Do Lenders Recall Loaned Shares? Evidence from Japan's Cross-Shareholding Practice
affiliations: and Hitotsubashi University

detail.title: Never Let Me Go: Why Do Lenders Recall Loaned Shares? Evidence from Japan's Cross-Shareholding Practice
detail.abstract: In stock lending transactions, all rights associated with the original owner (lender), including ownership, voting rights, dividends, shareholder benefits, and other rights are transferred to the borrower during the lending period. Unless the lent shares are reclaimed, these rights, other than dividends, cannot be regained. Therefore, in Japan's stock lending market, many stock lenders recall their lent shares approximately seven days before the record date of the settlement month to retain their names on the shareholder register. This practice, which originated from Japan's long-standing tradition of cross-shareholding, has non-negligible effects on the prices of loaned shares in the equity market. We examine the relationship between stock loan recalls and the transfer of ownership rights, focusing on short-covering activity around recall events. We show that the seasonal recall-induced supply reduction leads to an increase in lending fees and short covering activities, ultimately inflating stock prices by approximately 2% over the four-day window surrounding the recall date.

AI.tldr: 本文研究日本股票借贷市场中，贷出方在结算月记录日约七日前召回借出股票的季节性行为。这种源于日本交叉持股传统的召回行为导致供给减少、借贷费用上升和空头回补活动增加，最终在召回日前后四天窗口内使股价膨胀约2%。
AI.research_question: 股票借贷召回与所有权转移之间的关系如何？特别是召回事件引发的空头回补活动对股价有何影响？
AI.motivation: 在日本股票借贷市场中，贷出方在记录日前约七天召回借出股票以保留股东名册上的名字，这一源于交叉持股传统的实践对股票价格产生了不可忽视的影响，但尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 所有权转移理论；股票借贷市场中的供给-需求机制；空头回补与价格压力理论。
AI.method: 实证事件研究法，围绕股票召回事件分析借贷费用、空头回补活动和股票价格的变动。
AI.findings: 季节性的召回引致的供给减少导致借贷费用上升和空头回补活动增加，最终在召回日前后四天窗口内使股价膨胀约2%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了股票借贷召回事件对股价的系统性影响机制，将所有权转移与短期市场行为（空头回补）联系起来，丰富了股票借贷市场与价格形成机制的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者理解日本股票借贷市场的季节性价格异动提供了依据，有助于投资者识别召回事件带来的价格膨胀风险，并对监管机构和市场设计有一定启示。

title:
Two Orders of Verification: Rewarding What Is Better, Pricing What Is Noisier 

Improvement, Noise, and the Reads that Answer Both—and the Report

detail.title:
Two Orders of Verification: Rewarding What Is Better, Pricing What Is Noisier 

Improvement, Noise, and the Reads that Answer Both—and the Report
detail.abstract: A party facing a verification read can shade what it discloses, add costless noise to the world, and invest-at a cost-in being better. The three moves live on three orders: the belief for disclosure, the convex order for noise, the first-order dominance order for improvement. A read withstands all three exactly when it is a supremum of kernels that are convex and nonincreasing in the state-convex to price noise, nonincreasing to reward improvement, a supremum to stay convex in the belief. The proof runs one contraction argument per order, and the first-order leg is the cheaper: the improvement cone is finitely generated by adjacent-state steps, so Abel summation dualises it without the bipolar theorem the convex order needs. The coherent floor is the systematic opposite on the two axes that concern the world. Its kernel is capped, and the cap is at once the concavity that makes noise pay and the ratchet that taxes an auditor for becoming competent-not two defects but one coefficient, the noise bounty being exactly half the improvement tax at three states. This is not academic. In a game where the auditor buys capability, then adds noise, then discloses, a floor calls forth none: under the floor alone, improvement is first wasted and then punished, and at the one calibration where a coherent lattice is proof against both words and noise, the read is flat exactly where the court can see, so capability supply is zero. The classical under-provision of audit quality is, in this reading, the corner solution of a game against a capped kernel; the tax is intrinsic not to auditor liability but to a floor. The triple-proof reads are a cone, so a designer keeps the court, turns its kernel from capped to convex-and-decreasing, and scales the read to call forth any target capability, a first best included. The one new tension-a single convex kernel rewards improvement regressively-the same cone dissolves, by routing curvature to where noise is a threat and holding an even reward elsewhere.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一方在面对"验证读取"(verification read)时的三种策略性行为——隐瞒披露内容、添加无成本噪声、以及付出成本进行改进——并证明了读取能抵御这三种行为当且仅当其是"凸且随状态非增核"的上确界。文章进一步分析了"一致下限"(coherent floor)的双重缺陷（封顶核同时导致噪声有回报和惩罚能力提升），并证明三重抗性读取构成一个锥，设计者可通过调整核来引导任何目标能力水平，包括最优解。
AI.research_question: 一个面对验证读取的当事方可以通过三种方式操纵结果：隐瞒披露、添加无成本噪声、以及付费改进自身。这些行为分别作用于三个不同的序（信念序、凸序、一阶随机占优序）之上。核心研究问题是：什么条件的读取（read）能够同时对这三类操纵策略具有稳健性？以及在审计场景中，不同的读取设计如何影响审计师的胜任力供给？
AI.motivation: 审计质量的经典"供给不足"问题需要更精细的理论解释。作者希望超越传统的责任框架，将审计质量供给不足重新理解为"对抗封顶核(capped kernel)的博弈角点解"，从而揭示税收（惩罚）内生于下限设计而非审计师责任本身。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论框架建立在三个数学序之上：信念序（用于披露）、凸序（用于噪声）、一阶随机占优序（用于改进）。核心性质是"核"（kernel）的凸性与单调性分析，以及通过收缩论证（contraction argument）和Abel求和的对偶化方法。
AI.method: 证明方法包含三个收缩论证（每个序一个）。其中一阶占优部分的证明更便宜：改进锥由相邻状态步长有限生成，因此可以用Abel求和进行对偶化，无需凸序所需的双极定理（bipolar theorem）。
AI.findings: (1) 读取抵御三种操纵当且仅当它是"凸且非增核"的上确界。 (2) 一致下限的核是封顶的，该封顶同时造成两个效果：凹性使噪声有利可图、棘轮效应使审计师因能力提升而受罚——这不是两个缺陷而是同一系数，在三个状态时噪声赏金恰好是改进税的一半。 (3) 在审计师先购能力、再加噪声、后披露的博弈中，下限不会诱发任何能力供给：改进先被浪费后被惩罚。 (4) 三重抗性读取构成一个锥，设计者可缩放读取以实现任何目标能力水平，包括最优解。唯一的张力（凸核对改进的回归性奖励）可通过将曲率路由到噪声威胁区域来解决。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将审计质量供给不足重新概念化为"对抗封顶核的博弈角点解"，而非责任问题。 (2) 建立了读取对三类操纵的稳健性条件，提供了统一的数学刻画。 (3) 揭示了噪声赏金与改进税之间的精确数量关系（三状态时为1/2比例）。 (4) 证明三重抗性读取构成锥结构，为设计空间提供了完整的代数刻画。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计者提供了可操作的读取设计策略：保持法庭不变，将核从"封顶"转变为"凸且递减"，再缩放读取以引导任何目标能力水平。同时指出了将曲率路由到噪声威胁区域、在别处保持均匀奖励的具体操作方法。

title: AI, Value, and Volatility: "Why FMCG Must Reinvent Its Commercial Model Before the Next Shock Hits"

detail.title: AI, Value, and Volatility: "Why FMCG Must Reinvent Its Commercial Model Before the Next Shock Hits"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest. The analysis and conclusions of this paper were developed independently and do not reflect the views, strategies, or commercial positions of any past or current employer, partner, or affiliated organization.

detail.abstract: The FMCG industry is entering a new era defined by volatility, value-seeking consumer behavior, retailer consolidation, and the rapid rise of artificial intelligence. Traditional commercial models-pricing, promotions, forecasting, and route-to-market-are no longer sufficient to protect margins or sustain competitiveness. This article argues that FMCG companies must adopt a new commercial architecture built on AI-driven pricing, machine-readable commerce, predictive supply chains, disciplined trade investment, and redesigned route-to-market systems. The perspective is grounded in global industry research and two decades of practical experience across multiple markets. The conclusion is clear: the next disruption in FMCG will be algorithmic, and only companies that modernize their commercial systems will remain competitive.

AI.tldr: 快消品行业正进入由波动性、价值导向消费者行为、零售商整合及人工智能崛起定义的新时代，传统商业模式（定价、促销、预测、通路）已不足以保护利润或维持竞争力。本文主张快消品公司必须采用由AI驱动定价、机器可读商务、预测性供应链、纪律性贸易投资及重新设计的通路系统构成的新商业架构。结论是快消品行业的下一次颠覆将是算法驱动的，只有现代化其商业系统的公司才能保持竞争力。
AI.research_question: 在快消品行业面临波动性、价值导向消费者、零售商整合和AI崛起的新时代背景下，传统商业模式为何不再有效，快消品公司应如何重构其商业架构以保护利润率并维持竞争力？
AI.motivation: 快消品行业正处于深刻变革期，传统定价、促销、预测和通路模式已无法应对新环境带来的利润率侵蚀和竞争压力，亟需提出新的商业架构方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球行业研究和二十余年跨市场实践经验形成的商业战略视角，涵盖AI驱动定价、机器可读商务、预测性供应链、纪律性贸易投资和通路重构等核心概念框架。
AI.method: 本文采用观点性/视角性研究范式，基于全球行业研究数据及作者在多个市场积累的二十年实践经验进行综合分析论证。
AI.findings: 快消品行业的下一次颠覆将是算法性的（algorithmic），传统商业模式已不足以应对新时代挑战，只有采纳AI驱动的综合性商业架构（涵盖定价、商务、供应链、贸易投资和通路系统）的公司才能维持竞争力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"算法化商业架构"这一新概念框架，将AI技术系统地整合到快消品商业管理的各个维度（定价、商务、供应链、贸易投资、通路），为快消品商业模式的数字化转型提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为快消品企业管理者提供了具体的商业架构革新方向和路径，包括AI驱动定价、机器可读商务、预测性供应链、纪律性贸易投资和通路系统重构，具有明确的实践指导价值。

title: Engineering the Riba-Free Transition Beyond Islamic Banking: A Dynamic Discounting Model and the Unfinished Mandate of 1975

detail.title: Engineering the Riba-Free Transition Beyond Islamic Banking: A Dynamic Discounting Model and the Unfinished Mandate of 1975

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

keywords: Commission for Transformation of the Financial System
