detail.abstract: A companion working paper in this series developed a family-level architecture for a Riba-free economy: a six-category family typology, a mosque-based Ma'oon office, an income-generating Waqf network, and a formal growth-accounting identity. This paper turns to the question that architecture leaves open: can a national economy actually run without Riba at the sovereign level — in its public debt, its central bank operations, and the discount rate embedded in every investment decision it makes — and not only inside a commercially successful Islamic banking sector operating alongside a conventional one? Pakistan supplies thirty-five years of direct evidence on this question, from the Federal Shariat Court's first 1991 ruling through the Court's final 28 April 2022 verdict and Pakistan's 26th Constitutional Amendment of October 2024, which fixed 1 January 2028 as a binding constitutional deadline for the complete elimination of riba — apparently the first such calendar commitment by any modern state. Drawing on the author's own service, in 2000, as the first Member-Secretary of Pakistan's Commission for Transformation of the Financial System, the paper sets out why an economy-wide conversion gave way at that time to the dual-banking model in force today, and argues that that choice, reasonable on its own terms, left unbuilt exactly the sovereign-level instruments the 2028 deadline now requires. The paper then formalises a dynamic, real-return-anchored discount rate as the technical alternative to a fixed interest rate for project and sovereign-debt appraisal, shows that it behaves as a natural counter-cyclical stabiliser rather than a source of instability, extends it with a Zakat term that penalises idle capital, and shows how that same mechanism reconnects the sovereign-finance question to the family-level Waqf architecture of Part I.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨一个国家经济体能否在主权重——公共债务、央行操作和贴现率——层面完全消除利息（Riba），而不只是在伊斯兰银行部门内实现。以巴基斯坦35年的司法和宪法实践为直接证据，作者提出了一个动态的、以实际回报为锚点的贴现率作为固定利率的技术替代方案，并论证其具有自然逆周期稳定器特性。
AI.research_question: 一个国家经济体能否在主权重（公共债务、央行操作、投资决策中的贴现率）层面真正实现无利息运行，而不只是拥有一个与常规银行并存的商业上成功的伊斯兰银行部门？
AI.motivation: 已有配套工作论文建立了家庭层面无利息经济体的架构，但该架构留下了一个开放性问题：主权层面的经济能否真正实现无利息运行。巴基斯坦提供了35年的直接证据（从1991年联邦伊斯兰教法法院首次裁决到2022年终审判决，以及2024年宪法第26修正案设定2028年1月1日为消除利息的具有约束力的宪法期限）——这似乎是现代国家首次做出此类日历承诺。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无利息经济（Riba-free economy）理论框架；基于真实回报锚定的动态贴现率理论；伊斯兰金融中的Zakat机制（对闲置资本征税）；主权金融与家庭层面Waqf（宗教基金）架构的连接理论。
AI.method: 基于作者2000年担任巴基斯坦金融体系转型委员会首位委员秘书的亲身经历，进行历史性案例分析；结合形式化的动态模型推导——构建以实际回报为锚点的贴现率公式，纳入Zakat项以惩罚闲置资本；并进行经济学性质分析（逆周期稳定性检验）。
AI.findings: （1）巴基斯坦当年选择双银行模式而非全面转型，有其自身合理性，但这一选择恰恰没有构建起2028年截止日期所需的主权层面工具；（2）动态的实际回报锚定贴现率可以作为固定利率的技术替代方案；（3）该贴现率表现为自然的逆周期稳定器而非不稳定来源；（4）引入Zakat项后，该机制能够将主权金融问题与第一部分（配套论文）的家庭层面Waqf架构重新连接起来。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统论证了主权层面（而不仅是银行部门层面）无利息经济的技术可行性；形式化了实际回报锚定的动态贴现率理论，并证明其逆周期稳定特性；通过Zakat机制将主权金融与家庭层面Waqf架构在理论上统一起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦2028年宪法截止日期提供了具体的主权层面金融工具设计方案；为任何追求无利息经济的现代国家提供了可操作的贴现率替代方案和政策框架；基于作者实际参与政策制定的内部经验，提供了独特的制度史洞见。

title: Private Enforcement of the Digital Markets Act – First Procedural Insights from Case Law and Implications Beyond
affiliations: University of Vienna and University of Vienna - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Private Enforcement of the Digital Markets Act – First Procedural Insights from Case Law and Implications Beyond
detail.abstract:
The Digital Markets Act (DMA) establishes a primarily centralised system of public enforcement led by the European Commission, but its practical effectiveness also depends on the ability of consumers, business users and representative organisations to invoke its obligations before national courts. This article examines the first judgments on the private enforcement of the DMA: the Higher Regional Court of Cologne’s decision concerning Meta’s use of personal data for generative AI training and the Regional Court of Mainz’s judgment concerning Google’s treatment of Gmail. Adopting a procedural perspective, the article analyses how national courts operationalise DMA obligations in the absence of a harmonised EU framework for private enforcement.

The judgments confirm that consumer organisations and business users may seek injunctive relief independently of prior Commission enforcement. They further address representative standing, international jurisdiction under Article 7(2) Brussels I bis, applicable law, the territorial scope of judicial review, the identification of the appropriate defendant within a corporate group and coordination with the Commission under Article 39 DMA. In resolving these questions, the German courts draw extensively on concepts originating in competition law, consumer law, private international law and general civil procedure.

The article argues that these decisions are contributing to the emergence of a hybrid and decentralised procedural architecture for DMA enforcement with potential for other digital rules. Competition-law analogies make private enforcement operational, but their extension beyond their original setting may also shape the procedural law of the wider EU digital rulebook. The analysis further shows why injunctive relief is likely to remain more important than damages during the initial development of private enforcement: it permits rapid intervention against continuing conduct and avoids the difficulties of quantifying harm resulting from restrictions on fairness, contestability, user autonomy or visibility.

The article concludes that private enforcement can significantly strengthen the effectiveness of the DMA and other EU digital rules. At the same time, greater procedural coordination, Commission participation and use of the preliminary ruling procedure will be necessary to limit fragmentation and ensure consistent remedies across the internal market.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了《数字市场法案》（DMA）的私人执行机制，以德国科隆高等地区法院（涉及Meta使用个人数据训练生成式AI）和美因茨地区法院（涉及Google对Gmail的处理）的首批判决为案例，从程序法视角分析国家法院如何在缺乏统一的欧盟私人执行框架下落实DMA义务。文章认为这些判决正在催生一个混合且去中心化的DMA执行程序架构，竞争法类比使私人执行可操作化，且禁令救济在私人执行初期比损害赔偿更为重要。
AI.research_question: 在缺乏协调统一的欧盟私人执行框架的情况下，国家法院如何通过程序规则操作化DMA义务？德国法院的首批判决如何塑造DMA私人执行的程序架构？
AI.motivation: DMA主要依赖欧盟委员会主导的集中式公共执行体系，但其实际有效性还取决于消费者、商业用户和代表性组织在国家法院援引其义务的能力。然而，DMA缺乏统一的私人执行框架，导致国家法院面临大量程序性难题，需要分析法院如何解决这些问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文借鉴了竞争法、消费者法、国际私法和一般民事诉讼程序中的概念与理论，特别是程序法视角下关于代表诉讼资格、国际管辖权（《布鲁塞尔条例I bis》第7(2)条）、适用法律、司法审查的地域范围、公司集团内适当被告的认定以及与欧盟委员会依据DMA第39条协调等理论。
AI.method: 本文采用案例分析的方法，对德国两个法院的首批DMA私人执行判决进行程序法视角的深入分析，包括科隆高等地区法院关于Meta的判决和美因茨地区法院关于Google的判决，并在此基础上进行规范性论证。
AI.findings: （1）消费者组织和商业用户可在欧盟委员会执行之前独立寻求禁令救济；（2）德国法院大量借鉴竞争法、消费者法、国际私法和民事诉讼程序中的概念来解决代表诉讼资格、国际管辖权、适用法律、地域范围、适当被告和与委员会协调等问题；（3）这些判决推动了DMA执行中混合且去中心化程序架构的形成；（4）禁令救济在私人执行初期比损害赔偿更为重要，因为它允许快速干预持续性行为并避免量化损害的困难；（5）需要更大的程序协调、委员会参与和初步裁决程序的使用来限制碎片化并确保内部市场救济的一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文揭示了竞争法类比在使DMA私人执行可操作化中的作用，并指出这些类比超出其原始语境后可能塑造更广泛的欧盟数字规则体系（如数字服务法等其他数字法律）的程序法。文章还论证了禁令救济在数字市场监管中相对于损害赔偿的理论优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文为欧盟数字规则私人执行的程序架构提供了实践指引，指出需要强化程序协调、增加欧盟委员会参与和利用初步裁决程序来减少碎片化，确保内部市场救济的一致性，从而有效加强DMA及其他欧盟数字规则的实际执行效果。

title: An Autopsy of the Voluntary Carbon Market
affiliations: Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies (IHEID) - Department of Economics,  and University of Geneva - Graduate Institute, Geneva (IHEID)

detail.title: An Autopsy of the Voluntary Carbon Market
detail.abstract: The Voluntary Carbon Market (VCM) rests on the premise that one carbon credit compensates for one tonne of emissions. While a growing body of evidence questions the integrity of many credits, much less is known about whether the ability to offset affects firms' incentives to reduce their own emissions. Using a buyer-linked dataset covering the near-universe of offset retirements, we exploit the 2023 carbon-market scandals as a quasi-natural experiment. Firms that stop offsetting after the shock reduce their operational (Scope 1) emissions substantially more than firms that continue to purchase offsets. This finding is consistent with moral licensing: access to offsets weakens firms' incentives to undertake internal abatement. We also document persistent oversupply, opaque intermediation, and sharp price and volume responses to the scandals. Our results identify a demand-side problem in the VCM that is distinct from concerns about credit quality: even when credits represent genuine emissions reductions, the option to offset may slow decarbonization within purchasing firms.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2023年碳市场丑闻作为准自然实验，发现因丑闻停止购买碳抵消额度的企业，其运营排放（Scope 1）的减少幅度显著大于继续购买抵消额度的企业，支持了"道德许可"假说：获得碳抵消选项会削弱企业内部减排动力。
AI.research_question: 碳抵消能力是否会影响企业自身减排的激励？即企业拥有购买碳抵消额度的选项是否会削弱其内部减排动力？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注碳信用本身的完整性和质量问题，但很少探讨抵消能力对企业自身减排激励的影响。这一需求侧问题对于理解自愿碳市场（VCM）的完整效应至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德许可（Moral Licensing）理论：当个体或企业获得"做好事"的许可后（如购买碳抵消），可能会减少其他亲社会行为（如内部减排），因为购买抵消带来了道德上的"许可"感。
AI.method: 使用覆盖近全部抵消注销的买方关联数据集，以2023年碳市场丑闻作为准自然实验，比较丑闻后停止抵消的企业与继续抵消企业在运营排放变化上的差异。
AI.findings: （1）丑闻后停止抵消的企业Scope 1排放减少幅度显著大于继续抵消的企业；（2）发现碳市场存在持续供给过剩和中介不透明问题；（3）丑闻引发了价格和交易量的剧烈波动。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次从需求侧识别出自愿碳市场中的问题，区别于已有研究关注的信用质量问题；（2）为道德许可假说在企业碳减排情境中提供了经验证据；（3）揭示即使碳信用代表真实的减排量，抵消选项本身也可能减缓购买企业的脱碳进程。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）对碳市场设计者提供警示：需要在碳抵消机制与鼓励企业内部减排之间取得平衡；（2）对政策制定者而言，单纯提高碳信用质量可能不足以解决VCM的低碳化效应问题；（3）对企业管理者提供参考：依赖碳抵消可能反而延缓自身脱碳转型。

title:
Beyond Prediction: Permissibility and Admissibility
The Rules of Engagement Between Intelligence Fields and Environmental Complexity
affiliations: The Force Global Research Facility

detail.title:
Beyond Prediction: Permissibility and Admissibility
The Rules of Engagement Between Intelligence Fields and Environmental Complexity
detail.abstract: Under qualitative infinity, prediction becomes structurally limited as the primary basis for action. This paper specifies permissibility and admissibility as complementary rules of engagement between intelligence fields and environmental complexity. Permissibility concerns what the field’s present coherence architecture can process from within without increasing latency or fragmentation. Admissibility concerns what the field can receive from its environment and convert into coherence rather than distortion. Under C + L + D = 1, ∀t; ΔC ≥ 0, the two criteria provide internal and external readings of metabolic readiness. Situated within Structural Realism and Coherent Collective Cognition, they replace prediction-centred judgment with continuous, invariant-bound coherence navigation

AI.tldr: 本文提出在定性无限（qualitative infinity）条件下，预测作为行动的主要基础在结构上受到限制。论文将"允许性"（permissibility）和"可接纳性"（admissibility）界定为智能领域与环境复杂性之间的互补参与规则，替代以预测为中心的判断，转向连续、不变约束下的连贯性导航。
AI.research_question: 在定性无限的条件下，智能领域如何通过允许性与可接纳性两个互补标准来实现与环境复杂性的有效互动，从而替代以预测为中心的行动判断？
AI.motivation: 在定性无限条件下，预测作为行动基础存在结构性局限，需要寻找替代性的判断机制来指导智能领域的行动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构实在论（Structural Realism）与连贯集体认知（Coherent Collective Cognition）
AI.method: 概念性/理论性分析，基于C + L + D = 1, ∀t; ΔC ≥ 0的形式化约束框架，提出允许性与可接纳性作为代谢就绪性（metabolic readiness）的内外解读标准。
AI.findings: 允许性关注领域现有连贯性架构能够从内部处理的内容（不增加延迟或碎片化）；可接纳性关注领域能够从环境中接收并转化为连贯性而非扭曲的内容。两者分别提供代谢就绪性的内部与外部解读，共同构成替代预测中心判断的连续、不变约束连贯性导航。
AI.theory_contributions: 将允许性与可接纳性确立为智能领域与环境复杂性之间的互补参与规则，在结构实在论与连贯集体认知框架下替代预测中心主义，提出基于不变约束的连贯性导航理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智能系统在环境高度复杂、预测不可行的条件下提供新的行动判断准则，通过允许性与可接纳性的内外双重检验来指导决策与认知过程。

title: Autonomous Buses for Demand-Responsive Feeder Services: Intermodal Coordination and Feeder System Selection
affiliations: ,  and Technische Universität München (TUM)

detail.title: Autonomous Buses for Demand-Responsive Feeder Services: Intermodal Coordination and Feeder System Selection

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the European Union's Horizon Europe research and innovation programme through the Seamless Shared Urban Mobility (SUM) project [grant number 101103646].

detail.abstract: Conventional fixed-route bus services face a trade-off between service provision and operating cost. Higher service frequencies and broader coverage improve accessibility but can leave vehicles underused, whereas service reductions increase passenger waiting or access burdens. Autonomous buses (ABs) operated as demand-responsive transport (DRT) may ease this trade-off through flexible routing, on-demand fleet deployment, and lower operating costs. This study asks how AB-based DRT should be coordinated with scheduled trunk public transport (PT) services and when it should be preferred over conventional fixedroute bus services. We compare three intermodal coordination strategies: Plan-As-You-Go (PAYG), in which passengers book successive journey legs; Estimation-based Integration (EI), in which a Mobility-asa-Service (MaaS) platform pre-books the complete journey using conservative estimates of key DRT event times; and Collaborative Coordination (CC), which uses real-time information exchange to adjust DRT time windows and coordinate transfers. We then embed these strategies in a simulation-based evaluation framework that uses agent-based simulation, Pareto frontier analysis, and generalized total system cost calculations to evaluate AB-based DRT across operating contexts, thereby supporting context-specific decisions about feeder services and fleet design. Controlled synthetic experiments show that CC achieves higher service rates than PAYG and shorter passenger journey times than both PAYG and EI, with the clearest gains for intermodal journeys. In most tested scenarios, AB-based DRT achieves a lower generalized total system cost than conventional fixed-route bus services. The conventional fixed-route bus alternative is preferred only when high intermodal demand is concentrated along feeder corridors and trunk rail headways are short.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了基于自动驾驶巴士（AB）的需求响应型交通（DRT）如何与定时干线公共交通（PT）服务协调，并比较了三种多式联运协调策略（PAYG、EI、CC）。通过基于代理的仿真、帕累托前沿分析和广义总系统成本计算，研究发现协作协调（CC）在服务率和乘客出行时间方面表现最优，且AB-DRT在大多数场景下优于传统固定线路公交，仅在特定条件下传统公交更受青睐。
AI.research_question: 自动驾驶巴士需求响应型交通（AB-DRT）应如何与定时干线公共交通服务进行协调？在什么条件下应优先选择AB-DRT而非传统固定线路公交服务？
AI.motivation: 传统固定线路公交在服务供给与运营成本之间存在两难权衡——高频率和广覆盖提升可达性但导致车辆利用率低下，而减少服务则增加乘客等待或出行负担。基于自动驾驶巴士的需求响应型交通（DRT）通过灵活路线、按需车队部署和更低运营成本有望缓解这一权衡，但如何将其与干线公共交通有效协调尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多式联运协调理论、需求响应型交通（DRT）运营理论、Mobility-as-a-Service（MaaS）平台协作框架、代理基仿真模型
AI.method: 采用基于代理的仿真（agent-based simulation）为核心评估框架，嵌入三种多式联运协调策略（PAYG、EI、CC），并结合帕累托前沿分析和广义总系统成本计算，通过控制性合成实验对不同运营场景进行评估。
AI.findings: 1. CC策略在服务率上优于PAYG，在乘客行程时间上同时优于PAYG和EI，对多式联运出行改善最为显著；2. 在大多数测试场景中，AB-DRT的广义总系统成本低于传统固定线路公交；3. 仅当高密度多式联运需求集中在接驳走廊且干线铁路发车间隔较短时，传统固定线路公交更受青睐。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统比较了三种多式联运协调策略在AB-DRT场景下的表现，提出了将实时信息交换（CC策略）应用于DRT与干线PT协调的理论框架，为自主交通系统与公共交通系统的集成提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共交通规划者提供了情境化的决策支持，帮助其根据具体运营环境选择接驳服务模式（AB-DRT vs 传统固定线路公交）及车队设计方案；明确了CC协调策略在实践中的优势，为MaaS平台设计提供了指导。

title: Directing and Attributing AI Improvement: Feedback Rights, Measurement, and Expertise Bottlenecks

detail.title: Directing and Attributing AI Improvement: Feedback Rights, Measurement, and Expertise Bottlenecks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical study and does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Improving an AI system in a specialized domain can require feedback from the same scarce experts who produce and verify current services. This paper connects the institutions that direct such feedback to the downstream task system in which improved capability is used. Rights determine how quality-adjusted feedback produces a vector of capabilities. Locked model evaluations determine which feedback incentives can be contracted. Improved capability then changes endogenous task entry, expert routing, active review time, decision quality, delay, and nonreview. Social and private capability values are derived as gradients of this downstream system rather than imposed as disconnected primitives. I characterize feedback-priority inversion, complete implementation with active and inactive KKT conditions, and a two-stage distinction between capability directions excluded by rights and feedback incentives omitted by measurement. Downstream, capability and ordinary load remain observationally equivalent in operations when they induce the same entry indices and review primitives. Using an ex ante operational metric, the joint result shows that expanding locked evaluations monotonically improves implementation fit but can reduce the separation of the implemented operational response from a pre-specified nuisance span. Locked evaluations can still verify that capability changed even when its operational signature becomes load-equivalent. The model motivates one linked design that follows expert feedback into a versioned model and then into task-level operations.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个理论模型，将专业领域AI系统的专家反馈制度与下游任务系统联系起来。论文刻画了权利如何决定质量调整反馈产生的能力向量，以及锁定的模型评估如何决定可签约的反馈激励。研究推导了社会与私人能力价值作为下游系统的梯度，揭示了反馈优先级反转、完全实施的KKT条件、能力方向排除与激励遗漏的两阶段区分，以及下游运营中能力与普通负载的可观察等价性等重要结论。
AI.research_question: 在专业领域AI系统中，专家反馈的激励机制（由权利与锁定评估决定）如何与下游任务系统互动，从而影响能力提升的价值实现与运营表现？
AI.motivation: 专业领域的AI系统改进需要稀缺专家的反馈，而这些专家同时是现有服务的生产者和验证者。已有研究通常将能力价值视为外生给定的离散原语，忽视了反馈制度与下游任务系统之间的内在联系。本文旨在弥合这一理论缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论（合约理论）、KKT条件（含激活与非激活约束）、梯度分析、运营管理中的任务路由与审查模型、可观察等价性分析。
AI.method: 本文采用数学建模与理论分析的方法，构建了一个连接反馈制度（权利、锁定评估）与下游任务系统（任务进入、专家路由、审查时间、决策质量、延迟）的整合模型，通过KKT条件刻画完全实施条件，并运用梯度方法推导能力价值。
AI.findings: （1）识别了反馈优先级反转现象；（2）刻画了完全实施的条件，包括激活与非激活KKT条件；（3）区分了两阶段问题：权利排除的能力方向与测量遗漏的反馈激励；（4）证明了下游运营中能力提升与普通负载在诱导相同进入指数和审查原语时具有可观察等价性；（5）扩大锁定评估范围单调改善实施拟合度，但可能降低实施运营响应与预设干扰跨度的分离度；（6）即使能力变化在运营层面表现为负载等价，锁定评估仍可验证能力确实发生了改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于：（1）将反馈制度（权利与评估锁定）内生化到能力提升与下游任务系统的统一框架中；（2）提出能力价值应作为下游系统的梯度而非外生原语；（3）引入反馈优先级反转、两阶段能力方向/激励遗漏区分等新概念；（4）建立了运营可观察等价性与实施拟合度之间的分析关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践贡献在于：（1）提出了一种将专家反馈→版本化模型→任务级运营链接起来的一体化设计思路；（2）为管理者提供了如何在锁定的能力验证与运营表现分离之间权衡的指导；（3）帮助设计者在扩展锁定评估时理解其对实施拟合度与运营响应分离度的双向影响。

title: KDI Monthly Economic Trends 2026. 6
affiliations: Korea Development Institute (KDI)

detail.title: KDI Monthly Economic Trends 2026. 6

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Development Institute (KDI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The Korean economy has continued to improve modestly, led by the semiconductor upcycle, despite downside risks to activity from the war in the Middle East.
 
 ○ Domestic demand is improving gradually, while exports remain strong, underpinned by semiconductors.

  - Construction investment remains subdued, but consumption continues to improve modestly and equipment investment is expanding strongly, driven mainly by semiconductor-related investment.

  - Export volumes have continued to grow at a solid pace, with strong semiconductor demand pushing export prices sharply higher.

 ○ However, downside risks to activity persist as the war continues to disrupt crude oil shipments.
 
  - Persistently high oil prices have pushed headline inflation higher and raised production costs.

  - At the same time, the adverse effects of the war are becoming evident in part, as crude oil supply disruptions weigh on petroleum refining output and petroleum product export volumes.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了韩国经济在中东战争地缘政治风险背景下的最新状况，指出半导体上行周期推动出口强劲和内需改善，但原油供应中断导致的高油价对通货膨胀和部分行业产出构成下行压力。
AI.research_question: 中东战争对韩国经济的下行风险与半导体上行周期带来的增长动力如何相互交织影响韩国经济走势？
AI.motivation: 韩国经济面临半导体出口繁荣与地缘政治冲突引发的能源供应风险并存的复杂局面，需要评估经济增长的韧性与不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济周期理论、国际贸易与地缘政治经济学的综合分析框架。
AI.method: 基于宏观经济数据的定性分析，涵盖内需、出口、投资、通胀及产业产出等多维度指标。
AI.findings: 1) 半导体需求强劲推动出口持续增长，出口价格大幅上升；2) 消费温和改善，设备投资受半导体驱动显著扩张，但建筑投资低迷；3) 高油价推高整体通胀并抬升生产成本；4) 原油供应中断已对炼油产出和成品油出口产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了地缘政治冲击与产业周期上行在不同经济层面形成抵消或叠加效应的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估韩国经济面临的风险结构、制定应对通胀与供应中断的调控措施提供参考依据。

title: Categorical Stigma
affiliations: , Copenhagen Business School and University College London - UCL School of Management, University College London - UCL School of Management

detail.title: Categorical Stigma
detail.abstract: Categorical stigma results from ascribed membership in a devalued social group, whose members are seen as deviant, and whose affiliates risk devaluation-by-association. We bridge two literatures that have developed largely in parallel, namely micro research on stigmatized categories of individuals and macro research on stigmatized categories of organizations, to develop an integrative account of categorical stigma across levels of analysis. Using a structured, multi-level review of prior research, we synthesize evidence around three core processes. First, stigmatized categories form through labelling, stereotyping, and moralization, often accelerated by crises and social movements. Second, categorical stigma spills over through association: it can attach to individuals and organizations, diffuse across product and market categories, and intensify when targets appear more prototypical. Third, individuals and organizations exercise agency. They can manage categorical stigma by distancing (e.g., dilution through additional category associations, self-group distancing, divestment), by redrawing category boundaries (e.g., category creation, conflation), and by mobilizing intermediaries (e.g., allies, brokers) and emotions (e.g., empathy, compassion). Furthermore, the synthesis reveals two cross-level tensions that motivate a future research agenda. One concerns whether stigma is inherently harmful. While emphasis on stigma remediation in micro research could suggest that it is, macro research shows that categorical stigma can help contain harmful societal practices. The other concerns multiple category associations involving (at least some) stigma: "intersectionality" in micro work and stigmatized "category spanning" in macro work partially overlap, but can yield different outcomes depending on prototypicality and the salience of categorization dimensions. Ultimately, this paper offers an integrative framework for researching stigmatized categories across levels in the social sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结构化多层次文献综述，整合了微观层面（个体污名化类别）和宏观层面（组织污名化类别）两大并行发展的研究脉络，提出了一个跨层级的类别污名整合框架，围绕类别污名的形成、外溢和管理三大核心过程展开，并揭示了两个跨层级张力以推进未来研究议程。
AI.research_question: 微观层面的个体污名化类别研究与宏观层面的组织污名化类别研究如何整合？类别污名在不同分析层级之间如何形成、外溢和被管理？
AI.motivation: 微观与宏观研究大体并行发展，缺乏跨层级的整合性理论框架来解释类别污名在个体和组织层面的共性机制与差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 类别污名理论（categorical stigma），整合了微观研究中的个体污名化类别理论与宏观研究中的组织污名化类别理论，涵盖标签化（labelling）、刻板印象（stereotyping）、道德化（moralization）、原型性（prototypicality）与交叉性（intersectionality）等概念。
AI.method: 结构化、多层次的系统性文献综述（structured, multi-level review）。
AI.findings: 识别出类别污名的三大核心过程：（1）形成——通过标签化、刻板印象和道德化生成，危机与社会运动会加速过程；（2）外溢——通过关联扩散，可附着于个体和组织，跨越产品和市场类别传播，目标越具原型性扩散越强；（3）管理——个体和组织可采取疏离（稀释、自我群体疏离、剥离）、重绘类别边界（类别创造、类别合并）以及动员中介者（盟友、经纪人）和情绪（共情、同情）等策略。此外揭示了两个跨层级张力：污名是否本质上有害，以及多重类别关联（微观"交叉性"与宏观"污名化类别跨越"）的部分重叠与分歧。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了跨层级的类别污名整合框架，弥合了微观与宏观研究之间的理论断层；识别了"污名是否有害"和"多重类别关联的结果差异"两大跨层级张力，为未来理论发展指明方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者、政策制定者及社会行动者提供了管理类别污名的策略工具箱（疏离、重绘边界、动员中介），并有助于理解污名化类别在遏制有害社会实践中可能发挥的建设性作用。

title: Wrong and more Confident: A Field Experiment on Language Models Taking a Graduate

detail.title: Wrong and more Confident: A Field Experiment on Language Models Taking a Graduate
detail.abstract: A red herring, an irrelevant passage added to a problem, corrupts a language model's reasoning and, through it, its final answer, while the form of the response survives untouched. The benchmark, called the Graduate Economic Reasoning Benchmark (GERB), is sixty graduatelevel microeconomics problems, each a detailed setup with a verified final answer and a stepbystep reference solution. Each problem has two versions, one with the red herring and one without, and each of those is asked in two ways, one requesting an explanation and one not. This is a withinsubject 2 × 2 factorial experimental design. Thirtyeight language models answer all four versions of every problem. The clean problems (the control group) are already hard, with the models answering fewer than three of every five correctly on average. The red herring lowers the probability of a correct final answer by 12.3 percentage points, about a quarter of the models' mean accuracy of 0.525. The damage is largest on the problems the model rates as easy. Reasoning ability confers no protection, as the red herring's effect does not differ detectably across models with and without reasoning ability. The red herring also leads a model to rate a problem as easier than its clean version, while answering it wrong more often. Although open and closedweight models reach the same accuracy, the openweight models reach it at a substantially lower cost per correct final answer. The form of the response is preserved even as its substance fails. The model still produces an explanation (explanation given), the final answer still follows from the reasoning shown (coherence), and it remains the same across waves (consistency).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为GERB（研究生经济推理基准）的基准测试，包含60道研究生水平的微观经济学问题，每道题有包含"红鲱鱼"（无关信息）和不包含两个版本。通过38个语言模型参与2×2因子实验设计，研究发现无关信息会将模型答对概率降低12.3个百分点，且推理能力不能提供保护。模型在回答错误的同时反而会认为问题更简单，且回答形式（解释、连贯性、一致性）保持不变，即使实质内容已经失败。
AI.research_question: 无关信息（红鲱鱼）如何影响语言模型的推理能力与最终答案的正确性？这种影响是否因模型的推理能力而异？
AI.motivation: 语言模型在推理任务中容易受到无关信息的干扰，但此前缺乏严格控制的实验设计来量化这种干扰效应的大小和性质。此外，现有基准测试难度不足，难以区分不同模型的推理能力差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于认知心理学中"注意力分散"和"相关性与相关性过滤"理论，结合大语言模型推理鲁棒性研究框架。
AI.method: 采用被试内2×2因子实验设计：问题有/无红鲱鱼 × 要求/不要求解释，共4个版本。38个语言模型回答所有版本，比较干净问题（对照组）与含红鲱鱼版本的正确率和主观难度评分。
AI.findings: 1) 干净问题本身已经很难，模型平均正确率不足3/5；2) 红鲱鱼使正确率降低12.3个百分点，约占平均准确率0.525的四分之一；3) 伤害在模型认为简单的问题上最大；4) 推理能力无法提供保护，有/无推理能力的模型受影响程度无显著差异；5) 红鲱鱼使模型将问题评为更简单但答错更频繁；6) 开放权重模型与封闭权重模型准确率相同，但开放权重模型每次正确回答的成本显著更低；7) 回答形式（解释、连贯性、一致性）保持不变，即使实质内容失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了语言模型"形式完整性"与"内容正确性"的分离现象——模型的回答形式上保持连贯一致，但实质推理被无关信息破坏。这挑战了以往对模型推理鲁棒性的假设，并为理解大语言模型的推理机制提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了GERB基准测试，为评估语言模型在复杂经济推理任务中的鲁棒性提供了标准化工具；揭示了在实际应用中无关信息对模型输出的潜在风险，对模型部署和提示工程设计具有指导意义；比较了开放与封闭权重模型的性价比。

title:
When The Rules Survive but the Score Fails 

Independent Verification and Monotone Redesign of a Pre-Task Biological Capacity Architecture for Aviation Systems
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
When The Rules Survive but the Score Fails 

Independent Verification and Monotone Redesign of a Pre-Task Biological Capacity Architecture for Aviation Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal competing interests. Eva M. Erpenbach, who conducted the independent external verification, and the author had an existing professional research collaboration on an unrelated project. That collaboration preceded the BRI review but did not involve BRI design, analysis or manuscript preparation. Eva M. Erpenbach is not an author of the present paper and did not participate in the original BRI design, the internal audits, the subsequent construct adjudication or the Stage III candidate implementation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The reported work involved no human participants, biological samples or identifiable personal data. Ethics approval was therefore not required for the work reported in this paper. Any future expert-panel or participant studies will proceed only after the relevant ethics or institutional determination.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Aviation operator-state research increasingly combines physiological measurement with adaptive monitoring and decision support, yet a physiological value can be mistaken for an operational-readiness judgement. This paper reports the development, falsification and redesign of the Biological Resilience Index (BRI), an explicitly pre-task, task-relative research programme intended to represent biological capacity separately from Current Stress and Current Fatigue. Edition I comprised five candidate components, a 324-rule baseline Mamdani layer and a 16-rule conditional layer. Extended continuous verification identified reproducible directional reversals: improving a nominally protective input could lower the crisp output, and increasing conditional vulnerability could raise the final output. An external verifier separately reconstructed the model, reproduced all 47 targeted Layer-1 reversals with numerical agreement of approximately 10⁻¹³, reproduced the Layer-2 counts of 1,745 and 567 exactly, and found no ordinal violations across 12,636 dominance comparisons. The ordinal rule architecture was retained, whereas the continuous crisp-score path was suspended.

A provisional internal construct adjudication produced a non-scoring pre-task biological-capacity profile with ACI, HPA-R and ARI as candidate domains, FTP as an optional task-demand module, and biological context externalised from scoring. Three alternative projections were then frozen: an ordinal embedding, an equal-weight harmonic projection and a weighted arithmetic comparator. Their mathematical forms are non-decreasing in every active input. For each candidate, a frozen benchmark comprising exactly 2,113,125 structured, random and breakpoint test cases found no implementation-level directional violations. Separate checks confirmed endpoint attainment, inactive-module identity, missing-value propagation and agreement between vectorised and scalar implementations. The candidates nevertheless differed materially in compression, low-component sensitivity and profile ordering. No final score was selected.

The principal methodological contribution is the separation of canonical construct meaning from numerical projection. An ordinally coherent and interpretable architecture may still yield a directionally invalid continuous output, while a monotone projection may still encode an unsupported substantive theory. Independent content validity and participant validation remain prospective.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了生物弹性指数（BRI）的研发、证伪与重新设计过程。第一版BRI包含Mamdani模糊推理层，但在持续验证中发现方向性反转缺陷（改善保护性输入反而降低输出），外部验证者复现了所有47个目标反转。研究随后设计了三个非递减的新型候选投影方案，经过2,113,125个测试用例验证无方向性违规，但三个方案在压缩性、低组分敏感性和剖面排序上存在差异，最终未选择最终分数。核心方法论贡献是将构念意义与数值投影分离。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够将生物能力（Biological Capacity）与当前压力和疲劳相分离的、方向性有效（directionally valid）的航空操作员生物弹性指数（BRI）？
AI.motivation: 航空操作员状态研究中，生理测量结果常被误认为操作就绪判断。BRI旨在明确地作为任务前、任务相对的指标，区分生物能力与当前压力和疲劳，避免"生理值=操作就绪"的概念混淆。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以"构念意义与数值投影分离"为核心方法论框架，区分规范性的构念解释（canonical construct meaning）与数学投影（numerical projection）。候选领域包括ACI、HPA-R和ARI，FTP作为可选任务需求模块。
AI.method: 第一版采用5个候选组件、324条规则的Mamdani基线层和16条规则的条件层。通过扩展持续验证和外部验证者独立重建测试发现方向性反转。第二版冻结了三种替代投影方案（序数嵌入、等权调和投影、加权算术比较器），并通过2,113,125个测试用例（结构化、随机和断点测试）进行验证。
AI.findings: 第一版BRI存在方向性缺陷：改善名义保护输入可降低输出，增加条件脆弱性可提高最终输出。外部验证者精确复现了47个Layer-1反转（数值一致度约10⁻¹³）和Layer-2计数（1,745和567）。第二种方案中三种投影在数学形式上对每个活跃输入非递减，均通过大规模基准测试，但在压缩性、低组分敏感性和剖面排序上存在实质性差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 主要理论贡献在于证明：序数一致且可解释的架构（如模糊规则系统）仍可能产生方向性无效的连续输出；而单调投影也可能编码未经支持的理论。构念规范意义与数值投影必须分离考虑。
AI.practical_contributions: 保留了序数规则架构，暂停了连续的精确分数路径，提出了非评分的任务前生物能力剖面。独立内容效度和参与者验证仍待进行。

title: Cross-border Executive Leadership in Cooperative Financial Institutions: Cultural Intelligence, Regulatory Adaptability, and the Transfer of Strategic Capability
affiliations: Bellevue University

detail.title: Cross-border Executive Leadership in Cooperative Financial Institutions: Cultural Intelligence, Regulatory Adaptability, and the Transfer of Strategic Capability
detail.abstract:
Financial institutions increasingly recruit executives whose professional experience extends across national borders, regulatory jurisdictions, organizational systems, and cultural environments. Cross-border executives may contribute valuable knowledge concerning governance, commercial banking, enterprise risk management, organizational transformation, technology, and member service. However, leadership practices that are effective in one country cannot be transferred mechanically into another. Regulatory expectations, governance structures, labor markets, communication norms, competitive conditions, and organizational cultures shape how leadership is interpreted and whether imported practices gain legitimacy. 

This conceptual article examines cross-border executive leadership within cooperative and community-oriented financial institutions, with particular attention to leadership mobility between Canada and the United States. It integrates scholarship on global leadership, cultural intelligence, institutional theory, upper-echelons theory, dynamic capabilities, organizational culture, knowledge transfer, and banking governance. The article argues that cross-border leadership effectiveness depends on more than international experience. It requires the ability to distinguish transferable strategic principles from practices that must be adapted to local institutional conditions. 

The article develops a Cross-Border Executive Leadership Capability Framework consisting of seven interconnected dimensions: institutional intelligence, cultural intelligence, regulatory fluency, adaptive knowledge transfer, stakeholder legitimacy, integrative strategic leadership, and reflective learning. It further proposes that cross-border executives can function as strategic integrators by combining knowledge from multiple financial systems without assuming that either system is universally superior. 

The analysis concludes that cross-border leadership can strengthen cooperative financial institutions when international experience is translated through local listening, regulatory understanding, governance alignment, and cultural humility. Executives who successfully integrate external knowledge with local institutional identity can improve strategic adaptability, risk governance, commercial capability, and organizational resilience. When adaptation is neglected, however, imported practices may create resistance, governance conflict, regulatory risk, and cultural fragmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇概念性研究文章，探讨合作型和社区导向型金融机构中的跨境高管领导力，重点关注加拿大与美国之间的领导力流动。文章提出"跨境高管领导力能力框架"，包含七个相互关联的维度：制度智力、文化智力、监管流畅度、适应性知识转移、利益相关者合法性、整合性战略领导力和反思性学习。文章主张跨境领导效能不仅取决于国际经验，还需要区分可转移的战略原则与必须适应当地制度条件的实践。
AI.research_question: 跨境高管在合作型和社区导向型金融机构中的领导效能如何实现？具体而言，国际经验如何通过本地化适应转化为有效的组织领导力？
AI.motivation: 金融机构越来越多地招聘具有跨国经验的 executives，但一国有效的领导实践不能机械地转移到另一国。监管预期、治理结构、劳动力市场、沟通规范、竞争条件和组织文化都会影响领导力的解释方式和外来实践的合法性，因此需要系统化的理论框架来理解跨境领导力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了全球领导力、文化智力、制度理论、高层梯队理论（upper-echelons theory）、动态能力、组织文化、知识转移和银行治理等多元学术视角。
AI.method: 概念性研究（conceptual article），通过理论整合与框架构建的方法，不对实证数据进行统计分析，而是基于多学科文献提出理论框架和命题。
AI.findings: 跨境领导力可以增强合作金融机构的实力，前提是国际经验通过本地倾听、监管理解、治理对齐和文化谦逊得到转化。成功整合外部知识与本地制度身份的高管能提升战略适应性、风险治理、商业能力和组织韧性；忽视适应则会导致阻力、治理冲突、监管风险和文化碎片化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"跨境高管领导力能力框架"（Cross-Border Executive Leadership Capability Framework），包含七个维度；提出跨境高管可充当"战略整合者"（strategic integrators），在不假定任一金融系统普遍优越的前提下整合多元金融体系知识；丰富了高层梯队理论和制度理论在跨国金融领导力情境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为合作金融机构在选拔和培养跨境高管时提供能力框架参考；为跨境高管提供如何区分可转移战略原则与需本地化适应实践的实操指引；为组织设计跨境领导力发展计划、治理对齐和知识转移机制提供指导。

title: Forecasting Venezuela's Post-Maduro Recovery: Security, Trade Reliability, and Strategic Redevelopment to 2040

detail.title: Forecasting Venezuela's Post-Maduro Recovery: Security, Trade Reliability, and Strategic Redevelopment to 2040
detail.abstract: This study forecasts Venezuela's post-Maduro redevelopment from 2026 to 2040 and evaluates the conditions under which the country could reemerge as a reliable trading partner. It frames reopening as a securityconditioned redevelopment process and uses qualitative strategic forecasting, scenario analysis, nationalsecurity assessment, and geopolitical-risk analysis to develop five mutually exclusive futures: Strategic Recovery, Managed Instability, Criminalized Resource Economy, Foreign-Influenced Proxy State, and Failed Redevelopment. The evidence indicates that Venezuela has the resource base to support recovery but not yet the institutional foundation required for full trade reliability. Oil, natural gas, minerals, hydroelectric capacity, agriculture, freshwater, and Caribbean access create major commercial potential. Reliability, however, depends on enforceable contracts, secure infrastructure and resource zones, corruption control, lawful finance, effective courts and customs, political legitimacy, and foreign relationships that do not compromise strategic autonomy. Managed Instability is the most likely near-term trajectory: commercial activity expands selectively while institutional and security weaknesses continue to constrain dependable trade. Strategic Recovery remains possible if reopening becomes an institution-building process rather than a resource-access event captured by corrupt, criminal, or foreign-aligned networks. The study contributes an integrated framework for evaluating trade reliability in resource-rich transitional states.

AI.tldr: 本研究预测委内瑞拉2026-2040年后马杜罗时代的重建进程，评估其重新成为可靠贸易伙伴的条件，提出五种互斥的未来情景，并认为"受控不稳定"是最可能的近期轨迹。
AI.research_question: 委内瑞拉在马杜罗政权之后（2026-2040年）能否重新成为可靠的贸易伙伴？在何种条件下可以实现这一目标？
AI.motivation: 委内瑞拉拥有丰富的资源基础但缺乏可靠的制度基础，需要系统评估其在后马杜罗时代的重建前景及其作为贸易伙伴的可靠性条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将重新开放定位为安全约束下的重建过程（security-conditioned redevelopment process），整合国家安全评估与地缘政治风险分析框架。
AI.method: 定性战略预测（qualitative strategic forecasting）、情景分析、国家安全评估、地缘政治风险分析，构建五种互斥的未来情景。
AI.findings: 五种情景为：战略复苏、受控不稳定、犯罪化资源经济、外国影响的代理国、失败的重建。其中"受控不稳定"是最可能的近期轨迹；战略性复苏只有在重新开放成为制度建设过程而非资源获取事件时才有可能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个用于评估资源丰富转型国家贸易可靠性的综合框架（integrated framework）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估委内瑞拉的贸易伙伴可靠性提供具体标准（可执行合同、安全基础设施、反腐、合法金融、有效法院与海关、政治合法性、战略自主），并为政策制定者提供情景规划参考。

title: Decision Support or High-risk? Classifying AI Workforce-intelligence Systems under the EU AI Act

detail.title: Decision Support or High-risk? Classifying AI Workforce-intelligence Systems under the EU AI Act

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the research reported in this paper. The views expressed are the author's own and do not represent those of any employer or affiliated organization. No commercial product, vendor, or service is endorsed or recommended.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a conceptual and design-science analysis based on public regulatory texts and published scholarship. It does not involve human participants, patient data, personally identifiable data, animal subjects, or fieldwork requiring ethics-committee review.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant, contract, or other funding from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) designates AI systems used in employment, worker management, and access to self-employment as high-risk under Annex III. Such systems attract stringent obligations for risk management, data governance, transparency, human oversight, recordkeeping, and conformity assessment. A fast-growing class of enterprise systems sits ambiguously against this category: external workforce-intelligence platforms that convert public labour-market signals, such as job postings, competitor movements, and skill-demand shifts, into aggregate strategic guidance. These platforms inform workforce planning at the level of roles, functions, and populations rather than making decisions about identifiable individuals. The boundary between high-risk employment AI and governed strategic decision support is, however, neither self-evident nor consistently applied in practice. 

This paper develops a classification framework that distinguishes workforce-intelligence architectures falling within the Act's high-risk employment scope from those that constitute defensible decision support. Following the design-science research paradigm, and drawing on the derogation criteria in Article 6(3), it analyses four system archetypes and identifies five architectural properties that materially affect classification and defensibility: an aggregation boundary, deterministic and reproducible processing, explain-only outputs, human-in-the-loop escalation, and end-to-end provenance logging. The properties are instantiated on a generalised reference architecture, translated into an operational compliance checklist, and extended into a practice layer that covers vendor and product assurance, effectiveness and bias testing across the lifecycle, post-deployment monitoring and re-classification triggers, and an operating model of roles with worker-representative consultation. The paper offers HR leaders, system designers, and governance functions a practical instrument for the Act's phased enforcement, and sets out a research agenda for responsible workforce intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个分类框架，用于区分欧盟《人工智能法案》高风险管理范围内的劳动力情报平台与属于合规决策支持的系统。通过设计科学研究范式，识别了五个影响分类和合规防御能力的架构属性，并提供了操作化的合规检查清单和实践层指导。
AI.research_question: 如何区分受欧盟《人工智能法案》高风险管理约束的外部劳动力情报平台与属于合法决策支持的系统？哪些架构属性决定这种分类及合规性？
AI.motivation: 欧盟《人工智能法案》（2024/1689号法规）将就业、工人管理和自主就业准入中使用的AI系统列为高风险，但一类快速增长的"外部劳动力情报平台"（利用公开劳动力市场信号提供战略指导）在该分类下界限模糊，实践中缺乏一致适用的判定标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学研究范式；欧盟《人工智能法案》第6(3)条的豁免标准；基于架构属性的分类框架。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究（DSR）范式，分析四种系统原型，识别五个架构属性，实例化到通用参考架构，转化为操作合规检查清单，并扩展至实践层。
AI.findings: 识别出五个影响分类与合规防御能力的架构属性：聚合边界（aggregation boundary）、确定性与可复现处理、仅解释输出（explain-only outputs）、人在回路升级机制（human-in-the-loop escalation）、端到端溯源日志（end-to-end provenance logging）。这些属性被实例化到通用参考架构并转化为可操作的合规检查清单。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了区分高风险就业AI与受治理的战略决策支持系统的分类框架，为欧洲AI监管在劳动力情报领域的模糊地带提供了理论性边界界定。
AI.practical_contributions: 为HR领导者、系统设计者和治理职能提供实用工具，涵盖供应商和产品保证、全生命周期有效性与偏见测试、部署后监控与重新分类触发机制，以及包含工人代表咨询的角色运营模型，支持法案分阶段执法的应对。

title: Alpha Generation using Option Trading Strategies based on Modeling Options Prices considering Mandelbrotian Movement of Prices
affiliations: , WorldQuant University, WorldQuant University and WorldQuant University

detail.title: Alpha Generation using Option Trading Strategies based on Modeling Options Prices considering Mandelbrotian Movement of Prices

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Disclaimer: This paper was created as part of a WorldQuant University degree program towards an MSc in Financial Engineering. This paper is reproduced with the consent and permission of WorldQuant University. All rights reserved. (This disclaimer is also present in the preprint.)

detail.abstract: Multiple asset pricing models (the Multifractal Model of Asset Returns, classical Black-Scholes, Merton, Heston, and Bates models) are used to calculate S&P500 option prices based on historical S&P500 closing price data to identify the best performing model across options with short-term, medium-term, and long-term expiry dates, as well as across types of expiry (In-the-Money, At-the-Money and Out-of-the-Money). Subsequently, the usage of an optimization framework to assign weight coefficients to the price obtained by each model is explored, and its accuracy in predicting options prices relative to the other individual pricing models is evaluated. We then use the proposed option pricing models to develop option trading strategies to demonstrate the generation of alpha in a real financial scenario. We find that our optimization framework-weighted ensemble model not only features among the most accurate option pricing models alongside the Multifractal Model for Asset Returns and classical Black-Scholes models, but also forms the most successful trading strategy in backtesting.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了多种资产定价模型（多重分形模型、Black-Scholes、Merton、Heston和Bates模型）在S&P500期权定价中的表现，并提出一个基于优化框架的加权集成模型。该集成模型不仅与多重分形模型和Black-Scholes模型同样准确，而且在回测中形成了最成功的期权交易策略，能够产生alpha。
AI.research_question: 哪种资产定价模型在不同期限和不同货币状态（实值、平值、虚值）的S&P500期权定价中表现最佳？如何通过优化框架分配权重来提升定价准确性并生成alpha？
AI.motivation: 单一期权定价模型在不同市场条件下的表现存在差异，尚无统一的模型能全面超越其他模型。探索加权集成方法以提高定价准确性，并在真实金融场景中验证其交易策略的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多重分形资产收益模型（MMAR）、Black-Scholes模型、Merton跳跃扩散模型、Heston随机波动率模型、Bates跳跃-随机波动率模型，以及优化加权集成方法。
AI.method: 基于历史S&P500收盘价数据，使用五种定价模型计算期权价格；按到期期限（短期、中期、长期）和货币状态（实值、平值、虚值）进行对比；构建优化框架对模型价格分配权重系数形成集成模型；并利用该模型开发期权交易策略进行回测。
AI.findings: 优化框架加权的集成模型与多重分形模型和经典Black-Scholes模型同属最准确的期权定价模型之列；同时在回测中形成了最成功的交易策略，能够产生alpha。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种基于优化框架的加权集成定价方法，整合多种理论模型的优势，证明了集成方法在期权定价中的有效性，超越了单一模型的性能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期权交易者提供了更准确的定价工具和可执行的交易策略，在真实金融场景中通过回测验证了生成alpha的能力，具有实际投资指导价值。

title: How Technical Progress distorts the "inverted-U" shaped relationship between Competition and Innovation
affiliations: Orange

detail.title: How Technical Progress distorts the "inverted-U" shaped relationship between Competition and Innovation
detail.abstract: The inverted U-shaped relationship between competition and innovation identified by Aghion et al. (2005) is now well known. However, the role of technical progress in this relationship is less understood, even though it has significant implications for competition policy. From the article of Aghion et al. (2014) that completes Aghion et al. (2005), this paper shows that technical progress reduces the level of product market competition that maximizes innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Aghion等人（2005）提出的竞争与创新之间的倒U型关系，进一步探讨技术进步在其中所扮演的角色。通过结合Aghion等人（2014）的后续研究，本文证明技术进步会降低能够最大化创新的产品市场竞争水平。
AI.research_question: 技术进步如何影响竞争与创新之间的倒U型关系，尤其是技术进步如何改变最大化创新的最优竞争水平？
AI.motivation: Aghion等人（2005）提出的竞争与创新之间的倒U型关系已被广泛认可，但技术进步在这一关系中所起的作用尚未被充分理解，而这对竞争政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Aghion等人（2005）的倒U型竞争-创新理论框架，并结合Aghion等人（2014）的扩展模型。
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，基于Aghion等人（2014）的模型进行推导和论证。
AI.findings: 技术进步会降低能够最大化创新的产品市场竞争水平，即技术进步使得最优竞争水平向更低方向移动。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对竞争-创新倒U型关系的理解，明确了技术进步这一关键调节变量的作用，丰富了竞争政策相关的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争政策的制定提供了重要启示：在技术进步较快的行业中，监管机构可能需要调整对市场竞争水平的容忍度，以适应最优创新激励的变化。

title: 온라인 유통의 성장과 유통시장 정책 개선 방향 (The Growth of Online Retail and Directions for Improving Retail Market Policy)
affiliations: Korea Development Institute (KDI)

detail.title: 온라인 유통의 성장과 유통시장 정책 개선 방향 (The Growth of Online Retail and Directions for Improving Retail Market Policy)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Development Institute (KDI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Korean Abstract: 
온라인 유통시장이 급속도로 성장하고 있는 상황에서, 대형마트는 온라인과의 경쟁으로 매출 감소가 확인된 반면, SSM, 편의점 등 일부 오프라인 유통업은 근거리 기반의 차별화된 수요를 바탕으로 시장이 오히려 확장되었다. 이러한 결과는 대형마트 규제 중심의 현행 유통산업발전법을 오프라인 업체의 경쟁력 강화 및 온 · 오프라인 간 규제 불균형 해소 방향으로 재설계할 필요성이 있음을 시사한다.


English Abstract: 
Amid the robust expansion of online retail, the retail sector has shown a conspicuous divergence: hypermarket sales have decreased due to competition from online channels, whereas smaller formats like SSMs and convenience stores have expanded by capturing distinct, proximity-based demand. This asymmetrical outcome underscores the need to reform the Distribution Industry Development Act, shifting away from current hypermarket restrictions toward a framework that bolsters the competitiveness of brick-and-mortar retailers and addresses the regulatory imbalances between online and offline channels.

AI.tldr: 在线零售快速增长的背景下，大型超市因与线上渠道竞争导致销售额下降，而SSM、便利店等中小型线下零售业态凭借基于近距离的差异化需求实现了市场扩张。这种不对称结果凸显了改革《流通产业发展法》的必要性，应从当前以大型超市限制为中心的政策转向加强实体零售商竞争力、解决线上线下监管失衡的框架。
AI.research_question: 在线零售快速增长背景下，不同线下零售业态（大型超市与SSM、便利店等）的市场表现呈现何种分化？现行以大型超市限制为中心的流通产业监管政策应如何调整？
AI.motivation: 在线零售市场急剧扩张改变了零售竞争格局，但现行《流通产业发展法》仍以大型超市监管为核心，未能适应线上线下融合发展的新形势，需要重新审视监管框架的合理性与适切性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 零售业态演化理论、线上线下竞争理论、流通产业监管政策理论
AI.method: 基于市场数据的实证分析，对比在线零售扩张背景下各类线下零售业态的销售变化趋势
AI.findings: 在线零售扩张下零售业态出现明显分化：大型超市因线上竞争销售下滑，而SSM、便利店等小型业态凭借近距离开放性需求反而实现市场扩张，呈现不对称的竞争结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示在线零售冲击下不同线下零售业态的不同响应机制，丰富零售业态竞争与监管政策关系的理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为《流通产业发展法》改革提供实证依据，建议从大型超市限制监管转向增强实体零售竞争力、平衡线上线下监管差异的政策方向。

title: Below the Job: Substitution Failure and the Strategic Risk of Substrate Erosion

detail.title: Below the Job: Substitution Failure and the Strategic Risk of Substrate Erosion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No interests to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: Does not apply
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding to declare

detail.abstract: Strategic-management frameworks define competitive analysis in two ways: by the firms producing similar products, and, in the Jobs-to-Be-Done extension, by the firms fulfilling the same underlying customer need by different means. Both definitions miss a category of competitor operating one layer beneath. Substitution failure names the dynamic in which a market-mediated product replaces a function the substrate had been performing without market mediation, performs a lesser version of it, and erodes the substrate conditions that produced the original function. This article locates the pattern on a cyclical model of the firm, distinguishing where a substituting product enters (the substrate the firm draws on, or the commitment it operates from) from whose cycle carries the harm (the firm's own, or another's). Two forms follow that the existing literature does not develop: exogenous erosion, in which a product sold into another market hollows the conditions a firm's demand rests on, and auxiliary capture, in which a firm's own subordinate function acquires a market and rewrites its purposes from within.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"替代失败"（Substitution failure）这一新概念，指市场中介的产品取代原本由底层基质（substrate）无需市场中介即可执行的功能，执行更次要版本的功能，并侵蚀产生原始功能的基质条件。文章将这一模式定位在企业周期性模型上，区分替代产品进入的层面与伤害承载的循环，识别出两种未被现有文献发展的替代形式：外生侵蚀和辅助捕获。
AI.research_question: 现有战略管理框架中的竞争分析仅从"生产相似产品的企业"和"满足相同顾客需求的不同方式（Jobs-to-Be-Done）"两个维度定义竞争者，遗漏了一个位于更底层（substrate层）的竞争者类别。本文要回答的问题是：市场中介的替代产品如何在基质层面取代非市场中介的功能，从而侵蚀企业存在的条件？这种替代失败有哪几种形式？
AI.motivation: 战略管理框架对竞争者的定义存在盲区：传统定义关注同类产品竞争者，Jobs-to-Be-Done扩展关注满足同一需求的不同方式，但二者都遗漏了"替代失败"这一动态——即市场产品取代原本由底层基质无需市场中介即可提供的功能，这种替代发生在一个更深的层级上，现有文献未能充分刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于企业周期性模型（cyclical model of the firm），区分了两个维度：替代产品进入的位置（企业依赖的基质或企业运作的承诺/commitment），以及伤害由谁的循环承载（企业自身或其他企业的循环）。在这一框架下，文章将替代失败与市场中介、基质条件等概念整合。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性研究。文章通过构建企业周期性模型来定位替代失败模式，分析替代产品进入的层面与伤害承载循环，从而推导出两种替代失败形式。属于理论建构类论文。
AI.findings: 文章识别出两种现有文献未发展的替代失败形式：（1）外生侵蚀（exogenous erosion）：产品被销售到另一个市场，掏空了企业需求所依赖的基质条件；（2）辅助捕获（auxiliary capture）：企业自身的从属功能获得了市场，并从内部改写了企业的目的。这两者共同补充了传统竞争分析框架对竞争者定义的盲区。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对战略管理中的竞争分析理论做出贡献：超越了产品相似性和Jobs-to-Be-Done两种传统竞争定义，提出"基质层面"的竞争类别；通过区分替代进入层面与伤害承载循环，细化了替代失败的机制；识别并发展了外生侵蚀和辅助捕获两种新的替代形式，丰富了战略管理理论对竞争动态的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了更全面的竞争分析视角：企业不仅需关注同类产品和替代性需求满足方案，还需警惕来自基质层面的替代威胁——即外部市场产品削弱企业依赖的基础条件，以及企业内部从属功能被市场化后从内部改变企业目的的风险。

title: Online Retail Growth and Reforming Korea's Retail Policy
affiliations: Korea Development Institute (KDI)

detail.title: Online Retail Growth and Reforming Korea's Retail Policy

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Development Institute (KDI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Amid the robust expansion of online retail, the retail sector has shown a conspicuous divergence: hypermarket sales have decreased due to competition from online channels, whereas smaller formats like SSMs and convenience stores have expanded by capturing distinct, proximity-based demand. This asymmetrical outcome underscores the need to reform the Distribution Industry Development Act, shifting away from current hypermarket restrictions toward a framework that bolsters the competitiveness of brick-and-mortar retailers and addresses the regulatory imbalances between online and offline channels.

AI.tldr: 在线零售快速扩张背景下，零售行业呈现显著分化：大卖场因线上渠道竞争而销售下滑，而小型业态（如SSM和便利店）则通过捕捉基于邻近性的差异化需求实现扩张。这种不对称结果凸显了改革《分销产业发展法》的必要性，应从当前的大卖场限制转向强化实体零售商竞争力并解决线上线下渠道监管失衡的框架。
AI.research_question: 在线零售扩张背景下，大卖场与小型零售业态（SSM和便利店）为何呈现不对称的发展结果？现有的《分销产业发展法》大卖场限制政策是否需要改革以及如何改革？
AI.motivation: 在线零售的强劲扩张导致零售行业出现明显分化：大卖场因线上渠道竞争而销售下滑，而小型业态通过满足邻近性需求实现扩张。这种不对称结果凸显出现有监管框架（特别是对大卖场的限制）已不能适应零售业结构变化，亟需改革以平衡线上线下渠道的监管差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 零售业态竞争理论、渠道竞争理论、产业政策与监管理论
AI.method: 基于零售行业销售数据和市场表现的实证分析，比较不同零售业态（大卖场、SSM、便利店）在线上零售扩张背景下的差异化表现，并结合政策分析评估现有监管框架的适用性。
AI.findings: 1) 在线零售扩张对传统零售业态的影响呈不对称性：大卖场销售下滑，而SSM和便利店等小型业态实现扩张；2) 小型业态的成功源于其捕捉邻近性差异化需求的能力；3) 现有《分销产业发展法》对大卖场的限制政策已不能有效应对零售业结构变化，需要从限制大卖场转向增强实体零售商整体竞争力，并解决线上线下渠道间的监管失衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究揭示在线零售对不同传统零售业态的差异化影响机制，丰富了渠道竞争与零售业态演化的理论理解；同时为产业政策与零售监管领域的理论提供了新的政策框架视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者改革《分销产业发展法》提供依据：建议从限制大卖场转向提升实体零售商竞争力，并调整线上线下渠道的监管平衡；为零售企业理解不同业态在线上竞争下的生存策略（如发展邻近性小型业态）提供实践启示。

title: Exchange-Rate Regimes and The Behaviour of Exporters
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata - Department of Economics and Finance,  and University of Naples Federico II

detail.title: Exchange-Rate Regimes and The Behaviour of Exporters

publicationDetails.journalName: CEIS: Centre for Economic & International Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a firm-level mechanism that explains why exchange-rate regimes are largely neutral with respect to real macro variables: exporters actively adjust marginal costs and markups to absorb nominal exchange-rate fluctuations. Me quantify this mechanism using micro-level data from the European car market (1970–99). Me show that floating regimes are associated with limited adjustment in destination-currency prices and limited response in quantities sold. Me then estimate a structural demand-and-supply system to recover product-level markups and marginal costs. At breaks from pegged to floating regimes, producer-currency markups (marginal costs) fall on impact by around 11% (10%). A two-country real business cycle model with segmented financial markets, incorporating pricing-to-market and operational hedging, rationalises these patterns. Our model underscores the role of real micro rigidities, rather than nominal rigidities, in the weak transmission of exchange-rate fluctuations to real macro variables.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个企业层面的机制来解释为何汇率制度对实际宏观经济变量大体呈中性：出口商通过主动调整边际成本和加价来吸收名义汇率波动。作者利用欧洲汽车市场（1970-1999）的微观数据量化了这一机制，并构建结构性需求-供给系统来估计产品层面的加价和边际成本，最终用包含市场分割和定价到市场的两国实际商业周期模型来解释这些模式。
AI.research_question: 为何汇率制度对实际宏观经济变量大体呈中性？企业层面的何种机制解释了这一现象？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济学认为汇率制度（固定vs浮动）应影响实际经济变量，但实证证据表明汇率制度对实际宏观变量的影响有限。本文试图从企业微观行为（出口商调整边际成本和加价）的角度解释这一"汇率制度中性"之谜。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两国实际商业周期模型（two-country RBC model），包含细分金融市场（segmented financial markets）、定价到市场（pricing-to-market）和运营对冲（operational hedging）等理论机制。
AI.method: 利用欧洲汽车市场1970-1999年的微观层面数据，估计结构性需求-供给系统，恢复产品层面的加价和边际成本，并比较固定与浮动汇率制度下的差异。
AI.findings: (1) 浮动汇率制度下，目的地货币价格调整有限，数量响应也有限；(2) 从固定汇率转向浮动汇率时，生产者货币计价的加价（边际成本）在冲击当期分别下降约11%（10%）；(3) 汇率波动向实际宏观变量的传导弱，源于实际微观刚性而非名义刚性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了企业主动调整边际成本和加价以吸收汇率波动的企业层面机制，强调了实际微观刚性（而非名义刚性）在弱化汇率传导中的关键作用，为汇率制度中性提供了新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 对政策制定者理解汇率制度选择及其对宏观经济的影响提供了微观基础的实证依据，有助于评估浮动汇率制度的成本与收益。

title: From Modes to Myths: Untangling Governance, Management, and Institutional Elements in the Modes of Network Governance Typology
affiliations: , Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge, Tilburg University, , Tilburg University, Tilburg University, University of Central Florida, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Tilburg University - Tilburg School of Politics and Public Administration

detail.title: From Modes to Myths: Untangling Governance, Management, and Institutional Elements in the Modes of Network Governance Typology

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No data collection and thus no ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: There is no funding.

detail.abstract: Purpose-oriented networks (PONs) have become a common organizational form in contemporary governance, and the governance mode typology developed by Provan and Kenis (2008) remains the dominant framework for analyzing how such networks are governed. Despite its influence, persistent conceptual ambiguity surrounds what constitutes governance in PONs and how it differs from network management. This article offers a critical examination of empirical research on the governance of purpose-oriented networks, focusing on how governance modes are classified and justified, the lack of discernment between governance and management in empirical research, and how an institutional perspective helps clarify this distinction. Drawing on an institutional perspective, the article conceptualizes governance as the rules and processes at the constitutional and collective choice levels, distinct from the operational level of managerial processes. The article strengthens conceptual precision in the governance of PONs, explores institutional and management components, and highlights the importance of scholarship rigorously justifying the classification of governance modes.

AI.tldr: 本文对目标导向网络（PONs）治理的实证研究进行了批判性审视，指出治理与网络管理之间长期存在的概念模糊问题，并基于制度视角将治理界定为宪法层面和集体选择层面的规则与过程，区别于操作层面的管理过程，从而增强概念精确性并强调治理模式分类应被严格论证。
AI.research_question: 在目标导向网络（PONs）的实证研究中，治理模式如何被分类和论证？治理与网络管理之间是否缺乏区分？制度视角如何帮助厘清这种区分？
AI.motivation: 尽管Provan和Kenis（2008）提出的治理模式类型学是分析PONs的主导框架，但围绕"什么构成治理"以及"治理与网络管理有何区别"仍存在持续的概念模糊性，这阻碍了理论的精确性和实证研究的严谨性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度视角（institutional perspective），借鉴Ostrom的宪法层面、集体选择层面与操作层面的多层次制度分析框架。
AI.method: 批判性文献审视（critical examination），对目标导向网络治理的实证研究进行系统性批判分析，聚焦治理模式的分类与论证方式、治理与管理在实证研究中的区分程度。
AI.findings: 研究发现实证研究中治理模式分类缺乏严格论证，治理与管理之间存在明显的概念混淆；基于制度视角，治理应被概念化为宪法层面和集体选择层面的规则与过程，而管理属于操作层面的活动。
AI.theory_contributions: 文章通过引入制度视角，增强了PONs治理的概念精确性，将治理与管理进行清晰的概念区分，并探讨了制度性成分与管理性成分之间的关系，为治理模式分类提供了更严格的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了更清晰的概念框架以指导实证研究中治理模式的分类与论证；为治理实践者区分治理决策与日常管理活动提供了理论依据。

title:
The Constitutional Architecture of Presidential Impeachment in The United States

Historical Origins, Doctrinal Interpretation, and Institutional Practice

detail.title:
The Constitutional Architecture of Presidential Impeachment in The United States

Historical Origins, Doctrinal Interpretation, and Institutional Practice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest regarding the research, authorship, or publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it involved only the analysis of publicly available legal materials, including statutes, court decisions, constitutional provisions, and scholarly literature, and did not involve human participants or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research. This study was conducted as part of the author's academic coursework.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the constitutional foundations of the presidential impeachment power in the United States. It situates the modern doctrine within its English parliamentary antecedents, the deliberations of the Constitutional Convention of 1787, and the ratification debates recorded in The Federalist and the state conventions. It then analyses the enduring interpretive controversy surrounding the phrase ‘high Crimes and Misdemeanors’, tracing the narrow, indictable-offence tradition associated with Raoul Berger against the broader, functional tradition associated with Charles Black, Michael Gerhardt, Frank Bowman, Cass Sunstein, and Laurence Tribe and Joshua Matz. The paper describes the procedural architecture governing impeachment in the House and trial in the Senate, including the Supreme Court's holding in Nixon v. United States that the conduct of an impeachment trial is a non-justiciable political question. It reviews, in detail, the four instances in which a President has faced impeachment — Andrew Johnson, Richard Nixon, Bill Clinton, and Donald Trump, impeached twice — and the 1876 impeachment of former Secretary of War William Belknap, the principal precedent bearing on the impeachability of former officers. The paper closes by examining several doctrinal questions that remain unsettled: the constitutionality of ‘late impeachment’, the relationship between impeachment and the ordinary criminal law, and the competing interpretive methodologies that continue to divide constitutional scholars. It concludes that impeachment is properly understood not as a species of criminal adjudication but as a distinct, and deliberately open-textured, constitutional mechanism for the political accountability of high public office.

AI.tldr: 本文系统考察了美国总统弹劾权的宪法基础，从英国议会先例、1787年制宪会议和批准辩论追溯其历史渊源，分析"重罪与轻罪"条款的诠释争议，梳理弹劾程序架构，详述四起总统弹劾案及前官员弹劾先例，最终论证弹劾本质上是政治问责机制而非刑事审判。
AI.research_question: 美国总统弹劾权的宪法基础是什么？弹劾权应如何被正确理解和诠释？
AI.motivation: 弹劾条款中的"high Crimes and Misdemeanors"存在长期诠释争议，且相关宪法问题仍悬而未决，需要系统梳理其历史渊源与理论脉络。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法诠释理论；弹劾权的"狭窄/可起诉罪行"传统（Raoul Berger）与"宽泛/功能性"传统（Charles Black、Michael Gerhardt等）之争；政治问题原则（Nixon v. United States）。
AI.method: 宪法历史文献分析与法理诠释研究，涵盖制宪会议记录、《联邦党人文集》、州批准大会辩论、最高法院判例及总统弹劾案例的详细审查。
AI.findings: 弹劾应被理解为一种独特的、刻意保持开放性的政治问责宪法机制，而非刑事审判的一种形式；前官员可被弹劾（以Belknap案为先例）；"迟延弹劾"的合宪性等问题仍未解决。
AI.theory_contributions: 将弹劾权置于宪法诠释方法论的分歧中考察，系统整合历史渊源、判例与学说争论，论证弹劾区别于刑事司法的独特宪法定位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国历次总统弹劾实践提供系统框架，厘清弹劾程序架构与非司法化原则，对前官员弹劾等未决问题提供先例分析。

title: The Two Clocks: Positional Agency and Hysteresis in Substitution Failure

detail.title: The Two Clocks: Positional Agency and Hysteresis in Substitution Failure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No interests to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding to declare

detail.abstract: Organisations reproduce patterns of self-harm that nobody intends, nobody conceals, and many people can see. This article explains one such pattern. Substitution failure occurs when a market-mediated product replaces a function that a substrate had been performing without market mediation, performs a lesser version of it, and erodes the conditions that produced the original. Existing accounts locate the difficulty in incentives, myopia, or the length of the relevant horizon. This article locates it in the distribution of two things that are ordinarily assumed to travel together. Building on a cyclical model of organised reproduction, it argues that the capacity to perceive substrate erosion and the authority to arrest it are inversely distributed around the cycle: the actors who can see it cannot stop it, and the actors who can stop it cannot see it. It further argues that substrate erosion is hysteretic, so that the path of restoration is not the reverse of the path of erosion and the window in which correction is cheap closes early. These two claims produce the article's central proposition, that substitution failure persists because the clock governing erosion runs faster than the clock governing the movement of perception to authority, and that this asymmetry is structural rather than motivational: substitution requires no coordination, while its correction requires a great deal. The article develops a positional typology of agency, specifies the conditions under which distributed private perception can be converted into The Two Clocks 2 organised articulated interest, and states the boundary conditions under which the framework does not apply.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"替代失败"理论，解释组织如何无意识地再生产自我伤害的模式。核心论点是：感知基质侵蚀的能力与阻止侵蚀的权威在组织循环中呈反向分布——能看见问题的人无法阻止，能阻止的人看不见问题。此外，基质侵蚀具有滞后性，恢复路径并非侵蚀路径的逆转，纠错成本低廉的时间窗口会过早关闭。替代失败之所以持续存在，是因为侵蚀的时钟快于感知向权威转化的时钟，且这种不对称是结构性的而非动机性的。
AI.research_question: 为什么组织会持续再生产没有人意图、没有人隐瞒、但许多人能看见的自我伤害模式（特别是替代失败现象）？
AI.motivation: 现有解释将替代失败归因于激励扭曲、短视或时间视野长度，但这些解释未能充分说明为何此类模式如此顽固且难以纠正。作者试图提供一种结构性解释，超越个体动机层面的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文建立在组织再生产的循环模型基础上，引入两个核心理论构件：（1）感知能力与权威的逆向分布假设；（2）基质侵蚀的滞后性（hysteresis）假设。二者共同构成"双时钟"不对称的结构性论证。
AI.method: 本文为理论性/概念性论文，通过逻辑演绎构建理论框架，发展出代理的位置类型学（positional typology of agency），并阐述分散的私人感知转化为组织化表达利益的条件及框架的边界条件。
AI.findings: 核心命题：替代失败持续存在的原因是控制侵蚀的时钟快于感知向权威移动的时钟，且这种不对称是结构性的而非动机性的——替代无需协调即可发生，而纠错则需要大量协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于：（1）将替代失败的解释从动机层面转向结构性层面；（2）提出感知能力与权威的逆向分布这一新颖机制；（3）引入滞后性概念解释为何恢复路径不等于侵蚀路径的逆转；（4）发展代理的位置类型学，明确分散私人感知转化为组织化利益的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献在于：帮助组织识别替代失败的早期信号，理解纠错成本随时间快速上升的机制，从而在设计组织结构和治理机制时，主动缩短感知向权威传递的路径或时间，避免落入"窗口过早关闭"的陷阱。

title: The Inverted Helm: A Five Facet Multiplicative Model of Solar Irradiance, Falsified and Rebuilt on One Minute Plant Truth

detail.title: The Inverted Helm: A Five Facet Multiplicative Model of Solar Irradiance, Falsified and Rebuilt on One Minute Plant Truth

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Smart Grid Analytics Pvt. Ltd., which operates the forecasting platform evaluated in this study. The plant truth data were used only for scoring, isolated from the forecast path.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study involves no human or animal subjects. The data are plant sensor measurements and public weather model outputs.
declarations.funderStatement: Self funded by Smart Grid Analytics Pvt. Ltd.

detail.abstract: Solar irradiance at a plant site is the clear sky envelope multiplied by whatever the sky lets through. This paper takes a five facet, agent centric, multiplicative model that was first written for two agent competitive outcomes, Kumar's Helm, and inverts it into a model of atmospheric transmission. In the inverted form there is a single agent, the atmospheric column above the plant, and a single fixed opponent, the known clear sky reference. The five facets are mapped one to one onto physical drivers and onto the data source that estimates each: Vessel is clear sky geometry, Experience is seasonal climatology, Mindset is the instantaneous cloud state, Opportunity is inbound cloud advected on the steering flow, and Discernment is the trust weighted blending of sources. The composition is a product of per layer transmission terms with fitted exponents, and intraday revision is a bounded tanh surprise update. I test the model against one minute plant truth from ten weather stations at a 380 MW site in Rajasthan, India, over January 2024 to July 2026, under a leakage free walk forward protocol and a 389 day gated campaign in which each proposed change is adopted or rejected on the next fifteen days of forward data. The headline is honest rather than triumphant. Under holdout, median absolute daily irradiation error falls from 8.51 percent to 2.67 percent and the fraction of minutes within 2.5 percent of truth roughly doubles, but two monsoon overcast days remain a 72 percent bust that day ahead calibration cannot repair. The central scientific finding is falsifiable and partly falsified: the clear sky index K is not lognormal within any regime, yet the multiplicative form beats an additive form only in overcast, by about 15 percent, exactly where optical depth physics predicts a multiplicative law and nowhere else. I report the plant acting as its own cloud radar, resolving a shadow steering flow near 19 m/s that disagrees with surface wind by a median 77 degrees, and I state precisely what separates this construction from the classical clear sky index.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个五面向、代理中心、乘性的大气传输模型，将原本用于两人竞争结果的模型（Kumar's Helm）逆转为单代理大气柱模型。模型将五个面向分别映射到物理驱动因素和数据源：晴空几何、季节气候、瞬时云状态、流入云平流和信任加权混合。模型在印度拉贾斯坦邦380 MW电站的十台气象站一分钟数据上测试，中位绝对日辐照误差从8.51%降至2.67%，但两个季风阴天日仍存在72%的误差。关键科学发现是晴空指数K在任何状态内均非对数正态，乘性形式仅在阴天优于加性形式约15%，与光学深度物理预测一致。
AI.research_question: 如何将原本用于竞争结果的五面向乘性模型逆转为大气传输模型，以更准确预测光伏电站的太阳辐照度，并检验乘性形式与加性形式在不同天气状态下的适用性？
AI.motivation: 光伏电站的太阳辐照度预测对电网调度至关重要，现有晴空指数模型假设对数正态分布且乘性形式在所有条件下优于加性形式，但缺乏基于高频站点数据的严格验证。作者希望通过将竞争模型反转、以电站自身作为云雷达，构建更精确的辐照度预测模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kumar's Helm五面向乘性模型（Vessel-晴空几何、Experience-季节气候、Mindset-瞬时云状态、Opportunity-入流云平流、Discernment-信任加权混合）；晴空指数理论；光学深度乘性律；tanh惊讶更新机制。
AI.method: 将五面向模型逆转为单代理乘性大气传输模型，每层透射项带拟合指数，日内修订采用有界tanh惊喜更新。使用印度拉贾斯坦邦380 MW电站十台气象站的一分钟真实数据（2024年1月至2026年7月），采用无泄漏走前协议（walk forward protocol）和389天门控活动（每项提议变更在后续15天前瞻数据上被采纳或拒绝）。
AI.findings: 中位绝对日辐照误差从8.51%降至2.67%；2.5%误差内的分钟比例约翻倍；两个季风阴天日为72%误差无法通过日前校准修复；晴空指数K在任何状态内均非对数正态（该可证伪性假设部分被证伪）；乘性形式仅在阴天优于加性形式约15%，与光学深度物理预测一致；电站可充当自身云雷达，解析出约19 m/s的阴影导流流场，与地面风方向中位偏差达77度。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将竞争博弈模型（Kumar's Helm）逆转为大气传输模型，建立单代理与固定对手的映射关系；明确区分了该构造与经典晴空指数的差异；挑战了晴空指数对数正态假设；精确定位了乘性形式优于加性形式的适用区间（仅阴天），为乘性律提供了经验边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的辐照度预测框架，中位误差大幅降低（8.51%→2.67%）；验证了电站自身可作为云雷达的经济方案，无需额外雷达设备；识别了模型在季风极端天气下的局限，为后续改进指明方向。

title: Modeling and Measuring Preference for Early Resolution of Uncertainty
affiliations: University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: Modeling and Measuring Preference for Early Resolution of Uncertainty

keywords: Preference for Early Resolution of Uncertainty

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a decision model that separates risk aversion, intertemporal elasticity of substitution, and preference for the timing of resolution of uncertainty. It then uses this model to develop a measure of preference for early resolution of uncertainty (PER) that parallels the Arrow-Pratt measure of risk aversion in expected utility theory. A preference exhibits PER if and only if its risk aversion for late resolution exceeds its risk aversion for early resolution. I show that in general, a measure of PER can be constructed as the difference between the Arrow-Pratt measure of risk aversion for late resolution and the Arrow-Pratt measure of risk aversion for early resolution. I demonstrate how it can be used to compare preferences for early resolution, to compute the risk compensation for late resolution of uncertainty, and to compute the risk premium for the informativeness of macroeconomic announcements required on financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个决策模型，将风险厌恶、跨期替代弹性和对不确定性解决时点的偏好三者分离，并构建了一个类似Arrow-Pratt风险厌恶度量的"早期不确定性解决偏好(PER)"度量。PER可以通过晚期解决的Arrow-Pratt风险厌恶度量与早期解决的Arrow-Pratt风险厌恶度量之差来构造，用于比较偏好、计算延迟不确定性解决的风险补偿及金融市场宏观公告信息性的风险溢价。
AI.research_question: 如何将风险厌恶、跨期替代弹性与对不确定性解决时点的偏好分开建模，并构建一个可量化的早期不确定性解决偏好(Preference for Early Resolution, PER)度量？
AI.motivation: 在预期效用理论中，Arrow-Pratt度量提供了风险厌恶的标准度量，但对不确定性解决时点的偏好缺乏类似的系统化度量工具。已有模型（如Epstein-Zin效用）虽能体现这类偏好，但缺乏独立的定量度量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预期效用理论、Arrow-Pratt风险厌恶度量、Epstein-Zin递归效用模型、对不确定性解决时点的偏好理论
AI.method: 决策模型构建与理论推导，将风险厌恶、跨期替代弹性和时点偏好分离；基于Arrow-Pratt度量构造PER度量，并进行理论证明与应用演示。
AI.findings: 偏好具有早期解决偏好当且仅当其晚期解决的风险厌恶超过早期解决的风险厌恶。PER度量可构造为晚期解决与早期解决的Arrow-Pratt风险厌恶度量之差。该度量可用于比较不同偏好的早期解决倾向、计算延迟解决的风险补偿，以及金融市场中宏观公告信息性的风险溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将三类偏好（风险厌恶、跨期替代、时点偏好）分离的决策模型；首次构建了与Arrow-Pratt风险厌恶度量平行的PER度量框架，为不确定性解决时点的偏好提供了标准化的理论度量工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融市场上宏观经济公告的信息性定价提供了计算风险溢价的理论工具，并可用于评估延迟不确定性解决所需的补偿成本。

title: Stablecoins: Designs, Effectiveness, Opportunities

detail.title: Stablecoins: Designs, Effectiveness, Opportunities
detail.abstract: Stablecoins are the epitome of the actual evolution of money and financial markets. They unlock unique features and opportunities with various designs. In this article I provide a harmonized classification of stablecoins, viz. fully, over-or undercollater alized, and assess their ability to maintain the peg. In fact, the research proves that fully collateralized stablecoins seem to be the most stable ones, followed by overcollateralized and only then undercollateralized types.

AI.tldr: 本文对稳定币进行了统一分类（全额抵押、超额抵押和不足额抵押），并评估了各类稳定币维持锚定汇率的能力，研究发现全额抵押稳定币最为稳定，其次是超额抵押，最后是不足额抵押类型。
AI.research_question: 不同类型的稳定币（全额抵押、超额抵押、不足额抵押）在维持锚定（保持价格稳定）方面的能力是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 稳定币是货币和金融市场实际演变的缩影，具有独特的功能和多种设计形式，但缺乏统一的分类框架和对其维持锚定能力的系统性评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稳定币分类理论（全额抵押、超额抵押、不足额抵押），锚定维持能力评估框架。
AI.method: 通过构建统一的稳定币分类体系，并基于实证研究对不同类型稳定币维持锚定（价格稳定）的能力进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 全额抵押稳定币是最稳定的，其次是超额抵押稳定币，不足额抵押稳定币的稳定性最差。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一的稳定币分类框架（全额抵押、超额抵押、不足额抵押），填补了稳定币分类研究中的空白，并为稳定币稳定性提供了实证排序证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、监管机构和市场参与者提供了选择稳定币时的参考依据，有助于理解不同抵押设计对稳定币价格稳定性的影响。

title: Effect of Organisational Culture on Outcome of M&As

detail.title: Effect of Organisational Culture on Outcome of M&As

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare there is no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced my study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self funded, as part of the requirements for the fulfilment of my award of PhD from the Swiss School of Business Research

detail.abstract: Mergers and acquisitions (M&A) are a common growth strategy, yet outcomes remain unpredictable and failure rates high. Organisational culture is increasingly recognised as a decisive, though historically underweighted, determinant of M&A success. This study examines the effect of organisational culture on M&A outcomes in Nigeria using survey data from 203 professionals across finance, manufacturing, technology, and other sectors. Using descriptive statistics and a chi-square goodness-of-fit test, the study finds that 96.5% of respondents consider organisational culture likely or very likely to influence M&A outcomes, and the hypothesis test confirms this relationship is statistically significant (χ² = 147.78, p < 0.0001). Stakeholder commitment, strategic alignment, unity and synergy, due diligence, and organisational compatibility emerged as key success factors, while cultural differences, misaligned vision, and lack of openness were the principal barriers. The findings extend Synergy Gain, Strategic Realignment, and Agency Theory to the Nigerian context and offer practical guidance for managers and regulators overseeing business combinations.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用尼日利亚203名跨行业专业人士的调查数据，通过描述性统计和卡方拟合优度检验，证实组织文化对并购结果具有统计显著的影响（96.5%受访者认同，χ²=147.78, p<0.0001），识别出利益相关者承诺、战略对齐等关键成功因素及文化差异等主要阻碍，并将协同增益、战略调整和代理理论延伸至尼日利亚情境。
AI.research_question: 组织文化如何影响尼日利亚企业并购（M&A）的结果？
AI.motivation: 并购是企业常见的增长战略，但结果不可预测且失败率高。组织文化虽被认为是并购成功的关键决定因素，但在历史上往往被低估，因此需要系统研究其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协同增益理论（Synergy Gain Theory）、战略调整理论（Strategic Realignment Theory）和代理理论（Agency Theory）
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法，收集尼日利亚金融、制造、科技等行业的203名专业人士数据；使用描述性统计和卡方拟合优度检验（chi-square goodness-of-fit test）进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 96.5%的受访者认为组织文化很可能或非常可能影响并购结果，且该关系在统计上显著（χ²=147.78, p<0.0001）。利益相关者承诺、战略对齐、团结与协同、尽职调查和组织兼容性是关键成功因素；文化差异、愿景错位和缺乏开放性是主要障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 将协同增益、战略调整和代理理论扩展并验证于尼日利亚这一新兴市场情境，丰富了并购文化研究的理论适用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和监管机构在企业合并中提供了实践指导，帮助识别并购成功的关键文化因素和潜在障碍，以降低并购失败率。

title: Entry Mode Choice by Emerging Market Multinationals: A Review of Theory, Evidence, and Unresolved Debates

detail.title: Entry Mode Choice by Emerging Market Multinationals: A Review of Theory, Evidence, and Unresolved Debates
detail.abstract: The international expansion of emerging market multinationals (EMNEs) has become one of the defining features of the global economy, yet the theoretical apparatus of international business-developed largely from the experience of Western multinationals-fits EMNE behaviour imperfectly. This review synthesises three decades of research on foreign market entry mode choice and evaluates how well its core frameworks (transaction cost economics, the eclectic paradigm, institutional theory, and the resource-based and learning perspectives) explain the observed strategies of EMNEs. The review documents systematic divergences between theoretical predictions and EMNE behaviour: a greater willingness to enter institutionally difficult markets, heavier reliance on partnership-based modes, springboard acquisitions aimed at asset acquisition rather than asset exploitation, and internationalisation sequences that compress or invert the incremental stages predicted by process models. The paper organises competing explanations of these divergences, identifies the conditions under which conventional theory retains predictive power, and sets out an agenda for research on entry mode dynamics-mode change over timewhich remains the least developed area of the field.

AI.tldr: 本文综合回顾了过去三十年关于新兴市场跨国公司（EMNEs）外国市场进入模式选择的研究，评估核心理论框架（交易成本经济学、折衷范式、制度理论、资源基础与学习视角）对EMNE行为的解释力，记录其与理论预测的系统性偏离，并提出了未来研究议程。
AI.research_question: 核心理论框架在多大程度上能够解释新兴市场跨国公司的外国市场进入模式选择行为？EMNEs的行为与理论预测存在哪些系统性偏离，以及这些偏离背后的解释条件和未来研究方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场跨国公司的国际化扩张已成为全球经济的标志性特征，但国际商务的理论体系主要基于西方跨国公司的经验发展而来，对EMNE行为的解释并不充分，需要系统审视理论适用性并识别需要修正或扩展的领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本经济学、折衷范式（OLI框架）、制度理论、资源基础观与学习视角（包括国际化过程模型/乌普萨拉模型）
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，对三十年来的外国市场进入模式选择研究进行综合评估和批判性分析
AI.findings: EMNEs的系统性偏离行为包括：（1）更愿意进入制度困难市场；（2）更依赖伙伴关系型进入模式；（3）采取"跳板"型并购以获取资产而非利用既有资产；（4）国际化序列压缩或逆转了过程模型预测的渐进阶段。论文还识别了传统理论仍具预测力的条件，并指出进入模式动态（模式随时间的变化）是研究最薄弱的领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了传统理论对EMNE行为的解释局限，整合了竞争性解释框架，明确了传统理论保有预测力的边界条件，并指出进入模式动态作为亟待发展的研究议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和政策制定者理解新兴市场跨国公司的进入模式选择提供了整合性分析框架，明确了哪些理论工具适用于何种情境，并有针对性地指出了未来研究重点。

title: Prediction Markets as Event Hedges: Can They Actually Be Used in Practice?
affiliations: Maastricht University

detail.title: Prediction Markets as Event Hedges: Can They Actually Be Used in Practice?
detail.abstract: Prediction markets convert beliefs about discrete future events into tradable, binary claims, potentially allowing investors to hedge risks linked to political, regulatory, and other non-financial outcomes. This paper examines whether these contracts can be used as practical event hedges rather than merely as forecasting instruments. I propose a method for using prediction markets as hedging instruments. The method is applied to a hypothetical $100,000 position in the Invesco Solar ETF (TAN) before the 2024 U.S. presidential election, hedged using a Trump-win prediction-market contract. The evidence suggests that prediction markets can provide useful, narrowly targeted hedges for small retail positions exposed to discrete and difficult-to-trade events. Their effectiveness is nevertheless constrained by uncertainty in estimating the underlying asset's event sensitivity, imperfect event-asset matching, delayed equity-price adjustment, and severe liquidity limitations at institutional scale. Prediction markets should therefore be viewed as a complement to-not a replacement for-established derivatives markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究预测市场（如总统选举预测合约）能否作为实际的事件对冲工具，而不仅仅是预测工具。作者提出了一种利用预测市场进行对冲的方法，并以2024年美国总统大选前对Invesco Solar ETF（TAN）的10万美元头寸为假设案例进行验证。证据表明，预测市场可以为面临离散且难以交易事件的小型零售头寸提供有效且有针对性的事件对冲，但其有效性受到事件敏感性估计不确定性、事件与资产匹配不完美、股权价格调整滞后以及机构规模下严重流动性限制的约束。预测市场应被视为对传统衍生品市场的补充而非替代。
AI.research_question: 预测市场合约能否作为实际的事件对冲工具（而非仅仅是预测工具）来使用？
AI.motivation: 预测市场传统上被视为预测工具，本文试图探讨其在真实投资组合中作为事件对冲（hedging）工具的实用性和局限性，填补预测市场在风险管理应用方面的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件对冲理论、预测市场定价机制、资产-事件敏感性分析
AI.method: 提出预测市场对冲方法，并以2024年美国总统大选前对Invesco Solar ETF（TAN）的10万美元假设头寸为案例，运用特朗普胜选预测市场合约进行对冲分析。
AI.findings: 预测市场可以为面临离散和难以交易事件的小型零售头寸提供有用且针对性强的对冲；但其有效性受限于事件敏感性估计的不确定性、事件与资产匹配不完美、股权价格调整滞后以及机构规模下的严重流动性限制；预测市场应被视为传统衍生品市场的补充而非替代。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了预测市场的功能边界，将其从单纯的预测工具拓展为风险管理/对冲工具，并系统化地识别了预测市场作为对冲工具所面临的四大约束条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售投资者提供了利用预测市场对冲政治、监管等非金融事件风险的具体操作方法；帮助投资者理解预测市场对冲的适用场景（小型零售头寸）和局限性（机构规模下流动性不足）。

title: Quasi Fair Value under Inventory Risk in Prediction Markets
affiliations: and Powell Street Research LLC

detail.title: Quasi Fair Value under Inventory Risk in Prediction Markets
detail.abstract: A dealer in a binary prediction market carries inventory whose settlement value is zero or one. Under exponential (CARA) utility the certainty equivalent of holding q contracts at belief p is CE(q) =-γ-1 ln 1-p+p e-γq , and the marginal indifference price is r(q) = σ(logit p-γq): inventory tilts fair value linearly in log-odds. We call r(q) the quasi fair value. It is the event probability under an inventory-set Esscher tilt, and it never leaves (0, 1): quotes cannot exit the price simplex. Building on the classical Chen-Pennock equivalence between the logarithmic market scoring rule and exponential-utility market making, we exhibit the LMSR as a frozenbelief quasi-fair-value maker with γ = 1/b, in marginal prices and in trade costs. A maker who holds to settlement applies a tilt with no time-to-resolution factor, under any martingale belief process; a maker who liquidates early scales the tilt by the fraction of settlement variance already resolved, available in closed form under a Brownian-bridge information process. In simulations the quasi-fair-value maker attained the highest CARA certainty equivalent in every configuration; on Polymarket data the variance-resolution curve tracked the bridge benchmark in the testable belief bucket.
