AI.tldr: 本文提出"准公允价值"（quasi fair value）概念，在二元预测市场中，做市商在CARA（指数）效用下持有q份合约的边际无差异价格为r(q) = σ(logit p - γq)，即库存以对数几率（log-odds）线性倾斜公允价值。该价格可解释为库存设定的Esscher倾斜下的事件概率，且始终保持在(0,1)区间内。论文进一步展示了经典的对数市场评分规则（LMSR）可被视为冻结信念的准公允价值做市商（γ=1/b），并分析了持有至结算与提前清算两种做市商策略下的倾斜因子。模拟实验显示准公允价值做市商在所有配置下均获得最高CARA确定性等价，Polymarket数据也验证了方差分辨率曲线与布朗桥基准的吻合。
AI.research_question: 在二元预测市场中，做市商在CARA效用下持有库存时，其准公允价值（marginal indifference price）应如何定义？该定价机制与经典LMSR有何等价关系？在不同做市策略（持有至结算vs提前清算）下倾斜因子应如何调整？
AI.motivation: 预测市场的做市商（如LMSR）需要处理库存风险，但经典LMSR的定价参数与CARA效用之间的联系需要更清晰的解释。如何在保持报价始终在(0,1)区间（价格单纯形内）的前提下，将库存倾斜纳入定价？以及如何处理不同时间范围（持有至结算vs提前清算）下的库存风险补偿问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) CARA（指数）效用函数与确定性等价理论；2) Esscher倾斜（Esscher tilt）；3) 对数市场评分规则（LMSR）与指数效用做市之间的Chen-Pennock等价性；4) 布朗桥（Brownian bridge）信息过程；5) 方差分辨率（variance resolution）理论
AI.method: 理论推导：基于CARA效用推导边际无差异价格的闭式解；通过Chen-Pennock等价性证明LMSR与准公允价值做市商的等价关系；利用布朗桥信息过程推导提前清算情形的闭式倾斜因子。实证验证：在模拟实验中比较准公允价值做市商与其他做市策略的CARA确定性等价；在Polymarket真实数据上检验方差分辨率曲线与布朗桥基准的拟合度。
AI.findings: 1) 准公允价值的边际无差异价格为r(q) = σ(logit p - γq)，即库存以log-odds线性倾斜公允价值，且始终保持在(0,1)区间；2) LMSR可被诠释为冻结信念的准公允价值做市商，γ=1/b，在边际价格和交易成本两个层面均等价；3) 持有至结算的做市商在任何鞅信念过程下应用无时间分辨率因子的倾斜；4) 提前清算的做市商需按已解析的结算方差比例缩放倾斜，布朗桥信息过程下可获得闭式解；5) 模拟实验中准公允价值做市商在所有配置下CARA确定性等价最高；6) Polymarket数据中方差分辨率曲线在可测试信念区间内与布朗桥基准吻合。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将CARA效用下的库存倾斜定价与log-odds线性关系相联系，建立了"准公允价值"理论框架；2) 从效用理论角度重新诠释了LMSR的经济学含义，将LMSR视为特定参数下的准公允价值做市商；3) 将库存倾斜分解为信念更新与方差分辨率两个维度，区分了持有至结算与提前清算两种做市策略下的风险补偿机制；4) 通过Esscher倾斜给出了准公允价值的概率论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为预测市场做市商提供了明确的定价公式，可直接用于报出始终处于(0,1)区间的可执行价格；2) 为做市商选择"持有至结算"或"提前清算"策略提供了理论指导，并给出了相应的倾斜因子计算公式；3) 提供了基于布朗桥的方差分辨率闭式解，便于实际操作中的风险计量；4) 实证验证了该方法在CARA确定性等价上的优势及与真实市场数据的吻合性，具有直接的应用价值。

title: A Regulation-Grounded Disclosure Index for Sustainability Reporting in ASEAN: Instrument, Scoring Rubrics, and Coding Protocol

detail.title: A Regulation-Grounded Disclosure Index for Sustainability Reporting in ASEAN: Instrument, Scoring Rubrics, and Coding Protocol
detail.abstract: Research on sustainability disclosure in emerging markets is constrained by the measurement instruments available to it. Commercial environmental, social and governance ratings cover only part of the listed population, apply a single global template across jurisdictions with materially different reporting mandates, and do not disclose their construction. Academic disclosure indices, in turn, are typically assembled from prevailing reporting practice or adapted from instruments built for other jurisdictions, so that the items scored do not correspond to what any particular regulator actually requires. This paper documents a disclosure index instrument constructed from the opposite direction. Its sixty-five items are derived from the text of the reporting mandates of three ASEAN jurisdictions: Indonesia, through Appendix II of Financial Services Authority Regulation 51 of 2017; Malaysia, through the Bursa Malaysia Sustainability Reporting Guide and the common sustainability matters prescribed under Practice Note 9; and Singapore, through Listing Rules 711A and 711B and Practice Note 7.6. Each item is traceable to the provision that requires it. The instrument scores every item on a nought-to-four scale using one of three rubrics, distinguishing quantitative, narrative and forward-looking disclosures. It accommodates three features that a single uniform index cannot: applicability conditions that vary by firm within a jurisdiction, mandate content that changes across reporting years, and the difference between mandatory and comply-or-explain regimes, under which non-disclosure accompanied by explanation constitutes compliance. Four indices are computed from the same coded data: a compliance index, a quality index, the gap between them, and a breadth index capturing voluntary disclosure beyond mandate. The paper sets out the item list, the rubrics, the applicability matrix, the computation rules, and the coding and inter-coder reliability protocol. The instrument is documented here prior to field validation; no empirical results are reported.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个全新的可持续发展披露指数工具，其65个指标直接来源于东盟三个司法管辖区（印度尼西亚、马来西亚、新加坡）的监管要求文本，而非从现有实践或他国工具改编。该工具支持差异化适用条件、跨年度监管变化及强制与遵守或解释制度，可计算合规指数、质量指数、合规-质量差距和自愿披露广度指数四个指标，并详细记录了编码协议。本文为方法论文档，尚未进行实证验证。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个与新兴市场具体监管要求精确对应的可持续发展披露指数测量工具？
AI.motivation: 现有商业ESG评级仅覆盖部分上市公司、适用统一的全球模板且不披露构建方法；学术披露指数多基于现有实践或从其他司法管辖区改编，所评项目与实际监管要求不符。新兴市场的可持续发展披露研究因测量工具受限而无法深入。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于监管合规的披露指数构建理论，区分强制披露与遵守或解释制度，涵盖定量、叙述性和前瞻性披露三种披露类型。
AI.method: 从三个东盟司法管辖区的监管文件文本中逆向推导出65个披露指标，每个指标均可追溯到具体监管条款。采用0-4分评分量表，使用三种评分准则区分定量、叙述性和前瞻性披露。设计了适用性矩阵和跨年度编码规则，并制定了编码和编码者间信度协议。
AI.findings: 本文为方法论文档，不报告实证结果。其主要产出是一个可追溯至具体监管条款的65项披露指数工具，支持四个指标的计算：合规指数、质量指数、合规-质量差距、自愿披露广度指数。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种"监管导向"的披露指数构建方法，与传统的"实践导向"或"跨境改编"方法相对立，填补了新兴市场可持续发展披露测量工具的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术界和实务界提供了一个可追溯、可复制的披露测量工具，适用于三个东盟司法管辖区的监管环境，能够区分合规性、披露质量和自愿披露水平，便于监管机构和企业进行可持续发展披露评估。

title: Developing an Account-Level Mortgage Prepayment Model with an Agentic AI Team Methodology, Calibration, and The Case for Human Validation

detail.title: Developing an Account-Level Mortgage Prepayment Model with an Agentic AI Team Methodology, Calibration, and The Case for Human Validation
detail.abstract: A mortgage prepayment model decides how much of a bank’s ϐixed‑rate mortgage book returns as cash when rates fall, and how long it stays outstanding when rates rise. This paper documents a competing‑ risks mortgage model built on 27 origination vintages of the public Freddie Mac Single‑Family Loan‑ Level Dataset, and it documents both of the model’s arms. The voluntary arm, calibrated on 54,558,002 loan‑months, joins a turnover limb with linear rate lock‑in to a tiered, era‑tuned reϐinance S‑curve, and multiplies the whole voluntary hazard by a ϐloored logistic equity term that reads each month’s mark‑ to‑market loan‑to‑value from the model’s own recursion. The default arm reads origination credit score, loan age and the same collateral state, and its own crisis‑shape gate records a FAIL on crisis‑peak timing and vintage ordering that is disclosed rather than netted. Loss severity is a structural function of collateral whose two judgment inputs were re‑set by the model owner against 13,154 realized crisis loss observations, and the valuation cohort carries an empirical collateral distribution rather than a single representative loan‑to‑value. On a $100 million, 5.5 percent, 12‑month‑seasoned cohort, valued on the March 31, 2026 SOFR curve with a stated 250 basis point mortgage spread, the model reads base value at 94.58 percent of face, a weighted‑average life of 8.69 years, and re‑pricings of +1,040 and ‑1,220 basis points of base economic value at parallel shocks of ‑200 and +200 basis points; a 25 percent house‑price decline costs 326 basis points, a ϐigure quoted only together with its speciϐication band of [‑353, ‑292], and it extends average life by 2.7 years, which is the sign a housing stress should produce and the sign an equity‑blind voluntary arm cannot produce at all. A single current‑coupon loan prices the borrower’s option at 37 basis points of running spread under a Hull‑White engine and 35 under a BGM engine calibrated to the same swaption quotes, with the 2.2 basis point remainder disclosed as the price of the rate‑engine choice. The tested rate domain includes non‑parallel curve shocks and key‑rate durations whose twelve‑node sum reproduces the parallel duration. The paper also documents how the model was developed and challenged by AI systems working under a human owner, including three pre‑registered tests whose outcomes went against their own registration and are retained on the record with attribution, because how a model development process behaves when its tests surprise it is part of the evidence a validator needs. The author speciϐied the architecture, set the economic rules and adjudicated every acceptance without being a specialist in the loan‑level data engineering or the numerical calibration those systems carried out, and that asymmetry, rather than any defect the record shows, is the paper’s argument for why independent specialist validation is a precondition of risk‑management use and not a formality after it. The model is not ϐit for supervisory stress testing, for reasons Section 13 states structurally, and it has not been independently validated by a human. It is not approved for production use.

AI.tldr: 本文档记录了一个基于Freddie Mac单户贷款层级数据集构建的竞争风险抵押贷款提前还款模型，涵盖自愿提前还款和违约两个分支，并详细披露了模型开发过程中AI系统与人类所有者协作的过程，包括失败的前注册测试。模型未获批生产使用，也未经独立人工验证。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够准确刻画抵押贷款提前还款和违约双重风险的竞争风险模型，使其在利率变动和房价冲击下产生合理的经济价值与风险敞口估值？
AI.motivation: 抵押贷款提前还款模型在利率下降时决定银行固定利率贷款组合的现金回流速度，在利率上升时决定贷款存续时长，对银行资产负债管理和风险定价至关重要。现有模型往往忽视竞争风险结构、房价状态与危机时期行为，且缺乏透明可复现的开发记录。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争风险模型（competing-risks framework）、提前还款S曲线、利率锁定（rate lock-in）、逻辑斯蒂股权项（logistic equity term）、期权定价理论（Hull-White和BGM利率引擎）、久期与关键利率久期分析。
AI.method: 基于27个发起年份的Freddie Mac贷款层级数据，利用54,558,002个贷款月观测值校准自愿提前还款分支（包含周转、再融资S曲线与股权项），违约分支读取信用评分、贷款年龄和抵押物状态，损失严重度作为抵押物的结构化函数，并通过AI系统辅助开发与人工所有者裁定。
AI.findings: 在1亿美元、5.5%票息、12个月账龄的组合上，基值估值为面值的94.58%，加权平均寿命8.69年；-200/+200基点平行冲击下经济价值变动为+1,040/-1,220基点；25%房价下跌成本326基点（规范区间[-353,-292]），寿命延长2.7年；当前票息贷款的借款人期权定价为Hull-White引擎37基点、BGM引擎35基点。
AI.theory_contributions: 论文展示了竞争风险框架下提前还款与违约的内部一致性建模，证明了房价冲击对存续期的正向延长效应是股权感知（equity-aware）模型才能产生的信号；披露了利率引擎选择（Hull-White vs BGM）对期权定价的影响幅度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行抵押贷款组合的风险估值提供了透明的建模范式，展示了AI辅助开发流程中人类裁定与独立验证的必要性；公开了模型失败测试记录，为监管验证流程提供了可参照的开发实践。

AI.tldr: 本文档记录了一个基于Freddie Mac单家庭贷款级数据集（27个发起年份、5450万贷款月观测）构建的竞争风险抵押贷款提前还款模型，涵盖自愿提前还款（含周转、再融资S曲线及权益项）和违约（含危机形态门控）两大分支，并披露了损失严重度、估值队列、利率引擎对比等细节。模型在多个压力测试下的估值结果为94.58%面值、加权平均寿命8.69年，并明确声明该模型不适合监管压力测试、未经独立人类验证、未获生产使用批准。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个结构透明、经得起验证的抵押贷款提前还款（竞争风险）模型，并记录其开发与挑战过程（含AI协作）以供独立验证？
AI.motivation: 抵押贷款提前还款模型决定固定利率抵押贷款组合在利率下降时回流的现金量及利率上升时的久期，是银行风险管理的关键工具。作者旨在记录一个透明、可审计的模型及其开发过程中的失败与修正，论证独立专家验证是风险管理的先决条件而非形式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争风险模型（自愿提前还款与违约双分支）；线性利率锁定额（rate lock-in）；分级再融资S曲线；带下限的逻辑权益项（基于逐月按市值计价的贷款价值比LTV递归）；危机形态门控（crisis-shape gate）；损失严重度的结构性抵押品函数；Hull-White与BGM利率引擎定价对比。
AI.method: 基于Freddie Mac单家庭贷款级数据集27个发起年份构建竞争风险模型：自愿分支在5450万贷款月数据上校准，包含周转/再融资S曲线及逻辑权益项；违约分支读取FICO、贷款年龄与抵押品状态。损失严重度由模型所有者依据13,154个已实现危机损失观测重置两个判断输入。利率引擎采用Hull-White与BGM（校准至同一掉期报价）对比。执行非平行曲线冲击与关键利率久期测试，以及三项预注册测试。
AI.findings: 1亿美元、5.5%利率、12个月账龄队列在2026年3月31日SOFR曲线、250bp抵押利差下估值为面值的94.58%，加权平均寿命8.69年；±200bp平行冲击下经济价值变动为+1040/-1220bp；房价下跌25%成本326bp（区间[-353,-292]），平均寿命延长2.7年；单一当期票息贷款借款人期权定价为Hull-White下37bp、BGM下35bp运行利差，2.2bp差价为利率引擎选择的价格。三项预注册测试结果与注册相反但被保留记录。该模型不适合监管压力测试且未经独立人工验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了竞争风险提前还款模型的完整架构与透明披露；提出"模型开发过程在测试出乎意料时的行为亦是验证证据"的理念；论证了独立专业验证作为风险管理使用前提的结构性必要性（而非形式性）；披露了利率引擎选择的定价差异，纳入方法论不确定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行及资产管理实务提供了一套可审计的抵押贷款提前还款模型及其估值检验结果（如房价压力对久期的延长效应）；展示AI系统与人类所有者协作开发模型的过程记录（含预注册失败测试的保留）；明确警示该模型不适用于监管压力测试，为实务使用划定边界。

title: Energy Security vs. Food Inflation: An Empirical Analysis of Crop-Substitution and Price Spillover Effects in India's E20 Ethanol Expansion

detail.title: Energy Security vs. Food Inflation: An Empirical Analysis of Crop-Substitution and Price Spillover Effects in India's E20 Ethanol Expansion
detail.abstract: India's Ethanol Blended Petrol (EBP) Programme has advanced from a marginal 1.14–1.53 per cent blending rate in 2013–14 to the statutory 20 per cent (E20) target by Ethanol Supply Year (ESY) 2025–26, five years ahead of the original 2030 deadline set under the National Policy on Biofuels, 2018. This rapid scale-up has been accompanied by an equally rapid structural shift in feedstock composition: official data show the share of grain-based ethanol (maize, rice, and damaged food grain) rising from roughly 9 per cent of total procurement in ESY 2020–21 to nearly 60 per cent by early ESY 2024–25, with industry-association estimates placing maize's individual share alone at approximately 50 per cent by ESY 2024–25, up from 6.2 per cent two years earlier. This paper examines the resulting energy-security-versus-food-inflation trade-off using officially reported and peer-reviewed data. It synthesises the National Policy on Biofuels (2018, amended 2022), the NITI Aayog Roadmap for Ethanol Blending in India 2020–25, Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MoPNG) blending statistics, USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS) maize market data, Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and Ministry of Finance inflation reporting, and a 2026 peer-reviewed partial-equilibrium modelling study (published in PLOS One by researchers at the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad, the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research, and the FABLE Consortium). The analysis finds credible evidence of crop-substitution pressure — a 14.7 per cent year-on-year decline in maize production coinciding with record consumption, an 84 per cent collapse in maize exports, and open-market maize prices exceeding the government's minimum support price by approximately 11 per cent in April 2024 — alongside documented cumulative energy-security gains of over ₹1.36–1.59 lakh crore in foreign exchange savings. However, the paper finds that a direct, India-specific econometric (VAR/Granger) estimate of ethanol-to-food-price transmission does not yet exist in the peer-reviewed literature; this study is accordingly framed as a literature- and data-grounded empirical synthesis rather than primary econometric estimation, and it explicitly flags this gap as a priority for future research. Policy recommendations centre on feedstock diversification toward 2G/cellulosic ethanol, protection of grain buffer stocks, and integration of food-price monitoring into the biofuel roadmap.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了印度乙醇掺混汽油（EBP）计划从2013-14年不足2%的掺混率快速推进至2025-26年实现E20（20%掺混）目标的历程，指出其原料结构已从甘蔗糖蜜为主转向以谷物（玉米、大米、受损粮食）为主（谷物占比从2020-21年的约9%飙升至2024-25年的近60%）。论文基于官方数据和多源文献，剖析了由此产生的能源安全与食品通胀之间的权衡，发现存在作物替代压力的可信证据（玉米产量同比下降14.7%、出口暴跌84%、市价高于最低支持价约11%），同时也记录了逾1.36-1.59万亿卢比的外汇节省。但论文明确指出，目前同行评议文献中尚缺乏印度特有的乙醇-食品价格传导的计量估计（VAR/Granger），本研究定位为文献与数据支撑的经验综合而非原始计量估计，并将该空白列为未来研究优先事项。政策建议聚焦于原料多样化（2G/纤维素乙醇）、保护粮食缓冲库存以及将食品价格监测纳入生物燃料路线图。
AI.research_question: 印度乙醇掺混汽油计划快速扩展至E20目标的背景下，谷物基乙醇原料快速扩张所引发的能源安全与食品通胀之间究竟存在怎样的权衡关系？
AI.motivation: 印度EBP计划加速推进（提前5年实现E20目标）的同时，原料结构发生剧烈转变——谷物基乙醇占比从约9%飙升至近60%，玉米在两年内从6.2%跃升至约50%。这种快速转型可能对粮食安全和食品价格构成重大压力，亟需系统评估其能源安全收益与食品通胀代价之间的权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源安全-食品通胀权衡框架（energy-security-versus-food-inflation trade-off）；基于国家生物燃料政策（2018/2022修订）、NITI Aayog路线图、Policy Analysis（政策分析）等制度框架，辅以部分均衡建模（partial-equilibrium modelling）的经济学分析视角。
AI.method: 文献与数据驱动的经验综合（literature- and data-grounded empirical synthesis）：综合官方数据源（MoPNG掺混统计、USDA FAS玉米市场数据、RBI与财政部通胀报告）及2026年PLOS One发表的同行评议部分均衡建模研究，进行多源数据的交叉验证与综合分析。论文明确放弃原始计量估计，转而采用综合分析方法，并将VAR/Granger实证空白标记为未来研究方向。
AI.findings: （1）发现作物替代压力的可信证据：玉米产量同比下降14.7%但消费创纪录、出口暴跌84%、2024年4月开放市场玉米价格高于最低支持价约11%；（2）记录了累计能源安全收益：超过1.36-1.59万亿卢比的外汇节省；（3）关键空白：同行评议文献中尚不存在印度特有的乙醇-食品价格传导计量估计（VAR/Granger）。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究指出并系统勾勒了印度乙醇政策研究中食品价格传导计量分析的空白，为未来实证研究提供了明确的方向指引和分析框架；通过综合多方数据来源，构建了能源安全与食品通胀权衡的整合性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项具体政策建议：向2G/纤维素乙醇进行原料多样化、保护粮食缓冲库存、将食品价格监测纳入生物燃料路线图，为印度政府在推进乙醇掺混的同时平衡食品通胀风险提供了可操作的决策参考。

title: Teaching Statistical Reporting through Reproduction: Open Materials for a Logistic Regression Session Built on Published Data
affiliations: Nanzan University

detail.title: Teaching Statistical Reporting through Reproduction: Open Materials for a Logistic Regression Session Built on Published Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants were involved. The analysis uses de-identified data already published under an open licence, so ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this work.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study is not a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: Students of the social sciences are commonly taught to fit a logistic regression on a dataset prepared for the purpose, and are left to work out for themselves how to report one. This article reports an openly deposited set of materials for a 90-minute session — slides, a student worksheet, an instructor key, and a browser-based application in Japanese and English that renders a fitted model as a table and a draft paragraph in the reporting conventions of its research community, with the passages requiring theoretical justification and substantive interpretation left blank. In the session, students reproduce a published multivariable logistic regression from the patient-level data deposited with it. Four of the five published odds ratios reproduce to one decimal place; the fifth does not, and the published account is not detailed enough to say why. The exercise then yields statistics the source article does not report: the model classifies 85.6% of cases correctly against a no-information rate of 83.1%, with sensitivity of .95 and specificity of .37, while the area under the ROC curve is .858. A predictor recorded both continuously and dichotomized gives OR = 1.00 (p = .93) in the first form and OR = 5.59 (p < .001) in the second. The session has not yet been delivered and no learning outcomes are claimed; the applications, materials and reformatted dataset are openly deposited.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一套开放存取的90分钟教学材料（幻灯片、学生工作表、教师答案、日英双语浏览器应用），用于教授社会科学学生如何报告逻辑回归结果。学生通过复现一篇已发表的多变量逻辑回归论文来学习，发现了发表文章的复现问题（5个比值比中4个能在小数点后一位复现），并引导出原文章未报告的重要统计量（分类准确率85.6%、ROC曲线下面积0.858等），同时发现同一预测因子在不同编码形式下产生截然不同的结果（OR=1.00 vs OR=5.59）。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一套有效的教学材料，帮助社会科学学生学习报告逻辑回归结果，并通过复现已发表的回归分析来发现统计学报告中的问题？
AI.motivation: 社会科学学生通常只被教授如何拟合逻辑回归模型，但未被教授如何报告其结果。作者旨在填补这一教学空白，通过让学习者复现已发表论文的回归分析，来培养其报告能力并揭示发表文献中可能存在的统计报告问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文本身是教学方法论文章，而非基于特定理论框架的研究。其隐含的理论基础包括：体验式学习（通过复现实践学习）、开放性科学（开放材料与数据）以及统计报告规范/惯例的理论。
AI.method: 开发并开放存取一套90分钟教学材料（幻灯片、学生工作表、教师答案、日英双语浏览器应用）。教学中要求学生使用已发表论文所附的患者级数据复现一篇多变量逻辑回归。该应用将拟合模型渲染为表格和符合研究社区报告惯例的草稿段落，将需要理论论证和实质性解释的段落留空。论文报告了复现结果并与原文进行比较。
AI.findings: 1）五个已发表比值比中有四个可以在小数点后一位精确复现，第五个无法复现且原文未提供足够细节说明原因；2）原文章未报告的统计量：模型正确分类85.6%的案例（对比无信息率83.1%），敏感度0.95，特异度0.37，ROC曲线下面积为0.858；3）同一预测因子连续编码时OR=1.00（p=0.93），二分编码时OR=5.59（p<0.001），显示了编码方式对结果的显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 贡献在于教学法层面：提出了一种通过复现已发表研究来教授统计报告的新教学方法，展示了如何将开放科学原则应用于统计教学，并揭示了已发表研究在统计报告完整性方面的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接使用的开放教学资源（90分钟课程全套材料、日英双语应用、重新格式化的数据集），这些材料可供全球教师直接采用。同时，通过复现分析暴露了已发表论文中统计报告的缺陷和编码选择对结果的影响，对研究者和期刊编辑具有实务启示。

title: Information as a Substitute for Investment: The Benefit Channel of Verification

detail.title: Information as a Substitute for Investment: The Benefit Channel of Verification
detail.abstract: An auditor's capability is read through a single disclosure both as a liability, which invites suit, and as a benefit, the reputational value that competence commands. We ask when the benefit disturbs the cross-regime ranking of capability supply that the liability channel induces, and the answer is a law about curvature. A benefit leaves the ranking untouched exactly when it is belief-affine, so the natural deterrence benefit is inert and a channel with content requires curvature. But a convex benefit-the reward for perceived excellence-is harvested by disclosure rather than by investment: under joint optimisation it re-separates into a pull common to every regime and reorders nothing, so information substitutes for investment, and a benefit that can be gamed by information cannot buy capability. Only a concave benefit, which disclosure destroys rather than raises, survives to move the ranking; the re-separation and the protocol-invariance of the surviving reversal are theorems, and in the quadratic benchmark family the reversal sits in a single place, at a threshold available in closed form, the same threshold whether disclosure is set to manage liability or chosen jointly. The robustness of the liability ranking to reputational value is not the robustness of a model that ignored the benefit; it is the robustness of a benefit that, throughout the benchmark family, has one place, and one direction, in which it can bite.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了审计师能力供给中，声誉收益（披露带来的benefit）如何与法律责任（liability）渠道相互作用并影响跨制度的能力供给排序。研究发现：只有凹性（concave）的声誉收益才能改变责任渠道所决定的排序，而凸性（convex）收益会被披露本身攫取、无法购买能力，线性（belief-affine）收益则完全无效。
AI.research_question: 声誉收益在何种条件下会改变法律责任渠道所诱导的跨制度能力供给排序？
AI.motivation: 审计师的能力同时通过单一披露被解读为两种属性——作为责任（引发诉讼）和作为收益（能力的声誉价值）。需要理解声誉收益何时会扰乱责任渠道所决定的跨制度能力供给排序。
AI.theoretical_framework: 声誉收益的曲率理论（curvature law）：信念仿射（belief-affine）收益不改变排序；凸性收益被披露攫取而非投资，导致信息替代投资；只有凹性收益能存活并改变排序。
AI.method: 理论建模与博弈论分析，包括联合优化（joint optimisation）、再分离（re-separation）分析，以及在二次基准族（quadratic benchmark family）中求解闭式阈值。
AI.findings: （1）信念仿射的自然威慑收益是惰性的（inert），不影响排序；（2）凸性收益被披露攫取，信息替代投资，无法购买能力，不改变排序；（3）只有凹性收益能存活并改变跨制度排序（reversal）；（4）在二次基准族中，反转仅出现在一个位置，其阈值有闭式解，且该阈值在仅管理责任与联合选择披露两种情形下相同。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出了"曲率定律"（curvature law）——收益的曲率决定了其是否影响能力供给排序；（2）证明了责任排序对声誉价值的稳健性并非源于忽略收益，而是凹性收益仅在单一位置、单一方向上能起作用；（3）提供再分离定理和协议不变性（protocol-invariance）定理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者理解声誉激励与法律责任在审计市场中的互动提供理论指导：凸性声誉激励（如声誉奖励）可能被信息操纵攫取，无法真正购买能力；监管设计应考虑收益的曲率特性。

title: The Propagation of Inflation Shocks: A Momentum, Intensity, and Connectedness Diagnostic for Central Banks
affiliations: Stellenbosch University

detail.title: The Propagation of Inflation Shocks: A Momentum, Intensity, and Connectedness Diagnostic for Central Banks
detail.abstract: When inflation surges, central banks must judge in real time whether the shock is transitory or the onset of a persistent, broad-based shift. I argue that aggregate persistence often emerges from propagation: a shock lands in a few categories and then passes through cost linkages category by category, so headline inflation looks persistent because pass-through is staggered rather than simultaneous. From a diffusion model over a cost network of CPI categories I derive three real-time indices: breadth, intensity, and connectedness. Breadth is the share of the basket under sustained same-sign pressure, intensity is the size of those sustained surprises, and connectedness is where that pressure appears relative to the shock's origin. Across 391 disaggregated South African CPI categories (2008-2026), a difference-indifferences design that measures exposure through the national supplyuse network shows that after the 2022 Russia-Ukraine invasion magnitude-adjusted momentum rises by 0.45 (s.e. 0.12) within five months, with flat pre-trends, and grows with network distance from the commodity origin (a pattern a pure binary breadth index misses). The framework lets policymakers watch inflationary pressure broaden and anticipate where it will travel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通胀扩散框架，认为总体通胀的持续性源于冲击通过成本联系网络在CPI类别间逐类传导（错开传导而非同步传导），并基于成本网络扩散模型构建了三个实时指标：广度（breadth）、强度（intensity）和连通性（connectedness）。利用南非391个CPI类别的数据（2008-2026），通过双重差分设计验证了2022年俄乌冲突后通胀冲击沿供应链网络的扩散机制。
AI.research_question: 当通胀飙升时，央行如何实时判断冲击是暂时性的还是持续性、广泛性的转变？通胀持续性如何从部门间的传导中涌现？
AI.motivation: 传统上央行需要实时区分暂时性冲击与持续性冲击，但现有方法缺乏对通胀冲击如何在CPI类别间通过成本联系传播的系统理解。作者认为总体通胀的持续性往往源于传播机制：冲击先在少数类别中着陆，然后通过成本联系逐类传导，因此标题通胀看起来持久是因为传导是错开的而非同步的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CPI类别成本网络的扩散模型（diffusion model）；核心概念包括广度（breadth，篮子中承受持续同向压力的份额）、强度（intensity，持续性意外的规模）和连通性（connectedness，压力相对于冲击起源出现的位置）。
AI.method: 构建成本网络扩散模型推导三个实时指标；利用南非391个CPI类别（2008-2026）数据，通过国家供给使用网络衡量暴露度的双重差分（difference-in-differences）设计进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 在2022年俄乌冲突后，幅度调整的动量在五个月内上升0.45（标准误0.12），前期趋势平坦；效应随网络距离冲击起源（大宗商品）的距离增加而增强——这是纯二元广度指数无法捕捉的模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"通胀持续性源于错开传导"的理论视角，将通胀扩散建模为成本网络上的传播过程，并区分了广度、强度、连通性三个维度，补充了传统二元广度指标的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实时监控通胀压力扩散、预判冲击传播路径的工具性框架，有助于央行更好地判断通胀冲击的性质（暂时性vs持续性）并制定相应货币政策。

title: Climate Risk Management within the Climate Adaptation Strategy Framework of Rosneft PJSC

detail.title: Climate Risk Management within the Climate Adaptation Strategy Framework of Rosneft PJSC

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Institute for International Studies at Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO University) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation

detail.abstract: The article examines the climate strategy of Rosneft PJSC through the prism of corporate risk management, conceptualizing it as a comprehensive, multi-tiered framework for the identification, classification, quantitative and qualitative assessment, and subsequent mitigation of climate risks that exert direct and indirect influence on the company's financial stability, operational efficiency, investment appeal, and long-term strategic viability. The analysis is grounded in a fundamental premise of contemporary financial management theory: within the context of the global energy transition, climate factors are evolving from external externalities into endogenous determinants of business capitalization, necessitating systematic governance on par with traditional production and market risks. 1 The study identifies the principal sources of climate vulnerability, demonstrating that the formulation and execution of an adaptation strategy transcend mere corporate social responsibility or reputational maintenance, emerging instead as a critical determinant of sustained competitiveness in the medium and long term.

AI.tldr: 本文通过企业风险管理的视角，分析俄罗斯石油公司（Rosneft PJSC）的气候战略，将其概念化为一个多层次、综合性的框架，用于识别、分类、定量与定性评估以及缓解对财务稳定性、运营效率、投资吸引力和长期战略可行性产生直接和间接影响的气候风险。
AI.research_question: 罗斯石油公司如何通过企业风险管理框架构建和实施气候战略，以应对全球能源转型背景下的气候风险？
AI.motivation: 在全球能源转型背景下，气候因素正从外部性演变为企业资本化的内生决定因素，需要与传统的生产和市场风险同等重要的系统性治理。因此，气候适应战略的制定和执行已超越企业社会责任或声誉维护的范畴，成为中期和长期持续竞争力的关键决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 当代金融管理理论，特别是关于气候因素从外部性演变为企业资本化内生决定因素的核心理念，以及企业风险管理理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以罗斯石油公司为对象，通过企业风险管理的棱镜对其气候战略进行概念化分析，涵盖气候风险的识别、分类、定量与定性评估及缓解机制。
AI.findings: 研究识别了气候脆弱性的主要来源，证明适应战略的制定和执行不仅是企业社会责任或声誉维护，更是中长期持续竞争力的关键决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候风险管理纳入企业风险管理框架，论证气候因素已从外部性转变为影响企业资本化的内生变量，丰富了金融管理理论在能源转型情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为石油天然气行业企业提供了系统性气候风险管理的框架参考，指导企业将气候适应战略定位为竞争力维护而非单纯的社会责任行为。

title: Over-indebtedness, Discharge, and Personal Insolvency in Brazil and Mexico
affiliations: Instituto Tecnológico Autónomo de México (ITAM) - Law School

detail.title: Over-indebtedness, Discharge, and Personal Insolvency in Brazil and Mexico
detail.abstract: This paper discusses the developments and challenging areas of the new insolvency proceedings for natural persons in Brazil and Mexico. Both countries have introduced new systems which have yet to be tested. The systems are intended to facilitate access to debt renegotiation, but discharge of pre-existing debt may not occur. The purpose of the article is to compare the relevant features of the two systems and explore the central problems, and the challenges they face for a better understanding and implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了巴西和墨西哥新引入的自然人破产程序，指出两国新系统均尚未经过实践检验，旨在便利债务重新谈判，但已有债务的免除可能不会发生。文章通过比较两国制度的核心特征，探讨其在理解和实施方面面临的主要问题与挑战。
AI.research_question: 巴西和墨西哥新引入的自然人破产程序有何异同？两国制度在实施中面临哪些核心问题和挑战？
AI.motivation: 巴西和墨西哥都引入了新的自然人破产制度，但这些新系统尚未经过实践检验，需要对其特点进行比较分析，以促进更好的理解和实施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法分析框架，聚焦于两国自然人破产制度的设计理念、债务重新谈判机制与债务免除（discharge）规则。
AI.method: 比较法研究方法，对巴西和墨西哥两国的自然人破产制度进行横向比较，分析其相关特征及核心问题。
AI.findings: 两国新制度均旨在便利债务人进入债务重新谈判程序，但已有债务的免除可能不会实现；两国系统均尚待实践检验，面临实施层面的不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为比较破产法领域提供了巴西和墨西哥两个新兴经济体自然人破产制度的最新比较分析，填补了该领域对这些国家新制度的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于政策制定者、法律从业者和相关利益方更好地理解巴西和墨西哥自然人破产制度的运作机制及其潜在挑战，为制度完善和实施提供参考。

title: The ESG Scoring Function across Markets: Predictability and Drivers from Firm Fundamentals
affiliations: University of Trento and University of Trento

detail.title: The ESG Scoring Function across Markets: Predictability and Drivers from Firm Fundamentals

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study did not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. Access to the LSEG Workspace data used in this study was provided through an institutional subscription of the University of Trento.

detail.abstract: ESG ratings are widely used by investors and regulators, yet it is unclear how tightly they are anchored to observable firm characteristics and whether this anchoring is stable across markets and across the E, S and G pillars. We study the empirical scoring function behind LSEG ESG ratings using firms from five major equity indices-EUROSTOXX 600, S&P 500, CSI 300, BOVESPA and JALSH-and predict overall and pillar scores with random forests trained only on standard financial-statement and market variables, deliberately excluding past ESG information. We interpret the fitted models with variable-importance measures, global surrogate trees and Shapley values, applied uniformly across regions. Predictability is highest in Europe, intermediate in the United States, China and Brazil, and lowest in South Africa; it typically declines when moving from the aggregate score to the individual pillars, with governance generally the least predictable. All markets share a life-cycle and visibility component, but the variables carrying it differ by region: balance-sheet fundamentals in Europe, ownership dispersion and investor-base breadth in the United States, listing maturity in Brazil, and market-risk and capital-allocation proxies in South Africa. ESG scores are therefore not mechanically comparable across countries, and cross-market ESG integration requires market-specific adjustments.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用随机森林模型，仅基于标准财务报表和市场变量（排除历史ESG信息）预测五大股市指数公司（欧洲、美国、中国、巴西、南非）的LSEG ESG评分，发现ESG评分的可预测性因地区而异，且各支柱评分的可预测性也不同，最终得出ESG评分在不同市场间不具备机械可比性的结论。
AI.research_question: ESG评级在多大程度上锚定于可观测的公司特征？这种锚定关系在不同市场以及E、S、G三个支柱之间是否稳定？
AI.motivation: ESG评级被投资者和监管者广泛使用，但其与可观测公司特征的关联程度及跨市场稳定性尚不明确，理解这一问题对跨市场ESG整合至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机森林的可预测性分析框架，结合变量重要性、全局替代树和Shapley值等可解释机器学习方法。
AI.method: 使用五个主要股市指数（EUROSTOXX 600、S&P 500、CSI 300、BOVESPA和JALSH）的公司样本，以标准财务报表和市场变量训练随机森林模型预测ESG总分及各支柱分数，排除过去ESG信息，并用变量重要性度量、全局替代树和Shapley值统一解释模型。
AI.findings: 欧洲的ESG评分可预测性最高，美国、中国和巴西居中，南非最低；从总分到各支柱，可预测性普遍下降，其中治理（G）支柱最不可预测。所有市场共享生命周期和可见度成分，但承载这些成分的变量因地区而异：欧洲为资产负债表基本面，美国为股权分散度和投资者基础广度，巴西为上市成熟度，南非为市场风险和资本配置代理变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了ESG评分背后的经验评分函数在不同市场间存在系统性差异，证明ESG评分并非客观可比，为ESG评级方法论研究提供了跨市场的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管者提供跨市场ESG整合时的市场特定调整建议，表明直接比较不同国家的ESG评分存在误导风险。

title: Anchored for Whom? Household Inflation Expectations after a Decade of Inflation Targeting
affiliations: CAFRAL and

detail.title: Anchored for Whom? Household Inflation Expectations after a Decade of Inflation Targeting
detail.abstract: India has completed a decade of flexible inflation targeting, and headline inflation has spent most of that decade inside the 2-6% tolerance band. Whether household expectations have become similarly anchored remains an open question. Using 65 waves of the Reserve Bank of India's Inflation Expectations Survey of Households (IESH)-approximately 335,000 responses collected between 2014 and 2025-we examine how broadly anchoring extends across Indian households. Around three salient shocks, one-year-ahead expectations moved in the direction the shock would predict: they fell by about 2 percentage points after demonetisation, rose by 1.8 points after the COVID-19 lockdown, and moved little on impact after the Russia-Ukraine war. Beneath the aggregate, expectations differ systematically across demographic groups. Older respondents, retired individuals, and residents of Tier 1 cities report higher expected inflation, as do women at the one-year horizon. The gap between the demographic profile with the highest predicted expectations and the profile with the lowest is on the order of two percentage points, half the width of the tolerance band. The pandemic reshuffled this heterogeneity, narrowing age differences and widening occupational ones. These patterns suggest that anchoring is better read as a distribution than as a single measure, and they help identify the household groups for whom targeted central-bank communication may yield the greatest gains.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度央行65轮家庭通胀预期调查（2014-2025年，约33.5万份回复），考察了印度实施弹性通胀目标制十年期间家庭通胀预期的锚定程度。研究发现，尽管总体通胀预期在三次重大冲击下均按预期方向变动，但预期在不同人口统计群体间存在系统性差异，年龄、退休状况、城市级别和性别均显著影响预期水平，且疫情期间这些异质性发生了重塑。
AI.research_question: 印度实行弹性通胀目标制十年后，家庭通胀预期的锚定程度如何？这种锚定在多大程度上是广泛而均匀地分布于不同人口统计群体之间，还是仅限于总体层面的表面锚定？
AI.motivation: 总体通胀率已在2-6%容忍区间内运行了大部分时间，但家庭预期是否同样被锚定仍是未解之谜。现有研究多聚焦于总体或平均预期水平，忽视了预期锚定在不同群体间的异质性分布，这限制了央行沟通政策的精准性和有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀预期锚定理论；行为经济学中的异质性预期形成理论；通胀预期的人口统计特征差异理论
AI.method: 使用印度央行通胀预期家庭调查（IESH）2014-2025年间65轮、约33.5万份个体层面数据，围绕三次重大冲击（废钞令、新冠疫情、俄乌战争）分析一年期通胀预期的变动，并通过人口统计群体间的回归比较来揭示预期的系统异质性。
AI.findings: （1）三次冲击下总体预期均按理论预测方向变动：废钞令后下降约2个百分点，疫情封锁后上升1.8个百分点，俄乌战争后短期变动不大；（2）预期存在系统性人口统计差异：老年人、退休者、一线城市居民以及女性（一年期）报告的预期通胀更高；（3）最高与最低预期人口画像之间的差距约2个百分点，相当于容忍区间宽度的一半；（4）疫情重塑了异质性结构，缩小了年龄差距却扩大了职业间差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"锚定应被视为一种分布而非单一指标"的理论视角，拓展了通胀预期锚定的概念化方式，为理解预期异质性及其动态演变提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别出预期锚定最弱的家庭群体，为央行实施更有针对性的沟通政策提供了实证依据，帮助货币政策当局优化沟通资源的配置以提升预期锚定的有效性。

title: The Friction Trap: Transaction Costs, Fund Characteristics, and the Limits of Active Selection in the Chinese Mutual Fund Market

detail.title: The Friction Trap: Transaction Costs, Fund Characteristics, and the Limits of Active Selection in the Chinese Mutual Fund Market

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no relevant or material financial interests that relate to the research described in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: We study whether risk-adjusted selection skill survives transaction costs in the Chinese actively managed equity fund market. Our research sample is a daily panel of 1,350 funds from January 2005 to September 2024, aggregated to monthly frequency; the period after the data cutoff (October 2024-November 2025) is reserved as a genuine out-of-sample holdout. Transaction costs are computed with a fee engine parsed fund-by-fund from prospectus schedules. We report the following results. First, the t-statistic of a rolling two-factor alpha predicts performance: pre-transaction-cost returns rise monotonically across quintiles. Second, we document a "friction trap"-realized fee drag rises monotonically with rebalancing frequency, robustly in and out of sample. Third, once the same per-fund costs are applied to every portfolio, the selection strategy is statistically comparable to a naive equal-weighted basket of all funds (it trails narrowly both in and out of sample), while both dominate the passive CSI 300 and CSI 500 indices on a risk-adjusted basis. Fourth, in a look-ahead-free cross-section only fund age robustly predicts performance; size, ratings, and ESG do not. A strategy-level panel confirms that high-frequency rebalancing is structurally costlier, though we make no causal claim from the 2017 liquidity reform.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国主动管理型股票基金市场中，风险调整后的选股能力在扣除交易成本后是否依然存在。基于2005年1月至2024年9月的1,350只基金日度面板数据（聚合为月度），使用基金契约费率引擎逐基金计算交易成本，并保留2024年10月至2025年11月作为真实样本外验证期。研究发现：滚动双因子alpha的t统计量能预测收益；交易成本随调仓频率单调上升（"摩擦陷阱"）；扣除成本后选股策略与等权持有全部基金相当，但均跑赢被动指数；横截面上仅基金年龄稳健预测业绩。
AI.research_question: 中国主动管理型股票基金市场中，风险调整后的选股能力在扣除交易成本后是否依然存在？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多聚焦于美国市场，且常忽略交易成本对基金选股能力的侵蚀效应；中国市场基金费率结构独特（管理费+申赎费+托管费等），需要精细的成本核算来检验选股能力的"净"价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险调整后选股能力理论（alpha预测）、交易成本摩擦理论（friction trap）、有效市场假说检验
AI.method: 使用1,350只中国主动管理基金2005-2024年的日度面板（聚合至月度），构建滚动双因子alpha的t统计量作为选股信号；开发基于基金招募说明书费率表的逐基金交易成本引擎；进行样本外验证（2024年10月-2025年11月）；采用无前视偏差的横截面回归及策略层面面板分析。
AI.findings: （1）滚动双因子alpha的t统计量能单调预测税前收益；（2）实际费率拖累随调仓频率单调上升，样本内外均稳健（"摩擦陷阱"）；（3）扣除逐基金成本后，选股策略与等权持有全部基金在统计上相当（样本内外均略逊），但两者风险调整后均跑赢CSI 300和CSI 500指数；（4）无前视横截面中仅基金年龄稳健预测业绩，规模、评级和ESG均不显著；（5）策略层面面板证实高频调仓结构性成本更高，但对2017年流动性改革不做因果推断。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将交易成本纳入中国基金选股能力的评估框架，揭示了"摩擦陷阱"——调仓频率与成本拖累的单调关系——这一新的理论概念；为alpha可预测性与成本侵蚀之间的张力提供了新兴市场的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基金投资者提供净收益视角的选股策略评估；提示中国主动基金的高频调仓策略可能不划算，等权持有或被动指数投资更具性价比；为基金管理人提供费率结构对策略净收益影响的量化参考。

title: Performance Evaluation of a Serrated Drum Mucuna Flagellipes Nut Cracking Machine
affiliations: Michael Okpara University of Agriculture, Gregory University and Michael Okpara University of Agriculture Umudike, Abia state, Nigeria

detail.title: Performance Evaluation of a Serrated Drum Mucuna Flagellipes Nut Cracking Machine
detail.abstract: Food machinery development involves the application of mechanization and automation to the solution of problems associated with traditional food processing techniques. One operation that has been a bottleneck to the large-scale processing and utilization of Mucuna flagellipes which is a popular thickening agent in food is the cracking of its nut. The present approach to the operation is not only tasky and time consuming, it is also wasteful. To overcome this problem and add value to the crop, a nut cracking machine that works on the principle of compression and shear through the engagement of product against stationary rasp bars by a rotating serrated drum, was developed. The machine consists of a hopper equipped with flow rate control device, nut cracking unit, winnowing unit, kernel collection outlet and power system. Performance tests were conducted on the machine using M. flagellipes nuts in the moisture range of 1.15 – 39.43% (wb). Results show that the performance indicators (throughput, nut cracking efficiency, percentage kernel breakage, and winnowing efficiency) were significantly affected by moisture content, gate opening (material feed rate) and pretreatment (parboiling) time at constant machine speed. Machine throughput, and cracking efficiency decreased with increase in moisture content and parboiling time but increased with increase in feed rate. Percentage kernel breakage increased in the raw M. flagellipes nuts with increase in moisture content up to a point and decreased with further increase in moisture content. Parboiling of nuts remarkably increased kernel breakage. Winnowing efficiency decreased with increase in moisture content and was highest on raw nuts at low moisture levels and lowest on the same nuts at high moisture levels. Regression models with high coefficients of determination were used to express the relationship existing between the nut cracker performance indices and M. flagellipes nut moisture content, feed rate and parboiling time.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于压缩和剪切原理的Mucuna flagellipes坚果破壳机，通过旋转锯齿滚筒与固定刮条的配合实现破壳，并系统研究了水分含量、进料速率和蒸煮预处理时间对机器性能的影响。
AI.research_question: 如何设计并开发一种高效的Mucuna flagellipes坚果破壳机，以解决传统破壳方法劳动强度大、耗时且浪费的问题，并评估关键操作参数对机器性能的影响？
AI.motivation: Mucuna flagellipes是食品中广泛使用的增稠剂，但其坚果破壳环节一直是大规模加工和利用的瓶颈。现有方法不仅费力耗时，而且浪费严重，亟需机械化解决方案以提升加工效率和作物附加值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于压缩与剪切原理的机械破壳理论，涉及材料特性（水分含量）对破壳效率的影响以及预处理（蒸煮）对坚果结构改变的作用机制。
AI.method: 设计并制造了一台包含进料斗（带流量控制）、破壳单元、风选单元、集仁出口和动力系统的坚果破壳机。在水分含量1.15-39.43%（湿基）范围内进行性能测试，考察水分、进料口开度和蒸煮时间对吞吐量、破壳效率、仁破损率和风选效率的影响，并建立回归模型。
AI.findings: 机器吞吐量和破壳效率随水分含量和蒸煮时间增加而降低，但随进料速率增加而升高；生坚果的仁破损率随水分含量先增后减；蒸煮显著增加仁破损率；风选效率随水分含量增加而降低。所有性能指标均受水分含量、进料速率和蒸煮时间的显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了坚果破壳机性能指标与水分含量、进料速率和蒸煮时间之间的定量回归关系，为食品加工机械设计中材料特性与操作参数对性能影响机制提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一种高效的Mucuna flagellipes坚果破壳机，解决了传统破壳方法效率低、浪费大的问题，为大规模商业化加工该作物提供了可行的机械化解决方案，有助于提升作物附加值。

title: A Fee-Aware Break-Even Framework for Binary Prediction Markets under the Polymarket Fee Schedule

detail.title: A Fee-Aware Break-Even Framework for Binary Prediction Markets under the Polymarket Fee Schedule

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical and methodological analysis and does not involve human participants, patient data, animal subjects, or identifiable personal information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This note develops a deterministic analytical framework for the break-even condition imposed by platform taker fees on positions in binary prediction markets, instantiated on the Polymarket quadratic fee schedule ϕ = C r p(1-p), where C is the number of contracts. The framework is explicitly analytical rather than empirical: no execution data are used, no backtest is performed, and no profitability is claimed. Within a risk-neutral, held-to-resolution, taker-execution domain with the forecast probability treated as exogenous, the required probabilistic edge is shown to equal r p(1-p). This hurdle is an inverted parabola in price, attaining its maximum r/4 at p = 0.5 and decaying symmetrically to zero at the price boundaries; it scales linearly with the per-category fee parameter. Expressed as a fraction of deployed capital the hurdle is r(1-p), which is monotone decreasing in price and therefore largest for low-priced (longshot) contracts. The note separates the single-leg held-to-resolution case from active trading and derives the round-trip expectation explicitly, establishing that each additional taker fill contributes a further deterministic fee term and that a short-horizon round trip near a fixed price approximately doubles the single-leg hurdle. The framework is positioned as a deterministic lower bound on execution cost: spread, depth, slippage, partial fills, queue dynamics, and adverse selection are excluded by construction. Under standard execution assumptions their expected contribution is non-negative, so the deterministic hurdle reported here is a floor rather than an estimate of realised execution cost. Fee parameters are taken from the published Polymarket fee schedule as documented at the access date. The central conclusion is narrow: a raw forecasting edge is not equivalent to a tradable edge once deterministic platform fees are incorporated, and the size of the deterministic hurdle varies materially with price region and fee category. The note makes no claim regarding market efficiency, the existence of a forecasting edge, or realised profitability.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个确定性的分析框架，用于计算Polymarket二元预测市场中平台吃单费对仓位施加的盈亏平衡条件。在风险中性、持有至结算的假设下，所需概率优势等于 r·p(1-p)，这是一个以p=0.5为顶点、两端对称衰减到零的倒抛物线，并在价格极低（长线冷门）合约处占比最高。
AI.research_question: 二元预测市场中，纳入Polymarket平台吃单费后，交易者需要多大的概率优势才能达到盈亏平衡？该确定性门槛如何随价格和费用类别变化？
AI.motivation: 预测市场交易者通常将原始预测优势等同于可交易优势，但忽略了确定性平台费用的影响。作者希望提供一个严格的分析框架，明确区分原始预测优势与考虑平台费用后的可交易优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险中性定价框架；持有至结算假设；吃单执行假设；外生预测概率假设；确定性盈亏平衡分析。
AI.method: 纯分析/推导方法：构建确定性解析模型，基于Polymarket二次费用计划 ϕ = C·r·p(1-p) 推导单腿持有至结算及往返交易的盈亏平衡条件，不做任何实证分析或回测。
AI.findings: (1) 盈亏平衡所需概率优势等于 r·p(1-p)，为倒抛物线，在p=0.5处达最大值r/4，在价格边界衰减为零；随费用参数r线性缩放。(2) 以部署资本比例表示时，门槛为 r(1-p)，随价格单调递减，冷门合约门槛最高。(3) 每次额外吃单成交都会增加一个确定性费用项，短周期固定价格附近往返交易的门槛约为单腿的两倍。(4) 该确定性门槛是执行成本的底部下限，而非实际执行成本的估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 为预测市场平台费用分析提供了首个确定性解析框架；明确区分了原始预测优势与可交易优势；推导了单腿持有与往返交易的解析盈亏平衡公式；将确定性费用门槛定位为执行成本的确定性下限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Polymarket交易者提供了量化盈亏平衡门槛的解析公式，帮助理解不同价格区域和费用类别下的实际交易门槛；明确了在冷门合约和短周期高频交易中费用影响最大；不主张任何市场效率或盈利性结论。

title: Measuring a Scaffold from Inside: An Operator-Authored Self-Measurement Harness for a Constitutional Runtime over a Hosted Language Model
affiliations: Astrala Advisory Services Ltd

detail.title: Measuring a Scaffold from Inside: An Operator-Authored Self-Measurement Harness for a Constitutional Runtime over a Hosted Language Model
detail.abstract: Interactive intelligent systems constructed over hosted large language models cannot retrain the substrate on which they depend, and so their designers enforce a named epistemology at the surrounding scaffold layer. A difficulty follows that has received little methodological attention: when quality regresses, the regression frequently belongs to the scaffold rather than the substrate, and catching it requires instruments that measure the scaffold itself rather than the model beneath it. This article reports one such instrument set, added to a live constitutional runtime between 17 and 18 July 2026, and situates it as a reusable design pattern. The layer comprises five componentsoperator-authored adversarial batteries held as versioned regression fixtures, deterministic pattern screens encoding named defects, an emission quarantine that retains failure evidence as a first-class object, an instrument-health monitor issuing autonomous handoffs, and continuous-integration delivery tripwires. Eight falsifiable predictions are stated, each named against a specific runtime carrier-a code path, a database table, or a typed field-and each paired with an explicit falsification condition. The predictions are offered for adversarial replication under an honest empirical frame rather than as settled results: the batteries were authored by the platform's operator, classification is not independent, and the number of platforms studied is one. The discussion states a narrow priority claim, distinguishes the enforcement point of composition-time assertion from adjacent techniques, and argues that the interaction properties a reader encounters-an observation lock and per-turn provenance grounding-become testable precisely because they are structurally enforced.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一套针对托管大型语言模型所构建的交互式智能系统的脚手架层（scaffold layer）质量监控工具集，该工具集包含五个组件，用于捕捉脚手架而非底层模型的回归缺陷，并提出了八项可证伪的预测供对抗性复制验证。
AI.research_question: 当基于托管大型语言模型的交互式智能系统出现质量回退时，如何区分缺陷属于脚手架层而非底层模型，以及如何构建测量脚手架本身的仪器？
AI.motivation: 基于托管LLM的系统无法重训底层模型，因此设计者必须在脚手架层强制执行命名认识论（named epistemology）。当质量回退时，缺陷常属于脚手架而非底层模型，但现有方法论缺乏测量脚手架本身的工具，导致难以定位和捕捉此类回归。
AI.theoretical_framework: 命名认识论（named epistemology）；脚手架与基座（scaffold vs. substrate）分层框架；组合时断言（composition-time assertion）与相邻技术的区分。
AI.method: 在2026年7月17日至18日期间，向一个实时宪法运行时（constitutional runtime）添加五组件工具集：（1）操作者编写的对抗性测试集作为版本化回归夹具；（2）编码命名缺陷的确定性模式筛查；（3）保留失败证据为一等对象的发射隔离机制；（4）自动发出自主交接的仪器健康监控器；（5）持续集成交付绊线。同时提出八项可证伪预测，各针对特定的运行时载体（代码路径、数据库表或类型化字段）并配有明确的证伪条件。
AI.findings: 工具集成功添加到实时宪法运行时并作为可复用设计模式定位；八项预测以诚实经验框架提出供对抗性复制，但存在局限：测试集由平台操作者编写、分类非独立、研究对象仅一个平台。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了测量脚手架层而非底层模型的质量监控方法论框架；区分了组合时断言的执行点与相邻技术的差异；论证了观察锁（observation lock）和逐轮来源接地（per-turn provenance grounding）等交互属性因结构性强制而变得可测试。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个包含五个组件的可复用设计模式，用于在基于托管LLM的系统中检测脚手架层回归；为从业者提供了可对抗性复制的八项预测和明确证伪条件；将失败证据作为一等对象保留的发射隔离机制可辅助后续调试。

title: Third Space Engineering™: A Spatial Advocacy Paradigm Against Drugs and Substance Abuse, and Crime Prevention

detail.title: Third Space Engineering™: A Spatial Advocacy Paradigm Against Drugs and Substance Abuse, and Crime Prevention
detail.abstract:
Contemporary approaches to crime prevention and community development have traditionally relied on reactive law enforcement, social interventions, urban planning, or public health initiatives operating within separate disciplinary domains. While these approaches have achieved varying degrees of success, persistent challenges such as crime, substance abuse, social fragmentation, and the underutilization of public spaces highlight the need for more integrated and preventive strategies. This foundational white paper introduces Third Space Engineering™ (TSE), a novel interdisciplinary framework that advances Spatial Advocacy as a proactive, place-based approach to influencing behaviour through the intentional design, activation, and stewardship of positive social environments.

Drawing upon established theories in environmental criminology, Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED), routine activity theory, third place theory, environmental psychology, public health, and community development, Third Space Engineering™ synthesizes these perspectives into a unified conceptual framework while introducing original principles, terminology, and implementation models. The framework proposes that strategically engineered "third spaces" can strengthen informal social control, encourage legitimate community activity, promote social cohesion, stimulate local economic participation, and reduce opportunities for crime and other harmful behaviours by creating environments that naturally support positive human interaction.

The paper further presents the Dreams initiative as an illustrative case study that informed the development of the framework, demonstrating how the adaptive transformation of an underutilized space into a multifunctional community hub contributed to recreation, entrepreneurship, community engagement, and environmental stewardship. While the observations presented are exploratory and require further empirical validation across diverse contexts, they provide a practical foundation for the theoretical propositions advanced in this work.

As the inaugural publication of the Third Space Engineering™ framework, this white paper establishes its conceptual architecture, guiding principles, and potential applications across crime prevention, community safety, urban regeneration, public health, youth engagement, hospitality, and sustainable social development. It is intended to stimulate scholarly inquiry, interdisciplinary collaboration, and evidence-informed policy by positioning positive environments not merely as settings for human activity but as strategic instruments for achieving safer, healthier, and more resilient communities.

Keywords: Third Space Engineering™; Spatial Advocacy; Crime Prevention; Community Safety; Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED); Environmental Criminology; Third Places; Community Development; Place-Based Prevention; Community Resilience; Environmental Psychology; Preventive Policing; Public Health; Social Innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"第三空间工程™"（Third Space Engineering™）这一跨学科框架，倡导"空间倡导"（Spatial Advocacy）作为一种主动的、基于地点的行为干预策略。该框架整合了环境犯罪学、CPTED、日常活动理论、第三场所理论、环境心理学、公共卫生和社区发展等理论，主张通过战略性设计、激活和管理"第三空间"来加强非正式社会控制、促进社会凝聚力、减少犯罪机会。文章以"梦想"（Dreams）倡议作为案例研究，展示了将未充分利用的空间转变为多功能社区枢纽的实践，并作为该框架的开创性白皮书建立了其概念架构和应用方向。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合跨学科理论与创新实践，构建一个基于"第三空间"主动设计来预防犯罪、促进社区安全与可持续发展的统一框架（即第三空间工程™）？
AI.motivation: 传统犯罪预防和社区发展方法分别在执法、社会干预、城市规划或公共卫生等独立学科领域内运作，虽取得一定成效，但犯罪、药物滥用、社会碎片化和公共空间利用不足等持续性问题表明需要更整合、更主动的预防策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境犯罪学、犯罪预防环境设计（CPTED）、日常活动理论、第三场所理论、环境心理学、公共卫生理论、社区发展理论
AI.method: 概念性理论构建（白皮书）与探索性案例研究（"梦想"倡议）相结合，通过将既有理论综合为统一框架，并以实践案例说明框架的应用逻辑。
AI.findings: 战略性设计的"第三空间"能够加强非正式社会控制、鼓励合法社区活动、促进社会凝聚力、刺激地方经济参与、减少犯罪和有害行为的机会。"梦想"倡议展示了将未充分利用空间转变为多功能社区中心的可行性，促进了娱乐、创业、社区参与和环境管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将环境犯罪学、CPTED、日常活动理论、第三场所理论与环境心理学、公共卫生和社区发展等理论综合为统一的概念框架；提出原创性原则、术语和实施模型（第三空间工程™和空间倡导概念）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为犯罪预防、社区安全、城市更新、公共卫生、青年参与、酒店业和可持续社会发展等领域提供了基于地点的预防策略应用指南；通过"梦想"倡议案例为实践者提供了可参考的实施模型，推动循证决策和跨学科合作。

title: Human Capital Alpha in Private Equity: Leadership-System Execution Capacity as a Missing Layer in Value Creation Models

detail.title: Human Capital Alpha in Private Equity: Leadership-System Execution Capacity as a Missing Layer in Value Creation Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of PARALIPSE and the creator of the PHCI® framework discussed in this paper. PHCI® is a proprietary Human Capital Intelligence framework developed by PARALIPSE. No external organization, client, investor or third party influenced the analysis, arguments or conclusions presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is conceptual in nature and does not report empirical research involving human participants, patients, personal data or identifiable case studies. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was independently conducted and self-funded by the author through PARALIPSE.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces Human Capital Alpha as a missing analytical layer in Private Equity value creation. While financial, commercial and operational due diligence frameworks have become increasingly sophisticated, the collective human systems responsible for executing value creation plans often remain assessed through interviews, observation and qualitative judgment. The paper argues that leadership alignment, governance quality, decision-making dynamics, collective execution capacity and organizational adaptability are material drivers of enterprise performance and should be treated as measurable components of transaction risk, post-deal execution and value creation. Building on Human Due Diligence and Human Capital Intelligence, the paper proposes a framework for integrating structured human-dynamics indicators into investment, governance and portfolio value-creation processes. The objective is not to replace expert judgment, but to support it by making execution risk more visible, comparable and actionable before it materializes financially.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人力资本Alpha"作为私募股权价值创造中缺失的分析层，主张将领导力一致性、治理质量、决策动态、集体执行能力和组织适应性等人类系统动态作为可量化的指标，整合进投资、治理和投资组合价值创造流程中，以补充而非替代专家判断。
AI.research_question: 如何将人力资本动态作为可度量的分析层系统性地整合到私募股权价值创造过程中，以提升交易风险识别与投后执行的可视性、可比性和可操作性？
AI.motivation: 财务、商业和运营尽职调查框架已日趋成熟，但负责执行价值创造计划的集体人力系统仍主要依赖访谈、观察和定性判断进行评估，缺乏系统化的量化分析框架，导致执行风险在财务实现前难以被充分识别和管控。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本Alpha概念、人力尽职调查（Human Due Diligence）、人力资本情报（Human Capital Intelligence）
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，基于人力尽职调查与人力资本情报理论基础，提出将结构化人力动态指标整合到投资、治理及投资组合价值创造流程中的分析框架。
AI.findings: 领导力一致性、治理质量、决策动态、集体执行能力和组织适应性是企业绩效的重要驱动因素，应被视为交易风险、投后执行和价值创造的可用衡量组成部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"人力资本Alpha"这一新的分析层概念，弥合了传统尽职调查框架与人力系统评估之间的分析缺口，将人力动态从定性判断提升为可测量的结构化指标体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为私募股权机构提供了将结构化人力动态指标融入投资决策、治理监督与投后价值创造流程的实践框架，使执行风险在财务实现前更可视化、可比化且可操作化。

title: Neither Displacement nor Replacement: Re-evaluating the Relationship Between Development Assistance for Health and Government Health Expenditures

detail.title: Neither Displacement nor Replacement: Re-evaluating the Relationship Between Development Assistance for Health and Government Health Expenditures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: The master's degree associated with the original version of this work was made possible by the generous financial support of the Stichting Fulbright Commission in the Netherlands. The Fulbright Commission had no role in the conceptualization, analysis, interpretation, or reporting of this work.

detail.abstract:
In 2025, development assistance for health (DAH) to low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) fell by roughly one-fifth in a single year, the steepest contraction in over a decade, as the United States and other major donors abruptly withdrew funding. The forward-looking rationale offered for these cuts holds that recipient governments can and will mobilize domestic resources to fill the gap in funding. However, previous academic literature examining the relationship between DAH and domestically-sourced government health expenditures (GHE-S) lends little support to this perspective, with multiple studies from the “Golden Age” of global health financing (1995-2010) showing that increases in DAH displace GHE-S, but no work finding that decreases in DAH are replaced by GHE-S.


Drawing on a panel of 71 aid-dependent LMICs from 2010 to 2023, I estimate the effect of DAH on GHE-S using two-step system generalized method of moments estimation, decomposing aid by delivery channel (governmental, non-governmental, and unallocable) and by the year-to-year direction of change. I find that DAH neither displaces GHE-S when it rises nor is replaced by GHE-S when it falls, regardless of the channel through which aid is delivered. Although the confidence intervals behind my estimates are wide, even the upper bound of replacement falls far short of what would be required to offset the 2025 contraction in aid. These findings challenge the notion that DAH is fungible in the contemporary era and suggest that the roughly US$10 billion withdrawn from these countries is unlikely to be absorbed domestically, lending empirical support to projections of severe consequences for population health.

AI.tldr: 基于2010-2023年71个依赖援助的中低收入国家面板数据，使用两步系统GMM估计发现：发展援助（DAH）无论增减、无论通过何种渠道（政府、非政府或不可分配），都不会挤出或替代国内政府卫生支出（GHE-S）。即使考虑置信区间上限，国内替代也无法弥补2025年约100亿美元援助削减造成的缺口，挑战了当代DAH可替代性的观点。
AI.research_question: 发展援助（DAH）的增减是否会影响中低收入国家的国内政府卫生支出（GHE-S）？特别是当援助下降时，国内资源能否填补资金缺口？
AI.motivation: 2025年全球健康援助大幅缩减约五分之一，主要捐助国突然撤资，其理由是受援国政府可以调动国内资源来填补资金缺口。然而关于DAH与GHE-S关系的既有文献并不支持这一观点，且缺乏2010年以后的当代证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 援助可替代性（aid fungibility）理论；公共财政支出理论
AI.method: 使用2010-2023年71个依赖援助的中低收入国家面板数据，采用两步系统广义矩估计（two-step system GMM），将援助按交付渠道（政府、非政府、不可分配）和年度变化方向（增加/减少）进行分解。
AI.findings: DAH增加时不会挤出GHE-S，DAH减少时也不会被GHE-S替代，且这种关系不受援助交付渠道影响。尽管置信区间较宽，但即使替代效应的上限也远不足以抵消2025年援助收缩带来的缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了当代背景下DAH具有可替代性（fungibility）的传统观点；扩展了援助-卫生支出关系的研究至2010年后的当代时期，填补了"黄金时代"（1995-2010）之后的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为2025年约100亿美元援助削减将导致严重后果的预测提供了实证支持；对政策制定者和捐助方具有直接的警示意义，表明依赖国内资源替代国际援助的假设缺乏现实依据。

title: Spiritual Intelligence as a Dynamic Capability: A Biblical Framework for Organizational Transformation
affiliations: African Research Network (ARN)

detail.title: Spiritual Intelligence as a Dynamic Capability: A Biblical Framework for Organizational Transformation
detail.abstract: Research on spiritual intelligence has primarily examined its psychological characteristics and leadership implications while paying comparatively little attention to its role as an organizational capability. This article argues that spiritual intelligence should be understood as a dynamic capability enabling individuals and organizations to perceive emerging challenges, integrate ethical judgment with strategic foresight, mobilize collective learning, and sustain adaptation under conditions of uncertainty. Drawing upon the dynamic capabilities framework and biblical organizational narratives, the article develops a Biblical Dynamic Capability Framework centered on three archetypes: Joseph, Bezalel, and Daniel. Rather than treating these figures as moral exemplars alone, the framework interprets them as organizational models of strategic foresight, innovation capability, and institutional integrity. Integrating contemporary management theory with organizational resilience, adaptive leadership, and strategic management, the article proposes that spiritual intelligence functions as an organizational capability through discernment, anticipatory cognition, ethical reasoning, and collective purpose. The framework contributes to leadership theory by extending dynamic capability research beyond technological and economic adaptation toward ethical and societal transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文主张应将灵性智能（Spiritual Intelligence）理解为一种动态能力，而非仅仅是个体心理特质。文章基于动态能力框架和圣经组织叙事，提出了以约瑟、比撒列和但以理为原型的"圣经动态能力框架"，将灵性智能作为组织层面的战略预见、创新能力和制度诚信能力来理解。
AI.research_question: 灵性智能如何作为一种组织能力（而非仅个体心理特征）发挥作用，并推动组织在不断变化的环境中实现战略适应与道德转型？
AI.motivation: 现有灵性智能研究主要聚焦于其心理特征和领导力意涵，较少关注其作为组织能力的角色。作者希望弥补这一理论缺口，将灵性智能纳入组织能力分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力框架（Dynamic Capabilities Framework）、圣经组织叙事、组织韧性理论、适应性领导理论、战略管理理论。
AI.method: 理论建构型论文，结合动态能力框架与圣经组织叙事（约瑟、比撒列、但以理三个原型），进行概念性框架开发与整合分析。
AI.findings: 提出了"圣经动态能力框架"，通过约瑟（战略预见）、比撒列（创新能力）、但以理（制度诚信）三个原型，论证灵性智能通过辨识力、预期认知、伦理推理和集体目的感四大机制作为组织能力发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将动态能力研究从技术和经济适应拓展至伦理与社会转型领域；为灵性智能研究提供组织层次的动态能力视角；通过宗教叙事丰富了组织领导力理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在不确定性环境下发展战略预见、创新与制度诚信提供了基于灵性智能的能力培育路径，有助于管理者将灵性维度整合进组织战略与文化建设。

title: Nuclear Shell Regime Audit: The Magic-Number Shift Theorem and the Discovery of the N=14 Statistical Rupture --The η Hierarchy Structure, Bai-Perron Optimal 10 Breakpoints from Zero-Preset Exhaustive Search, and Six Quantitative Theorems

detail.title: Nuclear Shell Regime Audit: The Magic-Number Shift Theorem and the Discovery of the N=14 Statistical Rupture --The η Hierarchy Structure, Bai-Perron Optimal 10 Breakpoints from Zero-Preset Exhaustive Search, and Six Quantitative Theorems
detail.abstract: The central axiom of the nuclear shell model—that nucleons move independently in a static mean field—has never been systematically questioned. This paper deploys the Factor Hierarchy Law to nuclear physics for the first time, performing a zero-preset regime audit on the full AME2020 nuclide dataset—the algorithm does not know of the existence of "magic numbers" or "shells." Exhaustively testing 18 candidate execution factors, the optimal combination under the VIF < 5 constraint is mass_excess_keV + beta_decay_keV + N_over_Z (adjusted R² = 0.8052), with Bayesian model averaging confirming its statistical irreplaceability with a weight of 1.0000. The core findings unfold in four tiers. Tier 1: the η hierarchy—the ratio of interaction effect to direct effect for continuous N/Z exceeds 10⁶ (η > 10⁶), that for the binary magic-number marker is η = 19.19, and that for the continuous shell-correction energy is η ≈ 0. This three-tier η hierarchy points to a single conclusion: under continuous-variable proxies, N and Z behave as regime factors (function realized through interaction effects), the shell correction is an execution factor (directly explaining binding energy), and independent particle motion exists but is not the rule-maker. Tier 2: Triple cross-validation and supplementary evidence for the N=14 statistical rupture—all three inv-family activation operators lock onto N=14 (F = 415–572), the threshold interaction model locks onto N=25 as the optimal threshold, the PICO intervention effect attains its maximal intercept jump at N=14 (−245.98 keV, p < 0.001), and all eight breakpoints of the kernel change-point cosine kernel concentrate at N < 15. The existence of a statistically significant structural rupture at N=14 is a statistical fact confirmed by three independent tools. Tier 3: The full-N-axis Bai-Perron sequential blind test locks onto an optimal 10 regime-switch breakpoints with overwhelming statistical evidence (BIC = 13793.7). The individual ΔBIC values of all five traditional magic numbers conform to the Statistical Distinction Theorem of Shell-Closure Physical Mechanisms—N=28 is of deformation-transition type (ΔBIC = 415.9), and N=20 is of single-particle-gap type (ΔBIC = −514.4). Magic numbers are not optimal partition points in the statistical sense—the Magic-Number Shift Theorem, the Statistical Distinction Theorem, and the Magic-Number Node Theorem jointly establish the repositioning of traditional magic numbers within the statistical structure. Tier 4: Three lines of negative control exclude statistical artifacts (permutation test p = 0.002, fake-data R² = 0.0007, WLS residual Chow F = 482.55). This paper refines six quantitative theorems, establishes the statistical existence of regime-switch signals in the nuclear shell, and constitutes the necessary premise for the subsequent argument that "independent particle motion is not the fundamental organizing principle of the nuclear shell."

AI.tldr: 本文首次将因子层级定律（Factor Hierarchy Law）应用于核物理领域，对完整的AME2020核素数据集进行零预设体制审计（算法不知道"幻数"或"壳层"的存在），通过18个候选执行因子的穷举测试和贝叶斯模型平均，发现质量盈余、β衰变能和N/Z比是最优组合（调整R²=0.8052）。研究揭示了η层级结构（连续N/Z的交互效应/直接效应比超过10⁶，幻数标记为19.19，壳修正能约为0），确认了N=14处存在统计意义上的结构断裂，并发现传统幻数并非统计最优的分割点。通过三重交叉验证和三条阴性对照线排除了统计伪影，最终得出独立粒子运动不是核壳层基本组织原则的结论。
AI.research_question: 核壳层模型的中心公理——核子在静态平均场中独立运动——是否经得起系统性统计检验？传统"幻数"和"壳层"概念在无预设的统计框架下是否仍然成立？
AI.motivation: 核壳层模型的"独立粒子运动"公理从未被系统性地质疑过。本文旨在通过无预设的数据驱动方法，检验核壳层结构是否由独立粒子运动主导，还是存在更基本的体制切换（regime-switch）组织原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因子层级定律（Factor Hierarchy Law）、贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）、方差膨胀因子（VIF）约束、Bai-Perron顺序断裂检验、PICO干预效应检验、置换检验等统计理论与方法。
AI.method: 对AME2020全核素数据集进行零预设体制审计。具体包括：穷举18个候选执行因子，在VIF<5约束下寻找最优组合；使用贝叶斯模型平均验证统计不可替代性；运用三重交叉验证（inv家族激活算子、阈值交互模型、PICO干预效应）确认N=14结构断裂；进行全N轴的Bai-Perron顺序盲测识别体制切换断点；通过置换检验、假数据检验和WLS残差Chow检验排除统计伪影。
AI.findings: （1）最优因子组合为mass_excess_keV + beta_decay_keV + N_over_Z，调整R²=0.8052，BMA权重为1.0000；（2）η层级三阶层：连续N/Z的η>10⁶（体制因子），幻数标记η=19.19，壳修正能η≈0（执行因子）；（3）N=14处确认存在统计显著的结构断裂（F=415-572，PICO跳跃−245.98 keV）；（4）Bai-Perron识别出10个体制切换断点（BIC=13793.7），传统幻数并非统计最优分割点；（5）三条阴性对照（置换检验p=0.002、假数据R²=0.0007、Chow F=482.55）排除统计伪影。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提出了六个定量定理（Magic-Number Shift Theorem、Statistical Distinction Theorem、Magic-Number Node Theorem等），重新定位了传统幻数在统计结构中的位置，首次建立了核壳层中体制切换信号的统计存在性，为"独立粒子运动不是核壳层基本组织原则"的论证提供了必要前提。
AI.practical_contributions: 为核物理研究提供了一种全新的数据驱动分析框架——零预设体制审计方法，可用于核素性质的系统性统计检验；对核结构理论模型的验证和改进具有方法论参考价值。

title: Re-Engineering Municipal Supply Chain Governance: An Empirical Framework for Service Delivery Resilience in Limpopo Province
affiliations: University of Limpopo

detail.title: Re-Engineering Municipal Supply Chain Governance: An Empirical Framework for Service Delivery Resilience in Limpopo Province

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Background & Purpose: Municipalities across developing economies face a persistent operational dilemma: balancing strict statutory procurement compliance with rapid, highquality service delivery. In South Africa, local government institutions operate under rigid financial control frameworks primarily governed by Section 217 of the Constitution (RSA, 1996), the Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA Act 56 of 2003), and Preferential Procurement Policy Frameworks. Despite these statutory controls, systemic supply chain failures, contract defaults, and capital under-expenditure continue to hinder local infrastructure delivery (Auditor-General South Africa [AGSA], 2024). This paper presents an empirical framework designed to re-engineer municipal supply chain management (SCM) into a resilient vehicle for public value creation across local and district municipalities in Limpopo Province.
Methodology: Utilizing a Pragmatic Explanatory Sequential Mixed-Methods Design (𝑄𝑈𝐴𝑁 → 𝑞𝑢𝑎𝑙) (Creswell & Creswell, 2018), quantitative data were gathered from municipal accounting officers, Chief Financial Officers, and SCM practitioners (𝑁 = 312) across Limpopo’s five district municipalities (Capricorn, Mopani, Sekhukhune, Vhembe, and Waterberg). Hypothesized structural relationships were tested using Covariance-Based Structural Equation Modeling (CB-SEM) (Kline, 2023). Follow-up qualitative semi-structured interviews (𝑛 = 24) with provincial treasury officials, Auditor-General representatives, and municipal oversight chairs provided contextual explanation for the quantitative outcomes. 
Findings: Quantitative path analysis demonstrates that direct statutory compliance alone exerts a non-significant effect on service delivery lead times (𝛽 = 0.080, 𝑝 = .239). However, when mediated through E-Procurement Integration and Contractor Vetting Rigor, the indirect path toward service delivery resilience becomes highly significant (𝛽 = 0.540, 𝑝 < .001). Qualitative insights further reveal that political-administrative friction during bid adjudication and delays in contract variation approvals serve as the primary structural bottlenecks (Fourie & Malan, 2020).
Contribution: The study synthesizes these findings into the Public Supply Chain Resilience Model (PSCRM), offering public sector decision-makers a risk-adjusted operational framework to optimize procurement speed without compromising statutory accountability.

AI.tldr: 本研究以南非林波波省五个区级市政为对象，运用混合方法（CB-SEM + 定性访谈）检验法定采购合规对公共服务交付韧性的影响，发现直接合规效应不显著，但通过电子采购整合与承包商审查严格性的中介路径显著提升服务交付韧性，并整合为公共供应链韧性模型（PSCRM）。
AI.research_question: 市政法定采购合规如何影响服务交付韧性？其作用机制（中介路径）是什么？哪些结构性瓶颈阻碍了采购效率与服务质量之间的平衡？
AI.motivation: 发展中经济体市政机构面临严苛法定采购合规与快速高质量服务交付之间的持久运营困境。南非尽管有宪法第217条、市政财政管理法案等严格财务控制框架，但系统性供应链失败、合同违约和资本支出不足持续阻碍地方基础设施建设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共供应链韧性理论；法定合规理论；中介效应模型（合规→电子采购整合/承包商审查严格性→服务交付韧性）
AI.method: 务实解释性序贯混合方法设计（QUAN→qual）：量化阶段收集312名市政会计主管、首席财务官和供应链管理从业者数据，使用协方差结构方程建模（CB-SEM）检验假设路径；定性阶段对24名省级财政官员、审计长代表和市政监督主席进行半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: 直接法定合规对服务交付前置时间无显著影响（β=0.080, p=.239）；但通过电子采购整合和承包商审查严格性中介后，间接路径高度显著（β=0.540, p<.001）。定性分析发现投标裁定阶段的政治-行政摩擦和合同变更审批延迟是主要结构性瓶颈。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出公共供应链韧性模型（PSCRM），将法定合规从"直接驱动因素"重新定位为"通过中介机制发挥作用的使能条件"，丰富了公共部门供应链管理的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共部门决策者提供风险调整的运营框架，在保持法定问责的同时优化采购速度；识别出投标裁定和合同变更审批两大结构性瓶颈，为市政供应链管理改革提供可操作的改进方向。

title: Building a Deeply AI over a Substrate You Cannot Retrain: The Clara Nexus Reference Implementation of Layered Intelligence Theory
affiliations: Astrala Advisory Services Ltd

detail.title: Building a Deeply AI over a Substrate You Cannot Retrain: The Clara Nexus Reference Implementation of Layered Intelligence Theory
detail.abstract: Layered Intelligence Theory (LIT) specifies eight design principles for what its author terms a Deeply AI-a cognitive architecture whose parameters and surrounding structure jointly instantiate the preconditions for reorganisation, reflection, and falsifiable learning. The specification is silent on how a builder without write access to the substrate's parameters might proceed. This paper reports a working reference implementation, Clara Nexus, that instantiates LIT's design principles over a hosted frontier large language model. The eight principles are sorted, as this paper's analytic contribution, into two families: those describing what the model's parameters must do (structurally unreachable from a hosted substrate), and those describing what the architecture surrounding the model must do (implementable at the scaffold layer). Each principle receives a specificationconformance report identifying present, partial, or absent scaffold-side realisation with a specific runtime carrier-a typed identifier or database table-for every non-absent claim. The paper's core engineering contribution is a constitutional runtime: seven failclosed assertions checked at prompt-composition time, before any call reaches the substrate, encoded as a single assertConstitutional invariant with test-file coverage. A worked counterexample distinguishes composition-time assertion from output filtering and from Constitutional AI's critique-and-revise pattern. Perceptual Control Theory primitives are reported honestly as prompt-level Companion voice discipline rather than runtime-enforced mechanism, with the boundary between scaffold-enforceable and prompt-shaped stated explicitly. Three gaps are named without euphemism as v-next items. The contribution offered is an engineering pattern for building cognitive architectures over substrates the architect cannot retrain, with the scaffold-versussubstrate distinction proposed as the honest form such implementations can currently take.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一个名为Clara Nexus的工作参考实现，该实现在托管的前沿大语言模型上实例化了分层智能理论（LIT）的八项设计原则。论文的独到分析贡献在于将八项原则分为两个家族：模型参数必须实现的原则（在托管基底上结构上不可达）和架构外部必须实现的原则（可在脚手架层实现），并为每项原则提供规格符合性报告。核心工程贡献是一个宪法运行时：在提示组合时、调用基底前的七个fail-closed断言，编码为单一的assertConstitutional不变量。
AI.research_question: 如何在无法修改宿主大型语言模型参数的情况下（即无法接触基底参数写入权限），实例化Layered Intelligence Theory（LIT）的八项设计原则，构建一个"深度AI"认知架构？
AI.motivation: LIT规范对于一个无法访问基底参数写入权限的构建者如何操作保持沉默。现实中的前沿LLM通常以托管服务形式提供，构建者无法重训或修改模型参数，因此需要探索在脚手架层实现LIT原则的可行路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: Layered Intelligence Theory（LIT）的八项设计原则；Perceptual Control Theory（感知控制理论）；Constitutional AI（宪法AI）的critique-and-revise模式。
AI.method: 设计并实现一个名为Clara Nexus的工作参考实现：将LIT的八项原则分类为参数侧（基底不可达）与架构侧（脚手架可实现）；为每项原则生成了规格符合性报告，标明present/partial/absent三态；实现了一个宪法运行时，包含七个fail-closed断言，在提示组合时执行（在调用前），编码为单一的assertConstitutional不变量，并有测试文件覆盖；通过一个反例区分组合时断言与输出过滤及Constitutional AI模式。
AI.findings: 八项原则可以被划分为两个家族：参数侧原则在托管基底上不可达，架构侧原则可在脚手架层实现。宪法运行时的七个fail-closed断言可以在提示组合时执行并具有测试覆盖。Perceptual Control Theory原语只能作为提示层面的Companion voice纪律而非运行时强制机制实现。识别出三个未实现缺口作为v-next项目。脚手架与基底的区分是当前认知架构构建的诚实形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将LIT八项设计原则两分为"参数侧"与"架构侧"的分析框架；明确界定了脚手架层可强制执行与提示层面可塑形（prompt-shaped）之间的边界；区分了组合时断言、输出过滤和Constitutional AI批判-修正模式三种不同的安全机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个在不可重训的托管基底上构建认知架构的工程模式（Clara Nexus参考实现）；展示了以单一assertConstitutional不变量编码多个fail-closed断言的宪法运行时设计；提供了将LIT原则映射到具体运行时载体（类型化标识符或数据库表）的符合性报告方法；诚实地命名三个未实现缺口作为后续工作项。

title: Digital Governance and Public Service Delivery in Ethiopia Assessing the Role of Technology in Strengthening Institutional Accountability in Ethiopia (2015-2025)

detail.title: Digital Governance and Public Service Delivery in Ethiopia Assessing the Role of Technology in Strengthening Institutional Accountability in Ethiopia (2015-2025)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known personal, financial, professional, or institutional conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The research was conducted independently as part of the Tech Forward Fellowship at the Africa Center for Digital Transformation, and the views expressed are those of the author alone.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study because it was based exclusively on publicly available secondary sources, including academic literature, policy documents, and government reports. The research did not involve human participants, personal data, or identifiable information. All sources used in the study were appropriately cited.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted as part of the Tech Forward Fellowship at the Africa Center for Digital Transformation (ACDT). The fellowship provided an academic and professional learning environment to support the completion of this research. No direct financial funding or research grant was received for this study.

detail.abstract:
Digital governance has become a central pillar of public sector reform, offering opportunities to improve transparency, efficiency, and accountability through the adoption of digital technologies. This study examines the extent to which digital governance initiatives have strengthened public service delivery and institutional accountability in Ethiopia between 2015 and 2025. Using a qualitative desk review methodology, the research analyzes secondary data from government policy documents, international organization reports, and peer-reviewed academic literature. The study is guided by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) Good Governance Framework and the World Bank's Digital Government Readiness Assessment (DGRA) model.

The findings indicate that digital initiatives—including the Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS), the Fayda National Digital ID, electronic government procurement (e-GP), and other e-government platforms—have improved operational efficiency, transparency, and access to selected public services. However, their contribution to deeper institutional accountability remains constrained by challenges such as limited digital infrastructure, interoperability gaps, low digital literacy, cybersecurity concerns, uneven implementation, and weak institutional enforcement. The study concludes that while technology can enhance governance outcomes, it cannot substitute for broader institutional reforms, effective leadership, and inclusive policy implementation. The paper recommends strengthening digital infrastructure, institutional capacity, interoperability, data protection, and citizen participation to maximize the governance benefits of digital transformation in Ethiopia.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定性文献综述方法，分析了2015-2025年间埃塞俄比亚数字治理举措对公共服务提供和制度问责的影响，发现数字倡议改善了运营效率和透明度，但深层次的制度问责仍受限于基础设施、数字素养、网络安全等挑战，技术不能替代制度改革的结论。
AI.research_question: 数字治理举措在多大程度上加强了埃塞俄比亚（2015-2025年）的公共服务提供和制度问责？
AI.motivation: 数字治理已成为公共部门改革的核心支柱，但需要实证检验其在发展中国家（特别是埃塞俄比亚）的实际效果，尤其是在制度问责方面的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联合国开发计划署（UNDP）良好治理框架；世界银行数字政府就绪度评估（DGRA）模型
AI.method: 定性文献综述（Qualitative desk review），分析政府政策文件、国际组织报告和同行评审学术文献等二手数据。
AI.findings: 数字倡议（IFMIS、Fayda国家数字ID、电子政府采购e-GP等）改善了运营效率、透明度和部分公共服务的获取；但深层制度问责仍受限于数字基础设施不足、互操作性差距、数字素养低、网络安全问题、实施不均衡和制度执法薄弱等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了UNDP良好治理框架和世界银行DGRA模型在发展中国家数字治理情境中的适用性，揭示了技术手段与制度问责之间的非充分性关系，即技术不能替代制度改革的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃塞俄比亚及类似发展中国家提供政策建议：加强数字基础设施、机构能力、互操作性、数据保护和公民参与，以最大化数字转型的治理收益。
