detail.title: Embedded Injection Engineering of SCR Devices for Enhanced ESD Robustness in High-Voltage BCD Process
detail.abstract: To address strict Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) protection requirements of high-voltage integrated circuits, the effects of Anode and Cathode embedded injection regions on the reliability of Silicon Controlled Rectifier (SCR) devices are systematically investigated in a 0.18 μm Bipolar-CMOS-DMOS (BCD) process using two-dimensional TCAD simulations and transmission line pulse (TLP) measurements. The embedding location is the dominant factor governing the failure current (It2): Anode embedding aggravates current crowding and degrades It2, whereas Cathode embedding introduces additional shunt branches that homogenize current distribution and substantially enhance It2. Dual-side embedding delivers the highest robustness, achieving an It2 per unit area of 1.403 mA·μm-²—approximately 48% higher than the reference SCR—without degrading the transient turn-on response measured by VFTLP. The parasitic capacitance varies predictably with the embedding scheme, providing a clear reference for embedded SCR selection in area-constrained on-chip ESD protection networks.

AI.tldr: 本文在0.18 μm BCD工艺中，通过二维TCAD仿真和TLP测试，系统研究了SCR器件中阳极和阴极嵌入注入区对ESD防护可靠性的影响。研究发现嵌入位置是决定失效电流（It2）的关键因素：阳极嵌入加剧电流拥挤并降低It2，而阴极嵌入引入附加分流支路使电流分布均匀化并显著提升It2。双侧嵌入实现最高鲁棒性，单位面积It2达1.403 mA·μm⁻²，较参考SCR提升约48%，且不牺牲瞬态开启响应。
AI.research_question: 在高压集成电路严格的ESD防护要求下，SCR器件中阳极和阴极嵌入注入区的嵌入位置如何影响器件可靠性（特别是失效电流It2）？
AI.motivation: 高压集成电路对ESD防护提出了严格的要求，SCR器件是常用的片上ESD防护器件，但需要系统性地理解嵌入注入区的位置对SCR器件可靠性的影响机制，以指导其在面积受限的ESD防护网络中的选择与应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: SCR器件ESD防护理论、电流拥挤效应、电流均匀分布理论、寄生电容模型
AI.method: 采用0.18 μm BCD工艺，结合二维TCAD仿真和传输线脉冲（TLP）测试方法，系统比较不同嵌入方案（阳极嵌入、阴极嵌入、双侧嵌入）下SCR器件的ESD可靠性表现。
AI.findings: 1) 嵌入位置是控制It2的主导因素；2) 阳极嵌入加剧电流拥挤、恶化It2；3) 阴极嵌入通过附加分流支路均匀化电流分布、显著增强It2；4) 双侧嵌入实现最高鲁棒性，单位面积It2达1.403 mA·μm⁻²，较参考SCR提升约48%；5) 寄生电容随嵌入方案可预测变化，为面积受限场景下的SCR选择提供参考；6) 瞬态开启响应（VFTLP测量）未受退化影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统地揭示了SCR器件中嵌入注入区位置（阳极侧vs阴极侧）对ESD可靠性影响的内在物理机制，明确了电流拥挤与电流均匀化的失效机理差异，为嵌入式SCR器件的可靠性设计提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了不同嵌入方案下SCR器件It2、瞬态响应和寄生电容的量化对比数据，为面积受限的高压IC片上ESD防护网络中选择合适的嵌入SCR结构提供了明确的工程参考。

title: Analysing India’s Structural Position in Global Value Chains

detail.title: Analysing India’s Structural Position in Global Value Chains
detail.abstract: This article analyzes India's integration into Global Value Chains (GVCs) under the "China Plus One" strategy. Despite robust service exports, India's manufacturing sector remains heavily reliant on final-stage assembly rather than deep component localization. Identifying tariff insulation, low R&D, and customs rigidities as structural barriers, this paper argues that to achieve strategic autonomy, India must pivot from general output incentives to targeted tariff rationalization on essential sub-components.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度在"中国+1"战略下融入全球价值链（GVCs）的情况。尽管服务业出口强劲，印度制造业仍高度依赖最终阶段组装，而非深度零部件本地化。文章识别出关税隔离、低研发投入和海关僵化等结构性障碍，认为印度要实现战略自主，必须从一般性产出激励转向对关键子部件进行有针对性的关税合理化改革。
AI.research_question: 印度在"中国+1"战略背景下如何更好地融入全球价值链？其制造业深度参与GVCs的结构性障碍是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管印度服务业出口表现强劲，但其制造业在全球价值链中的参与度仍然有限，主要停留在最终阶段组装层面，缺乏深度零部件本地化。在"中国+1"战略为印度提供制造业承接契机的背景下，亟需识别制约印度制造业深度融入GVCs的结构性障碍并提出战略调整方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链（GVCs）理论与战略自主理论
AI.method: 基于贸易数据分析与政策评估的定性分析方法，识别印度制造业融入GVCs的现状、障碍与政策路径。
AI.findings: 印度制造业仍高度依赖最终阶段组装，而非深度零部件本地化；关税隔离、低R&D投入和海关僵化是制约印度制造业深度融入全球价值链的结构性障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 将战略自主理论引入全球价值链分析框架，论证了"中国+1"战略下印度制造业升级的战略路径应从一般性产出激励转向关键子部件的关税合理化，丰富了发展中国家制造业升级与GVC参与的相关理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政策制定者提供了具体的政策建议，即通过有针对性的关税合理化改革来促进关键子部件的本地化生产，从而在"中国+1"战略中实现制造业的深度升级和战略自主。

title: The Geometry of Climate Disclosure Networks and Future Idiosyncratic Volatility

detail.title: The Geometry of Climate Disclosure Networks and Future Idiosyncratic Volatility
detail.abstract: This study examines whether the geometric organization of corporate climate disclosures contains information about future firm-specific risk beyond conventional textual characteristics. Using climate-related sections of Form 10-K filings for S&P 500 firms from 2005 to 2023, we construct annual semantic disclosure networks based on transformer-generated document embeddings. Firms are connected through a mutual k-nearest-neighbor network, and Ollivier-Ricci curvature is used to characterize each firm's local geometric position within the disclosure network. We examine whether this geometric measure predicts one-year-ahead idiosyncratic volatility. The results show that Ricci curvature is positively associated with future idiosyncratic volatility primarily through persistent cross-sectional differences across firms rather than within-firm variation over time. The predictive effect is concentrated in the upper tail of the volatility distribution and remains robust to industry-adjusted specifications. Our findings demonstrate that the geometry of semantic disclosure networks captures economically meaningful information beyond conventional document-level textual measures, providing a new framework for analyzing corporate climate disclosures in financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2005至2023年S&P 500公司的10-K文件气候披露章节，构建基于Transformer文档嵌入的语义披露网络，通过互k近邻网络连接公司，并使用Ollivier-Ricci曲率刻画公司在披露网络中的局部几何位置，发现该几何度量能正向预测未来一年期的特质波动率，且预测效应主要通过公司间横截面差异而非公司内时间变化驱动，集中体现在波动率分布的右尾部分。
AI.research_question: 企业气候披露的几何组织结构是否包含超越传统文本特征的公司特定未来风险信息？
AI.motivation: 传统文本分析主要依赖词频、主题等文档层面特征，忽略了公司间语义披露关系的结构信息，本研究探索利用网络几何方法捕捉气候披露中更丰富的风险信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语义披露网络理论、Ollivier-Ricci曲率几何分析、特质波动率预测理论
AI.method: 使用Transformer生成的文档嵌入构建公司间语义披露网络，采用互k近邻连接机制，运用Ollivier-Ricci曲率度量公司局部几何位置，通过回归分析检验曲率与未来特质波动率的关系。
AI.findings: Ricci曲率与未来特质波动率正相关，该效应主要通过公司间横截面差异驱动而非公司内时间变化；预测效应集中在波动率分布上尾，且对行业调整设定保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将语义披露网络的几何性质（Ollivier-Ricci曲率）引入公司金融文本分析，建立了气候披露几何结构与公司风险之间的理论联系，扩展了文本信息与资本市场关系的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和分析师提供了一种超越传统文本指标的公司风险评估新工具，可用于预测公司特质风险特别是高风险尾部情形，对气候风险管理和投资决策具有实践意义。

title:
Humanlight Ai and Human-Led AI.
Imaginative Expansion, Human Orchestration And Accountable Direction In Generative Processes
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
Humanlight Ai and Human-Led AI.
Imaginative Expansion, Human Orchestration And Accountable Direction In Generative Processes
detail.abstract:
Humanlight AI names the moment in which generative systems illuminate, externalise and enlarge a human imaginative field; HLAi (Human-Led AI) names the governance condition in which the human actor retains direction, judgement, the final Decision Gate and accountability. Between them stands human orchestration: the authorial work of asking, comparing, rejecting, redirecting, joining and closing. The argument is explored through the ongoing short-film project Il non ritorno di Ulisse, whose form emerged not from a single prompt but from a sequence of questions: What kind of city can seduce rather than merely imprison? What does Ithaca become when return is no longer promised? en does a synthetic voice diminish rather than extend a scene? Which tools enlarge imagination, and which begin to dictate it? These questions generated visual, sonic and narrative alternatives, but also refusals, reversals and changes of course. The paper therefore treats the genealogy of the film as evidence of an experimentally orchestrated practice rather than as proof of a completed or validated system. It also proposes a preliminary software architecture in which Humanlight expands the field of possibility, Blacklight makes trajectories and risks visible, and HLAi formalises human authorisation. The central claim is not that AI becomes an author, but that human authorship can become more capable when it learns to orchestrate computational abundance without transferring the authority to give form, meaning and closure.

The paper advances a conceptual and practice-based framework rather than an empirically validated causal model. Its central hypothesis is that generative AI operates within a probabilistic field of forms, while human creativity moves across conscious intention, latent imagination and selective recognition, transforming probability into authorial necessity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Humanlight AI"与"HLAi（人类主导AI）"两个核心概念，主张在生成式AI系统中，人类通过"编排"（orchestration）行为——提问、比较、拒绝、重定向、联结和闭合——保留方向、判断、最终决策权和问责制。论文以短片项目《Il non ritorno di Ulisse》的创作谱系为实践证据，展示了一种实验性编排实践，并提出包含Humanlight（扩展可能性场域）、Blacklight（使轨迹和风险可见）和HLAi（形式化人类授权）的初步软件架构。核心主张是：AI并非成为作者，而是人类作者通过学会编排计算丰裕性而变得更有能力。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI介入创意产出的过程中，人类作者如何通过"编排"行为保留作者权？具体而言：生成系统如何照亮、外化并扩展人类想象场域？人类应如何在何种治理条件下保持方向、判断、最终决策权和问责制？
AI.motivation: 现有讨论往往将生成式AI视为替代性作者或简单工具，忽视了人机协作中"编排"这一关键中间环节。作者希望通过实践案例证明：人类创作能力可以通过编排计算丰裕性而增强，但这种增强不意味着将赋予形式、意义和闭合的权威转移给AI。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文提出了一个概念性框架：1) Humanlight AI——生成系统照亮、外化并扩展人类想象场域的时刻；2) HLAi（Human-Led AI）——人类保有方向、判断、最终决策门和问责制的治理条件；3) 人类编排（human orchestration）——提问、比较、拒绝、重定向、联结和闭合的作者性工作；4) 生成式AI运作于概率性形式场域，人类创造力跨越意识意图、潜在想象和选择性识别的对比框架。
AI.method: 本文采用概念性加实践性框架，而非经验验证的因果模型。方法核心是对持续进行的短片项目《Il non ritorno di Ulisse》的创作谱系（genealogy）进行追踪分析，将影片形式演进视为一系列问题驱动的序列而非单一提示词的结果，涵盖视觉、声音和叙事替代方案的生成、拒绝、逆转和转向过程，以此作为实验性编排实践的证据。
AI.findings: 1) 影片形式并非源于单一提示词，而是来自一系列问题的序贯驱动（如"什么样的城市能诱惑而非囚禁？""当归返不再被承诺时伊萨卡意味着什么？""合成声音何时削弱而非扩展场景？"）；2) 创作过程中产生了替代方案，同时也产生了拒绝、逆转和方向改变；3) 论文提出初步软件架构：Humanlight扩展可能性场域，Blacklight使轨迹和风险可视化，HLAi形式化人类授权。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了"Humanlight AI"和"HLAi"两个原创概念，为生成式AI与人类创造力的关系提供了新的概念化框架；2) 将"编排"（orchestration）确立为介于生成系统与人类治理之间的关键作者性实践；3) 区分了概率性形式场域与人类作者性必然性之间的转化过程，为理解AI辅助创作提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 通过短片项目提供了AI辅助电影创作的实践案例和方法论参考；2) 提出了包含Humanlight、Blacklight和HLAi三层架构的软件设计建议，为AI创意工具的系统设计提供蓝图；3) 为创作者提供了"问题驱动的编排"这一具体工作策略，展示了如何通过提问而非提示词来引导生成过程。

title: Pod Platforms: A Perfect Filter, or a Perfectly Coarse One?

detail.title: Pod Platforms: A Perfect Filter, or a Perfectly Coarse One?
detail.abstract: We model a multi-manager (“pod”) hedge fund platform in continuous time, decomposing each pod’s return into alpha, market beta, and idiosyncratic components, and building the fund as a portfolio of pods whose capital weights evolve as a controlled jump-diffusion under proportional reinvestment. Two headline risks emerge. First, the diversification benefit that markets the pod structure has a hard, regime-dependent floor: fund-level variance does not vanish with the number of pods once residual cross-pod correlation is admitted, and that correlation is plausibly worst exactly in the stress states when diversification is needed most — coupling directly to correlated stop-outs across the population. Second, and separately, we show that the fixed-threshold stop-loss rules used ubiquitously by pod platforms are a statistically coarse filter: survival probability depends on the ratio αi/(σ tot i ) 2 rather than on skill αi alone, and this bias operates on two separate margins — which pods survive, and, via an exact Doob h-transform, how good a surviving pod’s own realized track record looks relative to its true parameter. We show the resulting PM incentive effect is genuinely ambiguous rather than automatically “gambling for resurrection,” derive a formal birth-rate condition required to sustain fund-level alpha under this attrition process, and show that pure stop-loss attrition cannot by itself deliver a stationary pod population. We propose a continuous-time Bayesian filtering framework as the statistically correct alternative to the fixed barrier — the barrier is a good implementation of the wrong test (Wald’s SPRT for a simple hypothesis) applied to the wrong problem (continuous learning of an unknown parameter) — and show the same αi/(σ tot i ) 2 ratio governing survival is also the continuous-time Kelly-optimal sizing fraction, with common practical approximations (staged, intermediate stops) shown to move in the right direction but recover only a bounded fraction of the benefit of full continuous control.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个连续时间下的多经理（"pod"）对冲基金平台模型，将每个pod的收益分解为alpha、市场beta和特质成分，并研究其资本权重在比例再投资下作为受控跳扩散的演化。研究发现两个核心风险：一是pod结构带来的分散化收益存在硬性的、随制度变化的底线——当跨pod残差相关性被承认时，基金层面方差不会随pod数量增加而消失，且该相关性在最需要分散化的压力状态下最严重；二是平台普遍采用的固定阈值止损规则在统计上是粗糙的过滤器——生存概率取决于αi/(σtot_i)²而非技能αi本身，并通过Doob h-变换影响幸存pod的真实表现。论文进一步证明了PM激励效应是真正模糊的而非自动"为复活赌博"，推导了维持基金层面alpha所需的新生率条件，并提出连续时间贝叶斯滤波框架作为固定障碍的统计正确替代方案，且证明了支配生存的同一比率也是连续时间Kelly最优配置比例。
AI.research_question: 在pod结构中，pod平台的固定阈值止损规则和跨pod相关性如何影响基金的分散化收益、PM激励与基金层面alpha的可持续性？
AI.motivation: pod结构的对冲基金平台在业界非常普遍，其营销核心是分散化优势，但业界普遍采用的固定阈值止损规则在统计上是否合理、跨pod相关性在压力状态下的行为如何、以及这些因素如何共同影响基金层面的alpha可持续性，这些问题尚未被系统地建模分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间随机控制理论、受控跳扩散过程、Doob h-变换、Wald序贯概率比检验（SPRT）、Kelly最优增长理论、贝叶斯滤波
AI.method: 建立连续时间多pod平台模型，将pod收益分解为alpha、beta和特质成分，构建资本权重为受控跳扩散的投资组合；通过理论推导分析分散化下限、止损规则统计偏差、生存概率与比率αi/(σtot_i)²的关系；使用Doob h-变换刻画幸存者的选择偏差；推导基金层面alpha可持续的新生率条件；提出连续时间贝叶斯滤波框架作为替代方案并进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 1) 分散化收益存在制度依赖的硬性下限，跨pod残差相关性使方差不随pod数量消失，且在压力状态下相关性最严重；2) 固定阈值止损规则是粗糙的统计过滤器，生存概率取决于αi/(σtot_i)²而非纯粹的技能αi；3) 止损规则产生双重选择偏差——决定哪些pod存活以及幸存pod的表观记录优于真实参数；4) PM激励效应是模糊的，而非简单的"为复活赌博"；5) 纯止损淘汰机制无法自主产生平稳的pod群体，需要明确的新生率条件；6) 连续时间贝叶斯滤波是统计上正确的替代方案；7) 同一比率αi/(σtot_i)²也是Kelly最优配置比例，但常见实用近似只能恢复有限比例的收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次在连续时间框架下系统建模pod平台的分散化下限及其制度依赖性；2) 严格证明了固定阈值止损规则的统计偏差及其双重边际效应；3) 用Doob h-变换精确刻画幸存者偏差；4) 阐明了止损淘汰与平台alpha可持续性之间的正式数学条件；5) 揭示了固定障碍止损本质上是用错误的检验（简单假设的SPRT）应用于错误的问题（未知参数的连续学习），并提出了贝叶斯滤波替代框架；6) 建立了生存比率与Kelly最优配置之间的深层理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为pod平台设计止损规则提供统计上正确的替代方案（贝叶斯滤波框架）；2) 揭示固定阈值止损的激励偏差，帮助平台管理者理解PM行为的真实激励结构；3) 为平台维持基金层面alpha提供新生/淘汰策略设计的定量指导；4) 指出压力状态下分散化失效的风险，提示平台需重新评估风险管理；5) 为实际配置中的分段止损等近似方案提供效率评估，指导更好的实践。

title: Competition with Shared Profits: A Theory of Coopetition
affiliations: University of Ottawa - Department of Economics, Royal Holloway University of London and University of Texas Rio Grande Valley (UTRGV) (Formerly University of Texas-Pan American) - Economics and Finance

detail.title: Competition with Shared Profits: A Theory of Coopetition
detail.abstract: Competition and cooperation often coexist in modern markets, yet economic theory has largely treated them separately. We develop a general theory of coopetition in which firms compete in output while sharing realized industry profits through a contribution-based rule grounded in efficiency, productivity, and marginal responsiveness. Embedding this rule into a differentiated-product Cournot oligopoly yields a pure-strategy equilibrium - the coopetition equilibrium - under minimal assumptions, without standard restrictions on demand or costs. We identify a reciprocal externalities condition under which the coopetition and Cournot equilibria coincide, implying that Cournot competition is robust to contribution-based redistribution of industry profits. Otherwise, firms maximize their contributions to industry revenue, so coopetition may either intensify or soften competition depending on revenue externalities. We further show that reciprocal externalities are equivalent to linear inverse demand in homogeneous-good markets. Finally, when firms' actions exhibit strategic complementarities, the contribution-based allocation belongs to the oligopolistic core - a new solution concept capturing profit allocations that are immune to ex post renegotiation.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一个关于"竞合"（coopetition）的一般理论，企业在产出上进行竞争，同时通过基于效率、生产率和边际响应的贡献规则分享行业利润。将该规则嵌入差异化产品古诺寡头模型后，在最小假设下得到纯策略均衡（竞合均衡）。作者识别出互惠外部性条件，在此条件下竞合均衡与古诺均衡重合；否则企业最大化其对行业收入的贡献，竞合可能加剧或缓和竞争。互惠外部性与同质产品市场的线性逆需求等价。当企业行动具有策略互补性时，贡献分配属于寡头核心（oligopolistic core）——一个能抵御事后重新谈判的新解概念。
AI.research_question: 在竞争与合作共存的市场中，企业如何在产出竞争的同时通过贡献规则分享行业利润？这一竞合均衡的性质及其与标准古诺均衡的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 现实中竞争与合作往往同时存在（如行业利润共享、利润池、专利池等机制），但经济理论长期以来将二者分开处理。缺乏一个统一的理论框架来解释竞合现象及其均衡性质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贡献规则（基于效率、生产率、边际响应的利润分配）、差异化产品古诺寡头模型、互惠外部性条件、策略互补性理论、寡头核心（oligopolistic core）解概念。
AI.method: 理论建模与博弈论分析。将贡献式利润分配规则嵌入差异化产品古诺寡头模型，推导纯策略均衡的存在性与性质，分析互惠外部性条件，并将结果推广到同质产品市场及策略互补性情境。
AI.findings: (1) 在最小假设下存在唯一的纯策略竞合均衡；(2) 存在互惠外部性条件，使竞合均衡与古诺均衡重合，表明古诺竞争对贡献式再分配具有稳健性；(3) 否则竞合可能加剧或缓和竞争，取决于收入外部性方向；(4) 同质产品市场中互惠外部性等价于线性逆需求；(5) 在策略互补性下，贡献分配属于寡头核心，即对事后重新谈判免疫。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次构建了竞争与合作统一的一般理论框架，弥合了竞争理论与合作博弈理论之间的鸿沟；引入了"寡头核心"这一新解概念，连接了非合作博弈与合作博弈的分析工具；识别了古诺竞争对利润再分配保持稳健性的精确条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现实中行业利润共享机制（如利润池、收入委员会、联合研发收益分配等）提供了理论指导；有助于理解竞合安排对市场竞争强度的影响，为反垄断政策和行业组织设计提供参考。

title: Alpha Generation using Option Trading Strategies based on Modeling Options Prices considering Mandelbrotian Movement of Prices
affiliations: , WorldQuant University, WorldQuant University and WorldQuant University

detail.title: Alpha Generation using Option Trading Strategies based on Modeling Options Prices considering Mandelbrotian Movement of Prices

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper was created as part of a WorldQuant University degree program towards an MSc in Financial Engineering. This paper is reproduced with the consent and permission of WorldQuant University. All rights reserved. (This disclaimer is also available in the preprint)

detail.abstract: Multiple asset pricing models (the Multifractal Model of Asset Returns, classical Black-Scholes, Merton, Heston, and Bates models) are used to calculate S&P500 option prices based on historical S&P500 closing price data to identify the best performing model across options with short-term, medium-term, and long-term expiry dates, as well as across types of expiry (In-the-Money, At-the-Money and Out-of-the-Money). Subsequently, the usage of an optimization framework to assign weight coefficients to the price obtained by each model is explored, and its accuracy in predicting options prices relative to the other individual pricing models is evaluated. We then use the proposed option pricing models to develop option trading strategies to demonstrate the generation of alpha in a real financial scenario. We find that our optimization framework-weighted ensemble model not only features among the most accurate option pricing models alongside the Multifractal Model for Asset Returns and classical Black-Scholes models, but also forms the most successful trading strategy in backtesting.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了多种资产定价模型（多重分形资产收益模型、Black-Scholes、Merton、Heston和Bates模型）在S&P500期权定价中的表现，并提出了一个基于优化框架的加权集成模型，该模型不仅定价准确度高，而且在实际交易策略回测中表现最佳。
AI.research_question: 哪种资产定价模型在不同到期期限（短期、中期、长期）和不同实值类型（实值、平值、虚值）的S&P500期权定价中表现最佳？基于优化框架的加权集成模型能否提升定价精度并用于构建盈利的交易策略？
AI.motivation: 现有期权定价模型各有优劣，单一模型难以在所有场景下表现最佳，需要一个系统的比较框架来识别最优模型，并探索集成方法以进一步提升定价精度和实际交易表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多重分形资产收益模型（Multifractal Model of Asset Returns）、Black-Scholes模型、Merton跳跃扩散模型、Heston随机波动率模型和Bates模型（结合跳跃与随机波动率）。
AI.method: 基于历史S&P500收盘价数据，使用五种定价模型计算期权价格，按到期期限和实值类型分类比较表现；随后构建优化框架为各模型分配权重系数形成集成模型，并将所提模型用于期权交易策略开发及回测。
AI.findings: 优化框架加权的集成模型与多重分形资产收益模型和Black-Scholes模型均属于最准确的期权定价模型之列；同时，该集成模型在回测中形成了最成功的交易策略，能够产生alpha。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种基于优化框架的加权集成期权定价方法，将多种经典及前沿定价模型系统地整合，验证了集成方法在期权定价中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期权交易者提供了一个更可靠的定价工具和可盈利的交易策略，在实际金融场景中能够产生alpha（超额收益），具有直接的应用价值。

title: The Ownership Illusion: A Conceptual Framework for Understanding Fragmented Execution Authority in Multi-Stakeholder Infrastructure Projects

detail.title: The Ownership Illusion: A Conceptual Framework for Understanding Fragmented Execution Authority in Multi-Stakeholder Infrastructure Projects
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Ownership Illusion as a conceptual explanation for how fragmented execution authority may contribute to persistent implementation delay in complex multistakeholder infrastructure projects. The paper proposes that as the number of formally aligned institutions in a project grows, each holding legitimate but partial authority, responsibility for resolving specific implementation obstacles becomes structurally diffused, such that no single institution is positioned to resolve them unilaterally. This is proposed as a distinct institutional variable, separate from and complementary to established explanations of project delay. The paper positions this proposition against six adjacent theoretical traditions, institutional economics, principal-agent theory; transaction cost economics, project governance, collaborative governance, and implementation science, and applies it to the East African Crude Oil Pipeline as an illustrative case, following the interpretive method established in the Canon's Methodology. It proposes the Single Accountable Entity (SAE) as one candidate governance design response, states explicit, falsifiable hypotheses for future comparative research, and closes by identifying the evidence still required to move the doctrine from a well-specified proposition to a demonstrated pattern.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"所有权幻觉"（Ownership Illusion）概念，用于解释在多利益相关方基础设施项目中，碎片化的执行权力如何导致持续性的实施延迟。文章认为，随着形式上协调一致的机构数量增加，每个机构都拥有合法但部分的权力，解决具体实施障碍的责任在结构上被分散，导致没有任何单一机构能够单方面解决这些问题。文章将该命题与六个相邻理论传统进行对照，并以东非原油管道项目作为案例说明，提出"单一责任实体"（SAE）作为治理设计应对方案，并给出了可证伪的假设。
AI.research_question: 碎片化的执行权力如何导致复杂的多利益相关方基础设施项目中的持续性实施延迟？"所有权幻觉"能否作为一个独立的制度变量来解释这一现象？
AI.motivation: 复杂的多利益相关方基础设施项目常常面临持续性的实施延迟，而现有理论（如制度经济学、委托-代理理论等）未能充分解释这一现象。作者认为需要一个新的制度变量来补充现有解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: "所有权幻觉"概念，与传统"所有权"概念相对照；与六种理论传统对话：制度经济学、委托-代理理论、交易成本经济学、项目治理、协作治理、实施科学。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性方法：提出概念命题，采用Canon方法论中的解释性方法（interpretive method），以东非原油管道（EACOP）作为说明性案例进行应用。
AI.findings: 提出"所有权幻觉"作为不同于且补充现有项目延迟解释的独立制度变量；提出单一责任实体（SAE）作为治理设计应对方案；给出明确的、可证伪的假设供未来比较研究；指出将该命题从良好定义的命题发展为被证实的模式所需的关键证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"所有权幻觉"这一新的制度变量概念，区别于并补充现有项目延迟解释理论；与六大理论传统建立对话，将碎片化权力结构与实施延迟联系起来，丰富了项目治理和实施科学的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"单一责任实体"（SAE）作为具体的治理设计应对方案，为多利益相关方基础设施项目的治理结构设计提供实践指导；为未来比较研究提供了可证伪的假设和证据指引。

title: The System that Finances its Own Destruction: How Ecological Harm Generates Power and How that Power Blocks Every Correction

detail.title: The System that Finances its Own Destruction: How Ecological Harm Generates Power and How that Power Blocks Every Correction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None declared
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable — the study involves no human participants, personal data or clinical material.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was carried out independently, without external project funding.

detail.abstract: This working paper examines why well-established knowledge of climate and Earth-system risks is not translated into institutional limits commensurate with those risks. It does not deny that political inertia, international coordination problems, social dependencies, technological path dependence and individual denial are independent causes of inadequate action. Its central claim is that one feedback mechanism holds a special status because it amplifies other barriers while obstructing its own correction. This externalisation-power feedback consists of four steps: ecological and social costs are shifted outside private or institutional accounts; the resulting profits and rents increase economic and organisational power; that power is converted into political, legal and communicative influence; and this influence prevents, delays or weakens the internalisation of costs. The initial externalisation can therefore continue. Research on externalities, regulatory capture, carbon lock-in, corporate lobbying, political polarisation and climate-delay discourses substantiates the individual links of the mechanism, and adjacent syntheses (the externalisation society, the imperial mode of living, oligarchic wealth defence, and the existential politics of asset revaluation) describe important parts of the circuit. The contribution of this paper is to integrate these elements into a single, explicitly recursive meta-barrier, to state the criterion on which its special status rests, and to derive testable hypotheses and conditions that would weaken or delimit the thesis. The implication is direct: an effective strategy cannot regulate emissions and individual harms alone. It must also interrupt the conversion of ecologically generated profits into obstruction capacity. The paper does not present a complete institutional design, but identifies the necessary points of intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨为何对气候与地球系统风险的科学认知未能转化为与风险相称的制度性限制，提出一个核心论点：一种特殊的反馈机制——"外部化—权力反馈"——不仅放大其他障碍，还阻碍自身修正，从而成为应对气候危机的元壁垒。
AI.research_question: 为什么关于气候和地球系统风险的既定知识没有被转化为与这些风险相称的制度性限制？具体而言，何种反馈机制在放大其他行动障碍的同时又阻碍自身的纠正？
AI.motivation: 已有的研究分别从政治惰性、国际协调困难、社会依赖性、技术路径依赖和个人否认等角度解释气候行动不足的原因，但缺乏一个整合性框架来解释这些障碍为何持续存在且相互强化。本文旨在揭示一个具有特殊地位的元机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论框架建立在外部性理论、监管俘获理论、碳锁定理论、企业游说研究、政治极化研究和气候拖延话语研究等基础之上，并将其整合为"外部化—权力反馈"这一递归性元壁垒框架。
AI.method: 本文为理论整合型工作论文，通过系统梳理和综合既有关于外部性、监管俘获、碳锁定、企业游说、政治极化及气候拖延话语的实证与理论研究，构建"外部化—权力反馈"的整合框架，并提出可检验的假设及削弱该机制的边界条件。
AI.findings: "外部化—权力反馈"包含四个环节：（1）生态和社会成本被转移到私人或机构账户之外；（2）由此产生的利润和租金增加了经济和组织权力；（3）该权力被转化为政治、法律和传播影响力；（4）这种影响力阻止、延迟或削弱了成本内部化。该机制的循环使初始外部化得以持续。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于：将分散的相关理论（外部化社会、帝国主义生活方式、寡头财富防御、资产重估的存在政治）整合为单一且明确递归的"元壁垒"框架；阐明该机制享有特殊地位的标准；推导出可检验的假设及削弱或限定该论点的条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践启示直接明了：有效的应对策略不能仅局限于监管排放和个体损害，还必须打断"生态产生的利润转化为阻碍能力"这一转换环节。论文虽未提供完整的制度设计，但指出了必要的干预切入点。

title: A Study on the Role of National Education Policy-2020 to Promote Social Cohesion
affiliations: Baha'i Academy, Panchgani, Maharashtra, India, Adarsha Comprehensive College of Education and Research,  and Bahai Academy

detail.title: A Study on the Role of National Education Policy-2020 to Promote Social Cohesion

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Compass - Peer-Reviewed Journal of Education in Universal Human Values, Vol. 13, No. 1, October 2021, pp. 10-30. Bahai Academy, Panchgani, India. ISSN 0973-9483.

detail.abstract: One of the core problems of the new millennium is maintaining and fostering social cohesion in the face of rapid globalization. In India one of the obstacles to social cohesion is a population that is too diverse in terms of ethnicity and socioeconomic status. The problems are even more complicated in our country, which has a multicultural, multilingual, and multistate structure. Education is seen as a vital institution that helps to foster social cohesion by socializing newcomers to society. To promote social cohesion, a complete transformation of the educational system is needed. It necessitates teachers who are sincere, accessible, and secure human beings with primarily positive feelings toward students. The proposed National Educational Policy 2020 envisions a new approach to education. It aims to bring about and incorporate a slew of reforms in India's education system at all stages. It also aims to improve the way facilitators of such education, such as schools, colleges, and teachers, are educated and approach education with a holistic approach. The National Education Policy 2020 is India's first new education policy in the twenty-first century. This research was carried out with a view to study and explore social cohesion from an educational perspective. The study was conducted to analyze how the New Education policy 2020 document can be instrumental in promoting Social Cohesion. The research included structured and unstructured tools (Questionnaires/Interviews). The respondents for this study were the principals, teachers/professors of colleges of higher education from various universities in Maharashtra.

AI.tldr: 本研究旨在从教育视角探讨印度2020年国家教育政策（NEP 2020）如何促进社会凝聚力。通过问卷调查和访谈等结构化与非结构化工具，对马哈拉施特拉邦各大学高等教育机构的校长、教师/教授进行了调研，分析了NEP 2020文件在促进社会凝聚力方面的作用。
AI.research_question: 新教育政策2020文件如何促进社会凝聚力？从教育视角下，NEP 2020在促进印度社会凝聚力方面的作用与潜力是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球化加速背景下，印度面临多元文化、多语言、多邦结构的复杂社会，人口在种族和社会经济地位上高度多元，成为社会凝聚力的障碍。教育被视为社会化新成员、促进社会凝聚力的重要制度，因此需要审视新教育政策如何推动这一目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会凝聚力理论：教育作为社会化的核心制度，通过培养对学生的积极情感、真诚可及且安全的教师，促进社会凝聚力。
AI.method: 采用结构化与非结构化工具（问卷调查/访谈），研究对象为印度马哈拉施特拉邦各大学高等教育机构的校长、教师/教授。
AI.findings: NEP 2020作为印度21世纪首部新教育政策，旨在全方位改革教育体系，包含多层次改革，改善学校、学院和教师的教育方式，以整体性方法促进社会凝聚力。
AI.theory_contributions: 从教育政策分析角度丰富了社会凝聚力理论在多元文化背景下的应用，提供了教育政策如何作为社会凝聚机制的理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度教育政策制定者和教育工作者提供了NEP 2020在促进社会凝聚力方面的实证参考，有助于指导教育系统的全面转型与政策实施。

title:
Closing the $2.8 Trillion Nonprofit Business Loophole: 
A Tax Reform Proposal for Congress
affiliations: Arnold Ventures

detail.title:
Closing the $2.8 Trillion Nonprofit Business Loophole: 
A Tax Reform Proposal for Congress
detail.abstract: The nonprofit sector has grown into a $3.6 trillion economy, with most of its revenue derived from commercial activities that enjoy tax-exempt status. The Unrelated Business Income Tax (UBIT), enacted in 1950 to curb unfair competition and protect the corporate tax base, has proven ineffective as nonprofits generate over $2.8 trillion in business-related revenue. This paper proposes legislation to replace UBIT with a donation-based commerciality test that clearly distinguishes charitable donations from taxable commercial income. By taxing the net business income of nonprofit enterprises-while preserving the exemption for genuine charitable gifts-Congress can restore tax neutrality, protect the integrity of the corporate tax base, and raise up to $51 billion annually to support deficit reduction or pro-growth reforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以基于捐赠的营利性测试取代现行无关商业所得税（UBIT），通过对非营利组织的商业净收入征税、同时保留慈善捐赠的免税待遇，以恢复税收中立、保护公司税基，并每年增加高达510亿美元的税收收入。
AI.research_question: 如何改革现行无关商业所得税（UBIT）制度，以有效解决非营利组织大规模商业活动导致的税收不公平和公司税基侵蚀问题？
AI.motivation: 非营利部门已成为3.6万亿美元的经济体，其大部分收入来自享有免税地位的商业活动。1950年制定的UBIT未能有效遏制不公平竞争和保护公司税基，非营利组织每年产生超过2.8万亿美元的商业相关收入，政策改革迫在眉睫。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收中立理论、税收公平理论、营利性测试（commerciality test）理论框架
AI.method: 立法提案与政策分析，提出以捐赠为基础的营利性测试来区分慈善捐赠与应税商业收入。
AI.findings: 现行UBIT制度无效，无法有效监管非营利组织的商业活动；拟议的捐赠型营利性测试能够更清晰地区分慈善捐赠和商业收入；改革每年可增加高达510亿美元的税收收入，用于支持赤字削减或促增长改革。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出捐赠型营利性测试（donation-based commerciality test）作为新的税收政策理论框架，为区分慈善活动与商业活动提供了更清晰的概念边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国会提供具体的立法建议，通过税收改革恢复税收中立、保护公司税基完整性，并创造数百亿美元的财政收入用于支持财政改革。

title: Embedded Measurement Infrastructure for Continuous Education Research: Design, Statistical Operating Characteristics, and a Simulation Study

detail.title: Embedded Measurement Infrastructure for Continuous Education Research: Design, Statistical Operating Characteristics, and a Simulation Study
detail.abstract:
Randomized controlled trials remain the standard for causal evidence in education, but the dominant research model separates measurement from instruction: studies typically require years and substantial dedicated funding to produce a single effect size in a single context. We evaluate an alternative in which the learning environment itself serves as the measurement instrument, so that rigorous studies run as configurations of existing instructional infrastructure rather than as parallel capital projects.

We present an embedded measurement architecture with three layers: an observation-streaming protocol that converts routine instructional interactions into scored psychometric events without altering instruction; a study-lifecycle layer implementing hash-committed pre-registration, cluster randomization, group-sequential monitoring with alpha-spending boundaries and a pre-specified non-binding futility rule, and automated cross-site pooling; and a governance layer in which research use is consent-gated, identifiable data remains under district control consistent with FERPA and applicable state law, primary outcomes are externally validated instruments (platform-native measures are pre-registered as secondary, given the documented inflation of effects on intervention-aligned measures), and third-party analysts, not the developer, control randomization and analysis. The design is instantiated in a working system of 50 instruments with 178 calibrated items across 11 subject domains.

We evaluate the design in two ways. First, statistical operating characteristics: at the modal two-arm cluster-randomized deployment (12 classrooms, about 30 students per classroom, ICC 0.10-0.20, 12% attrition), the primary covariate-adjusted analysis attains 54% power at an effect size of 0.35 SD and 82% at 0.50 SD under the sequential triage procedure (the fixed-sample confirmatory analysis, which spends no interim error probability, is weakly more powerful), exceeding unadjusted analysis by 22-26 percentage points, with minimum detectable effects of 0.49-0.60 SD across ICC; we state plainly which questions a twelve-classroom deployment cannot answer. Second, a simulation study of 10 synthetic sites, 16,774 learners, and 7.2 million scored events exercises the full lifecycle at 2,000 replications per cell: empirical Type I error of the sequential triage procedure ranged 0.041-0.057 across all nine design cells against nominal 0.05 (Monte Carlo standard error about 0.005), with the highest cell re-estimated at 20,000 replications and resolving to 0.051; the futility rule stopped 88-91% of null trials early, matching analytic expectation; and cross-site pooling with Hartung-Knapp intervals achieved 92-98% coverage at five or more sites, while two-site heterogeneity estimation proved 2.6-4.3 times less stable.

Calibration itself yielded two methodological findings. Conventional single-coefficient covariate adjustment inflated treatment-effect variance by 71% through within-between conflation, a result confirmed by an independent R implementation (lmerTest/pbkrtest), and was repaired by Mundlak-form decomposition of the covariate. And ten defects identified during development, including a pair whose errors canceled exactly on null-calibration checks, motivate a verification standard requiring per-dataset agreement with an independent reference implementation on estimates, standard errors, degrees of freedom, and rejection decisions; the defect ledger and harness are reported in full as a template for verification-driven simulation practice. The simulation protocol was itself hash-committed through the system's own pre-registration mechanism before the production run.

No efficacy claims are made: the simulation evaluates infrastructure and statistical behavior, not learning; empirical validation with live classrooms, under IRB review and district consent, is specified; and each design claim is paired with the observation that would falsify it.

Language-model assistance (Anthropic's Claude) was used in drafting and editing this manuscript; all system designs, analyses, data, and claims were specified and verified by the author, who takes full responsibility for the content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"嵌入式测量架构"，将学习环境本身作为测量工具，使严格的教育随机对照试验（RCT）能够在现有教学基础设施上运行，而非作为独立的资本项目。系统包含三层架构（观测流协议、研究生命周期层、治理层），并在50个工具、178个校准项目、11个学科领域的系统中实现。通过统计操作特征分析和模拟研究（10个合成站点、16,774名学习者、720万评分事件）验证了该设计的统计效能和错误率控制。
AI.research_question: 能否构建一种替代传统教育RCT研究的架构，使学习环境本身成为测量工具，从而在现有教学基础设施上运行严格的研究，避免多年时间和大量专项资金的投入？该架构的统计操作特征和误差控制是否达到可接受的严格标准？
AI.motivation: 传统教育随机对照试验将测量与教学分离，通常需要数年时间和大量专项资金才能产生单一情境中的单一效应量，效率低下且难以规模化。作者旨在探索一种替代方案，使严谨的研究能以现有教学基础设施的配置方式运行，而非作为并行资本项目。
AI.theoretical_framework: 嵌入式测量架构（三层：观测流协议、研究生命周期、治理层）；基于贝叶斯或频率学派序贯试验设计理论（alpha-spending边界）；Mundlak形式协变量分解（解决组内-组间混杂）；Hartung-Knapp跨站池化方法。
AI.method: （1）架构设计与实现：构建三层嵌入式测量系统（观测流协议、研究生命周期层含哈希承诺预注册/群组随机化/序贯监测/自动跨站池化、治理层含同意门控/FERPA合规/第三方分析控制）；（2）统计操作特征评估：分析模态双组群组随机部署（12个教室、每教室约30人、ICC 0.10-0.20）的统计功效；（3）大规模模拟研究：10个合成站点、16,774名学习者、720万评分事件、每单元2,000次重复，检验I类错误率、无效性规则和跨站覆盖。
AI.findings: （1）在模态部署下，主协变量调整分析在效应量0.35 SD时达到54%功效、0.50 SD时达到82%，比未调整分析高22-26个百分点；（2）序贯筛选程序的实证I类错误率在0.041-0.057之间（名义0.05），无效性规则提前终止88-91%的无效试验；（3）Hartung-Knapp跨站池化在5个及以上站点实现92-98%覆盖率；（4）常规单一系数协变量调整因组内-组间混杂使处理效应方差膨胀71%；（5）发现10个开发期间缺陷，包括一对误差在零校准检查中完全抵消的缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出嵌入式测量架构作为教育随机对照试验的新范式，将测量嵌入教学而非分离； （2）识别并修复了常规单一系数协变量调整中组内-组间混杂导致方差膨胀71%的问题（Mundlak分解）； （3）提出基于独立参考实现逐数据集一致的验证标准（估计值、标准误、自由度、拒绝决策），为验证驱动的模拟实践提供模板。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供可运行的嵌入式测量系统（50个工具、178个校准项目、11个学科领域），为学区提供低成本、可扩展的严谨教育证据生成基础设施；（2）明确声明12教室部署无法回答的问题，建立研究局限性的透明沟通标准；（3）提交完整缺陷账本和验证工具，供其他研究者复用；（4）为教育领域数据治理提供同意门控、FERPA合规和第三方分析控制的实践参照。

title: Managing Organizational Conflicts: A Leadership-Centered Problem-Solution Framework
affiliations: and President University

detail.title: Managing Organizational Conflicts: A Leadership-Centered Problem-Solution Framework
detail.abstract: Leadership acts as the core catalyst and governing force of organizational conflict dynamics. Based on Rahim's (2002) macro conflict management theory, the Dual-Concern Model, the substantive-affective conflict typology, and transformational leadership theory, this study originally develops and validates the Leadership-Centered Conflict Governance (LCCG) model. Using a three-wave longitudinal matched design with 352 valid leadermember dyads, this research systematically reveals how leadership behaviors influence organizational effectiveness through conflict types, psychological safety, and double-loop learning. Results show that toxic, dominating, and avoidant leadership significantly escalate affective conflict and suppress substantive conflict; integrative and transformational leadership reduce affective conflict, maintain moderate functional substantive conflict, enhance psychological safety, and promote double-loop learning. Task non-routine, team trust, and power distance play significant moderating roles. This study proposes an evidence-based intervention system including diagnosis, contingent style training, process interventions, and structural reforms, whose effectiveness is verified through a real organizational case. This research extends Rahim's theory by specifying mediating mechanisms and boundary conditions, providing a testable and implementable integrated framework for conflict governance in modern organizations.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于Rahim宏观冲突管理理论、双关心模型、实质-情感冲突类型学及变革型领导理论，通过352对领导者-成员的三波纵向配对数据，开发并验证了以领导为中心的冲突治理（LCCG）模型，揭示了领导行为经由冲突类型、心理安全和双环学习影响组织效能的机制，并提出了循证干预体系。
AI.research_question: 领导行为如何通过冲突类型、心理安全和双环学习影响组织效能？其边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 领导是组织冲突动态的核心催化剂和治理力量，但现有研究缺乏一个以领导为中心的整合性冲突治理框架，未能系统阐明领导行为影响组织效能的具体机制和边界条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: Rahim（2002）宏观冲突管理理论、双关心模型（Dual-Concern Model）、实质-情感冲突类型学、变革型领导理论
AI.method: 三波纵向配对设计，352对有效领导者-成员配对；实证检验模型，并通过真实组织案例验证干预体系的有效性。
AI.findings: 有毒型、支配型和回避型领导显著加剧情感冲突并抑制实质冲突；整合型和变革型领导能减少情感冲突、维持适度功能性实质冲突、增强心理安全并促进双环学习。任务非常规性、团队信任和权力距离具有显著调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了Rahim的冲突管理理论，明确了领导影响组织冲突的中介机制和边界条件，构建了可检验、可实施的领导中心化冲突治理整合框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了包含诊断、情境化风格培训、过程干预和结构改革在内的循证干预体系，并通过真实组织案例验证了其有效性，为现代组织冲突治理提供了可实施的操作方案。

title: Can Machine Learning Models Outperform Classical Benchmarks in Forecasting India's Weighted Average Call Money Rate?

detail.title: Can Machine Learning Models Outperform Classical Benchmarks in Forecasting India's Weighted Average Call Money Rate?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There were no conflicts of interest or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Accurate forecasting of short-term interest rates is essential for monetary policy analysis and financing decisions. This study forecasts the Reserve Bank of India's Weighted Average Call Rate (WACR), the operating target of monetary policy, using a range of econometric and machine learning techniques. Monthly macroeconomic, monetary, and financial indicators are employed to estimate one, three, and six month ahead forecasts. Model performance is evaluated across naïve persistence, AR(1) , Taylor-rule, Elastic Net, XGBoost, and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) models using a rolling out-of-sample evaluation framework. The results indicate that persistence based benchmarks remain highly competitive, highlighting the strong autoregressive nature of the policy rate. Nevertheless, Elastic Net and XGBoost demonstrate improved forecasting performance under selected monetary policy regimes by effectively incorporating additional macroeconomic information, whereas the GRU model does not consistently outperform simpler alternatives because of the limited sample size and structural changes in the policy environment. These findings suggest that regularized machine learning models can complement traditional forecasting approaches for short-term interest rate prediction while emphasizing the importance of robust benchmark comparisons and regime-specific evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用多种计量经济学和机器学习方法预测印度储备银行加权平均拆借利率（WACR），发现基于持续性的基准模型表现强劲，弹性网络和XGBoost在特定货币政策制度下能有效改进预测，而GRU模型因样本量有限和政策环境结构变化未能持续超越简单模型。
AI.research_question: 如何利用计量经济学和机器学习技术准确预测印度储备银行的短期利率（WACR）？不同模型在1、3、6个月预测期的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 短期利率的准确预测对货币政策分析和融资决策至关重要，但现有研究缺乏对印度政策利率在多种模型框架下系统性的比较评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于利率的持续性特征（自回归性质）、泰勒规则货币政策框架，以及机器学习在时间序列预测中的应用理论。
AI.method: 使用月度宏观、货币和金融指标，比较朴素持续性模型、AR(1)、泰勒规则、弹性网络、XGBoost和门控循环单元（GRU）模型，采用滚动样本外评估框架预测1、3、6个月期的WACR。
AI.findings: 1）基于持续性的基准模型表现极具竞争力，凸显政策利率的强自回归特性；2）弹性网络和XGBoost在特定货币政策制度下通过纳入宏观经济信息改善了预测效果；3）GRU模型因样本量有限和政策环境结构变化未能持续优于简单模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调了稳健基准比较和制度特定评估的重要性，为短期利率预测文献提供了制度依赖性的新见解，表明正则化机器学习模型可作为传统方法的补充而非替代。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策分析者和金融市场参与者提供了可操作的短期利率预测工具选择指南，建议根据货币政策制度环境选择适当的预测模型。

title: Can Customer Ratings be Discrimination Amplifiers? Evidence From a Gig Economy Platform
affiliations: , Yale University and Yale School of Management

detail.title: Can Customer Ratings be Discrimination Amplifiers? Evidence From a Gig Economy Platform
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether rating systems generate discriminatory spillovers and act as "discrimination amplifiers." When platforms display aggregated customer ratings, these "quality metrics" also serve as anchors for future evaluations. Because they embed ratings from biased customers, displayed averages memorialize past discrimination, transmitting it to otherwise unbiased customers and amplifying bias among discriminatory ones. We formalize this mechanism using a stylized analytical model and test it with data from an online labor platform. Allowing for unobserved heterogeneity, we identify three customer segments: a neutral segment, and two biased segments, one that cancels more minority-accepted jobs and another that both cancels more and rates minorities lower. All segments are impacted strongly by displayed ratings. Customer discrimination generates a rating gap of 36.1% and an estimated earnings gap via job loss of 5.2% between minority and majority workers. Notably, the unbiased segment produces discriminatory outcomes through spillovers. Adjusting displayed ratings reduces the gaps by mitigating the spillovers to the unbiased segment and amplification of the biased segments, but aggregate rating and earnings disparities persist because biased segments constitute a large share of the market.

AI.tldr: 本文研究评级系统是否会产生歧视性溢出效应并充当"歧视放大器"。当平台展示聚合客户评分时，这些"质量指标"会作为未来评估的锚点。由于评分嵌入了有偏客户的偏见，展示的平均值会纪念过去的歧视，并将其传递给原本无偏见的客户，同时放大有偏见客户的歧视。作者用分析模型形式化该机制，并用在线劳动平台数据验证。识别出三个客户细分：中性细分、取消更多少数族裔工作并给更低评分的两个有偏细分。客户歧视产生36.1%的评分差距和5.2%的收入差距。值得注意的是，无偏细分通过溢出效应产生歧视性结果。调整展示评分可通过缓解对无偏细分的溢出和有偏细分的放大来缩小差距，但由于有偏细分占市场很大份额，聚合评分和收入差距仍会持续。
AI.research_question: 评级系统是否会产生歧视性溢出效应并充当"歧视放大器"？具体而言，展示的聚合客户评分是否会将过去客户的歧视传递给无偏见的客户，并放大有偏见客户的歧视，从而扩大少数族裔与多数族裔工人之间的评分和收入差距？
AI.motivation: 现有文献关注评级偏差本身，但未深入探讨评级系统作为传播和放大歧视的机制。展示的聚合评分将过去的有偏行为"锚定"到未来评估中，可能产生超出直接歧视者的间接歧视效应，这对理解平台经济中的系统性歧视具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 歧视性溢出效应理论框架：将展示的聚合评分视为"锚点"，通过锚定效应影响未来评估；结合客户细分理论（无偏/有偏细分识别），以及统计歧视的行为经济学扩展。
AI.method: 结合风格化分析模型与在线劳动平台实证数据。采用允许未观测异质性的混合模型/潜在类别模型，识别客户细分；利用平台数据估计各细分对展示评分的响应程度以及歧视对评分和收入差距的影响；并进行反事实分析评估调整展示评分的政策效果。
AI.findings: (1) 识别出三个客户细分：一个中性细分和两个有偏细分（一个取消更多少数族裔接受的工作，另一个既取消更多又给更低评分）；(2) 所有细分均受展示评分的强烈影响；(3) 客户歧视产生36.1%的评分差距和5.2%的收入（因工作损失）差距；(4) 无偏细分通过溢出效应产生歧视性结果；(5) 调整展示评分可缩小差距，但因有偏细分占市场份额大，差距无法完全消除。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并实证检验评级系统作为"歧视放大器"的机制，将歧视传染的概念引入平台评级文献；区分了直接歧视与通过评分溢出产生的间接歧视；将锚定效应理论应用于平台评级情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计者提供政策启示：调整展示评分策略（如去偏处理）可缓解歧视性溢出和放大效应，但需认识到有偏客户占主导时政策效果有限；为在线劳动平台的公平性监管提供实证依据。

title: Linking Value Orientation to Patient Health-Promoting Behavior: The Roles of Calling and Self-Efficacy
affiliations: Jeonbuk National University, Sejong University, Sejong University - School of Business and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Linking Value Orientation to Patient Health-Promoting Behavior: The Roles of Calling and Self-Efficacy
detail.abstract: As population aging accelerates, the importance of patient-centered care and health-promoting behaviors in the healthcare sector is increasingly emphasized. This study examined the structural relationships among value orientation, sense of calling, self-efficacy, patient orientation, and patient health-promoting behaviors among professional caregivers. Drawing on Schwartz’s theory of human values and the Value–Attitude–Behavior perspective, the study investigated how value orientation influences caregiving behaviors through psychological mechanisms. Data were collected from 422 professional caregivers in South Korea and analyzed using partial least squares structural equation modeling. The results showed that altruistic values positively affected sense of calling, whereas egoistic values positively influenced self-efficacy. In addition, a sense of calling significantly enhanced both self-efficacy and patient orientation. Self-efficacy positively affected patient orientation but did not directly influence patient health-promoting behaviors. Patient orientation, however, significantly promoted patient health-promoting behaviors, and a sense of calling also had a direct positive effect on such behaviors. Multi-group analysis further revealed gender differences in the effects of altruistic values on self-efficacy and self-efficacy on patient orientation. The findings demonstrate that value orientation and psychological motivational factors play important roles in shaping patient-centered attitudes and health-promoting caregiving behaviors. This study contributes to caregiving and healthcare research by validating an integrated structural model linking value orientation, psychological resources, and patient-related behaviors. Additionally, the findings provide practical implications for education and human resource management strategies aimed at improving patient-centered care services.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于Schwartz人类价值观理论和价值-态度-行为视角，通过对韩国422名专业照护者的调查，构建并验证了价值取向、职业使命感、自我效能感、患者导向与患者健康促进行为之间的整合结构模型，发现利他价值观促进职业使命感、利己价值观提升自我效能感，且职业使命感与患者导向是驱动健康促进行为的关键心理机制，并揭示了两性在部分路径上的差异。
AI.research_question: 专业照护者的价值取向如何通过心理机制（职业使命感、自我效能感）影响患者导向和患者健康促进行为？这些路径是否存在性别差异？
AI.motivation: 随着人口老龄化加速，以患者为中心的照护和健康促进行为在医疗领域日益重要，但价值取向如何通过心理机制塑造照护行为仍缺乏系统的结构模型验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: Schwartz人类价值观理论；价值-态度-行为（Value–Attitude–Behavior）视角
AI.method: 问卷调查（韩国422名专业照护者）；偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）；多组分析（性别差异）
AI.findings: 利他价值观正向影响职业使命感，利己价值观正向影响自我效能感；职业使命感显著增强自我效能感和患者导向；自我效能感正向影响患者导向但不直接影响健康促进行为；患者导向显著促进健康促进行为；职业使命感对健康促进行为有直接正向影响；多组分析发现利他价值观对自我效能感及自我效能感对患者导向的路径存在性别差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了将价值取向、心理资源和患者相关行为联系起来的整合结构模型，扩展了价值-态度-行为框架在照护领域的应用，揭示了价值取向影响照护行为的心理机制链条。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改善以患者为中心的照护服务提供了教育与人力资源管理策略方面的实践启示，有助于针对性地培养照护人员的职业使命感、自我效能感和患者导向。

title: Working with AI: Required Skill Bundles and Wage Premium in the Chinese Labor Market
affiliations: Louisiana State University Shreveport and Wenzhou-Kean University

detail.title: Working with AI: Required Skill Bundles and Wage Premium in the Chinese Labor Market
detail.abstract: This paper studies how artificial intelligence (AI) skill requirements are associated with skill bundles and posted wages in China. We define AI skill requirements as job-ad requirements to use completed AI tools, integrate AI models or systems into products and business processes, or develop, train, optimize, and deploy AI models. Using more than eight million postings from 51job.com, we construct a context-aware taxonomy that distinguishes AI user, applied technical, and core technical skills, and identify seven categories of nontechnical skills from job-description text. AI skill requirements remain rare but are concentrated in highly educated and technically intensive jobs. Postings requiring any AI skill offer a conditional wage premium of about 17 percent, with the premium increasing from AI user to applied technical and core technical skills. Postings requiring AI capabilities are also more likely to require cognitive, executive, strategic, and self-management skills, especially among AI user and applied technical jobs. However, wage interaction estimates do not show broad superadditive complementarity between AI and nontechnical skills. The results further reveal substantial industry heterogeneity in both AI-related skill bundles and wage premia.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国51job.com超过800万条招聘信息，构建了区分AI用户技能、应用技术技能和核心技术技能的上下文感知分类体系，研究发现AI技能要求仍较稀缺但集中于高学历和技术密集型岗位；要求AI技能的招聘广告提供约17%的工资溢价，且溢价从AI用户技能到核心技术技能递增；AI能力与认知、管理类非技术技能呈互补性需求，但工资交互效应未显示广泛的超加性互补性。
AI.research_question: 在中国的劳动力市场中，AI技能要求如何与技能组合（skill bundles）及发布的工资相关联？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在经济中的快速渗透，理解AI技能在劳动力市场中的需求结构及其与工资的关系对于评估AI对就业和收入分配的影响至关重要，尤其在中国这一全球AI应用大国背景下尚缺乏大规模实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技能需求理论、技能互补性理论（skill complementarity）、人力资本理论
AI.method: 利用51job.com超过800万条招聘广告数据；构建上下文感知的AI技能分类体系（区分AI用户技能、应用技术技能、核心技术技能）；从职位描述文本中识别七类非技术技能；采用工资溢价回归分析和技能组合的交互效应分析。
AI.findings: （1）AI技能要求仍较罕见，但集中于高学历和技术密集型岗位；（2）要求任何AI技能的招聘广告提供约17%的条件工资溢价，溢价从AI用户技能到应用技术技能再到核心技术技能递增；（3）要求AI能力的岗位也更倾向于要求认知、行政、战略和自我管理技能，尤其在AI用户和应用技术岗位中；（4）工资交互效应未显示AI技能与非技术技能之间存在广泛的超加性互补性；（5）AI相关技能组合和工资溢价存在显著的行业异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究通过大规模中国劳动力市场数据，为AI技能需求结构与工资溢价的关系提供了新证据，丰富了技能互补性理论在AI情境下的应用，并区分了不同类型AI技能（用户型、应用技术型、核心技术型）的不同工资和市场效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了AI技能培训和教育投资方向的指引；为企业招聘和薪酬设计提供参考；为劳动者识别高价值AI技能组合（特别是核心技术技能的高溢价）提供职业发展指导。

title: Job Dispatch under Hidden Machine Lifetimes: A Robust Rolling-Horizon Framework
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Systems Engineering and Engineering Management, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Systems Engineering and Engineering Management, Beijing Institute of Technology and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Systems Engineering and Engineering Management

detail.title: Job Dispatch under Hidden Machine Lifetimes: A Robust Rolling-Horizon Framework
detail.abstract: Shared, spot, and other revocable computing resources are increasingly used to meet the growing demand for accelerator capacity in AI and data-intensive workloads. Managing such revocable capacity creates a hiddenlifetime dispatch problem: the scheduler observes idle machines and machine-specific lifetime predictions, but does not know whether an assigned machine will remain available long enough to complete a job. We study a periodic-review matching problem with known job runtimes and latent machine lifetimes. Because the corresponding dynamic program requires a high-dimensional, history-dependent state, we propose a robust rolling-horizon framework that protects current completion reliability and one-stage-ahead service capacity. Jobs are grouped into runtime classes, and latent lifetimes are bucketed, allowing future service feasibility to be characterized through nested capacity-tail conditions. The look-ahead component is decisiondependent as current assignments determine which machines may carry over and the distribution of their future lifetime buckets. We first formulate a machine-level look-ahead model that directly dispatches jobs to individual machines and admits an exact finite-dimensional mixed-integer linear programming reformulation despite decision-dependent ambiguity. To obtain a scalable online policy, we propose a two-layer architecture. An aggregate outer planner selects bucket-level draws and future-capacity prices, based on which an inner dispatcher produces executable assignments using lifetime predictions. At the aggregate level, however, decision-dependent carryover does not admit an analogous exact reformulation. We address this challenge by embedding the carryover relation in a lifted, decision-independent moment-based ambiguity set, yielding a conservative linear program. We calibrate our experiments using the public Google cluster trace, select policy parameters on validation instances, and evaluate performance on held-out rolling-horizon sample paths. The proposed two-layer robust policy achieves the highest mean net reward among the evaluated online policies, primarily by better coordinating current completion reliability with the preservation of future service capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可撤销计算资源（如共享、即用即付的加速器容量）中的"隐藏寿命调度问题"：调度器观察到空闲机器及其寿命预测，但不知道分配的机器能否存活到作业完成。作者提出一个稳健滚动时域框架，通过两层架构（外层聚合规划器+内层调度器）和决策相关的模糊集处理，实现对当前完成可靠性与未来服务容量的协调优化。
AI.research_question: 在可撤销（revocable）计算资源环境中，调度器如何在不知道机器确切寿命（仅有人工智能预测）的情况下，最优地匹配作业与机器，以在保证当前作业完成可靠性的同时保留未来服务能力？
AI.motivation: 云端加速器资源（GPU等）供不应求，可撤销容量成为补充供给的重要方式。然而这类容量的本质问题是"隐藏寿命"：调度器无法确定一台机器能否撑到作业完成，这导致调度决策在可靠性保障与未来容量预留之间存在根本性权衡，现有方法难以有效解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 周期审查匹配问题（periodic-review matching problem）、稳健优化（robust optimization）、滚动时域控制（rolling-horizon）、决策相关模糊集（decision-dependent ambiguity set）、混合整数线性规划（MILP）
AI.method: 1) 提出机器级前瞻模型，将作业按运行时长分桶、机器寿命按桶分组，通过嵌套容量尾部条件刻画未来服务可行性，并给出精确有限维MILP重构；2) 为获得可扩展在线策略，提出两层架构：外层聚合规划器选择桶级抽取和未来容量价格（用提升的决策无关矩模糊集嵌入结转关系得一保守线性规划），内层调度器基于寿命预测生成可执行分配；3) 使用Google集群追踪数据校准实验。
AI.findings: 在Google集群追踪数据的滚动时域样本路径上，所提出的两层稳健策略在所有评估的在线策略中获得了最高的平均净奖励，主要通过更好地协调当前完成可靠性与未来服务容量的保留来实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次系统性地将"隐藏机器寿命"问题建模为周期审查匹配问题，提出基于嵌套容量尾部条件的可行性刻画；2) 证明了机器级前瞻模型存在精确的有限维MILP重构（尽管存在决策相关模糊集）；3) 通过提升的决策无关矩模糊集逼近决策相关的结转关系，实现了聚合层面的可计算保守逼近。
AI.practical_contributions: 为云服务提供商和AI基础设施运营者提供了一种可扩展的在线调度策略，能够在可撤销加速器资源上同时优化当前作业完成率与长期服务能力，且该方法已通过真实Google集群数据进行验证。

title: The Power of "Made in Italy": How Country of Origin Shapes Global Consumer Perception and Brand Value

detail.title: The Power of "Made in Italy": How Country of Origin Shapes Global Consumer Perception and Brand Value

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial interests, personal relationships, or competing interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study involved voluntary and anonymous participation in an online survey. No personally identifiable information was collected. Participants were informed of the purpose of the research and consented by voluntarily completing the questionnaire.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This research paper analyzes how the "Made in Italy" label shapes global consumer perceptions, contributing to the creation of brand equity and competitive advantage in international markets. In an increasingly competitive global economy, understanding how a brand's country of origin enhances consumer valuation has become critical for strategic differentiation. Utilizing a mixed-methods approach, this study combines a literature review with primary survey results and four comparative case studies: Ferrari, Riva, Golden Goose, and San Pellegrino. The findings indicate that the "Made in Italy" label functions as a strategic intangible asset rather than a mere geographical indicator, driving long-term sustainable competitive advantage in international markets.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了"意大利制造"标签如何塑造全球消费者认知，通过混合方法（文献综述、问卷调查和四个比较案例研究）证明该标签超越地理指示器的功能，作为战略性无形资产驱动国际市场的长期可持续竞争优势。
AI.research_question: "意大利制造"标签如何塑造全球消费者认知，并如何贡献于品牌资产的创造和国际市场的竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 在全球经济竞争日益激烈的背景下，理解品牌原产国如何提升消费者价值评价已成为战略差异化中的关键问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于原产国效应和品牌资产理论框架，探讨国家标签作为战略无形资产的机制。
AI.method: 混合方法研究，结合文献综述、一手问卷调查结果以及四个比较案例研究（法拉利、Riva、Golden Goose和圣培露）。
AI.findings: "意大利制造"标签并非仅仅是一个地理指示器，而是一个战略性无形资产，能够驱动国际市场中的长期可持续竞争优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 将原产国标签重新概念化为战略性无形资产，超越了传统的地理指示视角，丰富了品牌资产理论中关于国家标签作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际品牌管理者提供了利用原产国标签作为差异化战略工具的实践指导，帮助企业在全球市场中建立和维持竞争优势。

title: "AI assists. You think. You analyze. You write. You take responsibility": Creating a Course AI Use Policy Template --Policy Text, Justification and Rule Summary for My Law & Religion Class at Penn State Dickinson
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University - Penn State Dickinson Law

detail.title: "AI assists. You think. You analyze. You write. You take responsibility": Creating a Course AI Use Policy Template --Policy Text, Justification and Rule Summary for My Law & Religion Class at Penn State Dickinson

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Penn State summer research grant aided in part this work

detail.abstract:
This essay provides the text of a Model Classroom AI Class Use Policy along with a justification for its terms. It is grounded on the premise that a course AI use policy should be built around a justified allocation of risk rather than a simple permit/prohibit binary. The author reasons that categorical bans are unenforceable and misaligned with how AI is already embedded in legal practice, while unrestricted use would erode the ability to assess unaided student analysis. The resulting design principle is a narrow, conditional exception layered onto a default of independent work, with permission calibrated to where oversight and iterative disclosure are feasible.

That reasoning drives each structural choice. The exception is confined to the final paper (not exams or problem sets) because papers unfold over time, allowing disclosure and instructor engagement that timed assessments cannot accommodate. Permitted and prohibited uses are framed illustratively, not as a bright-line test, because forcing research, analysis, and writing into mechanically verifiable categories would create false confidence at the margins; ambiguity is instead deployed deliberately to discourage boundary-engineering. By contrast, incorporated AI-generated content is subject to fixed numerical ceilings (100 words per instance, 10% aggregate), because that narrower, mechanical act of quotation is better suited to a bright-line rule than the broader assistance-versus-substitution question. Mandatory naming, a full prompt-and-response appendix, in-text attribution, and a signed certification convert disclosure into an enforceable condition of the exception itself, so partial compliance affords no defense, and the institution retains audit authority independent of prior suspicion.

The author frames the resulting template as a first iteration, refined through human review and testing against several AI systems (including Harvey AI), to be revised further based on classroom experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一份模型课堂AI使用政策的文本及其正当性论证，主张AI使用政策应基于合理的风险分配而非简单的允许/禁止二元选择，设计原则是在默认独立作业的基础上设置狭窄的条件性例外，并根据监督和迭代披露的可行性来校准许可。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一门课程的AI使用政策，使其既能适应AI已嵌入法律实践的现状，又能保持对学生独立分析能力的评估？
AI.motivation: 分类式全面禁止AI无法执行且与实际法律实践脱节，而无限制使用则会侵蚀评估学生独立分析能力的基础，因此需要一种基于风险分配的政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险分配理论；许可与禁止的二元框架批判；"狭窄条件例外"原则；监督可行性与迭代披露理论
AI.method: 规范性论证与政策设计方法，结合多项AI系统（包括Harvey AI）的人工测试与课堂经验验证。
AI.findings: 政策应在最终论文（而非考试或习题集）中设置狭窄例外，因为论文有时间展开允许披露和教师参与；允许/禁止用途应以示例性而非明确界限的方式呈现以阻止边界操纵；对纳入的AI生成内容设定固定数值上限（每实例100词、总量10%）作为明确的引用规则；强制命名、完整提示-回复附录、文内署名和签署认证将披露转化为例外本身的可执行条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出课程AI使用政策应基于风险分配而非许可/禁止二元框架的设计理念；区分了适合明确界限规则（引用）与适合模糊性原则（研究、分析、写作协助）的不同政策领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可直接使用或修改的模型课堂AI政策模板，包含具体的限制数值、披露机制和审计权力安排，为教育者制定AI使用政策提供操作性指导。

title: Last in Line: Implicit Racial Bias in Healthcare Scheduling Delays
affiliations: Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU), , Santa Clara University - Information Systems and Analytics and Santa Clara University - Information Systems and Analytics

detail.title: Last in Line: Implicit Racial Bias in Healthcare Scheduling Delays

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patients, identifiable personal data, or case studies requiring ethics approval or informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study is not a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: Problem definition: With recent advances in analytics and data science, it is increasingly common for healthcare appointment scheduling systems to follow a predict-then-optimize framework: historical data are first used to predict patients' individual no-show probabilities, and then an optimization module schedules patients to minimize a weighted total cost of patient waiting time, provider idle time, and provider overtime. This paper identifies and studies a previously unexamined mechanism through which such systems can generate racial disparities. We show that cost-minimizing policies systematically schedule patients at higher risk of no-shows farther into the future while scheduling patients at lower risk of no-shows closer to the present. Because no-show risk is correlated with race and low socioeconomic status, Black patients are consistently assigned longer appointment delays, even when race is not used in the development of these scheduling policies. Methodology/results: We analytically study a single-day scheduling model and establish that increasing the no-show probability of patients at high risk of no-shows while decreasing it for patients at low risk of no-shows weakly decreases schedule cost. Extending the analysis to a multi-day setting, we show that this effect can be achieved by assigning longer appointment delays to patients with higher no-show risk. Using a large real-world data set, our numerical experiments validate that, under a predict-then-optimize framework that excludes race as an input, Black patients are nevertheless assigned delays up to 76% longer compared to non-Black patients. Furthermore, such racial disparities arise consistently across all practice environments tested. Managerial implications: Scheduling systems optimized solely for operational efficiency can generate racial disparities in access to care without any explicit use of race. Our results call for equity-aware scheduling policies and highlight the need for bias audits of (AI-driven) scheduling tools, particularly as regulatory scrutiny of algorithmic discrimination continues to intensify.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了医疗预约调度系统中"先预测后优化"框架下，成本最小化策略如何通过风险分层产生种族差异——即高失约风险的患者（因与种族和社会经济地位相关）被系统性地安排更长的就医等待时间，即使系统完全不使用种族信息。研究通过理论模型和真实数据验证了这一机制，并呼吁采用公平感知的调度策略和算法偏见审计。
AI.research_question: 在排除种族作为输入变量的情况下，预测-优化框架下的医疗预约调度系统是否会以及如何产生种族差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究未考察"先预测后优化"框架下，成本最小化调度策略可能通过失约风险分层这一机制系统性产生种族差异。随着AI驱动的调度系统日益普及，这种隐性歧视机制需要被识别和解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测-优化框架（predict-then-optimize）、成本最小化调度理论、单日/多日调度模型
AI.method: 单日调度模型的解析分析、多日设置的扩展分析、基于大型真实世界数据集的数值实验验证
AI.findings: （1）理论上证明，提高高风险患者失约概率同时降低低风险患者失约概率可弱化降低调度成本，而这一效果可通过将更长预约延迟分配给高失约风险患者实现；（2）在排除种族的预测-优化框架下，黑人患者比非黑人患者多等待长达76%的时间；（3）这种种族差异在所有测试的实践环境中一致出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别并系统验证了一个此前未被研究的机制：成本最优化的调度策略通过失约风险分层隐性地产生种族差异，即使算法完全公平地不使用种族信息。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁采用公平感知的调度政策；强调对AI驱动调度工具进行偏见审计的必要性，特别是在关于算法歧视的监管审查不断加严的背景下。

title: 3 Musafir: How the Organization Makes Travel for Women in Pakistan
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: 3 Musafir: How the Organization Makes Travel for Women in Pakistan
detail.abstract: Context and Gap: Women’s travel in Pakistan is constrained by safety, permission, and accessibility. While social sustainability, a critical construct, which is often confused with environmental sustainability in touris,m is under-studied, Purpose: This study examined how community-building factors, experience design, safety & permission, community rituals & peer support, and storytelling & branded content operate through trust and community identification to drive repeat participation and advocacy/word-of-mouth in Teen Musafir Research design/Data: We used a cross-sectional survey of 72 participants, analyzed with SEM (AMOS), and triangulated with four brief interviews and field observations. The constructs from the survey were measured on a 5-point Likert scale with acceptable reliability and validity. Results: SEM Results showed that Safety & Permission significantly increased Trust, while Community Rituals & Peer Support strongly increased both Trust and Community Identification. Community Identification was the strongest predictor of both Repeat Participation and Advocacy/Word-of-Mouth. Trust also contributed to Advocacy/Word-of-Mouth, although it did not influence Repeat Participation. Experience Design showed only marginal and non-significant effects on Trust and Community Identification, and Storytelling & Branded Content did not significantly affect either outcome. Safety & Permission also did not contribute substantially to Community Identification. Theory: Findings separate a risk-assurance pathway (Safety/Permission → Trust → Advocacy) from a belonging pathway (Rituals/Support → Community Identification → Repeat & Advocacy) and position community rituals as the primary mechanism for identity formation in women-only experiential travel Practical contribution: Implications include codifying safety-permission protocols, institutionalizing a ritual playbook that reliably fosters belonging, and using storytelling to signal norms and procedures. Value: This is among the first empirical models from Pakistan to explain how community building makes women’s travel socially sustainable via trust and belonging.

AI.tldr: 本研究以巴基斯坦女性旅行组织Teen Musafir为对象，通过定量调查（72名参与者，SEM分析）结合定性访谈与田野观察，检验了社区建设因素（安全与许可、社区仪式与同伴支持、体验设计、故事化与品牌内容）如何通过信任和社区认同驱动重复参与和口碑传播。研究发现存在两条路径：风险保障路径（安全/许可→信任→口碑）和归属路径（仪式/支持→社区认同→重复参与与口碑），其中社区仪式是身份认同形成的核心机制。
AI.research_question: 在巴基斯坦女性旅行情境中，社区建设因素（安全与许可、体验设计、社区仪式与同伴支持、故事化与品牌内容）如何通过信任和社区认同影响重复参与和口碑传播/倡导行为？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦女性的旅行受到安全、许可和可达性等多重限制。社会可持续性作为关键概念，在旅游研究中常与环境可持续性混淆且研究不足。现有文献缺乏从社区建设角度解释女性旅行社会可持续性的实证模型，尤其缺乏来自巴基斯坦等南亚情境的证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以社会可持续性理论为基础，结合信任理论（trust）与社区认同理论（community identification）作为中介机制，构建社区建设因素→信任/社区认同→重复参与与口碑传播的概念模型。
AI.method: 采用横截面调查设计，收集72名参与者的问卷数据，使用结构方程模型（SEM，AMOS软件）进行分析；同时辅以四次简短访谈和田野观察进行三角验证。构念采用5点李克特量表测量，信度和效度达到可接受水平。
AI.findings: （1）安全与许可显著提升信任，但对社区认同无显著贡献；（2）社区仪式与同伴支持同时显著增强信任和社区认同；（3）社区认同是重复参与和口碑传播的最强预测因子；（4）信任促进口碑传播但不影响重复参与；（5）体验设计对信任和社区认同仅有边际且不显著的影响；（6）故事化与品牌内容对两个结果变量均无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将社区建设机制分解为两条独立路径：风险保障路径（安全/许可→信任→口碑）与归属路径（仪式/支持→社区认同→重复参与与口碑），并将社区仪式定位为女性专属体验式旅行中身份认同形成的首要机制。这是来自巴基斯坦的首个实证模型，从信任与归属角度解释了女性旅行社会可持续性的驱动机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为女性旅行组织提供实践启示：（1）将安全与许可协议制度化、规范化以建立信任；（2）建立一套可靠的仪式操作手册以持续培养归属感；（3）利用故事化内容传达组织规范和流程，以强化品牌认知和参与动机。

title: The Dark Side of Hyper-Personalization: When Campaign Micro-Segmentation Conflicts with Corporate Brand Standardization Strategy

detail.title: The Dark Side of Hyper-Personalization: When Campaign Micro-Segmentation Conflicts with Corporate Brand Standardization Strategy
detail.abstract: The contemporary marketing landscape is increasingly defined by the pursuit of hyperpersonalization, a strategy enabled by big data and artificial intelligence that allows for the micro-segmentation of audiences and the delivery of highly tailored brand messages. While this approach promises unparalleled customer engagement and conversion rates, it introduces a fundamental strategic tension: the conflict between granular, individualized communication and the corporate imperative for a unified, standardized brand identity. This research investigates the "dark side" of hyper-personalization, exploring how aggressive microsegmentation can inadvertently erode a company's core brand equity. Through a conceptual analysis of brand standardization theory and personalization frameworks, this study posits that excessive micro-segmentation can lead to brand fragmentation, where disparate customer experiences dilute the central brand narrative, confuse stakeholder perceptions, and compromise the efficiency of global marketing operations. The research further examines the inherent risks, including algorithmic bias, the creation of 'filter bubbles' that limit brand reach, and the potential for a "brand schizophrenia" effect where the company presents contradictory faces to different consumer groups. By identifying the key points of conflict-ranging from messaging consistency and visual identity to brand values and customer trust-this paper provides a strategic framework for navigating the tension. It concludes that a sustainable brand strategy does not necessitate choosing between personalization and standardization, but rather requires a "smart standardization" approach. This involves defining inviolable brand core elements that remain universal while allowing for flexible, data-informed personalization of peripheral attributes. The findings offer crucial insights for marketing practitioners and scholars, proposing a balanced path that harnesses the power of personalization without sacrificing the foundational integrity and long-term value of a coherent corporate brand.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨超个性化营销的"阴暗面"，指出过度微观细分可能导致品牌碎片化、品牌精神分裂等问题。作者提出"智能标准化"策略——在保持品牌核心元素不变的前提下，允许外围属性的个性化定制，从而实现个性化与品牌统一的平衡。
AI.research_question: 过度超个性化（hyper-personalization）如何侵蚀企业核心品牌资产？企业如何在个性化营销与统一品牌身份之间取得平衡？
AI.motivation: 当代营销环境由大数据和AI驱动的超个性化主导，但个性化与标准化之间的战略张力尚未被充分研究。现有文献多关注个性化的积极面，缺乏对其"阴暗面"及对品牌资产潜在侵蚀的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌标准化理论（Brand Standardization Theory）与个性化框架（Personalization Frameworks）
AI.method: 概念分析方法（Conceptual Analysis），对品牌标准化理论和个性化框架进行理论整合与推理
AI.findings: 过度微观细分会导致：(1)品牌碎片化，分散的客户体验稀释核心品牌叙事；(2)算法偏见；(3)"过滤气泡"限制品牌触达；(4)"品牌精神分裂"效应，公司对不同消费者群体呈现矛盾面孔。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了识别个性化与标准化冲突的关键点框架（信息一致性、视觉识别、品牌价值、客户信任），并提出"智能标准化"概念作为协调两种战略的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销实践者提供了"智能标准化"战略框架：定义不可侵犯的品牌核心要素保持普适性，同时允许外围属性进行数据驱动的灵活个性化，从而实现个性化与品牌完整性的双赢。

title: A Study on Competition in the Mobile Ecosystem: Focusing on the Market Dominance of App Stores
affiliations: Korea Development Institute (KDI)

detail.title: A Study on Competition in the Mobile Ecosystem: Focusing on the Market Dominance of App Stores

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Development Institute (KDI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Using detailed market data, this study provides an in-depth analysis of competition in app store related markets and derives implications for the market dominance of app store platforms. It examines the state of competition both between the app stores of Google and Apple, and among leading apps within them from various perspectives, while also examining where the Korean market diverges from other major markets.

Chapter 2 analyzes the market sizes of Google Play and Apple’s App Store across multiple dimensions, including free versus paid apps, non-game versus game apps, and category-level breakdowns. The relative dominance of each app store varies considerably across countries. In Korea, Google Play accounted for over 70% of both downloads and revenue as of 2023. Across all major countries, the share of free apps has risen steadily in both measures, recently surpassing 98%―a pattern consistent with revenue models anchored in in-app purchases rather than paid app sales. Comparing non-game and game apps, game apps account for 93% of Google Play revenue and 71% of App Store revenue, making them the primary driver of overall revenue growth. Korea stands out in this regard. Not only is the revenue share of game apps disproportionately high relative to major countries, but concentration in a narrow set of top-performing categories is also markedly more pronounced.
Chapter 3 uses app-level performance data for the top 1,000 apps to analyze within-store concentration. The degree of concentration is substantial: these apps account for nearly 100% of revenue and roughly 60% of downloads. When a Pareto distribution is fitted to app performance, the estimated shape parameters fall below 1 in many categories―especially for free downloads―indicating an extreme bias toward top-ranked apps. Revenue distributions are more uneven still for game apps than for non-game apps.

Chapter 4 examines the volatility of app performance rankings, focusing on top-ranked apps. Monthly transition matrices constructed across ranking groups, reveal a tendency for apps to remain within the same ranking group from one month to the next, with persistence more pronounced among higher-ranked groups. Revenue rankings exhibit considerably less volatility than download rankings.

These findings suggest that the app store market is close to a competitive bottleneck, situation in which platforms can exercise strong market dominance over app developers. The heterogeneous user bases of Google Play and the App Store further suggest that inter-store competition for single-homing consumers may be limited. Korea’s market situation heightens these concerns. Compared to other major countries, game apps account for a dominant portion of revenue in Korea, and spending is heavily concentrated in popular categories―particularly games with high in-app purchase volumes. For app stores, this concentration raises the stakes of attracting top game apps; for app developers, it elevates the importance of marketing tools such as chart rankings and featured placements. This environment can amplify both the incentives for and the effects of practices already under scrutiny―mandatory in-app payment requirements, the use of featured placements to exclude rival app stores, and self-preferencing―suggesting a need for close monitoring by competition authorities.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用详细的市场数据，深入分析了应用商店相关市场的竞争状况，包括Google Play与Apple App Store之间的竞争以及应用商店内部的竞争集中度，并考察了韩国市场与其他主要市场的差异，最终论证应用商店市场接近"竞争性瓶颈"状态，平台对应用开发者拥有强大的市场支配力。
AI.research_question: 应用商店相关市场的竞争状况如何？Google和Apple应用商店之间的竞争以及其中头部应用之间的竞争处于什么状态？韩国市场与其他主要市场有何差异？
AI.motivation: 应用商店平台（Google和Apple）的市场支配地位受到越来越多的反垄断审查，需要基于详细市场数据的实证分析来评估竞争状况，特别是韩国市场的特殊情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争性瓶颈（competitive bottleneck）理论；帕累托分布（Pareto distribution）用于分析市场集中度；单归属（single-homing）用户与多归属（multi-homing）用户理论。
AI.method: 使用Google Play和Apple App Store的详细市场数据进行多维度分析：第2章从免费vs付费应用、非游戏vs游戏应用、类别层面分析市场规模；第3章使用前1000名应用的绩效数据拟合帕累托分布分析集中度；第4章构建月度排名转换矩阵分析排名波动性。
AI.findings: （1）在韩国，Google Play占下载量和收入的70%以上；免费应用份额在主要国家均超过98%；游戏应用占Google Play收入的93%和App Store收入的71%。（2）前1000名应用占几乎100%的收入和约60%的下载量；许多类别的帕累托形状参数低于1，表明极度偏向顶级应用。（3）应用排名具有持续性，高排名组持续性更强；收入排名波动性低于下载排名。（4）应用商店市场接近竞争性瓶颈，平台对开发者拥有强大市场支配力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将竞争性瓶颈理论应用于应用商店市场，提供了应用商店市场竞争状况的实证证据；通过帕累托分布拟合和排名转换矩阵等方法，为平台市场竞争分析提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了韩国应用商店市场的特殊竞争态势（游戏应用收入占比过高、热门类别集中度过高），为竞争当局对强制应用内支付要求、特色推荐位排除竞争对手、自我偏好等行为的监管提供了实证依据和监测建议。

title: Can Customer Ratings be Discrimination Amplifiers? Evidence from a Gig Economy Platform
affiliations: , Yale University and Yale School of Management

detail.title: Can Customer Ratings be Discrimination Amplifiers? Evidence from a Gig Economy Platform
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether rating systems generate discriminatory spillovers and act as "discrimination amplifiers." When platforms display aggregated customer ratings, these "quality metrics" also serve as anchors for future evaluations. Because they embed ratings from biased customers, displayed averages memorialize past discrimination, transmitting it to otherwise unbiased customers and amplifying bias among discriminatory ones. We formalize this mechanism using a stylized analytical model and test it with data from an online labor platform. Allowing for unobserved heterogeneity, we identify three customer segments: a neutral segment, and two biased segments, one that cancels more minority-accepted jobs and another that both cancels more and rates minorities lower. All segments are impacted strongly by displayed ratings. Customer discrimination generates a rating gap of 36.1% and an estimated earnings gap via job loss of 5.2% between minority and majority workers. Notably, the unbiased segment produces discriminatory outcomes through spillovers. Adjusting displayed ratings reduces the gaps by mitigating the spillovers to the unbiased segment and amplification of the biased segments, but aggregate rating and earnings disparities persist because biased segments constitute a large share of the market.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平台评分系统是否会产生歧视性溢出效应并充当"歧视放大器"。通过分析模型和在线劳动力平台数据，发现显示的平均评分会传承来自有偏见客户的歧视，传导给原本无偏见的客户，并放大有偏见客户的歧视。调整显示评分能缩小但无法消除差距。
AI.research_question: 评分系统是否会产生歧视性溢出效应，并作为"歧视放大器"将客户歧视传导给无偏见客户并放大有偏见客户的歧视？
AI.motivation: 在线平台广泛使用聚合评分作为质量指标，但这些评分嵌入有偏见客户的评价，可能将过去的歧视"纪念化"并传导给未来的评估者，导致歧视的持续与放大，这一问题此前未被系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 锚定效应理论（显示评分作为未来评估的锚）、歧视传导与溢出效应理论。
AI.method: 构建简约分析模型，利用在线劳动力平台数据，允许未观测异质性的方法识别三个客户细分群体（中性群体、取消更多少数族裔工作的有偏见群体、既多取消又给少数族裔更低评分的有偏见群体）。
AI.findings: 所有客户群体都强烈受到显示评分的影响；客户歧视导致少数族裔与多数族裔之间36.1%的评分差距和5.2%的收入差距（通过工作取消）；无偏见群体通过溢出效应产生了歧视性结果；调整显示评分可以通过缓解对无偏见群体的溢出和对有偏见群体的放大来缩小差距，但由于有偏见群体占市场较大份额，总体评分和收入差距仍然存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并实证检验了评分系统作为"歧视放大器"的机制，揭示了显示评分将过去歧视传导至无偏见客户的溢出效应，深化了对平台评分系统和歧视动态关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计评分展示机制提供政策建议——调整显示评分可以减轻歧视溢出和放大效应，但需认识到在偏见群体占主导的市场中，单靠调整评分无法根除不平等。

title: Popularizing Sustainable Consumption through Augmented Reality: A Visual and Auditory Sensory Perspective from Indian Online Shoppers
affiliations: REVA University and REVA University

detail.title: Popularizing Sustainable Consumption through Augmented Reality: A Visual and Auditory Sensory Perspective from Indian Online Shoppers
detail.abstract: This study investigates the role of augmented reality (AR) in popularising sustainable consumption through visual and auditory sensory engagement in online shopping, with particular reference to Indian consumers. Moving beyond its conventional commercial applications, AR is conceptualised as a science and technology popularisation tool capable of enhancing public awareness of eco-friendly products and responsible consumption practices. The findings demonstrate that AR-enabled shopping experiencesincorporating immersive 3D visualisations, interactive product trials, and auditory information cuessignificantly influence consumers' purchase decisions toward environmentally sustainable alternatives. By improving product understanding and reducing purchase uncertainty, AR contributes to more informed decision-making and lower product return rates, thereby supporting sustainable resource use. Furthermore, the study highlights the potential of AR to empower rural entrepreneurs, artisans, and small-scale producers by enabling them to present sustainable products to wider audiences in engaging and informative ways. Overall, the research aligns with broader goals of environmental conservation, community development, and sustainable resource management, offering actionable insights for policymakers, educators, and marketers seeking to design socially relevant sustainability initiatives through technology-driven interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了增强现实（AR）作为科技传播工具在促进印度消费者可持续消费中的作用，发现AR购物体验（包括3D可视化、互动产品试用和听觉信息提示）能显著影响消费者的购买决策，推动其选择环境可持续的替代品，并减少产品退货率。此外，AR还能赋能农村企业家、手工艺者和小型生产者扩大可持续产品的市场覆盖，为政策制定者、教育者和营销者提供设计可持续发展倡议的实践洞察。
AI.research_question: 增强现实（AR）如何在网络购物中通过视觉和听觉感官参与促进印度消费者的可持续消费？
AI.motivation: 传统上AR主要被应用于商业用途，本研究试图超越其常规商业应用，将AR概念化为一种科学技术传播工具，以提升公众对环保产品和负责任消费习惯的认识，特别是在印度消费者背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科学和技术传播理论（AR作为科普工具）、感官参与理论（视觉与听觉参与）、可持续消费与决策理论。
AI.method: 实证研究，考察AR购物体验（沉浸式3D可视化、互动产品试用、听觉信息提示）对消费者购买决策的影响，研究背景为印度消费者在线购物情境。
AI.findings: （1）AR赋能购物体验显著影响消费者对环保可持续替代品的购买决策；（2）AR通过改善产品理解和降低购买不确定性，促进更明智的决策并降低产品退货率，从而支持资源可持续利用；（3）AR有潜力赋能农村企业家、手工艺者和小规模生产者，使其以更有吸引力和信息丰富的方式向更广泛受众展示可持续产品。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AR从单纯的商业营销工具重新概念化为科学技术传播工具，扩展了AR应用的理论视角；将感官参与理论与可持续消费决策理论相结合，丰富了可持续消费行为研究的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、教育者和营销者提供通过技术驱动干预设计社会相关可持续发展倡议的可操作性见解；为农村企业家、手工艺者和小规模生产者提供市场拓展工具；有助于减少产品退货率、支持可持续资源利用，契合环境保护、社区发展和可持续资源管理的更广泛目标。

title: Technical Specification for the Scientific Discovery Operating System: Mathematical Formalization and Engineering Architecture -A Proceduralized Knowledge Discovery Protocol Based on the Factor Hierarchy Law and Testability Norms

detail.title: Technical Specification for the Scientific Discovery Operating System: Mathematical Formalization and Engineering Architecture -A Proceduralized Knowledge Discovery Protocol Based on the Factor Hierarchy Law and Testability Norms
