AI.practical_contributions: 发布了一套完整、开源、多格式的分区地理数据集及配套工具，可直接服务于诺伊达的城市管理、空间分析和规划决策，同时保留了官方sector体系作为源地理，实现了新旧两套空间参照体系的互补与衔接。

title: National trends and territorial disparities in psychiatry residency fill rates in France: a longitudinal panel study, 2016–2026
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: National trends and territorial disparities in psychiatry residency fill rates in France: a longitudinal panel study, 2016–2026
detail.abstract: Background: Mental health needs are increasing across Europe, while psychiatric workforce planning in France is challenged by workforce ageing and territorial inequalities. Objective: To assess national trends in psychiatry residency fill rates in France and examine the territorial distribution of unfilled positions from 2016–2017 to 2025–2026. Methods: We conducted a nationwide retrospective longitudinal panel study including all 28 French residency subdivisions over 10 academic years. Opened and filled positions were extracted from decrees published in the French Official Journal. Fill rates were modelled using a beta-binomial generalised linear mixed model. Heterogeneity was quantified using the median odds ratio, and concentration using the Gini coefficient and top-share estimates. Results: The panel included 280 subdivision-year observations, corresponding to 5282 opened, 4719 filled, and 563 unfilled positions. Observed national fill rates declined from near-complete levels before 2019 to 82.49% in 2019–2020 and remained below pre-2019 levels thereafter. The model-based national fill rate decreased from 98.10% in the early period to 82.74% in the late period, an absolute change of -15.4 percentage points. Between-subdivision heterogeneity was substantial. Unfilled positions were territorially concentrated and the top 25% of subdivisions accounted for 61.3% of all unfilled positions. Conclusions: Psychiatry residency underfilling in France has become a sustained, territorially uneven workforce planning issue. In centralised rank-based allocation systems, workforce planning should monitor not only the number of training positions opened, but also their conversion into filled positions and the territorial accumulation of vacancies.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于法国全部28个精神科住院医师培训分区、10个学年的国家级面板数据，系统评估了法国精神科住院医师职位填充率的时间趋势及地域分布。研究发现国家填充率从2019年前近乎满额（98.10%）降至后期82.74%，且未填充职位高度集中在少数分区（前25%分区占全部空缺的61.3%）。研究揭示法国精神科住院医师填充不足已成为持续且地域不均衡的劳动力规划问题。
AI.research_question: 法国精神科住院医师职位的填充率呈现怎样的全国趋势？未填充职位在地域上的分布特征如何？
AI.motivation: 欧洲精神卫生需求不断增长，而法国的精神科劳动力规划面临人员老龄化和地域不平等的双重挑战，亟需了解住院医师培训填充状况以指导劳动力规划。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于集中化排名匹配（centralised rank-based allocation）的劳动力规划理论，运用中位数比值比（MOR）量化地域异质性，运用基尼系数和顶部份额估计量化集中程度。
AI.method: 全国性回顾性纵向面板研究，涵盖2016-2017至2025-2026共10个学年、28个法国住院医师培训分区。数据源自法国官方公报发布的法令。采用beta-binomial广义线性混合模型建模填充率，用中位数比值比衡量异质性，用基尼系数和顶部份额估计衡量集中度。
AI.findings: 共纳入280个分区-年度观测，对应5282个开设职位、4719个填充职位和563个未填充职位。国家填充率从2019年前的接近满额下降至2019-2020年的82.49%，此后持续低于2019年前水平。模型估计的国家填充率从早期的98.10%降至后期的82.74%，绝对变化为-15.4个百分点。分区间的异质性显著，前25%的分区占全部未填充职位的61.3%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对法国精神科住院医师填充率进行覆盖全部培训分区的系统性纵向建模分析，将地域异质性和集中度量化纳入劳动力规划研究框架，为集中化分配系统中理解"职位开设"与"职位填充"之间的转化问题提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法国及其他采用集中化排名匹配系统的国家提供政策启示：劳动力规划不应仅关注开设培训职位数量，还应监测职位的实际填充情况以及空缺职位的地域累积，以应对精神科劳动力短缺和地域不平等问题。

title: A Landslide but Not a Mandate: Putin's Re-Election & the Russo-Ukrainian War
affiliations: Charles University in Prague - Faculty of Law

detail.title: A Landslide but Not a Mandate: Putin's Re-Election & the Russo-Ukrainian War
detail.abstract: This paper measures dynamic beliefs about Vladimir Putin and the Russo-Ukrainian War surrounding the 2024 Russian presidential election. I leverage the staggered timing of the Panel Study of Russian Public Opinion and Attitudes (PROPA) survey in an event study design. I find roughly a 7.2 percentage point (p.p.) decline in two measures for Putin's approval and a 10.5 p.p. increase in trust towards Russians who fled the country following the 24 February 2022 invasion of Ukraine. Omitting strongly polarized responses (i.e., restricting the analysis to marginal responses on these issues), I find an 8.9 p.p. decline in trust towards federal television, a 7.2 p.p. increase in perceived likelihood of a new mobilization campaign (next 12 months), and a 12.6 p.p. decline in the perceived likelihood of a ceasefire (next 12 months). These short-run results suggest that Putin's landslide re-election should not be interpreted as a mandate for the continuation of his wartime policies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2024年俄罗斯总统选举前后PROPA调查的错峰采样设计，评估选举事件对俄罗斯民众关于普京及俄乌战争动态信念的影响。研究发现选举后普京支持率下降约7.2个百分点，对逃离俄罗斯民众的信任度上升10.5个百分点；在排除高度极化反应后，对联邦电视的信任下降8.9个百分点，预期新动员的可能性上升7.2个百分点，预期停火的可能性下降12.6个百分点。结果表明普京的压倒性连任不应被解读为对其战时政策的授权。
AI.research_question: 2024年俄罗斯总统选举如何影响俄罗斯民众关于普京和俄乌战争的动态信念？
AI.motivation: 挑战将普京压倒性连任解读为民众对其战时政策授权的传统观点，通过测量选举事件前后民众信念的动态变化来揭示真实民意。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究设计（event study design），利用调查错峰采样时间作为识别策略，测量动态信念变化。
AI.method: 利用俄罗斯公众舆论与态度小组研究（PROPA）调查的错峰调查时间，采用事件研究设计（event study）进行因果推断；同时进行敏感性分析，排除极化反应（仅保留边缘/边际反应）后重新检验结果。
AI.findings: （1）选举后普京支持率下降约7.2个百分点；（2）对逃离俄罗斯民众的信任度上升10.5个百分点；（3）排除极化反应后，对联邦电视的信任下降8.9个百分点；（4）预期未来12个月内新动员可能性上升7.2个百分点；（5）预期未来12个月内停火可能性下降12.6个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 为独裁政权下选举与民意动态的关系提供实证证据，表明在威权环境中压倒性选举胜利并不必然反映民众对战时政策的真实支持；方法上展示了利用调查错峰时间进行事件研究的识别策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际社会理解俄罗斯国内民意真实状态提供实证依据，有助于评估普京政权的政治稳定性和战时政策延续的民意基础；对分析威权国家选举结果与政策合法性之间的关系具有政策参考价值。

title: The State of Electronification in 2026: From Venue Adoption to Workflow Automation in Global Fixed-income and Foreign-exchange Markets
affiliations: Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: The State of Electronification in 2026: From Venue Adoption to Workflow Automation in Global Fixed-income and Foreign-exchange Markets
detail.abstract: A decade after the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) described electronic trading as a steadily advancing transformation of fixed-income markets, the central empirical question has changed. The issue is no longer simply whether trading is electronic, but where further electronification is occurring, how it is measured, and whether the headline adoption rate has begun to flatten. This review revisits the 2016 BIS framework and reconstructs its cross-asset benchmark for 2012 and 2015. It then extends that benchmark with the latest defensible public indicators available by mid-2026, drawing on the 2025 BIS Triennial Central Bank Survey, ISDA SwapsInfo, Coalition Greenwich, official regulatory reports and recent market-microstructure research. The evidence supports a qualified slowdown thesis. In highly standardised markets, including futures, benchmark sovereign debt and the most liquid foreign-exchange products, the transition from voice to electronic execution is mature and incremental gains are constrained by saturation. In corporate credit, by contrast, adoption has continued to rise materially, with US investment-grade and high-yield electronic shares reaching approximately 48% and 32%, respectively, in 2025. The remaining non-electronic flow is increasingly selected: it is larger, less liquid, more bespoke, more information-sensitive and more dependent on dealer capital. At the same time, the most consequential developments have migrated beyond the binary electronic/voice distinction toward auto-quoting, algorithmic execution, portfolio trading, all-to-all protocols, data aggregation, consolidated tapes and central clearing. We therefore propose that electronification in 2026 should be measured as a multi-layer market-structure vector rather than a single execution-share statistic. The review concludes that electronification has slowed in its first-order extensive margin, but continues rapidly in its intensive margin: the composition, automation, connectivity and resilience of electronic markets.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾并重构了BIS 2016年固定收益市场电子化交易框架，利用截至2026年中的最新公开数据（包括2025年BIS三年期中央银行调查、ISDA SwapsInfo等），检验了电子化交易增长放缓的论点。研究发现：在高度标准化的市场（期货、基准主权债、高流动性外汇）中，电子化已趋于饱和；但在公司信用市场仍在显著增长（2025年美国投资级约48%、高收益约32%）。更重要的是，电子化的核心发展已从简单的电子/语音二元区分转向自动报价、算法执行、组合交易、全对全协议等多层结构特征。因此，论文建议将电子化衡量从单一执行份额统计转变为多层市场结构向量。
AI.research_question: 在BIS 2016年描述电子交易为固定收益市场的稳步转型十年后，核心实证问题已从"是否电子化"转变为：进一步的电子化正在哪里发生？如何衡量？头条采用率是否已开始趋于平稳？
AI.motivation: 2016年BIS框架已过去近十年，需要重新审视其基准，并利用最新的公开数据检验电子化采用率是继续增长还是已经放缓。此外，电子化的本质发展已超越了简单的电子/语音二元区分，需要更精细的衡量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于BIS 2016年电子化交易框架，引入"广义边际与集约边际"的分析视角，区分电子化在第一维度的采用率（extensive margin）与技术深化（intensive margin）两个层面的进展。
AI.method: 文献综述与数据重构方法。该研究回溯2016年BIS框架，重构2012年和2015年的跨资产基准数据，并利用截至2026年中的最新公开指标进行扩展，数据来源包括2025年BIS三年期中央银行调查、ISDA SwapsInfo、Coalition Greenwich、官方监管报告及近期的市场微观结构研究。
AI.findings: （1）支持"有条件放缓"论点：在期货、基准主权债和最流动性外汇产品等高度标准化市场中，电子化已趋成熟，增量收益受饱和制约；（2）公司信用市场电子化仍在显著上升，2025年美国投资级和高收益电子化份额分别约达48%和32%；（3）剩余非电子化交易流具有选择性特征——规模更大、流动性更低、更定制化、信息敏感性更高且更依赖做市商资本；（4）最具影响力的发展已转向自动报价、算法执行、组合交易、全对全协议、数据聚合、统一行情和中央清算等超越电子/语音二元区分的领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将电子化衡量从单一执行份额统计（single execution-share statistic）升级为多层市场结构向量（multi-layer market-structure vector），为理解市场电子化提供了更全面、更动态的理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、市场参与者和研究者提供了最新的固定收益市场电子化全景图，明确了不同资产类别电子化所处阶段（饱和vs.增长），并指出了未来监管和投资关注的重点方向（如中央清算、数据整合等）。

title: Harm Reduction as Governance: An Integrated Decision Architecture for Policy, Recovery, and Health Systems
affiliations: University of Calgary

detail.title: Harm Reduction as Governance: An Integrated Decision Architecture for Policy, Recovery, and Health Systems
detail.abstract: Harm reduction implementation gaps in Canada and comparable jurisdictions are substantially associated with governance failures rather than evidence deficiencies. Core harm reduction interventions — opioid agonist therapy (OAT), naloxone distribution, needle and syringe programmes, and supervised consumption services — are supported by established evidence bases and endorsed by national guidelines, yet implementation across Canadian provinces and territories remains deeply inconsistent, with only two jurisdictions having stand-alone harm reduction policies as of the most recent comprehensive policy analysis.This paper proposes the Integrated Harm Reduction Systems Framework (IHRSF): a five-layer governance decision architecture for health authorities responsible for authorising, sustaining, and holding accountable harm reduction programmes. The IHRSF diagnoses governance failures across three dimensions (fragmentation, illegitimacy, invisibility) and six failure types, then addresses them through seven framework components, a twelve-step governance decision algorithm, and five mandatory accountability indicators.The framework is distinguished from existing approaches — including the Risk Environment Framework, Recovery-Oriented Systems of Care, and implementation science frameworks — by its operational function: it is designed to structure governance decisions prospectively, not to explain implementation variance retrospectively. Its accountability architecture requires a publicly maintained governance record that enables independent contestation of governance decisions. Five proposed accountability indicators — coverage rate, treatment linkage rate, equity-weighted mortality, community safety, and public reporting compliance — constitute the minimum governance performance standard.The IHRSF was derived through theoretically informed narrative synthesis across thirteen disciplinary domains. Its components and indicators are proposed standards that require prospective empirical validation. Five limitations are acknowledged: single-author synthesis, absence of prospective validation, Canadian primary context, the absence of Indigenous co-production in framework development, and the dependence of the accountability architecture on an independent review function external to the governance body.The IHRSF offers health authorities and policymakers a reproducible, transparent, and accountability-linked decision architecture for the governance of contested evidence-based interventions. Prospective application, independent evaluation, and co-production with people with lived and living experience of substance use are required to determine its effectiveness in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"综合减害系统框架"(IHRSF)，这是一个用于卫生当局管理减害项目的五层治理决策架构。该框架诊断了加拿大减害实施中因治理失灵（而非证据不足）导致的执行差距，通过三维度（碎片化、非法性、不可见性）和六类失败类型识别问题，并提供七项框架组件、十二步治理决策算法和五项强制性问责指标来解决。框架区别于现有方法的核心在于其前瞻性治理决策功能，而非回顾性解释实施差异。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个可复制的、透明的、与问责挂钩的治理决策架构，以解决加拿大及类似司法管辖区中减害干预措施（如阿片类激动剂治疗、纳洛酮分发、针具交换项目和监督消费服务）实施不一致的治理失灵问题？
AI.motivation: 加拿大各省和地区的减害干预实施极不一致（截至最近一次政策分析仅有两个辖区制定了独立的减害政策），而这种实施差距主要源于治理失败而非证据不足。核心减害干预措施已有成熟证据基础和国家级指南支持，因此需要一个系统化的治理框架来诊断并解决治理层面的障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合减害系统框架(IHRSF)——一个五层治理决策架构；治理失败诊断框架（碎片化、非法性、不可见性三个维度，六种失败类型）；区别于风险环境框架、恢复导向护理系统和实施科学框架。
AI.method: 理论驱动的叙事综合法（narrative synthesis），跨越十三个学科领域进行综合；框架推导后提出组件和指标作为需要前瞻性实证验证的标准。
AI.findings: 提出IHRSF完整架构：包括七项框架组件、十二步治理决策算法和五项强制性问责指标（覆盖率、治疗衔接率、公平加权死亡率、社区安全、公开报告合规性）。该框架的问责架构要求公开维护的治理记录，允许独立对治理决策提出质疑。
AI.theory_contributions: 与现有框架（风险环境框架、恢复导向护理系统、实施科学框架）相比，IHRSF的独特性在于其操作性功能：设计用于前瞻性地构建治理决策，而非回顾性地解释实施差异；其问责架构要求公开治理记录以实现独立的治理决策质疑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卫生当局和政策制定者提供可复制的、透明的、与问责挂钩的决策架构，用于治理有争议的循证干预措施；提出五项最低治理绩效标准指标，促进减害项目的系统性实施与问责。

title: The Open-Source Frontier AI Shock: Fear, Volatility, and the Repricing of Tech Giants (2025-2026)
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: The Open-Source Frontier AI Shock: Fear, Volatility, and the Repricing of Tech Giants (2025-2026)
detail.abstract: This study examines how a series of open-source frontier artificial intelligence releases from Chinese laboratories shook financial markets between January 2025 and July 2026. We use event study methods and daily panel regressions to measure how high-tech and software stocks reacted to each announcement. Unlike past financial crises, where fear spread broadly across the entire market, the AI shock was highly concentrated. The ratio of tech volatility to broad market volatility (VXN/VIX) surged to 1.73, a level higher than during the 2008 Financial Crisis or the COVID-19 crash. This shows that investors were specifically worried about open-source AI disrupting proprietary software businesses, not about a general economic collapse. Options traders rushed to buy put options on tech stocks to hedge against further declines. On the announcement day of the Kimi K3 release, incumbent software companies experienced a cumulative abnormal return of-0.63%, confirming that markets view open-weight Chinese AI models as a threat to industry profits and future cash flows.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用事件研究法和日度面板回归，分析了2025年1月至2026年7月期间中国实验室发布的一系列开源前沿AI模型对金融市场的冲击。研究发现，与以往金融危机中恐慌广泛蔓延不同，此次AI冲击高度集中在科技板块，VXN/VIX比率飙升至1.73，超过2008年金融危机和COVID-19崩盘时期的水平。期权交易者大量买入科技股看跌期权进行对冲，Kimi K3发布当天，在位软件公司累计异常收益为-0.63%，表明市场将中国开源AI模型视为对行业利润和未来现金流的威胁。
AI.research_question: 中国实验室发布的开源前沿AI模型如何在2025年1月至2026年7月期间冲击金融市场？这种冲击的传导机制和影响范围是什么？
AI.motivation: 以往关于金融危机的研究通常关注恐慌情绪的广泛蔓延，但开源AI模型的发布可能产生不同于传统金融危机的、高度集中的冲击模式。理解这种新型技术冲击对市场的影响机制，有助于揭示AI技术进步如何重塑行业竞争格局和资产定价逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究法（Event Study）、有效市场假说、资产定价理论、行业竞争与破坏性创新理论（关于开源AI对专有软件商业模式的颠覆）
AI.method: 事件研究法（Event Study Methods）测量各次公告的异常收益；日度面板回归（Daily Panel Regressions）分析高科技和软件股票的反应；使用VXN/VIX比率衡量科技板块与整体市场的相对波动；分析期权市场（看跌期权交易量）作为投资者对冲行为指标。
AI.findings: （1）AI冲击高度集中在科技板块，与广泛市场恐慌形成鲜明对比；（2）VXN/VIX比率飙升至1.73，超过2008年金融危机和COVID-19崩盘水平，表明投资者主要担忧开源AI对专有软件业务的破坏而非经济崩溃；（3）期权交易者大量购买科技股看跌期权以对冲下行风险；（4）Kimi K3发布当天，在位软件公司累计异常收益为-0.63%，确认市场将中国开源AI模型视为对行业利润和未来现金流的威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了事件研究法在技术冲击领域的应用，揭示了与传统金融危机截然不同的"集中式"技术冲击传导模式，为理解破坏性创新如何通过资本市场定价提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了识别技术冲击信号（如VXN/VIX比率、期权市场动向）的参考指标；为科技公司管理层理解开源AI竞争威胁提供了市场层面的量化证据；为政策制定者理解AI技术进步对资本市场稳定的影响提供参考。

title: Adjusting the Hamilton Filter for One-Off Extraordinary Events

detail.title: Adjusting the Hamilton Filter for One-Off Extraordinary Events
detail.abstract: Hamilton's (2018) forecast-based filter can produce a mechanical, spurious cycle spike when an one-off extraordinary observation such as the onset of Covid-19 later enters its trend projection as a covariate. This paper introduces the Adjusted Hamilton (AH) filter, an intervention layer for the canonical Hamilton specification. AH retains the observed event when estimating its contemporaneous cycle while preventing its reuse as a later forecasting covariate; instead AH uses recursively constructed counterfactuals estimated from pre-event data. The resulting revision separates exactly into a global coefficient-estimation effect and a local covariate-replacement effect. Influence measures quantify the importance of the event designation, and a counterfactual diagnostic assesses whether AH improves forecasts at exposed dates. A U.S. GDP illustration and controlled simulations show the scope of the adjustment and the cost of false designation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出调整性Hamilton (AH)滤波器，针对Hamilton (2018)基于预测的滤波器在遭遇一次性极端观测（如Covid-19爆发）时产生机械性虚假周期尖峰的问题。AH滤波器在估计当期周期时保留观测事件，但防止其作为后续预测协变量被重复使用，转而使用基于事件前数据递归构建的反事实值。该修正可精确分解为全局系数估计效应和局部协变量替换效应，并辅以影响力测度和反事实诊断工具。
AI.research_question: 如何修正Hamilton (2018)滤波器在遭遇一次性极端观测时产生的机械性虚假周期尖峰问题？
AI.motivation: Hamilton (2018)的预测基滤波器在面临一次性极端观测（如Covid-19疫情爆发）时，该观测会作为协变量进入后续的趋势预测，导致机械性虚假周期尖峰，扭曲周期估计结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hamilton (2018)预测基滤波器框架；反事实推理；干预分析（intervention analysis）；滤波器修正与分解理论。
AI.method: 提出调整性Hamilton (AH)滤波器作为Hamilton规范模型的干预层；采用递归构建的反事实值替代事件后期预测中的事件观测；将修正分解为全局系数估计效应与局部协变量替换效应；结合影响力测度与反事实诊断评估；通过美国GDP实例和受控模拟进行验证。
AI.findings: AH滤波器能有效抑制一次性极端观测导致的虚假周期尖峰；修正可精确分解为全局系数估计效应和局部协变量替换效应；美国GDP实例展示了调整的范围，受控模拟展示了错误指定事件的经济代价。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统识别并解决Hamilton滤波器在极端事件下的机械性虚假周期问题；提出精确分解修正效应的理论框架；引入反事实方法处理极端观测的滤波器理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济周期分析提供更稳健的滤波器工具；提供事件指定重要性量化和反事实诊断的实用工具；帮助研究者评估是否需要对异常事件进行干预处理及其成本。

title: "Justice" by Deception: The Immigration Regime's Longstanding Reliance on Fraud and Coercion
affiliations: Seton Hall Law School

detail.title: "Justice" by Deception: The Immigration Regime's Longstanding Reliance on Fraud and Coercion
detail.abstract:
In Donald Trump’s America, ICE agents arbitrarily and violently arrest, detain, and deport immigrants without regard for their family ties, work history, benefit to the community, or military service.  Masked ICE agents make arrests when parents are dropping off children at school, attending court hearings or ICE check-ins, getting medical attention, or exercising their constitutionally protected right to free speech.  This dystopian reality is utterly terrifying, and it is reaching new heights, but it is not entirely new.  There is a long history of the courts and Congress countenancing, and condoning, ICE’s reliance on fraud and deception as enforcement tools.

For as long as the U.S. has been regulating our borders, immigration agents have been relying on fraud, deception, and coercion to enforce immigration laws; they have been masquerading as police to gain entrance to immigrants’ homes, and have been deceiving asylum seekers by telling them they would be reunited with children or taken to another state, when in reality they were being deported.  This Article explores why deception and coercion have long been countenanced in immigration matters, and how this has provided fertile ground for the mass weaponization of immigration enforcement against such a large segment of the population.  To do so, this Article analyzes the ever-increasing criminalization of immigration law and of immigrants.  Casting immigrants as criminals in the public mind laid the foundation for using the same types of tactics in immigration matters as in criminal interrogations where public safety is at risk.  But immigration regulation is civil, rather than criminal.  Significantly, this means that the same types of constitutional protections that apply in the criminal context, such as the right to appointed counsel, the right against self-incrimination, and the right not to be punished twice for same crime, do not apply to immigration regulation.

In addition to exploring the normative foundation for coercive tactics in immigration law that have provided the bedrock for the current massive deportation machine, this Article analyzes constitutional, state, and federal laws that should prohibit this type of action.  Prior to the second Trump Administration, immigrants rarely challenged ICE coercion and fraud through litigation.  But the heightened enforcement and detention and deportation of long-standing often lawfully present immigrants and citizens has resulted in greater legal challenges. This Article analyzes these challenges as well as legislative and regulatory actions aimed at prohibiting deceptive practices and coercion in immigration enforcement.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国移民执法中长期存在的欺诈、欺骗和胁迫手段，分析其历史根源、宪法依据缺失以及特朗普执政下大规模武器化移民执法的法律挑战。
AI.research_question: 为什么欺诈和胁迫手段在移民执法中长期被容忍？这些手段如何被武器化，以及哪些宪法、州和联邦法律应当禁止此类行为？
AI.motivation: 在特朗普政府领导下，ICE特工以欺诈和暴力手段任意逮捕、拘留和驱逐移民，包括有家庭纽带、工作历史和社区贡献的长期合法居民，甚至公民也面临挑战。作者希望揭示这一现象的历史根源，并分析当前针对这些做法的法律挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移民法的刑事化理论——将移民视为罪犯为执法中采用类似刑事审讯中允许的欺骗和胁迫手段奠定了基础；同时论证移民监管本质上是民事而非刑事的，因此不适用刑事语境下的宪法保护（如指定律师权、反对自证其罪权、禁止双重处罚权）。
AI.method: 法律条文分析（宪法、州法和联邦法）、历史分析、诉讼案例分析和立法/行政行动分析
AI.findings: 移民执法中的欺骗和胁迫手段由来已久，其根源在于移民法的刑事化将移民贬低为罪犯。由于移民监管被视为民事而非刑事程序，宪法保护不适用，为这些手段提供了空间。第二次特朗普政府期间，针对长期合法居住移民和美国公民的高强度执法导致越来越多的法律挑战出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了移民法中欺骗和胁迫手段的规范性基础，论证了移民法的刑事化如何为大规模驱逐机器奠定基础，同时阐明了民事与刑事框架差异如何造成了宪法保护的结构性缺失。
AI.practical_contributions: 系统分析了当前挑战ICE欺诈和胁迫行为的宪法、州和联邦法律依据，以及相关的立法和监管行动，为移民法律师和倡导者提供诉讼和立法策略参考，旨在推动禁止移民执法中的欺骗性做法。

title: The Cognitive Friction of Money: Information-Theoretic Evaluation of a Fully Cashless Society

detail.title: The Cognitive Friction of Money: Information-Theoretic Evaluation of a Fully Cashless Society
detail.abstract: As digital transactions proliferate, public discourse often frames skepticism about cashless societies in terms of political concerns over state surveillance-such as the CBDC Anti-Surveillance State Act-while neglecting the underlying economic and psychological mechanisms. Setting aside these political dimensions, this paper employs Shannon entropy (H(X)) and Kullback-Leibler divergence (D KL (F ∥ G)) to rigorously evaluate the cognitive and macroeconomic consequences of monetary digitization. The results indicate that abstract digital interfaces attenuate loss aversion (λ eff → 1) and diminish the "pain of paying," thereby increasing money velocity (V T) and reducing liquidity preference (L(r, Y)). Empirical analysis challenges Rogoff's thesis, revealing only a weak correlation (R 2 = 0.2045) between cash use and shadow economy prevalence. To reconcile transactional efficiency with the need for cognitive discipline, this paper advocates a dual-layered approach: systematically phasing out high-denomination banknotes, legally protecting low-denomination cash ($1-$20), and mandating algorithmic UI/UX friction-including haptic cues, pre-transaction balance overlays, and unified liability dashboards-within digital payment ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用信息论工具（Shannon熵和KL散度）评估货币数字化的认知与宏观经济后果，发现数字界面削弱损失厌恶和"支付疼痛感"，从而增加货币流通速度并降低流动性偏好。实证分析质疑了Rogoff关于现金与影子经济相关的论点，并提出双层策略：逐步淘汰大面额纸币、保护小面额现金，并在数字支付系统中强制实施算法性UI/UX摩擦。
AI.research_question: 货币数字化如何通过认知和心理机制（而非政治维度）影响经济行为，以及如何在数字化进程中平衡交易效率与认知纪律？
AI.motivation: 公共话语常将现金社会怀疑论框架化为对政府监视的政治担忧（如CBDC反监视法案），而忽视了货币数字化背后的经济和心理机制，本文旨在弥补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Shannon熵（H(X)）与Kullback-Leibler散度（D_KL(F∥G)）作为信息论框架；损失厌恶理论（λ_eff→1）；"支付疼痛感"概念；货币数量论与流动性偏好理论（L(r,Y)）。
AI.method: 理论建模结合实证分析：利用信息论指标评估数字化界面导致的认知变化，并通过回归分析（R²=0.2045）检验现金使用与影子经济的相关性。
AI.findings: （1）抽象数字界面使损失厌恶系数趋近于1，削弱"支付疼痛感"；（2）这导致货币流通速度（V_T）增加与流动性偏好（L(r,Y)）下降；（3）现金使用与影子经济的相关性很弱（R²=0.2045），挑战了Rogoff的论点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信息论与行为经济学（损失厌恶、支付疼痛）相结合，为货币数字化提供了新的认知经济学分析框架，并实证反驳了Rogoff关于现金与影子经济关系的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出政策建议：逐步淘汰高面额纸币、法律保护小面额现金（$1-$20），并在数字支付系统中强制设置算法性UI/UX摩擦（触觉提示、交易前余额覆盖、统一责任看板）。

title: GLP-1 Treatment and Work Capacity
affiliations: ETH Zurich and

detail.title: GLP-1 Treatment and Work Capacity
detail.abstract: Using linked Finnish administrative records and a staggered difference-indifferences design, we estimate how starting semaglutide (Ozempic) affects work capacity, measured by medically certified sickness absence. The first purchase is followed by persistent use and improved glycemic control, indicating that recorded purchases correspond to sustained and clinically active treatment. The reduction in sickness absence is near zero during months 0-5, becomes progressively larger thereafter, and is largest during months 12-18. Averaged over event months 0-18, sickness allowance receipt falls by 16.9 percent and compensated days by 14.3 percent relative to pre-treatment means. The decline in full-day sickness absence is not offset by greater reliance on unemployment or partial sickness benefits. The results show that semaglutide improves work capacity and can generate economic benefits beyond its direct effects on metabolic health.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用芬兰行政记录和交错双重差分设计，发现司美格鲁肽（Ozempic）的起始使用显著降低了经医学认证的病假缺勤：在0-18个月内，病假津贴领取减少16.9%，补偿天数减少14.3%，表明该药物改善了工作能力并带来超出代谢健康直接效益的经济收益。
AI.research_question: 起始使用司美格鲁肽（Ozempic）如何影响工作能力，具体以经医学认证的病假缺勤为衡量指标？
AI.motivation: 司美格鲁肽作为GLP-1受体激动剂在临床上显著改善代谢健康，但其对工作能力这一更广泛社会经济结果的影响尚不清楚。评估药物对劳动市场表现的影响有助于全面理解其经济价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康资本理论，健康改善能够提升个体的劳动供给能力和生产力。本文利用交错双重差分（staggered difference-in-differences）框架，将药物使用视为一种"健康冲击"，考察其对劳动市场结果的影响。
AI.method: 使用芬兰行政关联数据，采用交错双重差分设计（staggered DID），以首次购买司美格鲁肽为处理事件，比较处理组与对照组在病假缺勤方面的差异，并按事件月份（0-18个月）动态追踪效应。
AI.findings: （1）首次购买后药物使用持续且血糖控制改善，确认购买记录对应持续且临床有效的治疗；（2）病假减少在0-5个月接近零，之后逐步增大，在12-18个月达到最大；（3）事件月0-18个月平均而言，病假津贴领取减少16.9%，补偿天数减少14.3%；（4）全日病假减少未被失业或部分病假福利的增加所抵消。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文扩展了健康经济学中关于药物干预对劳动市场结果影响的实证证据，证明了GLP-1受体激动剂类减肥药物不仅改善代谢健康，还能显著提升工作能力，为健康资本理论在肥胖/糖尿病治疗领域的应用提供了因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明司美格鲁肽可带来超出直接代谢健康改善的经济效益（减少病假、降低社会保障支出），为政策制定者、保险公司和雇主评估该药物的成本效益提供了重要依据。

title: The Shape of Care: Planning for Telemedicine Rollout under Heterogeneous Adoption
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, University of Pennsylvania, University of Pennsylvania, Pennsylvania State University and University of Pennsylvania - Department of Biostatistics, Epidemiology, and Informatics

detail.title: The Shape of Care: Planning for Telemedicine Rollout under Heterogeneous Adoption
detail.abstract: When a multi-hospital health system expands telemedicine, managers must decide, hospital by hospital and specialty by specialty, whether expansion will require changes to downstream capacity such as staffing, scheduling, and follow-up appointments. This decision is challenging because telemedicine adoption is uneven across hospitals, leaving many rollout targets with little or no local data, and because average downstream utilization masks the pathway-level changes that determine downstream capacity needs. We develop a multitask K-modal regression framework that forecasts, for each hospitalspecialty cell, how telemedicine rollout would change 90-day downstream charges. The framework decomposes downstream charges into pathway membership and the typical charge within each pathway, and borrows information across hospitals within the same specialty through a shared low-rank structure, thereby enabling prediction for hospitals with little or no telemedicine adoption. We establish finite-sample guarantees that quantify the benefits of information sharing while accounting for bias from hospital heterogeneity. Applying the framework to the University of Pennsylvania Health System across four hospitals and nine specialties, we obtain three managerial findings. First, rollout effects are highly concentrated: for eight of the nine specialties, expanding telemedicine to the highest observed adoption level leaves downstream care pathways largely unchanged. Second, Psychiatry is the primary exception, with lowadoption hospitals exhibiting substantial increases in the typical charge of the follow-up pathway. Third, leave-one-out validation accurately reconstructs follow-up pathway intensity when local telemedicine variation is removed, supporting planning for hospitals with no prior telemedicine adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个多任务K模态回归框架，用于预测远程医疗推广对每家医院-专科组合90天下游费用的影响。该框架将下游费用分解为路径归属和路径内典型费用，通过在相同专科内共享低秩结构来跨医院借用信息，使缺乏远程医疗采用数据的医院也能获得预测。应用于宾夕法尼亚大学健康系统的四家医院和九个专科，发现远程医疗推广效应高度集中（八个专科路径基本不变），精神科是主要例外（低采用率医院随访路径典型费用显著增加），且留一法验证能够准确重构随访路径强度。
AI.research_question: 多院区医疗系统扩展远程医疗时，管理者如何预测每家医院-专科组合的远程医疗推广对下游容量（如人员配备、排班、随访预约）的影响？具体而言，如何预测远程医疗推广对90天下游费用的变化？
AI.motivation: 远程医疗在不同医院的采用率不均衡，许多推广目标医院几乎没有本地数据；此外，平均下游使用量掩盖了决定下游容量需求的路径层面变化。因此需要一种能够在数据稀疏情况下进行预测的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多任务K模态回归框架（multitask K-modal regression framework），基于路径分解（pathway decomposition）和共享低秩结构（shared low-rank structure）的理论框架。
AI.method: 开发多任务K模态回归框架，将下游费用分解为路径归属和路径内典型费用两个部分；通过相同专科内跨医院共享低秩结构借用信息，实现对小样本或无样本医院的预测；建立有限样本保证以量化信息共享收益并考虑医院异质性偏差；使用留一法验证预测准确性。实证应用：宾夕法尼亚大学健康系统四家医院、九个专科。
AI.findings: 三个管理发现：（1）推广效应高度集中——九个专科中有八个专科将远程医疗扩展到最高观察采用水平后，下游护理路径基本不变；（2）精神科是主要例外——低采用率医院表现出随访路径典型费用的显著增加；（3）留一法验证能准确重构随访路径强度，支持为无远程医疗采用史的医院进行规划。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了多任务K模态回归框架，该框架能够分解下游费用为路径归属和路径内费用两个层次，并通过共享低秩结构实现跨医院信息借用；建立了有限样本理论保证，量化信息共享收益并处理医院异质性偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多院区医疗系统管理者提供了在远程医疗推广中预测下游容量需求的实用工具；识别出精神科是远程医疗扩展中需要特别关注下游容量调整的专科；为无远程医疗采用数据的医院提供了基于信息共享的规划方法。

title: Unequal Burdens: Female Labor Force Participation and Informality in the Global North and South During the 2019-2024 Polycrisis

detail.title: Unequal Burdens: Female Labor Force Participation and Informality in the Global North and South During the 2019-2024 Polycrisis
detail.abstract:
Abstract

The 2019–2024 polycrisis—including the COVID-19 pandemic, inflationary pressures, supply chain disruptions, and climate-related shocks—has reshaped female labor market outcomes across the world. This study investigates whether these crises generated divergent labor market responses in the Global North and the Global South by comparing the "She-cession" hypothesis with the "Distress Sale of Labor" hypothesis. Using harmonized labor market data from the International Labour Organization (ILO) and the World Bank, the analysis focuses on Germany, France, India, Brazil, and South Africa over the period 2019–2024.

The study employs descriptive analysis, Pearson's correlation, Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression, and paired sample t-tests to examine changes in female labor force participation, unemployment, and informal employment. The findings reveal a clear divergence. In the Global North, rising unemployment significantly reduced female labor force participation, supporting the She-cession hypothesis. In contrast, the Global South experienced a statistically significant increase in female labor force participation during the recovery period; however, this increase was accompanied by persistently high levels of informal employment, indicating a distress-driven expansion of labor supply rather than improved economic empowerment.

The results demonstrate that post-pandemic labor market recovery differed not only in magnitude but also in quality. While the Global North faced a temporary crisis of labor force participation linked to care constraints, the Global South experienced a structural increase in precarious and informal employment. These findings highlight the limitations of evaluating women's economic progress solely through participation rates and emphasize the need to incorporate employment quality into policy assessment. The paper recommends region-specific policy interventions, including strengthened childcare infrastructure in advanced economies and expanded social protection and income security measures in developing economies.

Keywords: Female Labor Force Participation; She-cession; Distress Sale of Labor; Informal Employment; Global North; Global South; Gender Inequality; COVID-19; Polycrisis; Development Economics; OLS Regression.

AI.tldr: 本文利用ILO和世界银行的协调劳动力市场数据，比较2019-2024年多危机时期全球北方（德国、法国）与全球南方（印度、巴西、南非）的女性劳动力市场响应，发现北方支持"她衰退"假说（失业率上升显著降低女性劳动参与率），而南方出现"劳动力困境出售"现象（女性劳动参与率上升但伴随持续高水平的非正规就业），表明复苏不仅在规模上存在差异，在质量上亦不同。
AI.research_question: 2019-2024年的多重危机是否在全球北方和全球南方引发了不同的女性劳动力市场响应？具体而言，"她衰退"假说与"劳动力困境出售"假说何者更能解释不同地区的女性劳动参与变化？
AI.motivation: 2019-2024年的多重危机（新冠疫情、通胀压力、供应链中断和气候冲击）深刻重塑了全球女性劳动力市场结果，但现有研究缺乏对全球北方与全球南方系统性比较，也鲜有研究将"她衰退"假说与"劳动力困境出售"假说放在同一分析框架下进行检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: "她衰退"（She-cession）假说：危机中女性劳动参与率因照护约束等原因下降；"劳动力困境出售"（Distress Sale of Labor）假说：危机中女性因家庭收入压力被迫进入劳动力市场，但多从事低质量、非正规工作。
AI.method: 使用ILO和世界银行的协调劳动力市场数据，覆盖2019-2024年德国、法国、印度、巴西和南非五国；采用描述性分析、皮尔逊相关分析、普通最小二乘（OLS）回归以及配对样本t检验。
AI.findings: 全球北方：失业率上升显著降低了女性劳动参与率，支持"她衰退"假说；全球南方：复苏期女性劳动参与率统计显著上升，但伴随持续高水平的非正规就业，表明劳动力供给扩张源于困境驱动而非经济赋权改善。后疫情复苏在规模和质量上均呈现区域分化。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在统一的跨国比较框架下同时检验"她衰退"与"劳动力困境出售"两个竞争性假说；揭示仅以劳动参与率评估女性经济进步具有局限性，强调需将就业质量纳入分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议发达经济体加强儿童照护基础设施建设；建议发展中经济体扩大社会保护和收入安全措施；为政策制定者提供了区分"数量"与"质量"维度的女性就业评估框架。

title: The Value of Behavioral Policies
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, Bocconi University, Australian National University (ANU) and Washington University in St. Louis

detail.title: The Value of Behavioral Policies
detail.abstract: Behavioral interventions have become central to modern public policy, but their empirical promise remains contested because estimated treatment effects often appear small. We argue that a policy response is economically meaningful only relative to the response generated by alternative policies. We assemble more than 1,200 estimates from over 600 studies comparing "nudges" and traditional price interventions in the markets for cigarettes, alcohol, influenza vaccination, electricity, and residential water. Translating nudge effects into equivalent price changes, we find that behavioral interventions often correspond to enormous fiscal interventions, from an 11% tax on electricity to a 100% subsidy on influenza vaccinations. Nudges are also more cost-effective than price instruments in all markets, but cost-effectiveness does not predict the welfare ranking of policies. Using a behavioral extension of the Marginal Value of Public Funds, we show that nudges have high welfare returns at the margin, while price instruments often generate larger total surplus at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文通过整合超过600项研究、1200多个估计值，比较了行为干预（助推）与价格干预在五个市场（香烟、酒精、流感疫苗、电力、住宅用水）中的效果，发现助推措施通常对应巨大的财政干预规模（如11%的电税或100%的疫苗补贴），且在成本效益上优于价格工具，但在边际福利回报和总盈余规模上各有优势。
AI.research_question: 行为干预（助推）的政策效果相对于传统价格干预在经济意义上是否具有可比性？其成本效益和福利排序如何？
AI.motivation: 行为干预已成为现代公共政策的核心工具，但其估计的治疗效果通常看起来很小，导致其经验价值备受争议。作者认为，政策反应是否有经济意义取决于与替代政策的相对比较，而非绝对效应大小。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的助推理论、边际公共资金价值（Marginal Value of Public Funds）的行为扩展框架、成本效益分析。
AI.method: 荟萃分析：收集超过600项研究、1200多个效应估计值，比较助推与价格干预在五类市场中的效果；将助推效应转化为等价的税收/补贴变化；计算成本效益并应用行为扩展的边际公共资金价值（MVPF）框架进行福利分析。
AI.findings: 助推措施常对应巨大的财政干预当量（从11%的电税到100%的疫苗补贴）；在所有市场中助推比价格工具更具成本效益；但成本效益不预测政策的福利排序；在边际上助推具有较高的福利回报，而价格工具在大规模实施时通常产生更大的总盈余。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为干预与价格干预纳入统一的比较框架；提出行为扩展的边际公共资金价值（MVPF）模型，将助推与财政工具在福利经济学框架下进行系统比较；区分了边际福利回报与规模化总盈余的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了跨政策类型（助推vs.价格工具）的系统比较证据；帮助决策者理解助推政策在经济意义上的实际规模，避免因表面效应较小而低估其价值；为选择干预工具提供了成本效益和福利层面的决策依据。

title: Bridging the distance: Evaluating Chile's Institutional and Digital Competitiveness in the Era of U.S. Strategic Shoring

detail.title: Bridging the distance: Evaluating Chile's Institutional and Digital Competitiveness in the Era of U.S. Strategic Shoring

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: The disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic and the escalation of U.S.-China trade tensions revealed structural vulnerabilities in global supply chains that had been optimized primarily for cost efficiency. In response, the concept of strategic shoring emerged as a framework for relocating supply chain operations toward countries that share institutional and democratic standards with the United States (Savoy, 2023). This paper evaluates Chile's potential as a destination within that framework, focusing on three dimensions: democratic stability and rule of law, the bilateral Free Trade Agreement in force since 2004, and digital infrastructure. While Chile's geographic distance from the United States-approximately 8,500 kilometers-presents a clear disadvantage for goods-based trade, the analysis suggests that for high-value service operations, institutional reliability and digital connectivity may outweigh physical proximity. The paper also examines Chile's limitations, including its small domestic market, unresolved social tensions, and vulnerability to shifts in U.S. policy priorities.

AI.tldr: 本文评估智利作为"战略近岸外包"（strategic shoring）目的地的潜力，重点考察民主稳定性与法治、2004年生效的双边自由贸易协定、以及数字基础设施三个维度。尽管智利与美国的物理距离（约8500公里）在货物贸易上是明显劣势，但对于高价值服务业务而言，制度可靠性和数字连通性可能比物理邻近性更重要。文章同时分析了智利的局限性，包括国内市场规模小、未解决的社会紧张局势以及对美国政策变化的脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 智利是否适合作为美国"战略近岸外包"框架下的供应链转移目的地？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情和美中贸易紧张暴露了全球供应链因过度追求成本效率而产生的结构性脆弱性，因此需要探索将供应链转移到与美国共享制度和民主标准的国家。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略近岸外包（strategic shoring）框架，强调供应链应转向与本国制度与民主标准一致的伙伴国家。
AI.method: 三维度评估分析：民主稳定性与法治、双边自由贸易协定（2004年生效）、数字基础设施。
AI.findings: 智利在地理距离上对货物贸易不利（距美约8500公里），但对高价值服务业务而言，制度可靠性和数字连通性可抵消物理距离劣势；同时智利存在市场规模小、社会矛盾未解、易受美国政策变化影响等局限。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"战略近岸外包"框架提供了关于地理距离与制度/数字因素在服务贸易中相对权重的分析视角，拓展了该框架从货物贸易向服务贸易的适用性讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国企业和政策制定者评估智利作为供应链伙伴的可行性提供了系统分析，也为智利在吸引战略近岸外包投资方面的优劣势提供了参考。

title: When Political Uncertainty Mimics Efficiency under the Adaptive Markets Hypothesis: Peru as a Rare Case Today, a Precedent for Tomorrow?

detail.title: When Political Uncertainty Mimics Efficiency under the Adaptive Markets Hypothesis: Peru as a Rare Case Today, a Precedent for Tomorrow?
detail.abstract: This paper examines how extreme domestic political uncertainty disrupts expectation formation in the Peruvian stock market, causing market dynamics to appear as statistical efficiency-lower return predictability-rather than the temporary inefficiency predicted by the standard Adaptive Markets Hypothesis. Using weekly data from 1990 to 2026, the study applies parametric and nonparametric rolling variance ratio tests to compare global shocks and domestic political events, supported by fractional logit regressions for the latter. The evidence reveals a sharp asymmetry. Global crises, such as the Great Recession and the COVID-19 pandemic, generate temporary return predictability, consistent with investors relying on imperfect heuristics before adapting. By contrast, domestic political shocks produce the opposite pattern. Elections involving radical or outsider candidates and episodes of institutional crisis reduce return predictability, moving the market toward statistical efficiency. This does not indicate better information processing, but a breakdown in expectation formation under extreme regime uncertainty. Comparative evidence from Latin America suggests that Peru's party-system collapse and weak institutionalization explain this distinctive response. The paper shows that institutional fragility can reshape, and even invert, standard adaptive-market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文以秘鲁股市1990-2026年周度数据为样本，运用参数与非参数滚动方差比检验并结合分数logit回归，发现极端国内政治不确定性会使股市呈现"统计效率提升-预测力下降"的表象，而非标准适应性市场假说所预测的暂时性无效率。全球危机（如大衰退、新冠疫情）产生暂时性收益可预测性，而国内政治冲击（激进/局外人候选人选举、制度危机）反而降低可预测性、使市场趋向统计效率——这并非信息处理更优，而是极端制度不确定性下预期形成的崩溃。拉丁美洲比较证据表明，秘鲁政党体系崩溃与制度弱化解释了这种独特反应。
AI.research_question: 极端国内政治不确定性如何扰乱股票市场中的预期形成，并如何影响收益可预测性与市场效率的动态表现？
AI.motivation: 标准适应性市场假说预测冲击会产生暂时性无效率（收益可预测性上升），但现有研究主要关注全球性冲击，对国内政治不确定性可能产生的相反效应缺乏理论解释与实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 适应性市场假说（Adaptive Markets Hypothesis）、预期形成理论、制度经济学（制度脆弱性与政党制度崩溃）。
AI.method: 参数与非参数滚动方差比检验（比较全球冲击与国内政治事件），辅以分数logit回归分析国内政治事件的影响，并利用拉丁美洲跨国比较证据进行佐证。
AI.findings: 全球危机产生暂时的收益可预测性（符合AMH）；而国内政治冲击（激进候选人选举、制度危机）降低收益可预测性，推动市场向统计效率方向移动，但这种趋近效率源于预期形成的崩溃而非更优的信息处理；秘鲁政党体系崩溃与弱制度化是这一独特反应的根源。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了适应性市场假说，证明了制度脆弱性可以重塑甚至逆转标准的适应性市场动态；区分了"统计效率"与"信息处理效率"两个概念，表明统计效率并不总是市场理性的标志。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者理解新兴市场（特别是制度不稳国家）在政治冲击下的市场行为提供了实证参考，提示在极端政治不确定性下市场预测模型的适用性需重新评估。

title: Robust Currency Cointegration using Bayesian Optimization
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Singapore Management University, Singapore University of Social Sciences and Singapore Management University - Lee Kong Chian School of Business

detail.title: Robust Currency Cointegration using Bayesian Optimization
detail.abstract: Traditional econometric methods for cointegration analysis like the Johansen test are optimized for in-sample performance.  For portfolio managers, this often yields fragile,  unstable solutions, leading to high turnover and volatile out-of-sample performance. This paper reframes the portfolio approach as a Bayesian optimization (BO) problem, shifting the objective from in-sample statistical significance to out-of-sample portfolio stability and tradability.  By optimizing a dual-objective function that balances statistical stationarity with economically meaningful variation, the BO framework identifies globally robust cointegrating vectors.  Empirical analysis on G10 currencies from 2010 to 2024 demonstrates that BO portfolios exhibit substantially more stable cointegrating weights, leading to significantly lower portfolio turnover and better risk-adjusted returns compared to traditional benchmarks.  These results offer a resilient blueprint for practitioners seeking to integrate machine learning with classical econometrics to build durable trading strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将投资组合协整分析重构为贝叶斯优化（BO）问题，通过优化平衡统计平稳性与经济意义的双目标函数，识别全局稳健的协整向量。基于2010-2024年G10货币的实证表明，BO组合的协整权重更稳定，组合换手率显著降低，风险调整后收益优于传统基准。
AI.research_question: 如何将协整分析从传统的样本内统计显著性优化转向样本外组合稳定性与可交易性优化，以构建更稳健的投资组合？
AI.motivation: 传统的协整分析方法（如Johansen检验）以样本内表现为优化目标，导致组合权重脆弱且不稳定，产生高换手率和波动的样本外表现，难以满足投资组合管理者的实际需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协整理论、贝叶斯优化（BO）框架、双目标优化函数（统计平稳性与经济意义的平衡）
AI.method: 将组合构建问题重构为贝叶斯优化问题，优化双目标函数以同时考虑统计平稳性和经济意义的变异，识别全局稳健的协整向量；对2010-2024年G10货币进行实证分析。
AI.findings: BO组合相对于传统基准表现出显著更稳定的协整权重、更低的组合换手率以及更好的风险调整后收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机器学习（贝叶斯优化）与经典计量经济学（协整分析）相结合，重新定义了协整组合优化的目标函数——从样本内统计显著性转向样本外稳健性与可交易性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合管理者提供了一套整合机器学习与传统计量经济学以构建持久交易策略的韧性蓝图，显著降低换手率和交易成本，改善风险调整后回报。

title: Lex Doctrina: The Doctrinal Floor for Artificial Intelligence Competence in U.S. Legal Education
affiliations: New York Law School

detail.title: Lex Doctrina: The Doctrinal Floor for Artificial Intelligence Competence in U.S. Legal Education
detail.abstract:
Legal education has treated the integration of artificial intelligence into the curriculum as a matter of institutional discretion. This Article argues that framing is wrong and has been wrong since a specific date. ABA Accreditation Standard 301, Model Rule of Professional Conduct 1.1 Comment 8, and ABA Formal Opinion 512, issued July 29, 2024, together establish a doctrinal floor: a binding obligation, already in force, that accredited American law schools teach the competence to use generative artificial intelligence tools without compromising the duty of independent verification that now governs their use in practice.

The Article's method is conservative. It proposes no new rule. It shows that existing instruments, read together as courts and regulators already read them, compel a conclusion the academy has not yet drawn. It draws that conclusion from three converging bodies of evidence: an empirical record showing legal hallucination rates as high as eighty-eight percent in general-purpose models; a rapidly accumulating case law record running from Mata v. Avianca through a 2026 Quebec Superior Court decision annulling an arbitral award for an arbitrator's undisclosed delegation of judgment; and a parallel architecture of state regulation in California, New York, and Florida that is already defining what technological competence requires. Drawing on the Carnegie Foundation's three apprenticeships and the MacCrate Report's statement of lawyering skills and values, the Article translates the doctrinal floor into a model competence standard organized around three categories of AI use, distinguished by their relationship to the formation of professional judgment.

The question facing law schools is not whether to adapt their curricula to artificial intelligence. It is how quickly they can implement an obligation that has already attached.

AI.tldr: 本文论证美国法律教育界对AI融入课程的"机构裁量"框架是错误的。自2024年7月29日ABA正式意见512发布起，ABA认证标准301、职业行为示范规则1.1评注8及ABA正式意见512共同建立了约束性义务：经认证的美国法学院必须教授学生使用生成式AI工具的能力，同时不得违背实践中已确立的独立核验义务。文章采用保守方法，不提出新规则，而是基于三个证据体系（高幻觉率实证记录、累积判例法、州级监管架构），将这一教义底线转化为围绕三类AI使用之专业判断形成的模型胜任力标准。
AI.research_question: 美国法学院是否以及何时负有教授学生使用生成式人工智能工具之能力的约束性义务？
AI.motivation: 法律教育界一直将AI融入课程视为机构自主裁量事项，但本文认为现有法律文件（ABA认证标准301、职业行为示范规则1.1评注8、ABA正式意见512）共同已构成具有约束力的教义底线，学院尚未认识到这一已生效的义务。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卡内基基金会的三种学徒制（three apprenticeships）理论；MacCrate报告关于律师技能与价值的陈述。
AI.method: 保守的法律分析方法：不提出新规则，而是证明现有法律文件在法院和监管机构既有解读方式下共同得出某一必然结论。依据三类证据：1）实证记录（通用模型中法律幻觉率高达88%）；2）从Mata v. Avianca到2026年魁北克高等法院判例的累积判例法记录；3）加州、纽约和佛罗里达州的州级监管架构。
AI.findings: ABA认证标准301、职业行为示范规则1.1评注8与ABA正式意见512共同建立了已生效的约束性义务：经认证的法学院必须教授生成式AI工具的胜任使用能力，同时保持独立核验义务。文章将此教义底线转化为围绕三类AI使用（按其与专业判断形成的关系区分）的模型胜任力标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 将法律教育的AI课程整合从"裁量性问题"重构为"已生效的约束性义务"；通过卡内基学徒制与MacCrate报告将抽象教义底线转化为可操作的三类别胜任力标准框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国法学院提供明确的课程改革紧迫性依据和实施框架；将三类AI使用分类模型作为课程设计的操作指南，帮助法学院快速落实已存在的法律义务。

title: Estimating a Process of Health Formation in Older Adults: The Roles of Physical Functioning, Cognition, and Mental Health
affiliations: SUNY at Stony Brook University, College of Arts and Science, Department of Economics and State University of New York (SUNY), Stony Brook

detail.title: Estimating a Process of Health Formation in Older Adults: The Roles of Physical Functioning, Cognition, and Mental Health
detail.abstract: Health in older adults evolves along multiple, interdependent dimensions. This paper develops and estimates a dynamic model of health formation that distinguishes physical, cognitive, and mental domains. The model is estimated using a comprehensive set of health measures from the Health and Retirement Study. The results reveal novel patterns of complementarity across the health domains. Physical health plays a central role, serving as a significant determinant of mental health as well as of employment, health investment, and mortality. Mental health is an important determinant of employment and mortality, but it is found to be more transitory and to have little feedback on the other health domains. The model is used to identify the periods in which targeted health domains have the largest impacts and generate the greatest spillovers across domains. Finally, we map the latent domains to commonly used measures such as self-reported health, clarifying which aspects of health drive variation in these widely used indicators.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并估计了一个老年人健康形成的动态模型，将健康分解为身体、认知和心理三个维度，利用健康与退休研究（HRS）数据估计模型，发现各健康维度之间存在互补性，且身体健康处于核心地位，对心理健康、就业、健康投资和死亡率均有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 老年人健康的多维度（身体、认知、心理）如何动态形成并相互影响？各健康维度在生命周期不同阶段的相对重要性如何？
AI.motivation: 老年人健康沿着多个相互依存的维度演化，以往研究往往将健康视为单一维度，忽略了身体、认知和心理健康之间的动态互补关系及其对就业、投资和死亡率的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康资本动态形成理论（基于Grossman健康生产模型），多维度健康互补性理论
AI.method: 利用Health and Retirement Study（HRS）的综合健康数据，构建并估计动态结构模型，将健康分解为身体、认知和心理三个潜在维度。
AI.findings: （1）各健康维度之间存在互补性；（2）身体健康处于核心地位，是心理健康、就业、健康投资和死亡率的重要决定因素；（3）心理健康是就业和死亡率的重要决定因素，但更具暂时性，对其他健康维度反馈很小；（4）不同时期对特定健康维度的干预会产生不同的溢出效应；（5）潜健康维度可以映射到自报健康等常用指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在多维度框架下系统刻画了身体、认知、心理健康之间的动态互补关系，明确了身体健康的核心枢纽作用，并识别了各维度在不同生命阶段的影响时间窗口。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果可为政策制定者识别最优健康干预时机提供依据，明确哪些时期干预哪些健康维度能产生最大的跨维度溢出效应；同时澄清了自报健康等常用指标究竟反映哪些潜在健康维度，有助于更好地解读实证研究中常用的健康测量指标。

title: Two Selection Problems, One Bias Term: Experimental Sign-Up Is Treatment Choice in Disguise
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics

detail.title: Two Selection Problems, One Bias Term: Experimental Sign-Up Is Treatment Choice in Disguise
detail.abstract: Consider a referee report containing the sentence: "Assignment to treatment was voluntary, though the authors acknowledge this as a limitation in the conclusion." The Editor would summarily reject. Now replace "assignment to treatment" with "entry into the experimental sample," and the sentence describes the modal published experiment. This study shows that both biases are the same mathematical object. The bias from non-random sample entry is the sorting-on-gains term from the classic selection decomposition. Interestingly, they both admit an isomorphic Roy micro-foundation and inverse-Mills characterization. A simple calibration reveals that for the typical experiment, the observed bias can be large. One solution to this bias is to conduct a natural field experiment (NFE). When an NFE is not possible, three alternative reporting practices are offered.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了实验样本非随机进入（voluntary entry into experimental sample）与处理分配非随机（assignment to treatment）所导致的偏差在数学上是同一个对象，即经典选择分解中的sorting-on-gains项。两者具有同构的Roy微观基础和逆Mills比率特征，且校准显示典型实验中的该偏差可能很大。作者提出自然田野实验（NFE）作为解决方案，并在无法实施时提供三种替代性报告实践。
AI.research_question: 实验研究中样本非随机进入所产生的偏差与处理分配非随机所产生的偏差，在数学结构上是否相同？这种偏差在典型实验中有多大，以及如何解决？
AI.motivation: 学术界的双重标准：处理分配非随机被审稿人视为致命缺陷（编辑直接拒稿），但样本进入非随机却是已发表实验的常态（modal published experiment），无人质疑。本文旨在揭示这两种偏差的本质同一性，并挑战这种不一致的学术审稿标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典选择分解框架（selection decomposition）中的sorting-on-gains项；Roy模型（Roy micro-foundation）；逆Mills比率（inverse-Mills ratio）特征化。
AI.method: 理论推导证明两种偏差的数学等价性；通过同构映射建立Roy微观基础；利用逆Mills比率进行特征化；进行简单的校准分析（calibration）以量化典型实验中的偏差规模。
AI.findings: 两种偏差是同一个数学对象（sorting-on-gains项）；它们具有同构的Roy微观基础和逆Mills比率特征；校准显示典型实验中该偏差可能很大；自然田野实验（NFE）是解决此偏差的途径之一。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在理论上证明样本选择偏差与处理分配偏差的数学同一性，打通了两个看似独立的文献（实验设计和经典选择模型），为实验偏差分析提供了统一的数学框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实验研究者提供了实践指导：优先采用自然田野实验（NFE）；当NFE不可行时，提出三种替代性报告实践以透明化偏差；同时呼吁学术审稿标准的一致性。

title: Hierarchical PANI@Cu₀.₉₅V₂O₅@Carbon Cloth Composites Enabling Self-Powered Flexible Multimodal Sensing for Parkinsonian Handwriting Recognition
affiliations: Hebei University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Hebei University, Hebei University, Hebei University, Hebei University and Hebei University

detail.title: Hierarchical PANI@Cu₀.₉₅V₂O₅@Carbon Cloth Composites Enabling Self-Powered Flexible Multimodal Sensing for Parkinsonian Handwriting Recognition
detail.abstract: Flexible electronic technology is rapidly advancing toward intelligence, self-powering, and multi-scenario adaptability. However, critical bottlenecks remain unresolved: most functional materials possess a single performance and thus fail to simultaneously realize sensing and energy storage capabilities. Herein, flexible carbon cloth (CC) was employed as the substrate to successfully construct PANI@Cu0.95V₂O₅@CC composite electrode materials, which feature a hierarchical polyaniline (PANI) coating architecture, via a synergistic combination of hydrothermal synthesis and electrodeposition coating techniques. Performance characterization reveals that the pressure sensor delivers an ultrahigh sensitivity of 1.2 × 10⁴ kPa⁻¹, a broad pressure detection range spanning 0–200 kPa, remarkable durability over 8000 cycles, and a fast, consistent response and recovery time of 83 ms. The gas sensor, in turn, enables accurate detection of ethanol at concentrations from 1 to 100 ppm. Meanwhile, the photoelectric sensor exhibits superior performance in the visible spectrum, with its photocurrent varying from 10 to 100 mW·cm-2. Furthermore, the PCC-derived zinc-ion battery achieves a specific capacity peak of 231 mAh·g-1, retaining 90% of its initial capacity after 2000 charge–discharge cycles. The pressure sensor was integrated with the zinc-ion battery, and a self-powered sensing system was constructed by incorporating deep learning algorithms, which achieved accurate recognition of handwritten strokes between healthy individuals and patients with Parkinson’s disease. This work provides a novel approach for the design and preparation of multifunctional composite materials, and also opens up a new technical pathway for the development of self-powered wearable electronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过水热合成与电沉积的协同方法，在柔性碳布上构建了PANI@Cu0.95V₂O₅@CC层级复合电极材料，同时实现了压力传感、气体传感、光电传感和锌离子电池储能等多重功能，并集成了基于深度学习算法的自供电传感系统，用于帕金森病患者手写笔迹的精准识别。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和制备一种兼具传感与储能多种功能的柔性复合电极材料，并构建自供电的可穿戴电子设备系统？
AI.motivation: 柔性电子技术正朝着智能化、自供电和多场景适应性方向发展，但大多数功能材料性能单一，无法同时实现传感和储能能力，成为关键瓶颈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于层级聚苯胺包覆结构的复合材料设计理论，结合水热合成与电沉积的协同制备原理，以及自供电传感系统与深度学习算法的集成框架。
AI.method: 采用水热合成与电沉积涂层协同的方法，在柔性碳布基底上构建PANI@Cu0.95V₂O₅@CC复合材料；对压力传感、气体传感、光电传感和锌离子电池性能进行系统表征；将压力传感器与锌离子电池集成，结合深度学习算法构建自供电传感系统。
AI.findings: 压力传感器灵敏度高达1.2×10⁴ kPa⁻¹，检测范围0-200 kPa，8000次循环后仍具优异耐久性，响应/恢复时间83 ms；气体传感器可检测1-100 ppm乙醇；光电传感器在可见光谱下光电流随10-100 mW·cm⁻²变化；锌离子电池比容量峰值231 mAh·g⁻¹，2000次循环后保持90%容量；自供电系统可准确区分健康人与帕金森病患者的手写笔迹。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种多功能复合电极材料的设计与制备新方法，验证了层级PANI包覆结构在传感与储能性能协同提升中的可行性，为多功能柔性电子材料研究提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自供电可穿戴电子设备的开发开辟了新路径，尤其在医疗健康监测（如帕金森病的早期识别与诊断辅助）方面展现了广阔的应用前景，同时有助于提升可穿戴装置在多样场景下的综合性能。

title: Deep Learning for Stenosis Assessment and Intraplaque Neovascularization Grading in Carotid Artery Using Contrast-Enhanced Ultrasound Video
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Shanghai General Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Shanghai General Hospital and

detail.title: Deep Learning for Stenosis Assessment and Intraplaque Neovascularization Grading in Carotid Artery Using Contrast-Enhanced Ultrasound Video
