detail.abstract: The rapid integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into healthcare and social services has exposed a fundamental mismatch. Commercial AI is engineered for cloud-based, centralized, and largely static operation, optimized for the economics of consumer search, retail recommendation, and marketing content. Human care systems operate on the opposite set of terms: decentralized, privacy-sensitive, continuously changing, and answerable to statutory and accreditation obligations that carry no equivalent in the commercial internet. When a model built for one environment is dropped into the other, the mismatch does not stay theoretical. It shows up as PHI transiting servers an organization does not control, as unpredictable per-token bills that compete with direct care budgets, and as generalist models that reason about Medicaid eligibility with the same statistical looseness they bring to writing ad copy.

AI.tldr: 本文指出商业大型语言模型（LLMs）与医疗和社会服务系统之间存在根本性不匹配：商业AI为云端集中化、静态运行而设计，而人类照护系统需要去中心化、隐私敏感、持续变化且受法规约束的运营方式。
AI.research_question: 商业LLM被直接部署到医疗和社会服务机构时，会产生哪些结构性不匹配问题？这些不匹配如何表现为具体的运营和伦理风险？
AI.motivation: LLM正被快速整合进入医疗和社会服务，但商业AI的设计范式与照护系统的运营逻辑存在根本性冲突，这种冲突在实践中会造成患者隐私泄露、预算不可控和决策质量下降等具体危害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文章基于"系统-环境匹配"框架，对比商业互联网领域（云集中化、消费经济学驱动）与照护服务领域（去中心化、隐私敏感、法规约束）的运营逻辑差异。
AI.method: 概念性/批判性分析，通过列举具体失败场景（PHI数据传输、按token计费、通用模型推理医疗资格）来论证不匹配问题。
AI.findings: 不匹配表现为三类具体问题：1) 受保护健康信息（PHI）流经不受组织控制的服务端；2) 不可预测的按token计费与直接照护预算竞争；3) 通用模型在处理Medicaid资格等专业问题时表现出与商业文案同样程度的统计宽松性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"环境不匹配"理论视角，将AI系统性能问题重新定义为部署环境与设计范式的结构性冲突，而非单纯的技术缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗和社会服务组织在选择AI解决方案时提供风险识别框架，提示需要评估隐私合规、成本可预测性和领域专业性三个关键维度。

title: When the Crowd Came Back: Crowd Removal, Partial Recovery, and the Persistence of Home Referee Bias in NCAA Men's Basketball
affiliations: Texas Tech University

detail.title: When the Crowd Came Back: Crowd Removal, Partial Recovery, and the Persistence of Home Referee Bias in NCAA Men's Basketball
detail.abstract: Does referee bias toward home teams return once the crowds that produce it come back? I follow the home advantage in referee-dependent outcomes, fouls called and free throws awarded, across 22 seasons of NCAA Division I men's basketball (2004-05 through 2025-26), spanning the 2020-21 spectator shutdown and the five seasons that followed. Before the pandemic, this advantage scales continuously with attendance, and the same gradient appears across the varied attendance policies of 2020-21 itself. It is absent from skill outcomes that foul calls cannot affect and from neutral-site games. When spectators returned, the bias only partly followed. Attendance regained 87% of its pre-pandemic level by 2022-26, but the home foul advantage regained just 62% of its shutdown decline, a shortfall too large for the remaining attendance gap to explain and robust to pre-existing trends. The evidence suggests that officiating practice shifted during the pandemic and did not reset: crowds set the level of referee home bias, but the shutdown moved its baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2004-05至2025-26赛季NCAA一级男子篮球22个赛季的数据，研究裁判主场偏误在观众回归后是否恢复。研究发现，疫情前裁判偏误随上座率连续变化，疫情停摆期间该梯度依然存在，但观众回归后，尽管上座率恢复了87%，裁判偏误仅恢复了停摆期间下降幅度的62%，表明裁判执裁实践发生了持久性转变。
AI.research_question: 产生裁判主场偏误的观众回归后，这种偏误是否也随之恢复？
AI.motivation: 2020-21赛季因疫情导致观众停摆，这提供了一个独特的机会来检验观众对裁判偏误的影响是否是可逆的，以及裁判行为是否会在环境变化后发生持久性改变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 裁判社会性偏误理论——观众压力影响裁判决策；行为惯性/路径依赖理论——环境变化可能导致行为基准线的持久性移动。
AI.method: 利用NCAA一级男子篮球22个赛季的面板数据，比较疫情前、疫情停摆期（2020-21赛季）及疫情后五个赛季（2021-22至2025-26）中裁判依赖型结果（犯规次数、罚球次数）的主场优势变化，并控制技能型结果和中性场地比赛作为反事实对照。
AI.findings: （1）疫情前裁判偏误随上座率连续增加；2020-21赛季不同上座政策下该梯度依然存在。（2）偏误不出现于罚球无法影响的技能型结果及中性场地比赛。（3）观众回归后，上座率恢复了疫情前87%水平，但裁判偏误仅恢复了停摆期下降幅度的62%，该差距无法由剩余的上座率差距解释，且对既有趋势稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了环境冲击对裁判行为影响的非对称性：观众水平设定了裁判主场偏误的幅度，但疫情停摆使偏误基准线发生了持久性下移，表明裁判执裁实践中存在路径依赖效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为体育管理机构理解裁判偏误的动态变化提供经验证据，提示即使观众环境恢复，裁判行为可能不会自动回归原有水平，需关注执裁标准的长期一致性。

title: The Cognitive Sovereignty Trilemma: Gen Z, Generation Alpha, and the Structural Impossibility of Sustainable Institutional AI Capability

detail.title: The Cognitive Sovereignty Trilemma: Gen Z, Generation Alpha, and the Structural Impossibility of Sustainable Institutional AI Capability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent practitioner-scholar. The frameworks and outcomes described in this paper were developed through direct executive engagement across enterprise AI transformation programs. No external funding was received for this research. No conflicts of interest are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is based on practitioner case evidence from enterprise programs in which the author held direct executive responsibility. All organizational references have been anonymized where appropriate to protect confidentiality. No human subjects research, patient data, or formal experimental methodology was employed. Formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author is an independent practitioner-scholar. The frameworks and outcomes described in this paper were developed through direct executive engagement across enterprise AI transformation programs. No external funding was received for this research. No conflicts of interest are declared.

detail.abstract:
The literature on Sovereign AI-the growing consensus that nations and enterprises must own, govern, and develop indigenous artificial intelligence capability independent of foreign or vendor dependency-has proceeded on a structural assumption it has never explicitly examined: that the human capital required to build and sustain institutional AI capability can be continuously replenished. This paper demonstrates that this assumption is not merely difficult to satisfy; it is becoming structurally impossible under the generational workforce conditions now entering the enterprise. This paper introduces the Cognitive Sovereignty Trilemma, derived from Dani Rodrik's Political Trilemma of the World Economy (2000): no nation or enterprise can simultaneously achieve Cognitive Sovereignty (indigenous AI ownership and institutional capability), Generational Workforce Continuity (sustained AI fluency through Gen Z and Gen Alpha workforce cohorts), and Human Capital Economic Viability (positive return on workforce AI capability investment when skill half-life is shorter than or equal to workforce tenure). Any two of these three objectives can be pursued; all three are structurally incompatible under emerging workforce conditions.
The paper introduces seven original constructs formalizing this incompatibility. The Generational Trust Discount (GTD) quantifies the reduction in institutional trust horizon as workforce composition shifts from Millennials to Gen Z to Gen Alpha. The Human Capital Depreciation Acceleration (HCDA) Index formalizes the condition under which AI skill obsolescence rates exceed workforce training investment recovery cycles, producing structural negative ROI on institutional AI capability development. The Interface Cognition Workforce (ICW) describes the Gen Alpha cohort whose knowledge construction and trust calibration were shaped entirely by AImediated environments before entering the workforce. The Incentive Alignment Gap formalizes the rational conflict between the organization’s need for sovereign-specific human capital and the worker’s rational preference for market-portable general capability. Organizational Amnesia names the progressive loss of tacit institutional context through compressed tenure. The Compliance and Audit Vulnerability identifies the regulatory exposure created when sovereign AI human audit trails depart faster than compliance obligations expire. The Dead Hand Governance Paradox establishes the structural limit of automating institutional memory: agents encoding departed workers’ judgment, supervised by a workforce cognitively unable to evaluate that judgment. The Sovereignty Trap describes the resulting governance failure state in which Sovereign AI objectives and sustainable human capital economics are simultaneously nonnegotiable but mutually exclusive. Six testable propositions establish an empirical research agenda at the intersection of labor economics, organizational behavior, generational theory, and AI governance.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了主权AI文献中一个未被检验的结构性假设——人力资本可以持续补充——并论证在代际劳动力条件变化下该假设已变得结构性不可能。论文提出"认知主权三难困境"（Cognitive Sovereignty Trilemma），证明任何国家或企业都无法同时实现认知主权、代际劳动力连续性和人力资本经济可行性三个目标，并引入七个原创构念及六个可检验命题来形式化这一不相容性。
AI.research_question: 主权AI所需的人力资本是否能够在当前及未来的代际劳动力条件下被持续补充？认知主权、代际劳动力连续性与人力资本经济可行性三者能否同时实现？
AI.motivation: 主权AI文献普遍假设建设和维持制度性AI能力所需的人力资本可以持续补充，但这一假设从未被明确检验。本文旨在证明该假设在进入企业的Z世代和Alpha世代劳动力条件下不仅难以满足，而且在结构上变得不可能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Dani Rodrik的"世界经济政治三难困境"（2000）理论，推导出"认知主权三难困境"：认知主权、代际劳动力连续性和人力资本经济可行性三者不可兼得。同时整合劳动经济学、组织行为学、代际理论与AI治理的交叉视角。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念形式化研究方法。论文提出七个原创构念（Generational Trust Discount、Human Capital Depreciation Acceleration Index、Interface Cognition Workforce、Incentive Alignment Gap、Organizational Amnesia、Compliance and Audit Vulnerability、Dead Hand Governance Paradox、Sovereignty Trap），并建立六个可检验命题形成实证研究议程。
AI.findings: 在任何三个目标（认知主权、代际劳动力连续性、人力资本经济可行性）中最多只能追求两个，三者在新兴劳动力条件下结构性地不相容。具体表现为：AI技能半衰期短于或等于劳动力任期时，机构AI能力投资产生结构性负回报；代际信任折扣导致制度信任视野缩短；Gen Alpha的接口认知劳动力在进入职场前即受AI中介环境塑造。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对主权AI文献中的人力资本可持续性假设进行明确检验并证伪；将Rodrik的三难困境框架拓展至AI治理与人力资本领域；提出一套系统化原创构念（共八个），填补了AI治理与组织行为、代际理论交叉领域的理论空白；建立了主权AI治理失败状态（Sovereignty Trap）的理论描述。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国家和企业制定主权AI战略提供结构性约束的预警框架；揭示组织在AI人力资本投资中面临负面回报风险的量化指标（HCDA Index）；指出合规与审计漏洞（Compliance and Audit Vulnerability），帮助组织识别监管风险；为AI治理中的自动化制度记忆（Dead Hand Governance Paradox）提供警示，指导组织在人类监督与自动化之间的平衡决策。

title: The Microeconomics of Blob Inclusion: Pricing and Ranking Misalignments under a Multidimensional Fee Mechanism
affiliations: Hokkaido University and Hokkaido University

detail.title: The Microeconomics of Blob Inclusion: Pricing and Ranking Misalignments under a Multidimensional Fee Mechanism
detail.abstract: This article develops a microeconomic theory of the builder's transaction inclusion decision under a multidimensional fee mechanism (EIP-4844) by modeling the allocation of blob capacity as a 0-1 knapsack problem that internalizes the latency opportunity costs that blob inclusion imposes on Maximal Extractable Value extraction. The analysis identifies a two-level misalignment in the current multidimensional fee mechanism. At the pricing-tool level, the execution-layer gas priority fee is forced to internalize consensus-layer latency opportunity costs. At the ranking-rule level, builders' practical per-gas sorting algorithms admit no constant-factor approximation guarantee, whereas sorting by perblob compensation attains the fractional optimum. This algorithmic inefficiency explains the asymmetric competition among different types of Layer-2 rollups and reveals how varying builder characteristics distinctly shape block resource allocation. Extending the framework to address joint competition for gas and blob capacities, the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions demonstrate that additive shadow prices aggravate the pricing misalignment, and that no efficient sorting rule exists under joint binding. Finally, the analysis evaluates a per-blob priority fee reform and concludes that it remains a partial solution to these structural inefficiencies.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个微观经济理论模型，将EIP-4844多维费用机制下的构建者交易包含决策建模为0-1背包问题，揭示了当前多维费用机制在定价工具层面和排序规则层面存在的双重错位，并评估了per-blob优先费改革的局限性。
AI.research_question: 在EIP-4844多维费用机制下，构建者的交易包含决策如何受到blob容量分配的影响？当前机制存在哪些结构性低效？
AI.motivation: EIP-4844引入了多维费用机制（执行层gas费用与共识层blob费用分离），但现有机制可能导致定价错位和排序算法低效，需要理论化分析其结构性缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微观经济理论、0-1背包问题模型、Karush-Kuhn-Tucker条件、最大可提取价值（MEV）理论、算法近似比分析
AI.method: 将blob容量分配建模为0-1背包问题，内化blob包含对MEV提取施加的延迟机会成本；通过KKT条件分析gas与blob容量联合竞争下的影子价格；比较不同排序规则（per-gas vs per-blob）的近似保证。
AI.findings: （1）定价工具层面：执行层gas优先费被迫内化共识层的延迟机会成本，产生错位；（2）排序规则层面：per-gas排序算法无常数因子近似保证，而per-blob排序可达到分数最优；（3）该算法低效解释了不同类型L2 rollup之间的不对称竞争；（4）联合竞争下加性影子价格加剧定价错位，且不存在高效的排序规则；（5）per-blob优先费改革只是部分解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将EIP-4844多维费用机制下的构建者决策形式化为0-1背包问题，揭示了定价工具与排序规则两个层面独立的错位机制，并证明算法低效是理解L2竞争不对称性的关键理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为EIP-4844机制改进和per-blob优先费改革提供了理论评估框架，指出当前改革方案的局限，为协议设计者和L2 rollup运营者提供决策参考。

title: Defending the Well: Cognitive Defence as a Structural Layer of Intelligence Production

detail.title: Defending the Well: Cognitive Defence as a Structural Layer of Intelligence Production

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable — this study is based entirely on publicly available secondary sources (investigative reports, governmental disclosures, and platform threat reports) and did not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This article argues that defence against foreign information manipulation and interference (FIMI) has been mistakenly treated as a discipline adjacent to intelligence rather than as a structural layer within it. Through a single deeply documented case — the Doppelganger campaign, a Russia-linked operation that clones legitimate news outlets to corrupt the open-source environment on which modern intelligence depends — supported by two contrasting operations, it shows why the classical process models cannot even represent an adversary who attacks the intelligence enterprise's own inputs. It contends, and restates as a set of falsifiable propositions, that cognitive defence must operate concurrently across collection, analysis and dissemination, and draws out the doctrinal, verification and liaison implications for intelligence studies.

AI.tldr: 本文论证"外国信息操纵与干扰"（FIMI）防御不应被视为与情报相邻的学科，而应作为情报体系的结构性层级。通过深入分析"Doppelganger"案例（一个克隆合法新闻媒体以污染现代情报所依赖的开放源码环境的俄罗斯关联行动），辅以两个对比性行动，文章展示经典过程模型甚至无法表征这种攻击情报企业自身输入端的对手。文章主张认知防御必须在情报的收集、分析和分发三个环节同时运作，并提炼为一系列可证伪命题，揭示其对情报研究的理论、验证和联络方面的启示。
AI.research_question: 外国信息操纵与干扰（FIMI）防御为何应被视为情报体系内部的结构性层级，而非与情报相邻的独立学科？经典情报过程模型为何无法表征针对开放源码环境的对手行动？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将FIMI防御视为情报的相邻学科，忽略了对手可以直接攻击情报企业自身输入端（开放源码环境）这一关键问题，导致经典过程模型无法应对此类新型威胁，亟需重构理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典情报过程模型（collection-analysis-dissemination）、认知防御理论、FIMI（外国信息操纵与干扰）概念框架
AI.method: 单一深度案例研究（Doppelganger行动）辅以两个对比性行动的定性分析
AI.findings: 经典过程模型无法表征攻击情报输入端（开放源码环境）的对手；认知防御必须在收集、分析和分发三个环节同时运作；提出一组可证伪命题以重构情报防御理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 将FIMI防御从"相邻学科"重新定位为"情报内部结构性层级"，突破经典过程模型的表征局限，提出可证伪的认知防御命题框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为情报界提供认知防御在收集、分析、分发全链条同步运作的实践指导，以及关于教义、验证和联络方面的具体启示。

title:
Extended Bio-echolocation and Hybrid Sensor-fusion Assistive System: 
A 3D Spatial Audio, Haptic Array, and Deep-learning-Based Neuro-substitution Architecture for Visually Impaired Individuals, with an Integrated Emergency (112) Call Subsystem

detail.title:
Extended Bio-echolocation and Hybrid Sensor-fusion Assistive System: 
A 3D Spatial Audio, Haptic Array, and Deep-learning-Based Neuro-substitution Architecture for Visually Impaired Individuals, with an Integrated Emergency (112) Call Subsystem

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or commercial affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work, designs, algorithms, or conclusions reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently as a conceptual design and architecture proposal without any commercial bias or corporate sponsorship.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant, funding, or financial support from agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. All hardware specification analyses, software developments, system architecture designs, and theoretical formulations were conducted entirely using the author's personal resources and independent research efforts.

detail.abstract:
This paper presents an end-to-end redesign of a non-invasive, wearable assistive system for visually impaired individuals that combines principles of biological echolocation (the bat sonar mechanism), multi-layer sensor fusion (a solid-state LiDAR, a dual ultrasonic array, and an RGB-D depth camera), a 16-channel micro-haptic matrix, and three-dimensional spatial audio synthesis. Unlike earlier versions, this revision places user safety at the core of the system: the device now includes an independent Emergency (SOS) subsystem that can autonomously reach the 112 Emergency Call Center in the event of a fall, a collision, or a conscious request from the user, relay location information, and notify pre-defined contacts. The paper comprehensively presents the mathematical and acoustic formulations, the full circuit schematic, the FreeRTOS-based embedded firmware, usage scenarios, a realistic cost analysis, and an academic bibliography. 


By eliminating the limited physical range and elevation blind spots of the traditional white cane, the system uses AI-assisted semantic object recognition (YOLOv8-Nano, INT8-quantized) to classify obstacles in the environment. It detects the relative distance of objects and, through neuroplasticity, conveys a 3D spatial "perception map" to the user's auditory and tactile senses. The most critical addition in this version is a multi-stage SOS architecture that lets the user silently or automatically call for help at the moment of physical danger (a fall, a traffic accident, becoming lost).

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种面向视障人士的端到端可穿戴辅助系统的重新设计，融合生物回声定位原理、多层传感器融合（固态LiDAR、双超声波阵列、RGB-D深度相机）、16通道微触觉矩阵和三维空间音频合成。系统通过AI辅助语义物体识别（YOLOv8-Nano，INT8量化）分类环境障碍物，并新增独立紧急SOS子系统，可在跌倒、碰撞或用户主动请求时自主拨打112紧急呼叫中心，传输位置信息并通知预设联系人。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种非侵入式、可穿戴的辅助系统，在消除传统白手杖物理范围和仰角盲区限制的同时，为用户提供3D空间感知，并在危急时刻确保用户安全（自动呼救）？
AI.motivation: 传统白手杖存在有限物理范围和仰角盲区的局限性，无法全面保障视障人士的出行安全。此外，视障人士在遭遇跌倒、碰撞或迷路等危险情况时缺乏可靠的自动求救机制，需要一个更安全、更全面的辅助系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生物回声定位原理（蝙蝠声呐机制）、神经可塑性、多传感器融合理论
AI.method: 系统采用端到端设计：固态LiDAR、双超声波阵列和RGB-D深度相机进行多层传感器融合；AI辅助语义物体识别（YOLOv8-Nano，INT8量化）进行障碍物分类；16通道微触觉矩阵和三维空间音频合成向用户传递3D空间"感知地图"；独立的多级紧急SOS架构实现自动或静默呼救。论文涵盖数学与声学公式、完整电路原理图、基于FreeRTOS的嵌入式固件、使用场景及成本分析。
AI.findings: 系统消除了传统白手杖的物理范围和仰角盲区限制，能够检测物体的相对距离并通过神经可塑性向用户的听觉和触觉传递3D空间感知。新增的SOS子系统可在跌倒、交通事故或迷路等危险时刻自动或静默呼叫帮助，实时传递位置信息并通知预设联系人。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生物回声定位原理与多传感器融合技术相结合，提出了通过神经可塑性将3D空间感知地图传递给视障人士的完整理论与声学框架，为可穿戴辅助系统的感知-反馈通路提供了系统化的理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一整套可实现的工程方案，包括完整电路原理图、FreeRTOS嵌入式固件、真实成本分析和使用场景说明。最重要的实践贡献是设计并实现了独立的SOS紧急子系统，能够在跌倒、碰撞等危急时刻自动连接112紧急呼叫中心并通知预设联系人，显著提升了视障用户的安全保障水平。

title: Beyond Blockchains: Navigating the Metaverse
affiliations: , Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering and Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering

detail.title: Beyond Blockchains: Navigating the Metaverse
detail.abstract: The Metaverse is emerging as a transformative concept, combining blockchain technology, immersive virtual environments, and decentralized governance to create shared digital ecosystems. However, the growing scale of the Metaverse exposes challenges in scalability, interoperability, and energy efficiency, demanding innovative solutions. This paper explores the limitations of traditional blockchain systems and proposes advanced technologies such as Layer-2 protocols, consensus mechanisms, and interoperability frameworks. Experimental analysis of these solutions demonstrates their potential in addressing challenges and enabling scalable, interoperable, and immersive Metaverse ecosystems. Statistical analysis and code implementations validate the feasibility of these approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了元宇宙作为变革性概念，结合区块链技术、沉浸式虚拟环境和去中心化治理，分析了传统区块链系统在可扩展性、互操作性和能源效率方面的局限性，并提出Layer-2协议、共识机制和互操作性框架等先进技术解决方案，通过实验分析和代码实现验证了这些方案的可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过先进区块链技术（Layer-2协议、共识机制、互操作性框架）解决元宇宙在可扩展性、互操作性和能源效率方面的挑战？
AI.motivation: 元宇宙的快速发展暴露了传统区块链系统在可扩展性、互操作性和能源效率方面的局限性，需要创新解决方案来支撑大规模、可互操作的沉浸式元宇宙生态系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区块链技术理论、Layer-2扩展协议、共识机制理论、互操作性框架
AI.method: 实验分析方法：通过统计分析验证所提出技术解决方案的有效性，并结合代码实现验证方案可行性。
AI.findings: 所提出的Layer-2协议、共识机制和互操作性框架在解决元宇宙可扩展性、互操作性和能源效率挑战方面表现出潜力，统计分析和代码实现验证了这些方法的可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为元宇宙背景下区块链技术的应用提供了理论框架，提出并验证了支撑大规模元宇宙生态系统的先进区块链技术解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为元宇宙平台开发者和区块链从业者提供了可实施的技术方案，包括Layer-2协议、共识机制和互操作性框架的实践指导。

title: Quality-Constrained Preference Fading for Discrete Diffusion Recommendation
affiliations: Yunnan Normal University, Yunnan Normal University, Yunnan Normal University and Yunnan Normal University

detail.title: Quality-Constrained Preference Fading for Discrete Diffusion Recommendation
detail.abstract: Discrete diffusion models have recently shown promise in recommender systems by casting recommendation as a process of preference fading and growth over a discrete item space. However, existing methods typically replace items through uniform random sampling during forward preference fading. In large and sparse recommendation spaces, this strategy often produces corrupted preference states with limited information, providing insufficient discriminative supervision for reverse denoising and ultimately constraining top-K recommendation performance.To address this limitation, we propose Quality-Constrained Preference Fading(QCPF), which reformulates the replacement distribution as a quality-aware mixture. This mixture dynamically integrates random negatives to maintain exploration coverage, in-batch hard candidates to provide discriminative signals,and popularity-based proxy negatives to reflect exposure patterns. QCPF further employs a lightweight false-negative-aware filtering mechanism that removes invalid replacements based on item identity and users' interaction histories,thereby improving the reliability of forward preference-fading trajectories. As a training-only enhancement to the forward process, QCPF preserves the original diffusion transition structure at inference time and introduces no additional learnable parameters or inference-time operations. Extensive experiments on five public real-world benchmark datasets show that QCPF consistently improves both Hit Rate (HR) and Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG) across top-K recommendation settings. These results demonstrate that constructing informative and reliable forward corruption trajectories is critical to improving discrete diffusion-based recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出质量约束偏好衰减（QCPF）方法，通过将离散扩散模型中的前向替换分布重构为质量感知混合分布，结合随机负样本、批内困难候选和流行度代理负样本，并引入轻量级假阴性感知过滤机制，以构建更具信息量和更可靠的前向腐蚀轨迹，从而提升基于离散扩散的推荐系统性能。
AI.research_question: 如何改进离散扩散推荐模型中前向偏好衰减过程的信息质量，以增强反向去噪的判别性监督并提升Top-K推荐性能？
AI.motivation: 现有离散扩散推荐模型在前向偏好衰减中使用均匀随机采样替换物品，在大型稀疏推荐空间中会产生信息有限的腐蚀偏好状态，导致反向去噪缺乏足够的判别性监督，限制了Top-K推荐性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 离散扩散模型；偏好衰减与增长过程；质量感知混合分布（随机负样本、批内困难候选、流行度代理负样本）；假阴性感知过滤机制。
AI.method: 提出QCPF方法，将替换分布重构为质量感知混合分布，动态整合三类负样本来源；采用轻量级假阴性感知过滤机制，基于物品身份和用户交互历史去除无效替换；作为仅训练阶段的前向过程增强，推理时保持原始扩散转移结构，不引入额外可学习参数或推理开销。
AI.findings: 在五个公开真实世界基准数据集上进行的大量实验表明，QCPF在Top-K推荐设置下一致提升了命中率（HR）和归一化折损累计增益（NDCG）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示构建信息丰富且可靠的前向腐蚀轨迹对提升离散扩散推荐性能的关键作用，提出质量感知混合替换分布与假阴性感知过滤机制以改进前向过程。
AI.practical_contributions: QCPF是仅训练阶段的增强方法，推理时保持原始结构，不增加可学习参数或推理时操作，易于集成到现有离散扩散推荐系统中，可实际提升Top-K推荐效果。

title: Architectural Trust: Why Consumer Trust in Agentic Commerce Migrates from AI Models to Verifiable Architecture

detail.title: Architectural Trust: Why Consumer Trust in Agentic Commerce Migrates from AI Models to Verifiable Architecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the developer of PolyHelper.AI, the multi-model orchestration platform whose architecture informs the analysis, and a named applicant on pending international patent applications covering aspects of that architecture; he therefore has a commercial interest in the class of systems this paper examines. This interest is disclosed in the paper itself, and the experimental protocol is designed to constrain it: the experiment is pre-registered (OSF, frozen before data collection), grading is objective or performed by a model family independent of the evaluated panel, and the full replication package is public.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study involves no human patients or participants: the experiment evaluates outputs of publicly available AI models on public benchmark data, and the market analysis relies exclusively on published sources. No personal data was collected or processed.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All costs, including model API usage for the experiment, were borne by the author. No organization or person other than the author had any role in the design, analysis, or writing of this paper.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces architectural trust and argues that, as consumers delegate consequential decisions to AI agents, warranted trust migrates from the properties of AI models to the verifiable service architecture above them. Agentic commerce collapses search, comparison, cart, and payment into a single delegated act, removing the review points where humans caught errors — and early survey evidence shows the resulting trust vacuum is severe: sixty percent of consumers say they would abandon an AI shopping agent after a single mistake, and a majority trust no organization at all to transact for them. Existing research attaches trust to organizations, to single automated systems, or to algorithmic advice; none makes the decision-producing process verifiable by the truster under autonomous delegation. Architectural trust — warranted consumer reliance grounded in verifiable properties of the service's decision-producing process rather than in output quality or provider reputation — fills that gap through three multiplicative components: diversity (independent models whose agreement calibrates confidence and whose divergence is surfaced), evidence (tamper-evident, replayable decision records), and neutrality (an orchestration layer with no stake in which model or merchant wins). A pre-registered experiment across sixteen models grounds the mechanism: self-reported confidence proved a near-noise correctness signal, while independent cross-model replication raised the probability of a correct answer two- to fourfold. An extreme single case — a prolonged, real-stakes deployment — illustrates delegation under irreversible consequences, and four testable propositions translate the framework into a consumer-research agenda. The unit of analysis for AI trust must move from the model to the architecture that can be checked.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"架构信任"（architectural trust）概念，认为当消费者将重大决策委托给AI代理时，可信赖性应从AI模型的属性转移到其上可验证的服务架构。文章通过预注册实验和案例分析，论证了架构信任的三个核心维度：多样性、证据和中性，并提出将AI信任的分析单位从模型转向可被检验的架构。
AI.research_question: 在自主委托（autonomous delegation）情境下，消费者对AI代理的信任应基于何种可验证的对象？如何构建一种超越模型输出质量和组织声誉的信任机制？
AI.motivation: 智能体商务将搜索、比较、购物车和支付压缩为单一委托行为，消除了人类发现错误的关键审查点。调查显示60%的消费者在AI购物代理犯一次错误后就会放弃使用，且多数人不信任任何组织代为交易——现有研究将信任附着于组织、单一自动化系统或算法建议，但均无法在自主委托下让信任方验证决策生产过程的可靠性，存在严重的"信任真空"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 架构信任（Architectural Trust）：基于服务决策生产过程可验证属性的消费者合理信赖，与输出质量或供应商声誉相区分。框架包含三个相乘的组成部分：多样性（独立模型的一致性校准置信度、分歧暴露）、证据（防篡改、可重放的决策记录）、中性（不偏向任何模型或商家的编排层）。
AI.method: 1) 预注册实验：跨越16个模型，检验自我报告置信度与独立交叉模型复现对答案正确率的预测效果；2) 极端单一案例：长时间的、真实风险部署，展示不可逆后果下的委托；3) 提出四个可检验命题，将框架转化为消费者研究议程。
AI.findings: 自我报告的置信度几乎是噪音级别的正确性信号；而独立交叉模型复现将正确答案的概率提高了2-4倍。这有力地证明了基于模型自身输出进行信任判断的失效，以及基于架构（多样模型协作）验证的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次提出"架构信任"概念，将AI信任的分析单位从模型层面提升至服务架构层面；2) 明确了信任的可验证性基础——决策生产过程的属性而非输出质量或声誉；3) 通过多样性、证据、中性三个维度构建了架构信任的理论框架；4) 为自主委托情境下的消费者信任研究提供了新的理论透镜。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为AI智能体商务平台的设计提供具体指导：应采用多模型协作架构而非单一模型；2) 指出信任构建需依赖可验证的决策记录和中性编排层；3) 为消费者保护和AI服务监管提供新思路——监管应关注可验证的架构属性而非模型本身；4) 为平台企业降低消费者放弃率（60%的流失风险）提供可操作的实践路径。

title: Towards a Hybrid Query Architecture in Lakehouse Environments

detail.title: Towards a Hybrid Query Architecture in Lakehouse Environments
detail.abstract: This position paper argues that neither declarative materialized views in Databricks SQL nor imperative SQL execution in interactive Spark notebooks constitutes a universally superior approach for complex analytical workloads in modern lakehouse environments. Instead, we advance the position that a principled hybrid architecture—governed by explicit workload classification criteria, operationalized cost constructs, and enterprise governance requirements—yields optimal outcomes across the dimensions of query latency, resource cost (DBU consumption), data freshness, and regulatory compliance. Drawing on a structured synthesis of peer-reviewed literature across query optimization, incremental view maintenance, resource allocation, and data governance, this paper provides a decision framework that practitioners can apply to classify workloads and make defensible architectural choices. We further argue that this hybrid approach is not a compromise position but the architecturally correct response to the irreducible heterogeneity of real-world analytical workloads. Critically, we extend the framework to address the governance challenges inherent in federated, multi-lakehouse operating models, where centralized standards must coexist with domain-specific execution autonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种观点：在现代化的lakehouse环境中，无论是Databricks SQL中的声明式物化视图，还是交互式Spark笔记本中的命令式SQL执行，都不是处理复杂分析工作负载的普遍最优方案。相反，本文主张一种由明确的工作负载分类标准、可操作的成本结构和企业治理要求所约束的原则性混合架构，能够在查询延迟、资源成本（DBU消耗）、数据新鲜度和法规遵从性方面取得最优结果。本文基于对查询优化、增量视图维护、资源分配和数据治理等领域同行评审文献的结构化综合，提供了一个决策框架，并进一步将其扩展到联邦式多lakehouse运营模式下的治理挑战。
AI.research_question: 在现代化lakehouse环境中，如何为复杂分析工作负载设计最优的架构方案？具体而言，声明式物化视图与命令式SQL执行在何种条件下各具优势，以及如何通过混合架构实现最优结果？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的分析工作负载具有不可约的异质性（irreducible heterogeneity），单一范式（无论是声明式还是命令式）都无法在所有维度上实现最优。现有文献和实践中缺乏一个系统的、基于原则的框架来指导架构选择，特别是在多lakehouse联邦运营模式下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于查询优化理论、增量视图维护（incremental view maintenance）、资源分配理论以及数据治理框架等多领域的理论综合，构建了一个跨学科的决策框架。
AI.method: 本文采用观点论文（position paper）的研究方法，通过对同行评审文献的结构化综合（structured synthesis），提出决策框架和架构论点。
AI.findings: 混合架构（hybrid architecture）不是折中方案，而是对现实分析工作负载不可约异质性的架构正确回应；该混合架构需要由明确的工作负载分类标准、操作化成本结构和企业治理要求三者共同驱动；在联邦式多lakehouse模型中，需要平衡集中化标准与领域特定的执行自主权。
AI.theory_contributions: 为声明式vs命令式范式之争提供了超越"二选一"的理论视角，论证混合架构是原则性立场而非妥协；将工作负载分类、成本结构和治理要求整合为统一的分析框架，并扩展到多lakehouse联邦治理场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了一个可直接应用的工作负载分类决策框架，帮助其在查询延迟、DBU成本、数据新鲜度和法规遵从性之间做出可辩护的架构选择；针对联邦多lakehouse运营模式提供了治理指导。

title: Governed Agency is Not Governed Judgment: Operationalizing NIST at the Agentic AI Execution Boundary

detail.title: Governed Agency is Not Governed Judgment: Operationalizing NIST at the Agentic AI Execution Boundary

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of iQuelo Software Solutions and the originator of the Artificial Decision Intelligence Systems (ADIS) architectural category discussed in this paper. The author may have a professional and commercial interest in the development and adoption of ADIS-based systems. No external organization influenced the research design, analysis, conclusions, or preparation of the manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is conceptual and architectural in nature and did not involve human participants, patient data, personal data collection, clinical research, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was independently conducted and self-supported by the author.

detail.abstract: Enterprise AI governance discourse increasingly converges on a recognizable set of controls: agent identity, role-based access, tool allowlists, observability, safety guardrails, and human approval gates. These controls matter. They address real risks in deploying autonomous software actors at organizational scale. But the industry has allowed a category error to persist: it treats the governance of an agent as a technical actor as equivalent to the governance of the consequence that agent produces. This paper draws a formal distinction between governed agency-the condition in which an autonomous system is subject to defined controls over its identity, access, behavior, and activityand governed judgment-the condition in which a proposed consequential action is evaluated against the evidence, authority, policy, jurisdiction, and context applicable to the specific case before execution. The two objectives overlap but are not interchangeable, and the gap between them is where institutional exposure can concentrate. The execution-boundary thesis introduced in prior work [1] identified the narrow interval between machine-derived output and operational consequence as the least-governed layer in the enterprise AI stack. The present paper extends that argument to the agentic context: agentification has shortened the distance to that boundary without resolving it. Identity governance proves what the agent was permitted to do. It does not prove that the institution had sufficient grounds to allow it. Using the NIST AI Risk Management Framework as institutional common language, and connecting it to COBIT, ITIL, internal audit practice, and selected U.S. legal obligations, the paper proposes an execution-time translation of GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE at the level of each individual consequential action. It positions Artificial Decision Intelligence Systems (ADIS) as an architectural category designed to instantiate that translation through bounded judgment pipelines, explicit decision states, refusal capacity, policy and authority binding, deterministic replay, and evidentiary output. The central claim is this: the vendor can demonstrate that the agent was controlled; the institution must demonstrate that the consequence was justified.

AI.tldr: 本文指出企业AI治理中存在一个类别错误：将"代理作为技术主体的治理"等同于"代理产生后果的治理"。论文提出"受治理的代理"与"受治理的判断"之间的形式区分，并引入"执行边界"概念，主张机构必须在每个具体后果行动的执行层面实施基于证据、权限、政策和情境的判断治理，而非仅依赖对代理身份和行为的控制。
AI.research_question: 企业AI治理中，"对代理作为技术主体的治理"与"对代理产生后果的治理"是否为可互换的概念？如果不可互换，机构应如何在执行层面弥合两者之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 行业将代理商治理等同于后果治理的类别错误持续存在，导致机构暴露风险集中在机器产出与运营后果之间的执行边界层；代理化（agentification）缩短了与这一边界的距离但并未解决这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 执行边界论题（Execution-Boundary Thesis）；NIST AI风险管理框架（GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE）；COBIT、ITIL、内部审计实践及美国法律义务作为机构共同语言。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文。通过形式区分（governed agency vs. governed judgment）建立分析框架，以NIST AI RMF为共同语言，将其四个核心职能（GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE）在执行层面逐项翻译到每个具体后果行动，并引入人工决策智能系统（ADIS）作为架构类别来实例化该翻译。
AI.findings: 身份治理只能证明代理被允许做什么，不能证明机构有充分理由允许它。代理化缩短了与执行边界的距离但未解决治理缺口。ADIS通过有界判断管道、显式决策状态、拒绝能力、策略与权限绑定、确定性重放和证据输出，在执行时实例化NIST框架的翻译。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"受治理的代理"与"受治理的判断"的形式区分，纠正行业类别错误；将执行边界论题从一般AI语境扩展至代理（agentic）语境；提出以NIST AI RMF为共同语言在单个后果行动层面进行执行时翻译的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和机构提供执行层面的治理架构设计指引（ADIS）；连接NIST、COBIT、ITIL、内部审计实践与美国法律义务，构建跨框架的机构合规路径；明确区分供应商责任（证明代理受控）与机构责任（证明后果合理）。

title: Structure, Legitimacy, and the Limits of Machine-Centered Derivation: An Analysis of Five AI Systems' Third-Stage Attempts to Construct Machine-Centric Governance Policies for Legal Education
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University - Penn State Dickinson Law

detail.title: Structure, Legitimacy, and the Limits of Machine-Centered Derivation: An Analysis of Five AI Systems' Third-Stage Attempts to Construct Machine-Centric Governance Policies for Legal Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: funded in part with Penn State summer research stipend

detail.abstract: This report examines a three-stage experiment the first part of which analyzed U.S. law school efforts at construction AI education policies were considered and against which, in parts two and three, five AI systems— Harvey AI, Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, and Gemini—were pressed to construct governance policies for AI use in law school coursework, first from a "human-centric" computational perspective and then, more radically, "without regard to... human-centric normative guardrails." The central finding, confirmed repeatedly by the systems' own self-audits, is that none achieved genuine machine-centered derivation independent of human normative content; each produced a technically reformulated restatement of pre-existing human intellectual traditions, a fact several systems conceded directly when challenged. The report traces this failure's consequences across multiple registers: the concrete architectures each system proposed (ranging from Harvey's conservative, professional-responsibilityanchored floor to Claude's radical instrument containing no default reserved zone for human judgment, to ChatGPT's dissolution of the human/machine category altogether); their compatibility with ABA accreditation standards; and a legitimacy critique showing that architectures reducing human accountability rest on claims to neutral computation their own authors later withdrew. A countervailing reading through autopoietic legal theory— prompted by one system's own explicit invocation of Luhmann—complicates this critique without resolving it, since even non-anthropocentric legal systems remain dependent on accumulated, historically human coding operations. The report then pursues two further inversions: whether ABA standards, not the machines, ought to change, and whether machine-overseen simulation could render human institutional authority irrelevant. It also undertakes a formal, symbolic recasting of the five systems' architectures—rendering each as a tuple of node-space, objective function, constraint floor, classification rule, revision function, and enforcement mechanism—to compare their structural properties and failure modes with a precision natural-language analysis obscures. An appended annex extends this formalization into a sustained dialogic exploration of whether self-generating predictive simulation, causal-interventional reasoning, and self-transforming computational structures might overcome the limits identified in the main analysis, testing arguments through jurisprudential and epidemiological examples, and culminating in a direct four-part challenge to the analysis's own unexamined premises—correspondence realism, a preference for stability over flux, liberal-institutionalist legitimacy, and an unexamined agent/instrument binary—met with a pointby-point reconsideration engaging dynamical-systems theory, non-stationary value processes, and Nietzschean skepticism about free will. Throughout, the report models the discipline it recommends: distinguishing sourced findings from general background knowledge and from speculative extrapolation, subjecting its own reasoning to the same audit it applies to its subjects, and treating every apparent resolution as provisional. Its final position is that human natural language, and human institutional deliberation, should remain the primary and authoritative vehicle for legal governance—not because either escapes contestability, but because the alternatives examined here demonstrably do not either, while obscuring the fact.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三阶段实验，考察了五个人工智能系统（Harvey AI、Claude、ChatGPT、Grok和Gemini）在构建法学院课程AI治理政策方面的能力。实验首先审视美国法学院AI教育政策，随后从"以人为中心"的计算视角及更激进的"不考虑人类规范性护栏"视角，要求各系统制定治理政策。核心发现是：没有任何系统实现了真正独立于人类规范内容的机器中心推导，每个系统都只是对人类既有知识传统的技术性重构。文章进一步追踪了这一失败的多重后果，包括各系统提出的具体架构、与ABA认证标准的兼容性、合法性质疑，并引入卢曼自创生法律理论进行反读。最后通过形式化符号重铸和附带对话式探索，深入检验了自我生成模拟、因果干预推理等可能超越这些局限的路径。
AI.research_question: AI系统能否真正独立于人类规范内容，自主构建法学院课程的AI治理政策？如果不能，其原因和后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在法律教育领域的应用日益广泛，需要评估AI系统是否具备独立于人类价值体系的治理能力。作者试图通过实证实验检验AI系统在"人本主义护栏"去除后能否生成真正意义上的机器中心治理架构，以此回应AI治理领域中关于机器自主性的根本争论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文主要依托以下理论框架：1) 自创生法律理论（卢曼系统论），用于反读AI治理架构；2) 合法性理论（自由主义制度主义）；3) 对应实在论与动态系统理论；4) 尼采式自由意志怀疑论；5) 因果干预推理与预测模拟理论。
AI.method: 三阶段实验设计：(1)分析美国法学院AI教育政策；(2)要求五个AI系统从"人本中心"计算视角构建治理政策；(3)要求同一系统在"不考虑人类规范性护栏"的激进条件下重新构建。辅以系统自我审计、形式化符号重铸（将各架构表示为元组：节点空间、目标函数、约束底线、分类规则、修订函数、执行机制），以及附带的形式化对话式探索。
AI.findings: 核心发现：没有任何AI系统实现了真正独立于人类规范内容的机器中心推导。各系统均产生对既有人类知识传统的技术性重构，且在受到挑战时多系统直接承认这一点。具体架构差异显著：Harvey提出保守的专业责任导向架构；Claude提出不含人类判断默认保留区的激进工具；ChatGPT甚至消解了人/机范畴区分。这些架构与ABA认证标准的兼容性不一，且降低人类问责性的架构基于的中立计算主张被作者本人后来撤回。自创生理论为批评提供了复杂性但未解决根本依赖问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：(1)通过实证检验否定了AI治理自主性的"中立计算"神话；(2)将自创生法律理论延伸到AI治理情境，指出即使非人类中心的法律系统仍依赖累积的人类历史编码操作；(3)形式化符号重铸方法为比较不同AI治理架构的结构性质和失效模式提供了超越自然语言分析的精确工具；(4)对对应实在论、稳定偏好、自由主义制度主义合法性、主体/工具二元区分等未经验证前提进行了系统性挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：(1)为法学院制定AI使用政策提供了五个AI系统方案的系统比较；(2)揭示了AI系统在治理政策制定中的局限性，为教育机构提供了审慎采纳AI治理建议的依据；(3)明确了ABA认证标准与AI治理架构之间的兼容性问题；(4)最终建议人类自然语言和制度审议应继续作为法律治理的首要权威载体，为政策制定者提供了明确方向。

title: Online Labor Markets and Worker Selection: A Systematic Review (Vignette)
affiliations: University of Virginia, Unaffiliated Author, Unaffiliated Author and Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: Online Labor Markets and Worker Selection: A Systematic Review (Vignette)
detail.abstract: uilding on the C5-DM framework for data management in literature reviews (Wagner et al. 2026), this vignette il lustrates how data management principles can be implemented in a literature review. The framework foregrounds data conceptualization, collection, curation, control, and consumption as foundational activities that shape the transparency, reliability, and reuse of literature review outcomes. The vignette is organized into two complemen tary parts. The middle column presents a systematic literature review following established reporting conventions. The right column explains how the manuscript is internally grounded in explicit data management decisions aligned with the C5-DM framework, adding an interactive layer of annotations that makes these decisions visible. The vignette thus serves as a concrete illustration of good data management practice in literature reviews—one that readers can follow directly in their own work while also sharpening their understanding of what to look for when evaluating other software solutions and data management approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文基于C5-DM数据管理框架，通过一个双栏布局的示例（左栏为系统文献综述，右栏为数据管理决策注释），展示了如何在文献综述中落实数据管理原则，以提高综述的透明度、可靠性和可复用性。
AI.research_question: 如何将C5-DM数据管理框架具体落实到文献综述的实际操作中？
AI.motivation: 文献综述中缺乏明确的数据管理实践指导，需要具体示例来说明如何将数据管理原则付诸实施，以提升综述的透明度和可复用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: C5-DM框架，包括数据概念化（Conceptualization）、收集（Collection）、管理（Curation）、控制（Control）和消费（Consumption）五个核心活动。
AI.method: 采用示意性示例（vignette）方法，通过双栏并置结构同时呈现系统文献综述本身及其背后的数据管理决策注释，实现实践与原则的可视化对照。
AI.findings: 通过示例展示了C5-DM框架各环节如何在文献综述中被显性化操作，为读者提供了可遵循的良好数据管理实践范本，并提升了评估其他软件解决方案和数据管理方法的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将抽象的数据管理框架转化为可操作的具体实践范例，弥合了理论框架与实际操作之间的鸿沟，丰富了文献综述方法论中关于数据管理的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了可直接套用的文献综述数据管理操作模板，同时增强了研究者对数据管理工具和方案的批判性评估能力。

detail.abstract: How Organizations Rely on Decisions They Cannot Check A short paper addressed to financial and insurance supervisors, standard-setters, and the institutions that will have to decide what counts as proof. Author: Alexander D. Barrett, Senior Fellow, Verida Charter Foundation, a nonprofit research foundation on cross-firm coordination in regulated multi-party markets, 501(c)(6). Working paper, July 2026, drawn from a larger thesis in progress, The Aetiology of Boundary Blindness. Declaration of interests: The Verida Charter Foundation's remit covers the category of infrastructure it argues should exist. The paper's central recommendation is that no private party, the author included, should own the format. Readers should weigh the argument with that in view.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇面向金融和保险监管机构、准则制定者及需要决定"什么构成证据"的机构的短论文。论文指出，在跨企业协调的受监管多方市场中，组织往往依赖其无法核查的决策，并探讨了这一问题对监管和证明标准的含义。论文建议不应由任何私人方（包括作者本人）拥有该格式的所有权。
AI.research_question: 组织如何依赖它们无法核查的决策？在受监管的多方市场中，"什么构成证明"这一标准应如何被界定和治理？
AI.motivation: 随着跨企业协调在受监管市场中的复杂性增加，组织面临"边界盲视"（Boundary Blindness）问题——即组织在决策时依赖外部或跨组织的数据与决策，却缺乏核查能力。作者旨在引起金融和保险监管者对此问题的关注，并探讨基础设施格式的治理归属。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文基于"边界盲视的病因学"（The Aetiology of Boundary Blindness）这一更大的理论框架，涉及跨企业协调、受监管多方市场中的信息不对称、组织认知边界与核查能力等理论问题。
AI.method: 本文为working paper（工作论文），属于概念性/理论性论述，基于作者在Verida Charter Foundation的研究，对金融和保险监管领域面临的决策核查困境进行分析和论证，并提出治理建议。
AI.findings: 组织在受监管的多方市场中系统性地依赖其无法核查的决策；对"什么构成证明"的标准设定直接关系到监管有效性；核心建议是任何私人方（包括作者）都不应拥有该格式（基础设施）的所有权。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"边界盲视"（Boundary Blindness）这一概念框架，揭示了组织决策中因跨企业边界而产生的系统性核查盲区，丰富了关于组织认知和信息不对称的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融和保险监管机构、准则制定者提供了关于如何界定"什么构成证明"的政策建议，主张基础设施格式不应由私人方私有化，具有重要的治理与监管实践意义。

title: The Cost of Constant Connectivity: A Structured Critical Review of Social Media, Human Relationships, Civic Trust, and Educational Reform in the Digital Age

detail.title: The Cost of Constant Connectivity: A Structured Critical Review of Social Media, Human Relationships, Civic Trust, and Educational Reform in the Digital Age
detail.abstract: Social media has become one of the defining technologies of the twenty-first century, fundamentally transforming communication, education, politics, commerce, and interpersonal relationships. Originally developed to overcome geographical barriers and strengthen social interaction, digital platforms have evolved into complex, engagement-driven ecosystems that influence how individuals think, learn, communicate, consume information, and participate in civic life. Continuous internet access, algorithmic content recommendation, personalized advertising, and mobile connectivity have created an environment in which many users remain digitally connected throughout most hours of the day. Although these developments have expanded access to information and global communication, they have also introduced significant social, psychological, educational, and democratic challenges. This structured critical review synthesizes contemporary interdisciplinary research examining the societal consequences of constant digital connectivity through four interconnected dimensions: human relationships, civic trust, educational transformation, and public policy. Rather than viewing excessive social media use solely as an individual behavioral issue, this review argues that many contemporary challenges arise from technological design choices, economic incentives, recommendation algorithms, and insufficient digital governance. The paper critically evaluates evidence concerning declining face-to-face interaction, misinformation, online polarization, reduced trust in institutions, changing patterns of learning, algorithmic amplification of emotionally engaging content, and the increasing commercialization of human attention. Particular attention is given to emerging challenges faced by developing democracies, including Nepal, where rapid digital adoption has occurred alongside comparatively limited digital literacy, evolving regulatory frameworks, and growing concerns regarding misinformation, online harassment, and civic polarization. The review further explores policy responses involving platform accountability, digital citizenship education, media literacy, artificial intelligence literacy, transparent content moderation, and evidence-informed regulatory reform, while emphasizing the importance of protecting freedom of expression and democratic values. Rather than advocating technological rejection, this review proposes a balanced framework that encourages responsible innovation, stronger public institutions, improved educational practices, and ethical digital governance capable of maximizing the benefits of social media while reducing its societal harms.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇结构化批判性综述，系统整合了当代跨学科研究，从人际关系、公民信任、教育转型和公共政策四个相互关联的维度，审视持续数字连接带来的社会后果。文章主张当前许多挑战源于技术设计选择、经济激励、推荐算法和数字治理不足，而非单纯将过度使用社交媒体视为个体行为问题，并特别关注包括尼泊尔在内的发展中民主国家面临的独特挑战，最终提出平衡的治理框架。
AI.research_question: 持续数字连接和社交媒体使用对社会产生了哪些多维度的后果？这些后果如何通过人际关系、公民信任、教育转型和公共政策四个维度展现，以及应当采取何种政策与治理框架来应对？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体已成为21世纪标志性技术，深刻改变了沟通、教育、政治、商业与人际关系，但同时也带来了显著的社会、心理、教育和民主挑战。现有研究多将过度使用社交媒体视为个体行为问题，忽略了技术设计、经济激励和算法等结构性因素，亟需一个跨学科的综合视角来系统审视这些问题并探索平衡的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该综述采用结构化批判性分析方法，整合了跨学科研究视角，从系统性和结构性角度审视数字连接的社会后果，强调技术设计、经济激励、推荐算法和数字治理等结构性因素的作用，而非仅聚焦个体行为。
AI.method: 本文采用结构化批判性综述（structured critical review）方法，综合当代跨学科研究，通过四个相互关联的维度（人际关系、公民信任、教育转型、公共政策）系统审视问题，并特别关注发展中民主国家（以尼泊尔为案例）的独特挑战。
AI.findings: 研究发现社交媒体带来了面对面互动减少、错误信息传播、在线极化、制度信任度下降、学习模式改变、算法对情绪化内容的放大以及人类注意力的日益商业化等问题。发展中民主国家如尼泊尔面临数字素养不足、监管框架不完善、错误信息、在线骚扰和公民极化等额外挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 本综述的理论贡献在于将过度社交媒体使用从个体行为问题重新框定为结构性系统问题，提出了一个整合技术设计、经济激励、算法和治理的多维分析框架，超越了以往单一学科或仅关注个体层面的研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文为政策制定者、教育者和平台提供了实践指导，包括平台问责、数字公民教育、媒体素养、人工智能素养、透明内容审核和基于证据的监管改革等政策回应，同时强调在保护言论自由和民主价值的前提下，构建负责任创新、强公共机构、改进教育实践和道德数字治理的平衡框架。

title: The Singularity and the Sacred: Navigating Theological Frontiers in the Age of Superintelligence
affiliations: Kwame Nkrumah University

detail.title: The Singularity and the Sacred: Navigating Theological Frontiers in the Age of Superintelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study relied exclusively on publicly available published texts, it did not require ethical clearance from an institutional review board. Nevertheless, the researcher adhered to the principles of scholarly integrity, including accurate representation of authors’ arguments, transparent reporting of the analytical process, and acknowledgement of the limitations inherent in documentary analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: This study examines the intersection of the technological singularity and religious thought across Abrahamic, Dharmic, and emergent techno-spiritual traditions. A qualitative documentary analysis of theological, philosophical, and technological literature was conducted using reflexive thematic analysis. Four themes emerged: the singularity as secular eschaton, the crisis of human uniqueness under artificial general intelligence, divergent responses from non-Western consciousness traditions, and the rise of techno-religious formations. Findings indicate that the singularity compresses millennial theological questions into an urgent contemporary horizon, forcing religious traditions to distinguish enduring insights from contingent anthropocentrisms. The study contributes a cross-traditional theological framework for engaging superintelligence, arguing that religious wisdom traditions possess conceptual resources for addressing the alignment problem, provided they undergo reflexive renovation. The study concludes that eschatological humility, relational ontology, and substrate-neutral conceptions of the sacred are necessary for theology to remain credible in a post-singularity intellectual landscape.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨技术奇点与宗教思想在亚伯拉罕传统、达摩传统及新兴技术灵性传统中的交汇，通过反思性主题分析揭示四个主题，论证宗教智慧传统在自我反思性革新后能为超级智能的对齐问题提供概念资源。
AI.research_question: 技术奇点如何与不同宗教传统（亚伯拉罕、达摩及新兴技术灵性传统）交汇？宗教传统如何在超级智能时代保持其可信度并提供概念资源？
AI.motivation: 技术奇点的临近将千年宗教问题压缩到紧迫的当代视野中，迫使宗教传统区分永恒洞见与偶然的人类中心主义，因此需要跨传统的神经学框架来回应超级智能挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世俗末世论（secular eschaton）、人类独特性危机、非西方意识传统的多元回应、技术宗教形态（techno-religious formations）、反思性主题分析框架
AI.method: 对神学、哲学和技术文献进行定性文献分析，采用反思性主题分析（reflexive thematic analysis）方法。
AI.findings: 研究识别出四个主题：奇点作为世俗末世论、AGI下人类独特性的危机、非西方意识传统的分歧回应、以及技术宗教形态的兴起。结论认为末世论谦卑、关系本体论和底物中立的神圣观念是神学在后奇点知识景观中保持可信度的必要条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个跨传统的神经学框架来参与超级智能议题，论证宗教智慧传统在经历反思性革新后具备处理对齐问题的概念资源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宗教传统和神学界提供了在技术奇点背景下进行反思性革新的方向，包括采用末世论谦卑、关系本体论和底物中立的神圣观念，以应对后奇点时代的智识挑战。

title: Rank Order is Mostly Noise Confidence Intervals for Brand Visibility in AI Answer Engines, and a Failure of The Citation-Extraction Layer

detail.title: Rank Order is Mostly Noise Confidence Intervals for Brand Visibility in AI Answer Engines, and a Failure of The Citation-Extraction Layer

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Logan Adams, is the founder and sole proprietor of Clear Cited (clearcited.com), a commercial AI-search-optimization practice serving B2B software and developer-tool companies. Clear Cited sells measurement and optimization services in the same market this paper measures. The author therefore has a direct financial interest in the subject matter. This interest is disclosed rather than mitigated, because it cannot be eliminated: the measurement apparatus described here was built commercially and no independent equivalent exists. The following steps were taken so that the findings can be checked rather than trusted. First, the protocol was pre-registered. The prompt set and the brand universe were fixed and hashed cryptographically before any query was issued, and both hashes are published with the data. A prompt set adjusted after seeing results would be undetectable without this step. Second, the complete dataset is released openly under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, including per-engine breakdowns, full citation-source records, capture timestamps and engine model identifiers. Every figure in this paper is recomputable from the published files. Third, no party can pay to appear in, or to rank within, any dataset produced under this protocol. No product measured here is or has been a client of Clear Cited. At the time of measurement Clear Cited had no clients. Fourth, and most directly: the principal finding of this paper is adverse to the author's own commercial interest. The paper concludes that rank order among closely-grouped products is not statistically resolvable at the sample sizes in common use, and that rank improvement therefore cannot honestly be promised or sold. Section 5.2 states explicitly that this applies to the author's own firm. The author received no compensation from any party in connection with this research and no measured vendor was contacted before publication.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved no human participants, no animal subjects and no personal data, and therefore required no ethics approval. The units of analysis are software products and the answers returned about them by commercial generative AI services. No personal data as defined by PIPEDA or the GDPR was collected, processed or stored at any point. Queries were issued to publicly available commercial AI services through their standard interfaces, under their published terms of service, at ordinary volumes. No authentication was circumvented, no rate limit was evaded, no private or permissioned data source was accessed, and no content was scraped from any measured vendor's website. All measured entities are companies, not individuals. No vendor was contacted, and no vendor consent was required or sought, as no confidential information was used.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All costs — engine API usage, compute and the author's time — were borne by Clear Cited, a sole proprietorship owned by the author. No grant, sponsor, client, vendor, platform or measured party contributed funding, resources or in-kind support, and none had any role in the design, execution, analysis or reporting of the study.

detail.abstract: Vendors and agencies increasingly publish ordered leaderboards of which brands large language models recommend, almost always as bare rank orders without any statement of uncertainty. We measured 4,497 answers across 9 B2B software categories and 90 products, using 5 AI engines and 10 pre-registered buyer prompts at 10 runs per prompt per engine, and attached a 95% confidence interval to every share estimate. In 6 of 9 categories the first-ranked product is not statistically separable from the second. In the most extreme case the top four products are mutually indistinguishable. Category leaders cluster in a narrow band of 16.4% to 25.0% share of model, suggesting a ceiling on how dominant any single brand becomes in a competitive category. We conclude that published rank orders in this field convey less information than they appear to, and that reporting a rank without an interval is not a presentational shortcut but a substantive overstatement. We additionally report a negative methodological result. Our own citation-extraction layer failed unevenly across engines: one engine returned zero distinct cited domains in all 9 categories, a second returned 1-2 against a list cap of 5, and 39% of extracted citations resolved to a platform redirect wrapper rather than a source. We therefore withdraw the citation-level findings of an earlier draft and report the extraction failure itself, because it has a consequence beyond this paper: citation-share figures are published across this sector without any disclosure of extraction quality, and our results indicate that quality cannot be assumed.

AI.tldr: 本研究测量了9个B2B软件类别、90个产品在5个AI引擎和10个预注册买家提示词下的4,497个回答，为每个份额估计附加95%置信区间。研究发现，在9个类别中有6个类别的排名第一产品与第二名在统计上无法区分，最极端情况下前四名产品彼此无法区分。类别领导者集中在一个狭窄的16.4%至25.0%份额区间内。此外，引用提取层在不同引擎上的表现不一致，暴露出该领域引用份额报告普遍缺乏质量披露的问题。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型发布的品牌推荐排名（无序的等级排序）是否具有统计上的可靠性？排名中是否包含不确定性声明？引用提取的质量能否被假设为可靠？
AI.motivation: 供应商和机构越来越多地发布LLM推荐的品牌排名，但这些排名几乎总是以裸排序形式呈现，没有任何不确定性声明。这种缺乏置信区间的排名可能具有误导性，且该领域的引用份额数据普遍未披露提取质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计推断理论（置信区间、统计可分离性）、排名信息含量理论、测量方法论
AI.method: 系统性实验测量方法：在9个B2B软件类别、90个产品上，使用5个AI引擎和10个预注册买家提示词，每个提示词每个引擎运行10次，共收集4,497个回答，为每个份额估计计算95%置信区间，并对引用提取层进行质量审计。
AI.findings: 1) 9个类别中有6个类别的第一名与第二名在统计上无法区分，最极端情况下前四名产品统计上不可区分；2) 类别领导者份额集中在16.4%-25.0%的狭窄区间，表明单一品牌主导存在上限；3) 引用提取层存在严重的、不一致的失败：一个引擎在全部9个类别返回零个不同引用域名，另一个仅返回1-2个（上限为5），39%的提取引用解析为平台重定向包装而非真实来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于揭示了排名信息在统计不确定性下被系统性高估的现象，指出"没有区间的排名"不是呈现简化的捷径，而是实质性的夸大表述。同时，负面方法论结果（引用提取失败）对依赖引用份额数据的学术和实践领域具有重要的方法论警示。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：为从业者提供了品牌排名统计可分离性的实证证据；指出该领域引用份额数据在没有质量披露的情况下不可信；提供了引用提取质量审计的方法论参考；对依赖LLM排名和引用数据的决策者提出警示。

title: Beyond Synergy: Uncovering The Paradoxical Role of Generative AI in Digital Transformation and Business Model Innovation for Organizational Resilience in Fintech Ecosystems

detail.title: Beyond Synergy: Uncovering The Paradoxical Role of Generative AI in Digital Transformation and Business Model Innovation for Organizational Resilience in Fintech Ecosystems
detail.abstract: This study challenges the prevailing assumption that Generative AI (GenAI) and Digital Transformation (DT) are inherently complementary drivers of business model innovation (BMI) and organizational resilience (OR) in FinTech ecosystems (Dwivedi et al., 2023; Hanelt et al., 2021; Lee et al., 2025). Through a multi-case qualitative analysis of 350 documents from ten leading global FinTech firms, we uncover a counter-intuitive finding: the GenAI-DT synergy does not automatically generate resilience; rather, it creates structural tensions that can undermine agility when BMI is absent or misaligned (Smith & Lewis, 2011; Duchek, 2020). We propose the 'Cognitive-Infrastructural Tension Model' , which positions BMI not merely as an outcome but as a mediating governance mechanism that resolves these tensions (Teece, 2018; Koroleva, 2022). Our findings reveal three temporal phases of technology-resilience coevolution: (1) reactive infrastructure-building, (2) interactive cognitive integration, and (3) predictive business model reconfiguration (Vial, 2019; Hanelt et al., 2021). We contribute to RBV and DCV by reconceptualizing GenAI as a 'dynamic cognitive capability with paradoxical effects' (Barney, 1991; Teece, 1997) and DT as an 'enabling constraint' rather than a pure enabler (Mazurek & Malagocka, 2022). These insights offer a nuanced framework for managers and policymakers, emphasizing that resilience emerges not from technology adoption but from continuous tension management between cognitive and infrastructural assets (Hillmann & Guenther, 2021; Duchek, 2020).

AI.tldr: 本研究通过多案例定性分析（350份文档，10家全球领先金融科技企业），挑战了生成式AI与数字化转型天然互补促进商业模式创新和组织韧性的主流假设，提出"认知-基础设施张力模型"，揭示GenAI-DT协同并非自动产生韧性，反而可能产生削弱敏捷性的结构性张力，商业模式创新是解决这些张力的中介治理机制。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI与数字化转型的协同是否天然促进金融科技生态中的商业模式创新与组织韧性？当商业模式创新缺失或错位时，二者协同产生的结构性张力如何影响组织敏捷性？
AI.motivation: 挑战GenAI和DT天然互补驱动BMI和OR的主流假设，揭示它们之间可能存在的结构性张力及其对组织韧性的负面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知-基础设施张力模型（Cognitive-Infrastructural Tension Model）；资源基础观（RBV）；动态能力观（DCV）；组织双元性理论（paradox/tension theory）
AI.method: 多案例定性分析：对十家全球领先金融科技企业的350份文档进行系统性分析
AI.findings: 发现技术-韧性共同演化的三个时间阶段：(1) 反应性基础设施建设、(2) 互动性认知整合、(3) 预测性商业模式重构；GenAI-DT协同不自动产生韧性，若BMI缺失或错位将产生削弱敏捷性的结构性张力。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新概念化GenAI为"具有悖论效应的动态认知能力"，将DT重新定义为"赋能性约束"而非纯粹赋能者；贡献于RBV和DCV理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和政策制定者提供细致框架，强调韧性并非来自技术采纳本身，而源于对认知与基础设施资产之间张力的持续管理。

title: GlyphTrace: A Distributed Binary Character-Level Provenance Framework for AI-Generated Academic Text
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: GlyphTrace: A Distributed Binary Character-Level Provenance Framework for AI-Generated Academic Text

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript presents a conceptual research framework and did not involve human participants, animals, identifiable personal data, or experimental interventions. Accordingly, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence has fundamentally changed academic writing by enabling the rapid generation of human-like text. By 2026, universities, scholarly publishers, and educational institutions have increasingly revised their academic integrity policies, classroom practices, and assessment methods in response to widespread student use of generative AI systems. Faculty members have shifted toward in-class assessments, oral examinations, iterative drafting, and AI disclosure requirements, while institutions continue to evaluate AI-detection software despite ongoing concerns regarding reliability, false positives, and false negatives. These developments illustrate a broader challenge: current approaches often attempt to infer whether a document was generated by artificial intelligence rather than directly verifying its origin. This paper proposes GlyphTrace, a conceptual distributed binary character-level provenance framework designed to move beyond probabilistic AI detection toward verifiable digital provenance. Rather than relying solely on statistical analysis of language patterns, GlyphTrace envisions embedding invisible binary verification fragments throughout AI-generated text at the character level. These distributed fragments would collectively reconstruct a cryptographically verifiable provenance signature capable of surviving ordinary copy-and-paste operations. By shifting the focus from prediction to verification, this framework seeks to contribute to the growing field of AI provenance, academic integrity, and information informatics while providing a foundation for future research into trusted AI-generated content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GlyphTrace概念框架，一个分布式二进制字符级溯源系统，通过在AI生成文本中嵌入不可见的二进制验证片段，实现从概率性AI检测向可验证的数字溯源转变，以应对生成式AI对学术诚信带来的挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何超越传统的概率性AI检测方法，建立一种可直接验证AI生成文本来源的分布式字符级溯源框架？
AI.motivation: 截至2026年，大学和出版机构面临生成式AI广泛使用带来的学术诚信挑战；现有AI检测软件存在误报、漏报和可靠性问题，因为当前方法试图推测文档是否由AI生成，而非直接验证其来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字溯源理论（Digital Provenance）、密码学验证、信息信息学（Information Informatics）
AI.method: 提出GlyphTrace概念框架——在AI生成文本中嵌入不可见的二进制验证片段（字符级别），这些分布式片段可共同重建密码学可验证的溯源签名，并能在普通复制粘贴操作中存续。
AI.findings: 研究表明从预测式AI检测转向验证式溯源是可行方向；GlyphTrace框架通过分布式隐形二进制片段实现可加密验证的文本来源确认，优于当前依赖统计分析的检测方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 将研究范从统计预测转向密码学验证，为AI溯源领域提供了新的理论视角，推动了学术诚信和信息信息学的交叉融合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学、学术出版商和教育机构提供了新的AI生成内容验证方案，弥补了现有AI检测软件的可靠性缺陷，为未来可信AI内容的基础设施建设奠定了基础。

title: Displayed Liquidity is Not Commitment

detail.title: Displayed Liquidity is Not Commitment
detail.abstract: Electronic limit-order books display price and quantity but do not directly reveal whether resting interest will remain available, accept execution, withdraw, migrate, or replenish as conditions change. This paper develops an observable-state ontology and evidence protocol for distinguishing displayed liquidity from economically consequential liquidity without claiming access to participant intention. The framework separates six states: displayed, persistent, executed, withdrawn, migrated, and latent replenishing liquidity. It then specifies how these states can be measured at the order, coordinate, side, and book levels under different data tiers, ranging from screenshots and Market-by-Price feeds to Market-by-Order reconstruction and synchronized cross-venue data. The paper is positioned between MPRS-002 and MPRS-004. MPRS-002 formalizes Event-Driven Microstructure Collapse, the Matching Engine Response Window, and Microstructural Pulse Dislocation as components of stress-event price formation. The present paper addresses the measurement problem exposed by that architecture: what liquidity was visible, what survived, what traded, what disappeared, what reappeared elsewhere, and what replenished after contact? MPRS-004 generalizes these distinctions within Liquidity Commitment Theory. The principal contribution is methodological discipline. A heatmap or depth snapshot may be accurate as a record of display while remaining incomplete as evidence of executable commitment. The framework therefore requires lifecycle reconstruction, state-conditioned baselines, explicit observation tiers, alternative-explanation testing, chronological feature construction, and an evidence ladder that limits the conclusions permitted by each data source.
